name: Obelisk the Tormentor
cn_text:
這張卡通常召喚的場合，必須把3只解放作召喚。
①：這張卡的召喚不會被無效化。
②：在這張卡的召喚成功時雙方不能把卡的效果發動。
③：雙方不能把場上的這張卡作為效果的對象。
④：把自己場上2只怪獸解放才能發動（這個效果發動的回合，這張卡不能攻擊宣言）。對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
⑤：這張卡特殊召喚的場合，結束階段發動。這張卡送去墓地。
description: Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Cannot be targeted by Spells, Traps, or card effects. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the Graveyard. You can Tribute 2 monsters; destroy all monsters your opponent controls. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。這張卡通常召喚的場合，必須把3只解放作召喚。
①：這張卡的召喚不會被無效化。
②：在這張卡的召喚成功時雙方不能把其他卡的效果發動。
③：這張卡召喚時，把基本分支付到變成100基本分才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升支付的數值。
④：支付1000基本分，以場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, other cards and effects cannot be activated. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can pay LP so that you only have 100 left; this card gains ATK and DEF equal to the amount of LP paid. You can pay 1000 LP, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
cn_text:
這張卡通常召喚的場合，必須把3只解放作召喚。
①：這張卡的召喚不會被無效化。
②：在這張卡的召喚成功時雙方不能把卡的效果發動。
③：這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升自己手卡數量×1000。
④：每次對方場上有怪獸攻擊表示召喚·特殊召喚發動。那些怪獸的攻擊力下降2000。變成0的場合那怪獸破壞。
⑤：這張卡特殊召喚的場合，結束階段發動。這張卡送去墓地。
description: Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the Graveyard. This card gains 1000 ATK and DEF for each card in your hand. If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your opponent's field in face-up Attack Position: That monster(s) loses 2000 ATK, then if its ATK has been reduced to 0 as a result, destroy it.

name: Banner of Courage
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，自己場上的怪獸的攻擊力在自己戰斗階段內上升200。
description: All monsters you control gain 200 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

name: Weapon Change
cn_text: 此效果只能在自己每回合的准備階段支付700基本分發動1次。使自己場上1只戰士族·機械族怪獸的攻擊力與守備力互換直到對方的下一個結束階段終了時為止。當這張卡被破壞時，此效果無效化。
description: Once during each of your Standby Phases: You can pay 700 Life Points, then target 1 Warrior or Machine-Type monster you control; switch the current ATK and DEF of that target until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Protector of the Throne
cn_text: 國王離開時，保衛王座不受外敵攻擊的王妃。守備力高。
description: While the king is away, this queen protects his throne with a mighty defense.

name: Jurassic World
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的恐龍族怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: All Dinosaur-Type monsters gain 300 ATK and DEF.

name: Masked Sorcerer
cn_text: 這張卡造成對方玩家基本分傷害的時候，自己抽1張卡。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, draw 1 card from your Deck.

name: Skull Red Bird
cn_text: 在羽毛里藏?小刀，從空中降下發起攻擊。
description: This monster swoops down and attacks with a rain of knives stored in its wings.

name: Decayed Commander
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，可以從手卡特殊召喚1只「僵尸虎」。這張卡對對方直接攻擊成功時，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, you can Special Summon 1 "Zombie Tiger" from your hand. If this card successfully attacks your opponent's Life Points directly, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

name: Goe Goe the Gallant Ninja
cn_name: 忍者義賊 五衛五衛
cn_text: 對方手卡是5張以上的場合，這張卡給與對方基本分戰斗傷害時，對方手卡隨機丟棄2張。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Your opponent must discard 2 random cards. Your opponent must have at least 5 cards in their hand for you to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Lava Golem
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把對方場上2只怪獸解放的場合可以在對方場上特殊召喚。把這張卡特殊召喚的回合，自己不能通常召喚。
①：自己准備階段發動。自己受到1000傷害。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's side of the field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. During each of your Standby Phases: Take 1000 damage.

name: Cyber Blader
cn_text:
「電子化明星」＋「利刃滑冰者」
這張卡的融合召喚不用上記的卡不能進行。
①：對方場上的怪獸數量讓這張卡得到以下效果。
●1只：這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。
●2只：這張卡的攻擊力變成2倍。
●3只：對方發動的魔法·陷阱·怪獸的效果無效化。
description: "Etoile Cyber" + "Blade Skater"A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While your opponent controls only 1 monster, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. While your opponent controls only 2 monsters, double this card's ATK. While your opponent controls only 3 monsters, negate the effects of your opponent's Spell, Trap, and Effect Monsters.

name: The Statue of Easter Island
cn_text: 存在於復活島的石像，能夠發射圓形的激光。
description: A stone monument from Easter Island that launches laser blasts from its rock-hewn lips.

name: Yaiba Robo
cn_text: 方形的身體內部隱藏?無數刀刃、能切碎一切的機械。
description: A cubical machine equipped with cutting blades for shredding an opponent to mincemeat.

name: Scroll of Bewitchment
cn_text: 裝備的1只怪獸的屬性，變成自己選擇的屬性。
description: Select 1 Attribute. Change the Attribute of the equipped monster to the one you select.

name: Command Knight
cn_text:
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，自己場上的戰士族怪獸的攻擊力上升400。
②：只要自己場上有其他怪獸存在，對方不能選擇這張卡作為攻擊對象。
description: All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 400 ATK. If you control another monster, monsters your opponent controls cannot target this card for an attack.

name: T.A.D.P.O.L.E.
cn_text: 自己場上存在的這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以從自己卡組把「惡魂邪苦止」加入手卡。之后卡組洗切。
description: When this card you control is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can add any "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) from your Deck to your hand.

name: Barrel Rock
cn_text: 一邊用雙肩的機關槍發射，一邊用身體亂撞進行攻擊。
description: Shouldering a pair of machine guns, this monster is unstoppable.

name: Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上存在的1只「海龍-泰達路斯」解放的場合才能特殊召喚。可以通過把自己場上存在的「海」送去墓地，這張卡以外的雙方的手卡·場上的卡全部送去墓地。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Levia-Dragon - Daedalus". You can send "Umi" you control to the Graveyard to send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, except this card.

name: Leogun
cn_text: 渾身百獸之王般漂亮的鬃毛，身體也很龐大。
description: Huge monster with a lion's mane similar to the King of Beasts.

name: Zarigun
cn_text: 由蝦進化成的怪獸。用大鉗子攻擊對方的頸項。
description: A lethal crawfish with extremely dangerous claws.

name: Ancient Rules
cn_text: 從手卡把1只5星以上的通常怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your hand.

name: Guardian Ceal
cn_text: 當自己場上存在「流星之弓-燁焰」時才能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。將1張這張卡身上裝備的自己的裝備卡送去墓地，破壞對方場上1只怪獸。
description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Shooting Star Bow - Ceal". You can send 1 Equip Spell Card you control that is equipped to this card to the Graveyard to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Great Phantom Thief
cn_text: 每當這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害時，宣言1張卡的名字。檢視對方手卡，若其中有被宣言名字的卡，則將其全部扔進墓地。
description: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, declare the name of 1 card. Then see your opponent's hand and discard all copies of the declared card in his/her hand to the Graveyard.

name: Pyro Clock of Destiny
cn_text: 1張卡的回合計算前進1回合。
description: Move the turn count forward by 1 turn. The turn in which this card is activated continues as normal.

name: Holograh
cn_text: 使人看見各種幻想、趁機進行攻擊的機器。
description: This machine generates illusions that leave an enemy wide open to attacks.

name: Barrier Statue of the Torrent
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，雙方不能把水屬性以外的怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except WATER monsters.

name: Gradius
cn_name: 超時空戰斗機 Viper毒蛇
cn_text: 擁有后備倉庫，能發揮各種能力的高性能戰斗機。
description: A high-performance jet fighter with power capsules for variable attack capabilities.

name: Luster Dragon
cn_text: 全身被藍寶石覆蓋，樣子非常美麗的龍。雖然并不喜歡斗爭，卻具備很高攻擊力。
description: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

name: Lancer Dragonute
cn_text: ①：這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，不會受到魔法效果的影響。這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的回合的結束階段時，可以把這張卡送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「荷魯斯之黑炎龍 LV8」。
description: This card is unaffected by Spell effects. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck.

name: Emperor of the Land and Sea
cn_text: 可以用大嘴向四方噴火的爬蟲怪。
description: A reptilian monster that sprays fire in every direction.

name: Dark Blade
cn_name: 暗魔界的戰士 暗黑之劍
cn_text: 據說會操縱龍的暗魔界的戰士。邪惡之力所使出的揮斬攻擊威力驚人。
description: They say he is a dragon-manipulating warrior from the dark world. His attack is tremendous, using his great swords with vicious power.

name: Electric Snake
cn_text: 這張卡被對方的卡的效果從手卡丟棄去墓地時，從自己卡組抽2張卡。
description: When this card is discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by an effect of a card controlled by your opponent, draw 2 cards from your Deck.

name: Cannon Soldier
cn_text: 可以把自己場上存在的1只怪獸解放，給與對方基本分500分傷害。
description: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Grave Protector
cn_text: 當這張卡在場上以表側表示存在時，被戰斗破壞的怪獸不再被送去墓地，直接回到持有者卡組。
description: Any monster destroyed by battle is shuffled into the Deck instead of going to the Graveyard.

name: Etoile Cyber
cn_text: ①：這張卡直接攻擊的傷害步驟內，攻擊力上升500。
description: If this card attacks your opponent directly, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: Deck Lockdown
cn_text:
這張卡發動后，第2次的自己准備階段破壞。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，雙方不能用抽卡以外的方法從卡組把卡加入手卡，也不能從卡組把怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Neither player can add cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them. Monsters cannot be Special Summoned from the Main Deck. Destroy this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.

name: Gamma The Magnet Warrior
cn_text: 用α、β、γ來變形合體。
description: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

name: Gellenduo
cn_text:
①：天使族·光屬性怪獸上級召喚的場合，這張卡可以作為2只的數量解放。
②：這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。
③：自己因戰斗·效果受到傷害的場合發動。場上的表側表示的這張卡破壞。
description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. When this card's controller takes any damage, destroy this face-up card. This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT Fairy-Type monster.

name: 30,000-Year White Turtle
cn_text: 生活了三萬年的巨大烏龜。守備力高。
description: A huge turtle that has existed for more than 30,000 years.

name: Union Rider
cn_text: 得到對方場上1張處於怪獸狀態的同盟怪獸的控制權，裝備在這張卡身上。這張卡至多只能以這種方式裝備1只同盟怪獸。裝備在這張卡身上的同盟怪獸不能以自身效果回復成怪獸狀態。
description: You can take control of up to 1 Union Monster that is currently a monster on your opponent's side of the field, and equip it to this card. The Union Monster that is equipped to this card cannot be changed back to a monster using its own effect.

name: Sasuke Samurai #2
cn_text: 支付800基本分。到本回合結束階段為止，所有的魔法·陷阱卡都不能發動。
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can pay 800 Life Points. If you do this, until the End Phase, Spell and Trap Cards cannot be activated.

name: Beast of Talwar
cn_text: 其雙刀。即使是惡魔也只能由被允許的劍朮高手所持有。
description: Only the master of the sword among the Fiend-Type monsters is permitted to hold the Talwar.(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

name: Gorgon Egg
cn_text: 蛇發女所產下的巨卵。其他一切資料不詳。
description: The gorgon egg's massive eyes are said to reflect the fate of its enemies.

name: Great Angus
cn_text: 非常凶暴的怪獸。據說從來沒人看見過其溫順一面的姿態。
description: A very violent beast, it is always berserk. People say that they have never seen it silent.

name: Kojikocy
cn_text: 獵殺人類的獵手，具有連岩石都能擊碎的力量。
description: A man-hunter with powerful arms that can crush boulders.

name: Goblin's Secret Remedy
cn_text: ①：自己回復600基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 600 points.

name: B. Skull Dragon
cn_text: 「惡魔召喚」＋「真紅眼黑龍」
description: "Summoned Skull" + "Red-Eyes B. Dragon"(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

name: Hunting Instinct
cn_text: 對方場上有怪獸特殊召喚時才能發動。從手卡特殊召喚1只恐龍族怪獸。
description: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field: Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your hand.

name: Different Dimension Capsule
cn_text: 從自己卡組選擇1張卡，里側表示從游戲中除外。發動后第2次的自己的准備階段這張卡破壞，那張卡加入手卡。
description: Select 1 card from your Deck and remove it from play face-down. During your 2nd Standby Phase after activation, destroy this card and add the removed card to your hand.

name: Nin-Ken Dog
cn_text: 忍朮攀登到頂峰的狗忍者。通過嚴格的修行，變得可以使用擬人化的忍朮。
description: A Ninja dog who has mastered extreme Ninjutsu. Through hard training, it learned the technique to metamorphose into a human being.

name: Goblin Calligrapher
cn_text: 為了完全弄懂暗黑界的文字，而日日精進的小矮人。將一切精力全部奉獻於研究之中。
description: A Goblin who devotes himself to mastering perfect calligraphy of the word "False". He gives his all to each stroke.

name: People Running About
cn_text: 一直在忍受?飢餓的痛苦，發誓一定要發起革命的人民。
description: Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.

name: Bolt Escargot
cn_text: 吐出粘液然后用電擊對方。
description: After rendering an opponent immobile by spitting a sticky goo, this monster closes in for the attack.

name: Scrounging Goblin
cn_text: ①：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。對方可以把1張手卡交給這張卡的控制者讓這個效果無效。沒交的場合，自己從卡組把1張「哥布林」卡加入手卡。
description: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: They can hand you 1 card from their hand to negate this effect, otherwise you add 1 "Goblin" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Goblin Fan".

name: Elephant Statue of Disaster
cn_text: 當這張卡因對方控制的卡的效果從手卡被送去墓地時，給與對方基本分2000分的傷害。
description: When this card is sent from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Inflict 2000 damage to your opponent.

name: Zeradias, Herald of Heaven
cn_name: 天空的使者 杰拉迪亞斯
cn_text:
①：把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地才能發動。從卡組把1張「天空的聖域」加入手卡。
②：場上沒有「天空的聖域」存在的場合這張卡破壞。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 "The Sanctuary in the Sky" from your Deck to your hand. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not face-up on the field, destroy this card.

name: Triangle Ecstasy Spark
cn_text: ①：場上的全部「鷹身女郎三姐妹」的攻擊力直到回合結束時變成2700。這個回合，對方不能把陷阱卡發動，對方場上的陷阱卡的效果無效化。
description: Until the End Phase, the ATK of all "Harpie Lady Sisters" currently on the field becomes 2700, your opponent cannot activate any Trap Cards, also negate all your opponent's Trap Card effects on the field.

name: Card Shuffle
cn_text: 支付300基本分。自己或對方洗1次卡組。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Pay 300 Life Points to use this card's effect. Shuffle either your or your opponent's Deck. You can only use this effect during your own turn, once per turn.

name: Harpie Lady Sisters
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。「萬華鏡-華麗的分身-」的效果可以特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Elegant Egotist".

name: Inferno Reckless Summon
cn_text: ①：對方場上有表側表示怪獸存在，自己場上只有攻擊力1500以下的怪獸1只特殊召喚時才能發動。那只特殊召喚的怪獸的同名怪獸從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地盡可能攻擊表示特殊召喚，對方選自身場上1只表側表示怪獸，那只怪獸的同名怪獸從自身的手卡·卡組·墓地盡可能特殊召喚。
description: When exactly 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK is Special Summoned to your field while your opponent controls a face-up monster: Special Summon as many monsters as possible with the same name as the Summoned monster, from your hand, Deck, and Graveyard, in Attack Position, also your opponent Special Summons as many monsters as possible with the same name as 1 of their face-up monsters, from their hand, Deck, and Graveyard.

name: Malevolent Catastrophe
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: World Suppression
cn_text: 場地卡發動時才能發動。直到回合結束時場地卡的效果無效。
description: You can only activate this card when a Field Spell Card is activated. Negate the Field Spell Card during the turn this card is activated.

name: Prime Material Dragon
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，給與基本分傷害的效果變成基本分回復的效果。此外，持有「把場上的怪獸破壞的效果」的魔法·陷阱·效果怪獸的效果發動時，可以把1張手卡送去墓地讓那個發動無效并破壞。
description: Any effect that would inflict damage to a player increases their Life Points by the same amount, instead. During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that would destroy a monster(s) on the field: You can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Aqua Snake
cn_text: 尾巴前端的光球可施展催眠朮，使對方精神恍惚。
description: This monster hypnotizes an opponent with the ball on its tail and draws them to a watery doom.

name: Curse of Fiend
cn_text: 場上全部怪獸的表示形式交換。發動回合，怪獸的表示形式不能變更。這張卡只能在准備階段發動。
description: Change the battle positions of all Attack Position monsters on the field to Defense Position and vice-versa. These positions cannot be changed during the turn this card is activated except by the effect of a Spell, Trap or Effect Monster Card. You can only activate this card during your Standby Phase.

name: Leghul
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Ojama Green
cn_text: 據說能使盡一切手段去搗亂的擾亂三人組一員。據說若三人到齊了將會有什么事情發生。
description: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Chain Destruction
cn_text: ①：攻擊力2000以下的怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚時，以那1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。從那只表側表示怪獸的控制者的手卡·卡組把作為對象的怪獸的同名卡全部破壞。
description: When a monster(s) with 2000 or less ATK is Summoned: Target 1 of them; destroy all cards with that name in its controller's hand and Main Deck.

name: Dunames Dark Witch
cn_text: 勇敢的光之天使。出於那強烈的正義感，明知必敗也決不逃避與邪惡的戰斗。
description: Even when all odds are against this brave fairy, she will press onwards in battle and never retreat.

name: Rare Metalmorph
cn_name: 稀有金屬化·魔法反射裝甲
cn_text: 選擇場上表側表示存在的1只機械族怪獸發動。選擇的怪獸的攻擊力上升500，那只怪獸為對象的魔法卡的效果只有1次無效。那只怪獸從場上離開時這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by targeting 1 Machine-Type monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK. Once, negate a Spell effect that targets that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

name: Neo-Parshath, the Sky Paladin
cn_name: 天空勇士 尼奧珀耳修斯
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以把自己場上1只「天空騎士 珀耳修斯」解放從手卡特殊召喚。
②：場上有「天空的聖域」存在，自己基本分比對方多的場合，這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升那個相差數值。
③：這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
④：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Airknight Parshath" you control. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card. While "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field and your Life Points are higher than your opponent's, this card gains ATK and DEF equal to the difference in Life Points.

name: Treeborn Frog
cn_text: ①：這張卡在墓地存在，自己場上沒有「黃泉青蛙」存在的場合，自己准備階段才能發動。這張卡特殊召喚。這個效果在自己場上沒有魔法·陷阱卡存在的場合才能發動和處理。
description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you do not control "Treeborn Frog": You can Special Summon this card. You must control no Spell/Trap Cards to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Raigeki
cn_text: ①：對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

name: Exodia Necross
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。「與艾克佐迪亞的契約」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡不會被戰斗以及魔法·陷阱卡的效果破壞。
②：自己准備階段發動。這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
③：自己墓地是「被封印的艾克佐迪亞」「被封印者的右腕」「被封印者的左腕」「被封印者的右足」「被封印者的左足」的其中任意種不存在的場合這張卡破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Contract with Exodia", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Cannot be destroyed by battle or Spell/Trap effect. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 500 ATK. Destroy this card unless all 5 of these cards are in your Graveyard - "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One" and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One".

name: Waboku
cn_text: ①：這個回合，自己怪獸不會被戰斗破壞，自己受到的戰斗傷害變成0。
description: You take no battle damage from your opponent's monsters this turn. Your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

name: Skull Dice
cn_text: ①：擲1次骰子。對方場上的怪獸的攻擊力·守備力直到回合結束時下降出現的數目×100。
description: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK and DEF equal to the result x 100, until the End Phase.

name: Abaki
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，雙方受到500分傷害。
description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players take 500 damage.

name: Rainbow Veil
cn_text: 裝備怪獸和對方怪獸進行戰斗的場合，只在戰斗階段內那只對方怪獸的效果無效化。
description: If the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, while that monster is on the field its effect(s) is negated during the Battle Phase only.

name: Garuda the Wind Spirit
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把1只風屬性怪獸除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：對方結束階段，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側表示怪獸的表示形式變更。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Normal Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard. During your opponent's End Phase, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and change its battle position.

name: Dark Lucius LV6
cn_text: 用「漆黑之魔王 LV4」的效果特殊召喚的場合，這張卡戰斗破壞的對方怪獸的效果無效化。這個效果把對方怪獸的效果無效化的下次的自己回合的准備階段時，可以把這張卡送去墓地從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「漆黑之魔王 LV8」。
description: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV4", the effects of your opponent's monsters that this card destroys by battle are negated. During your next Standby Phase after this card has negated your opponent's monster effect, by sending this card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV8" from your hand or Deck.

name: Kanan the Swordmistress
cn_text: 像蝴蝶飛舞像蜜蜂蜇人，雙手持劍與盾的女戰士。
description: A lady warrior armed with sword and shield, she floats lightly and stings sharply.

name: Flame Dancer
cn_text: 揮舞?燃燒的繩子慢慢接近，不能和他對眼。
description: This monster moves while swinging its burning rope.

name: Swords of Concealing Light
cn_text:
這張卡發動后，第2次的自己准備階段破壞。
①：作為這張卡的發動時的效果處理，對方場上有表側表示怪獸存在的場合，那些怪獸全部變成里側守備表示。
②：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，對方場上的怪獸不能把表示形式變更。
description: When this card resolves, all monsters your opponent controlled when this card was activated are changed to face-down Defense Position. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions. Destroy this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.

name: Nuvia the Wicked
cn_text: 召喚的場合，這張卡破壞。對方有怪獸控制的場合，對方場上每有1張可控制的怪獸這張卡的攻擊力下降200。
description: If this monster is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls any monster, decrease the ATK of this card by 200 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Des Dendle
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「血蘭」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸每次戰斗破壞怪獸時把1只「魔草衍生物」（植物族·地·1星·攻/守800）特殊召喚。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Vampire Orchis" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster destroys 1 of your opponent's monsters, Special Summon 1 "Wicked Plant Token" (Plant-Type/EARTH/1 Star/ATK 800/DEF 800). (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit
cn_text: 這個效果可以在對方回合使用。對方發動陷阱時，可以把表側表示的這張卡作祭品，陷阱的發動無效并且破壞。
description: This effect can be used during either player's turn. When your opponent activates a Trap Card, Tribute this face-up card to negate the activation of the Trap Card and destroy it.

name: Giant Soldier of Stone
cn_text: 岩石的巨人兵，巨腕的攻擊能震動大地。
description: A giant warrior made of stone. A punch from this creature has earth-shaking results.

name: Sword Arm of Dragon
cn_text: 全身都附有刀刺的恐龍。以突進為手段進行攻擊。
description: This Jurrasic juggernaut has a spine covered in sword-like plates, and a tail to split open skulls.

name: Charcoal Inpachi
cn_text: 完全燃燒殆盡的巨木之化身。用此炭烤出的肉被公認為極品而受到珍重。
description: A wicked wooden spirit that has burned out. The barbecue grilled with this charcoal is so awesome that everybody thinks it's priceless.

name: Dark Plant
cn_text: 在被污染的土地以及暗之力的環境下生長的花。非常凶暴。
description: This mutant flower draws its power from pollutants and the dark forces.

name: Dream Clown
cn_text: 這張卡的表示形式從攻擊表示變成守備表示時，破壞對方場上的1只怪獸。
description: When this card is changed from Attack Position to Defense Position, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Deepsea Macrotrema
cn_text: 這張卡從場上送去墓地時，自己場上表側表示存在的全部水屬性怪獸的攻擊力直到結束階段時上升500。
description: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, all face-up WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Ghost Knight of Jackal
cn_text: 可以將1只被這張卡戰斗破壞并被送去墓地的對方怪獸以表側守備表示特殊召喚到自己場上。
description: You can Special Summon an opponent's monster that is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by this card as a result of battle to your side of the field in face-up Defense Position.

name: Desertapir
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以「沙貘」以外的場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸變成里側守備表示。
description: FLIP: Flip 1 face-up monster on the field into face-down Defense Position. You cannot select "Desertapir".

name: Great White
cn_text: 巨大的白鯊，若被咬到絕對無法脫身。
description: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

name: Mysterious Guard
cn_text:
①：這張卡反轉的場合，從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象發動。那只表側表示怪獸回到持有者卡組最上面。
●自己場上有戰士族怪獸存在的場合，以場上2只表側表示怪獸為對象發動。那1只表側表示怪獸回到持有者卡組最上面。那之后，自己場上有戰士族怪獸存在的場合，另1只表側表示怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: FLIP: Target 1 face-up monster on the field, and if you control a face-up Warrior-Type monster, you can target 1 additional face-up monster on the field; return the first target to the top of the Deck, then return the additional target (if any) to the hand if you still control a face-up Warrior-Type monster.

name: Spirit of Flames
cn_name: 炎之精靈 伊夫里特
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把1只炎屬性怪獸除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：這張卡的攻擊力在自己戰斗階段內上升300。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your Graveyard. This card gains 300 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

name: Dummy Golem
cn_text: 反轉：對方選擇所控制的1只怪獸。選擇怪獸和這張卡的控制權交換。
description: FLIP: Your opponent selects 1 monster that they control. Switch control of the selected monster and this card.

name: Valhalla, Hall of the Fallen
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。從手卡把1只天使族怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果在自己場上沒有怪獸存在的場合才能發動和處理。
description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Steel Scorpion
cn_text: 機械族以外的怪獸攻擊這張卡的場合，那只怪獸（以對方的回合來數）第3個回合的回合結束時破壞。
description: A non Machine-Type Monster attacking "Steel Scorpion" will be destroyed at the End Phase of your opponent's 2nd turn after the attack.

name: Sage's Stone
cn_text: ①：自己場上有「黑魔朮少女」存在的場合才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「黑魔朮師」特殊召喚。
description: If you control a face-up "Dark Magician Girl": Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand or Deck.

name: Malice Dispersion
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。場上表側表示存在的永續陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all face-up Continuous Trap Cards.

name: Grand Tiki Elder
cn_name: 假面咒朮師 詛咒之喉
cn_text: 以詛咒的咒文念殺對手的假面怪獸。
description: A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.

name: Dark Flare Knight
cn_text:
「黑魔朮師」＋「炎之劍士」
①：這張卡的戰斗發生的對自己的戰斗傷害變成0。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「幻影之騎士」特殊召喚。
description: "Dark Magician" + "Flame Swordsman"You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Mirage Knight" from your hand or Deck.

name: Man-Eating Treasure Chest
cn_text: 寶石箱形狀的怪獸，欺騙冒險者接近并發動攻擊。
description: A monster disguised as a treasure chest that is known to attack the unwary adventurer.

name: King Dragun
cn_name: 龍魔人 龍騎士之王
cn_text:
「龍之支配者」＋「神龍 末日龍」
只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方不能指定龍族為魔法·陷阱·怪獸的效果的對象。1回合1次，可以從手卡特殊召喚1只龍族怪獸到自己場上。
description: "Lord of D." + "Divine Dragon Ragnarok"Your opponent cannot select any Dragon-Type monsters as the target(s) of Spell, Trap, or Monster Card effects. Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand.

name: Mokey Mokey King
cn_text:
「悠悠」＋「悠悠」＋「悠悠」
這張卡從場上離開時，可以把自己墓地存在的「悠悠」盡可能多的特殊召喚。
description: "Mokey Mokey" + "Mokey Mokey" + "Mokey Mokey"When this card is removed from the field, you can Special Summon as many "Mokey Mokey" as possible from your Graveyard.

name: Yellow Gadget
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·特殊召喚成功時才能發動。從卡組把1只「綠色零件」加入手卡。
description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Green Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Firestorm Prominence
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，場上表側表示存在的炎屬性怪獸以外的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-FIRE monsters.

name: Granadora
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時，自己回復1000基本分。這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，自己受到2000點傷害。
description: When this monster is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned, increase your Life Points by 1000 points. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you take 2000 points of damage.

name: Wall of Illusion
cn_text: 向這張卡攻擊的怪獸回到持有者手卡。傷害計算適用。
description: If this card is attacked by a monster, after damage calculation: Return that monster to the hand.

name: Stronghold the Moving Fortress
cn_text:
①：這張卡發動后變成效果怪獸（機械族·地·4星·攻0/守2000）在怪獸區域守備表示特殊召喚。這張卡也當作陷阱卡使用。
②：自己場上有「綠色零件」「紅色零件」「黃色零件」存在的場合，這張卡的效果特殊召喚的這張卡的攻擊力上升3000。
description: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Machine-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 2000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) While you control "Green Gadget", "Red Gadget", and "Yellow Gadget", this card gains 3000 ATK.

name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
cn_text: 很久以前住在森林里的白羊，真身是森林長老。
description: This creature adopts the form of a white goat living in the forest, but is actually a Forest Elder.

name: Spirit of the Books
cn_name: 書之精靈 飛鷹主教
cn_text: 書本的精靈，擁有非常高的智慧，發動多彩的攻擊。
description: This wise spirit dwells in books, using its accumulated knowledge to defeat enemies.

name: Book of Moon
cn_text: ①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸變成里側守備表示。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

name: Blue Thunder T-45
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，在自己場上把1只「雷電子機衍生物」（機械族·光·4星·攻/守1500）特殊召喚。這衍生物不能為上級召喚而解放。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Special Summon 1 "Thunder Option Token" (Machine-Type/LIGHT/Level 4/ATK 1500/DEF 1500). This Token cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

name: Super Roboyarou
cn_text:
「稀有金屬女郎」＋「稀有金屬戰士」
這張卡在對怪獸的戰斗傷害計算時，攻擊力上升1000，在場上的這張卡可以和融合區的「稀有金屬女武神」互換（這張卡特殊召喚的回合不可以互換。）
description: "Roboyarou" + "Robolady"You can Special Summon "Super Robolady" by returning this card from the field to the Extra Deck. You cannot use this effect during the same turn this monster is Special Summoned. In addition, increase the ATK of this monster by 1000 points during the Damage Step when this monster battles with a monster.

name: Great Moth
cn_text: 裝備了「進化之繭」的「飛蛾寶寶」4回合后（用自己的回合來數）作祭品來特殊召喚。
description: This monster cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by Tributing "Petit Moth" on the 4th of your turns after "Petit Moth" has been equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: B.E.S. Big Core
cn_text: 這張卡召喚時放置3個指示物。這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。進行戰斗的場合，傷害步驟終了時取除這張卡的1個指示物。沒有指示物的狀態下進行戰斗的場合，傷害步驟終了時這張卡破壞。
description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 3 counters on it. Cannot be destroyed by battle. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled: Remove 1 counter from this card. If you cannot, destroy it.

name: Mushroom Man
cn_text: 在潮溼的地方發揮力量！從蘑菇帽中吐絲攻擊。
description: Found in humid regions, this creature attacks enemies with a lethal rain of poison spores.

name: Malice Ascendant
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方回合的准備階段時自己墓地存在的「增幅的惡意」的數量的對方卡組最上面的卡送去墓地。
description: During your opponent's Standby Phase, send 1 card from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard for each "Malice Ascendant" in your Graveyard.

name: Gradius' Option
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。自己場上有「超時空戰斗機 V形蛇」表側表示存在的場合可以特殊召喚。這張卡特殊召喚的場合，必須選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只「超時空戰斗機 V形蛇」。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力一直和選擇的怪獸相同。選擇的怪獸不在場上表側表示存在時，這張卡破壞。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This monster can only be Special Summoned by selecting 1 face-up "Gradius" on your side of the field. The ATK and DEF of this card becomes the same as the ATK and DEF of the selected "Gradius". If the selected "Gradius" is removed from the field, destroy this card.

name: Negate Attack
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，以那1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那次攻擊無效。那之后，戰斗階段結束。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.

name: Life Absorbing Machine
cn_text: 每次自己的准備階段，回復之前的那個自己的回合支付的基本分的一半。
description: During your Standby Phase, gain Life Points equal to half of the total Life Points you paid during your last turn.

name: Chaos Necromancer
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力為自己墓地里存在的怪獸卡數量×300點的數值。
description: The ATK of this card is the number of Monster Cards in your Graveyard x 300.

name: Dragon Treasure
cn_text: 龍族才能裝備。1只裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: A Dragon-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Gokipon
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以從卡組選擇1只攻擊力1500以下的昆蟲族怪獸加入自己手卡。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Insect-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

name: DUCKER Mobile Cannon
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以自己墓地1只4星怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Target 1 Level 4 monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Opticlops
cn_text: 為冥王哈帝斯效命的獨眼巨人。用尖角把敵人扯成碎片。
description: A one-eyed giant that serves the "Dark Ruler Ha Des", it skewers its enemies with its sharp horn, shattering them to pieces.

name: Dark Grepher
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以從手卡丟棄1只5星以上的暗屬性怪獸，從手卡特殊召喚。
②：1回合1次，從手卡丟棄1只暗屬性怪獸才能發動。從卡組把1只暗屬性怪獸送去墓地。
description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 Level 5 or higher DARK monster. Once per turn: You can discard 1 DARK monster; send 1 DARK monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Crimson Ninja
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以場上1張表側表示的陷阱卡或者場上蓋放的1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象發動。那張陷阱卡破壞（那張卡在場上蓋放中的場合，翻開確認）。
description: FLIP: Target 1 Trap Card on the field; destroy that target. (If the target is Set, reveal it, and destroy it if it is a Trap Card. Otherwise, return it to its original position.)

name: Summoner of Illusions
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。這張卡以外的自己場上1只怪獸解放，從額外卡組把1只融合怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸在這個回合的結束階段破壞。
description: FLIP: Tribute 1 other monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

name: Cannon Soldier MK-2
cn_text: 每把自己場上存在的2只怪獸作為祭品，給與對方基本分1500分傷害。
description: You can Tribute 2 monsters to inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.

name: Arlownay
cn_text: 花中的女性散發?有毒的花粉。任何人都不能靠近她。
description: A lady monster dwelling in a flower, she sprinkles the air with poisonous pollen.

name: Allure of Darkness
cn_text: ①：自己抽2張。那之后，手卡有暗屬性怪獸存在的場合，選那之內的1只除外。不存在的場合，自己手卡全部送去墓地。
description: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 DARK monster from your hand, or, if you do not have any in your hand, send your entire hand to the Graveyard.

name: The Tricky
cn_text: ①：這張卡可以丟棄1張手卡，從手卡特殊召喚。
description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by discarding 1 card.

name: Jellyfish
cn_text: 漂浮在海面上的海蜇，半透明的身體使人難以察覺。
description: An almost invisible, semi-transparent jellyfish that drifts in the sea.

name: Vorse Raider
cn_text: 做盡壞事并以此為樂的魔獸人。手上的斧子經常沾滿鮮血。
description: This wicked Beast-Warrior does every horrid thing imaginable, and loves it! His axe bears the marks of his countless victims.

name: Garoozis
cn_text: 長有龍頭的獸戰士，斧頭具有相當大的威力。
description: An axe-swinging beast-warrior with the head of a dragon.

name: Simorgh, Bird of Divinity
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。這張卡上級召喚的場合，解放的怪獸必須是風屬性怪獸。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，雙方玩家在每次雙方的結束階段受到1000分傷害。這個時候，各自玩家受到的傷害變少魔法·陷阱卡控制數量×500的數值。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. If you Tribute Summon this card, all Tributes must be WIND. Each player takes 1000 damage during each of their End Phases, while this card remains face-up on the field. This damage is decreased by 500 for each Spell/Trap Card the player controls.

name: Andro Sphinx
cn_text: 場上有「光之金字塔」存在的場合，可以支付500基本分把這張卡從手卡特殊召喚。這張卡在召喚·特殊召喚的回合不能攻擊。這張卡不能作從墓地的特殊召喚。這張卡戰斗破壞守備表示怪獸的場合，給與對方基本分破壞的怪獸的攻擊力一半數值的傷害。
description: You can pay 500 Life Points to Special Summon this card when "Pyramid of Light" is on the field. This card cannot attack during the turn that it is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. If this card destroys a Defense Position monster as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to half of the ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Stone Ogre Grotto
cn_text: 能將巨大的岩石堆積起來的岩石巨人。
description: A behemoth shaped by giant boulders.

name: Mystical Elf
cn_text: 雖然是縴弱的精靈，但以神聖力量護身有很強的守備。
description: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Hurricail
cn_text: 荒野的龍卷風。用風之刃切割對方。
description: A tornado that ravages the wastelands with sharp winds that can cut to the bone.

name: Violet Crystal
cn_text: 不死族才能裝備。1只裝備怪獸的攻擊力和守備力上升300。
description: A Zombie-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: House of Adhesive Tape
cn_text: 對方把守備力500以下的怪獸召喚·反轉召喚時才能發動。那1只怪獸破壞。
description: If the DEF of a monster summoned by your opponent (excluding Special Summon) is 500 points or less, the monster is destroyed.

name: Whirlwind Prodigy
cn_text: 祭品召喚風屬性怪獸的場合，這只怪獸1只作為2只份的祭品使用。
description: When Tribute Summoning a WIND monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Self-Mummification
cn_text: 選擇自己場上存在的1只怪獸送去墓地。
description: Select 1 monster you control, and send it to the Graveyard.

name: White Magical Hat
cn_text: 這張卡造成對方玩家基本分傷害的時候，對方隨機丟棄1張卡。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

name: Archfiend Mirror
cn_text: 對映在鏡子上的東西施以催眠朮，從而避開攻擊的惡魔之鏡。
description: A wicked mirror that hypnotizes enemies, diverting attacks from their intended targets.

name: Empress Judge
cn_text: 「女王的影武者」＋「響女」
description: "Queen's Double" + "Hibikime"

name: The Hunter with 7 Weapons
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，宣言1個種族發動。這張卡和宣言的種族的怪獸進行戰斗的場合，這張卡的攻擊力只在傷害計算時上升1000。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, declare 1 Type of monster. When battling that Type of monster, increase the ATK of this card by 1000 points during Damage Calculation.

name: Toon World
cn_text: 支付1000基本分才能把這張卡發動。
description: Activate this card by paying 1000 LP.

name: Ryu-Kishin
cn_text: 假裝是石像，從黑暗中攻擊。逃跑速度也很快。
description: A very elusive creature that looks like a harmless statue until it attacks.

name: Creature Seizure
cn_text: 雙方選擇自己場上怪獸各1只，那些怪獸的控制權交換。但是這張卡的控制者必須選擇自己場上表側表示存在的通常怪獸。
description: Each player gives their opponent control of 1 of their monsters (controller's choice). You must choose a face-up Normal Monster.

name: B.E.S. Covered Core
cn_text: 這張卡召喚時放置2個指示物。這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。進行戰斗的場合，在傷害步驟結束時投擲硬幣猜正反。猜錯的場合，卡上的1個指示物取除。沒有指示物放置的狀態進行戰斗的場合，傷害步驟結束時這張卡破壞。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 2 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, at the end of the Damage Step toss a coin and call it. If you call it wrong, remove 1 counter. If this card battles without a counter, destroy it at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Gokibore
cn_text: 圓溜溜的蟑螂。滾來滾去進行攻擊。守備想不到還挺強。
description: A large, spherical roach that attacks its enemies by rolling over them.

name: Swarm of Scarabs
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合可以有1次變回里側守備表示。這張卡反轉召喚成功時，破壞對方場上1只怪獸。
description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Kagemusha of the Blue Flame
cn_text: 侍奉?紫炎的影武者，持有鋒利的名刀。
description: Serving as a double for the Ruler of the Blue Flame, he's a master swordsman that wields a fine blade.

name: Cyber End Dragon
cn_text:
「電子龍」＋「電子龍」＋「電子龍」
這張卡的融合召喚不用上記的卡不能進行。
①：這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Armored Lizard
cn_text: 擁有堅硬軀體的蜥蜴。如果被咬到會立即斃命。
description: A lizard with a very tough hide and a vicious bite.

name: Sectarian of Secrets
cn_text: 崇拜黑暗的魔法師。呼喚魔手將敵人拖入暗陰之中。
description: This wizard worships the darkness, and is served by a sinister hand that drags its enemies into oblivion.

name: Thunder Kid
cn_text: 在它的體內平時儲蓄?雷電。因此當它哭泣時非常危險。
description: This monster stores electricity within his body, and can unleash it with catastrophic power.

name: Silver Bow and Arrow
cn_text: 天使族才能裝備。1只裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: A Fairy-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Skull Knight #2
cn_text: 用這張卡做祭品召喚惡魔族怪獸的場合，從卡組特殊召喚1張「骷髏騎士」上場。之后卡組洗切。
description: If you Tribute Summon a Fiend-Type monster by Tributing this monster, Special Summon 1 "Skull Knight #2" from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion
cn_text: 這張卡可以作為1只融合素材怪獸的代替。那個時候，其他的融合素材怪獸必須是正規品。此外，把需要的融合素材怪獸（包含這張卡）解放才能發動。把以那些解放的怪獸為融合素材的1只光屬性的融合怪獸從額外卡組特殊召喚。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding LIGHT Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

name: White Ninja
cn_text: 反轉：破壞場上1只守備表示的怪獸。
description: FLIP: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Soul Tiger
cn_text: 據說是貪婪人類靈魂的可怕老虎的邪惡靈魂。如果可以的話，任誰都不想遇見的怪獸。
description: The soul of a tiger that is said to devour human souls. He is a famous soul that you wouldn't want to run into in a dark alley.

name: Monsturtle
cn_text: 裝備了帶刺的甲殼的龜。非常凶暴不喜歡接近人類。
description: Protected by a spiked shell, this turtle has a very nasty disposition.

name: Spiritualism
cn_text: ①：以對方場上1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的卡回到持有者手卡。這張卡的發動和效果不會被無效化。
description: Return 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls to the hand. This card's activation and effect cannot be negated.

name: Ultimate Tyranno
cn_text:
①：自己戰斗階段有可以攻擊的「究極恐獸」存在的場合，「究極恐獸」以外的怪獸不能攻擊。
②：這張卡可以向對方怪獸全部各作1次攻擊。
description: This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. During your Battle Phase, if you control an "Ultimate Tyranno" that can attack, monsters other than "Ultimate Tyranno" cannot attack.

name: Mirage Dragon
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方在戰斗階段不能把陷阱卡發動。
description: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

name: Agido
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，擲1次骰子。可以從自己的墓地中特殊召喚1只等級與擲出點數相同的天使族怪獸上場。（若擲出6，則包括6星以上的怪獸）。
description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, roll a six-sided die. You can Special Summon 1 Fairy-Type monster from your Graveyard whose Level is equal to the number rolled. (If the result is 6, you can Special Summon a Level 6 or higher monster.)

name: Sasuke Samurai
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊里側守備表示的怪獸的場合，不進行傷害計算，里側守備表示的怪獸以本來的里側守備形式直接破壞。
description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster.

name: Night Assailant
cn_text:
①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只對方怪獸破壞。
②：這張卡從手卡送去墓地的場合，以「深淵的暗殺者」以外的自己墓地1只反轉怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.When this card is sent from the hand to the Graveyard: Target 1 Flip Effect Monster in your Graveyard, except this card; return that target to the hand.

name: Inspection
cn_text: 每次對方的准備階段可以支付500基本分，隨機看對方1張手卡。
description: During your opponent's Standby Phase, you can randomly select 1 card in your opponent's hand and look at it at the cost of 500 Life Points.

name: Gale Dogra
cn_text: ①：支付3000基本分才能發動。從自己的額外卡組把1只怪獸送去墓地。
description: You can pay 3000 Life Points to send 1 monster from your Extra Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Armored Rat
cn_text: 可以用像鎧甲般堅固的毛守護身體的老鼠。
description: The fur on this monster rat is tough enough to repel swords.

name: Beckoning Light
cn_text: ①：自己手卡全部丟棄。那之后，從自己墓地選這個效果丟棄去墓地的卡數量的光屬性怪獸加入手卡。
description: Discard your entire hand, then for each card you discarded to the Graveyard by this effect, add 1 LIGHT monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Zolga
cn_text: ①：這張卡為上級召喚而被解放的場合發動。自己回復2000基本分。
description: When a monster is Tribute Summoned by Tributing this card: The owner of this card gains 2000 Life Points.

name: Drooling Lizard
cn_text: 借?夜色襲擊行人的人形吸血蛇。
description: A blood-sucking snake in human form that attacks any living being that passes nearby.

name: Fusionist
cn_text: 「小天使」＋「催眠羊」
description: "Petit Angel" + "Mystical Sheep #2"

name: The Reliable Guardian
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸的守備力直到結束階段時上升700。
description: Increase 1 face-up monster's DEF by 700 points until the end of this turn.

name: Dragged Down into the Grave
cn_text: ①：雙方各自把對方手卡確認，從那之中選1張卡丟棄。那之后，雙方各自從卡組抽1張。
description: Both players reveal their hands, each player chooses 1 card from their opponent's hand, then you discard the chosen cards from both players' hands, then both players draw 1 card.

name: Flint Missile
cn_text: 把有「打火石」裝備的1只怪獸破壞。發動后這張卡被送去墓地時，這張卡可以回到卡組。
description: Destroy 1 monster equipped with "Flint". You can return this card to your Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard after it resolves.

name: Lesser Fiend
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，這張卡戰斗破壞的怪獸不送去墓地從游戲中除外。
description: (This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card.

name: Bracchio-raidus
cn_text: 「雙頭恐龍王」＋「貪尸龍」
description: "Two-Headed King Rex" + "Crawling Dragon #2"

name: Royal Keeper
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合可以有1次變回里側守備表示。這張卡反轉時，在回合結束前這張卡的攻擊力守備力上升300。
description: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is flipped face-up, it gains 300 ATK and DEF until the end of the turn. (If attacked, this effect resolves after damage calculation.)

name: Freed the Brave Wanderer
cn_text: 可以把自己墓地存在的2只光屬性怪獸從游戲中除外，選擇持有比場上表側表示存在的這張卡的攻擊力高的攻擊力的場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸破壞。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn: You can banish 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster on the field with higher ATK than this face-up card; destroy that target.

name: Neo Bug
cn_text: 據說是從異星來的巨大昆蟲型怪獸。集體行動捕捉目標。
description: A huge bug-like monster said to come from another planet. It gathers in swarms.

name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
cn_name: 疾風之暗黑騎士 蓋亞
cn_text: ①：手卡只有這1張卡的場合，這張卡可以不用解放作召喚。
description: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon it without Tributing.

name: Spell Purification
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。場上表側表示存在的永續魔法全部破壞。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all face-up Continuous Spell Cards.

name: Gravekeeper's Servant
cn_text: 對方若不把卡組最上面的1張卡送去墓地，則不能攻擊宣言。
description: Your opponent must send 1 card from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard to declare an attack.

name: Big Eye
cn_text: 反轉：從自己卡組上面把最多5張卡確認，用喜歡的順序回到卡組上面。
description: FLIP: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your Deck, then place them on the top of the Deck in any order.

name: The Big March of Animals
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示的獸族怪獸的攻擊力，在結束階段前提升自己場上獸族怪獸數目×200的數值。
description: Until the end of this turn, all face-up Beast-Type monsters on your side of the field gain 200 ATK for each Beast-Type monster on your side of the field.

name: Beautiful Headhuntress
cn_text: 在那美麗容貌的背后，卻是個用刀子使許多人身首異處的女子。
description: A vicious creature that has decapitated numerous enemy monsters.

name: Synthetic Seraphim
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，每次反擊陷阱卡發動，在自己場上把1只「人造天使衍生物」（天使族·光·1星·攻/守300）特殊召喚。
description: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, Special Summon 1 "Synthetic Seraphim Token" (Fairy-Type/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 300).

name: Doma The Angel of Silence
cn_name: 死之沉默天使 多瑪
cn_text: 司職死亡的天使，若被這家伙盯上，難逃一死。
description: This fairy rules over the end of existence.

name: Blazewing Butterfly
cn_text:
①：這張卡只要在場上·墓地存在，當作通常怪獸使用。
②：可以把場上的當作通常怪獸使用的這張卡作為通常召喚作再1次召喚。那個場合這張卡變成當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●把這張卡解放，以「炎妖蝶 維爾普斯」以外的自己墓地1只二重怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸當作再1次召喚的狀態使用。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.? You can Tribute this card, then target 1 Gemini monster in your Graveyard, except "Blazewing Butterfly"; Special Summon that target, and if you do, it becomes an Effect Monster, and gains its effect.

name: Wall of Revealing Light
cn_text: 支付1000的倍數的基本分發動。只要這張卡在場上存在，持有支付的數值以下的攻擊力的對方怪獸不能攻擊。
description: Activate by paying any multiple of 1000 Life Points. Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack if their ATK is less than or equal to the amount you paid.

name: Ancient Telescope
cn_text: 查看對方卡組最上面的最多5張卡，然后放回原處。
description: See the top 5 cards of your opponent's Deck. Return the cards to the Deck in the same order.

name: Yormungarde
cn_text: 出現在神話世界的蛇。非常的長。
description: An extremely long snake that dwells in the world of myth.

name: Molten Behemoth
cn_text: 從熔岩大地誕生的巨人。使用熔岩拳擊攻擊。
description: A giant born from magma, it attacks with a magma punch.

name: Maiden of the Aqua
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，場地變成「海」。場地魔法卡表側表示存在的場合，這個效果不適用。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the field is treated as "Umi" (however there is no increasing or decreasing of ATK/DEF due to "Umi"'s effect). If there is an active Field Spell Card on the field, this effect is not applied.

name: Wretched Ghost of the Attic
cn_text: 各家屋頂都有的冤魂。從不做壞事。
description: A harmless monster found lurking in just about any attic.

name: Zombie Master
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，從手卡把1只怪獸送去墓地，以自己或者對方的墓地1只4星以下的不死族怪獸為對象才能發動。那只不死族怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果在這張卡在怪獸區域表側表示存在的場合才能發動和處理。
description: Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie-Type monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon that target. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Helios Trice Megistus
cn_name: 三子太陽 赫利俄斯
cn_text: 這張卡可以用自己場上的1只「雙子太陽 赫利俄斯」作為祭品特殊召喚。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力為從游戲中除外的怪獸卡數量×300的數值。這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合，結束階段時攻擊力·守備力上升500并特殊召喚。對方場上有怪獸存在的場合，只有1次可以繼續進行攻擊。
description: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Helios Duo Megistus". This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 300. After this card attacks, it can attack once more if your opponent controls a monster. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase and it gains 500 ATK and DEF.

name: Lady of Faith
cn_text: 詠唱起聞所未聞的咒語，使所有人的心平靜下來。
description: Soothes the souls of others by chanting a mysterious spell.

name: Confiscation
cn_text: 支付1000基本分發動。把對方手卡確認，從那之中選1張卡丟棄。
description: Pay 1000 Life Points. Look at your opponent's hand, select 1 card in it and discard that card.

name: Turtle Raccoon
cn_text: 背?烏龜甲殼的狸貓。誘惑敵人進行攻擊。
description: A cunning raccoon protected by a solid turtle shell, it attacks with deception.

name: Kaiser Sea Horse
cn_text: ①：光屬性怪獸上級召喚的場合，這張卡可以作為2只的數量解放。
description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT monster.

name: Nobleman of Extermination
cn_text: 蓋放的1張魔法或者陷阱卡破壞并且從游戲中除外。陷阱卡的場合把雙方卡組確認，和破壞陷阱卡同名卡全部從游戲除外。
description: Select, destroy, and remove from play 1 face-down Spell or Trap Card. If it was a Trap Card, both players must remove from play all copies of that card from their Decks.

name: Exchange of the Spirit
cn_text:
這個卡名的卡在決斗中只能發動1張。
①：雙方墓地的卡各自是15張以上的場合支付1000基本分才能發動。雙方玩家各自把自身的卡組和墓地的卡全部交換，那之后卡組洗切。
description: If both players have 15 or more cards in their Graveyards: Pay 1000 LP; each player swaps the cards in their Graveyard with the cards in their Deck, then shuffles their Deck. You can only activate 1 "Exchange of the Spirit" per Duel.

name: Wood Clown
cn_text: 作出令人討厭的笑容的惡魔。以手中的鐮刀熟練的回避?攻擊。
description: A creature with a wicked smile and a lethal sickle.

name: Armored Starfish
cn_text: 表面堅固，守備力較高的青色海星。
description: A bluish starfish with a solid hide capable of fending off attacks.

name: Deep Diver
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合，戰斗階段結束時從卡組選擇1張怪獸卡，放在卡組最上面。
description: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Choose 1 Monster Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck.

name: Sword of Dark Rites
cn_text: 暗屬性怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升400。裝備怪獸被作為祭品讓這張卡送去墓地的場合，這張卡回到手卡。
description: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK. When the equipped monster is Tributed and this card is sent to the Graveyard, return this card to your hand.

name: Byser Shock
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時，將場上的所有蓋放的卡回到持有者的手卡。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned, return all Set cards on the field to their owner's respective hands.

name: Nekogal #1
cn_text: 貓精靈。與可愛的身姿相反、敏捷的攻擊對方。
description: A pussycat-fairy. Contrary to her lovely beauty, she claws on her enemies.

name: Fairy's Hand Mirror
cn_text: 把以場上1只怪獸為對象發動的對方的魔法，轉移給其他正確的對象。
description: When your opponent activates a Spell Card that targets exactly 1 monster (and no other cards) on the field: Target another card that would be an appropriate target; that Spell now targets the new target.

name: Burst Stream of Destruction
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能用「青眼白龍」攻擊。
①：自己場上有「青眼白龍」存在的場合才能發動。對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: If you control "Blue-Eyes White Dragon": Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

name: Luster Dragon #2
cn_text: 吞食翡翠的龍。被其美態吸引住并丟掉性命的人不計其數。
description: This dragon feeds on emerald. Enchanted by this monster even when attacked, few people live to tell of its beauty.

name: Neo-Spacian Glow Moss
cn_text:
這張卡進行戰斗的場合，對方抽1張卡。這個效果抽到的卡給雙方確認，這張卡得到那張卡的種類的以下效果。
●怪獸卡：這個回合的戰斗階段結束。
●魔法卡：這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
●陷阱卡：這張卡變成守備表示。
description: When this card attacks or is attacked: Your opponent draws 1 card. Reveal it, and based on its type apply this effect. ? Monster: End the Battle Phase. ? Spell: If this card is attacking, you can change it to a direct attack instead. ? Trap: Change this card to Defense Position.

name: Wood Remains
cn_text: 森林守護神死后，被惡魔復活的尸體。
description: A living corpse of wood re-animated by the power of darkness.

name: Fuh-Rin-Ka-Zan
cn_text:
①：風·水·炎·地屬性怪獸在場上全部存在的場合才能發動。從以下效果選1個適用。
●對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
●對方場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
●對方手卡隨機選2張丟棄。
●自己從卡組抽2張。
description: When there are face-up WIND, WATER, FIRE and EARTH monster(s) on the field: Apply 1 of these effects.?Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.?Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.?Discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.?Draw 2 cards.

name: Reinforcements
cn_text: ①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升500。
description: Target face-up monster gains 500 ATK until the End Phase.

name: Uraby
cn_text: 擅長奔跑的恐龍，利用尖銳的爪子進行攻擊。
description: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

name: Darkfire Dragon
cn_text: 「火炎草」＋「小龍」
description: "Firegrass" + "Petit Dragon"

name: Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，丟棄1張手卡才能發動。把對方手卡確認，從那之中選1只怪獸。持有選的怪獸的攻擊力以上的攻擊力的怪獸在自己場上存在的場合，選的怪獸破壞，給與對方500傷害。那以外的場合，自己受到500傷害。
description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 Monster Card in it. If you control a monster with ATK greater than or equal to the ATK of the chosen card, destroy the chosen card and inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Otherwise, take 500 damage.

name: Amazon of the Seas
cn_text: 侍奉海神的美麗人魚戰士，守護?神聖的區域。
description: A mermaid who serves as a herald to the Ocean Lord. She protects the sacred domain of Atlantis.

name: Lord of D.
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不能把場上的龍族怪獸作為效果的對象。
description: Dragon-Type monsters on the field cannot be targeted by card effects.

name: Airknight Parshath
cn_name: 天空騎士 珀耳修斯
cn_text:
①：這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
②：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

name: Dark Coffin
cn_text:
蓋放的這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，對方從以下的效果選擇1個適用。
●隨機丟棄自己的1張手卡。
●自己場上的1只怪獸破壞。
description: When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, your opponent selects and executes 1 of the following effects:? Discard 1 random card in their hand.? Select 1 monster on their side of the field and destroy it.

name: Harpie's Feather Duster
cn_text: ①：對方場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

name: Mystic Plasma Zone
cn_text: 全部的暗屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500，守備力下降400。
description: Increase the ATK of all DARK monsters by 500 points and decreases their DEF by 400 points.

name: The Thing That Hides in the Mud
cn_text: 腳下粘呼呼的溶化時、是這家伙出現的前兆。
description: This monster melts its way underground to attack enemies from below.

name: Micro Ray
cn_text: 使場上1張表側表示怪獸的守備力變成零直到結束階段終了時為止。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target's DEF becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

name: Battle Steer
cn_text: 住在森林里的牛魔人，用突起的角進行突襲。
description: A bull monster often found in the woods, it charges enemy monsters with a pair of deadly horns.

name: Chthonian Blast
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的怪獸破壞送去墓地時發動。場上表側表示攻擊力最低的1只怪獸破壞，雙方受到那個攻擊力一半的數值的傷害。
description: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.

name: Abyss Soldier
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，從手卡把1只水屬性怪獸丟棄去墓地，以場上1張卡為對象才能發動。那張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard to target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand.

name: Archlord Zerato
cn_text: 這張卡不能進行通常召喚。這張卡僅當場上存在「天空的聖域」時，祭掉自己場上1只以表側表示存在的「杰拉的戰士」才能特殊召喚。從手卡將1張光屬性怪獸卡棄到墓地，破壞對方場上存在的所有怪獸。此效果僅當自己場上存在「天空的聖域」時才適用。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on your side of the field, by discarding 1 LIGHT Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

name: Instant Fusion
cn_text:
這個卡名的卡在1回合只能發動1張。
①：支付1000基本分才能發動。把1只5星以下的融合怪獸當作融合召喚從額外卡組特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸不能攻擊，結束階段破壞。
description: Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot attack, also is destroyed during the End Phase. (This Special Summon is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You can only activate 1 "Instant Fusion" per turn.

name: Fusion Recovery
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1張「融合」和1只融合召喚使用過的融合素材怪獸為對象才能發動。那些卡加入手卡。
description: Target 1 "Polymerization", and 1 Fusion Material that was used for a Fusion Summon, in your Graveyard; add them to your hand.

name: Goblin King
cn_text: 若自己場上有除這張卡以外的惡魔族怪獸存在，則這張卡不能被攻擊。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力成為與全場除這張卡以外的惡魔族怪獸數量×1000點等同的數值。
description: While you control another Fiend-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked. The ATK and DEF of this card are each equal to the number of Fiend-Type monsters on the field (excluding this card) x 1000.

name: Tornado Wall
cn_text:
場上有「海」存在的場合才能把這張卡發動。
①：只要場上有「海」存在，自己受到的戰斗傷害變成0。
②：場上沒有「海」存在的場合這張卡破壞。
description: Activate only while "Umi" is on the field. While "Umi" is face-up on the field, you take no Battle Damage from attacking monsters. Destroy this card when "Umi" leaves the field.

name: The Furious Sea King
cn_text: 偉大的海之王。喚起永不停息的大海嘯將敵人吞沒。
description: Grand King of the Seven Seas, he's able to summon massive tidal waves to drown the enemy.

name: Spellbinding Circle
cn_text: 選擇對方場上存在的1只怪獸發動。選擇的怪獸不能攻擊，也不能把表示形式變更。選擇的怪獸破壞時，這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Cranium Fish
cn_text: 這張卡可以把自己場上存在的1只「海洋怪魚衛士」解放，從手卡特殊召喚。可以從手卡把1只水屬性怪獸丟棄去墓地，場上蓋放的1張卡破壞。
description: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Ocean's Keeper". You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard to destroy 1 face-down card.

name: Perfect Machine King
cn_text: 場上存在的這張卡以外的機械族怪獸每有1只，這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
description: This card gains 500 ATK for each other Machine-Type monster on the field.

name: Change Slime
cn_text: 能自由地變換形態的史萊姆。
description: A slime that can morph and adopt the shape and size of any monster it chooses.

name: Burning Spear
cn_text: 炎屬性的怪獸才能裝備。裝備的怪獸攻擊力上升400，守備力下降200。
description: A FIRE monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

name: Dimension Explosion
cn_text: 把自己場上表側表示存在的1只融合怪獸回到融合卡組才能發動。雙方選擇從游戲中除外的怪獸最多2只，在各自場上特殊召喚。
description: Return 1 face-up Fusion Monster you control to the Extra Deck. Both players select up to 2 of their monsters that are removed from play, and Special Summon them.

name: Gemini Summoner
cn_text: 對方的結束階段時只有1次支付500基本分才能發動。把手卡或者自己場上表側表示存在的1只二重怪獸通常召喚。此外，這張卡1回合只有1次不會被戰斗破壞。
description: Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can pay 500 LP; Normal Summon/Set 1 Gemini monster from your hand or Normal Summon 1 face-up Gemini monster you control. The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed.

name: Roaring Ocean Snake
cn_text: 「魔法燈」＋「兵主部」
description: "Mystic Lamp" + "Hyosube"

name: Second Goblin
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「巨大獸人」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸的表示形式1回合只有1次可以變更。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Giant Orc" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change the equipped monster's battle position once per turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Patrician of Darkness
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方怪獸的攻擊對象由這張卡的控制者選擇。
description: You choose the attack targets for your opponent's attacks.

name: De-Spell
cn_text: ①：以場上1張表側表示的魔法卡或者場上蓋放的1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張魔法卡破壞（那張卡在場上蓋放中的場合，翻開確認）。
description: Select 1 Spell Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Spell Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Trap Card, return it to its original position.

name: Minor Goblin Official
cn_text: 對方的基本分3000以下的場合才可以發動。每次對方的准備階段對方基本分受到500分的傷害。
description: You can only activate this card when your opponent's Life Points are 3000 or less. Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases.

name: Offerings to the Doomed
cn_text: ①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只表側表示怪獸破壞。下次的自己抽卡階段跳過。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target, also skip your next Draw Phase.

name: Trap Jammer
cn_text: 戰斗階段中才能發動。對方發動的陷阱卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: When your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Key Mace
cn_text: 非常細小的天使。無論是誰都被那可愛魅力折服而敞開心屝。
description: Enemies' hearts will melt at the sight of this small fairy's cuteness.

name: Molten Destruction
cn_text: 全部的炎屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500，守備力下降400。
description: All FIRE monsters gain 500 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

name: Ookazi
cn_text: 給與對方基本分800分傷害。
description: Inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Disc Fighter
cn_text: 這張卡對守備力2000以上的守備表示怪獸進行攻擊時，不經過損傷計算而直接將其破壞。
description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster with DEF 2000 or more, destroy that monster with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

name: Heavy Storm
cn_text: ①：場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Mokey Mokey Smackdown
cn_text: 「悠悠」在自己場上表側表示存在時，自己場上天使族怪獸被破壞的場合，這個回合的結束階段前自己場上「悠悠」的攻擊力變為3000。
description: While a face-up "Mokey Mokey" is on your side of the field, if a Fairy-Type monster on your side of the field is destroyed, the ATK of all "Mokey Mokey" on your side of the field becomes 3000 until the end of this turn.

name: Gatekeeper
cn_text: 為守備王家墓地入口而造的機器。非常難以被破壞。
description: An indestructible mechanoid created for the sole purpose of guarding the gateways.

name: Barrier Statue of the Drought
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不是地屬性怪獸不能特殊召喚。
description: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for EARTH monsters.

name: Return of the Doomed
cn_text: 自己的手卡的1張怪獸卡丟棄去墓地。這個回合因為戰斗被破壞送去自己的墓地的怪獸1只回合結束的時候回到手卡。
description: Discard 1 Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard. Return 1 of your monsters destroyed and sent to your Graveyard as a result of battle during this turn to your hand at the end of this turn.

name: Infernal Flame Emperor
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡上級召喚時，從自己墓地把最多5只炎屬性怪獸除外才能發動。把除外數量的場上的魔法·陷阱卡破壞。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can remove from play up to 5 FIRE monsters in your Graveyard. Destroy a number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field equal to the number of monsters removed from play for this effect.

name: Ultimate Insect LV7
cn_text: 「究極昆蟲 LV5」的效果特殊召喚的場合，只要這張卡在自己場上存在，對方的全部怪獸攻擊力·守備力下降700。
description: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV5", while it remains on the field all your opponent's monsters lose 700 ATK and DEF.

name: Silent Swordsman LV3
cn_text:
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，這張卡為對象的對方的魔法卡的效果無效化。
②：自己准備階段把場上的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「沉默劍士 LV5」特殊召喚。這個效果在這張卡召喚·特殊召喚·反轉的回合不能發動。
description: Negate your opponent's Spell effects that target this card. During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV5" from your hand or Deck. You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Summoned or flipped face-up.

name: Hard Armor
cn_text: 擁有心靈的鎧甲，堅硬的身體裝備在戰士身上。
description: A living suit of armor that attacks enemies with a bone-jarring tackle.

name: The Flute of Summoning Kuriboh
cn_text: 把自己卡組1只「栗子球」或「羽翼栗子球」，加入手卡或者在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: Add 1 "Kuriboh" or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your Deck to your hand, OR Special Summon 1 "Kuriboh" or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your Deck.

name: Non-Spellcasting Area
cn_text: 場上所有表側表示的效果怪獸以外的怪獸不受魔法效果的影響。
description: All face-up monsters, except for Effect Monsters, are unaffected by other Spell effects.

name: Breath of Light
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的岩石族怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all face-up Rock-Type monsters on the field.

name: Fairy of the Spring
cn_text: 從自己的墓地里選擇1張裝備魔法卡加入手卡。這張裝備魔法卡本回合不能發動。
description: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. That Equip Spell Card cannot be activated this turn.

name: Ceremonial Bell
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，雙方玩家把手卡全部持續公開。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, both players must show their respective hands.

name: Armored Zombie
cn_text: 充滿怨念而蘇醒的武者，要警惕在黑暗中揮舞的太刀。
description: This warrior blindly swings a deadly blade with devastating force.

name: Fairy Dragon
cn_text: 在妖精中意外地強，非常漂亮的龍妖精。
description: This beautiful Dragon spirit harbors hidden strength.

name: Begone, Knave!
cn_text: ①：這張卡已在魔法與陷阱區域存在的狀態，怪獸給與玩家戰斗傷害的場合發動。那只怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: If a monster inflicts Battle Damage to a player, return the monster to its owner's hand.

name: Lava Battleguard
cn_text: ①：自己場上的「野蠻人2號」每有1只，這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
description: This card gains 500 ATK for each "Swamp Battleguard" you control.

name: Ring of Magnetism
cn_text: 自己場上的怪獸才可以裝備。裝備的怪獸攻擊力·守備力下降500。對方只能攻擊裝備了這張卡的怪獸。
description: You can only equip this card to a monster on your side of the field. Decrease the ATK and DEF of a monster equipped with this card by 500 points. In addition, all the monsters on your opponent's side of the field can only attack the monster equipped with this card, if they attack.

name: King Pyron
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●可以給與對方基本分1000分傷害。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? Once per turn, you can inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Hidden Soldiers
cn_text: 對方把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚時才能發動。從手卡把1只4星以下的暗屬性怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower DARK monster from your hand.

name: Dark Mirror Force
cn_text: 對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。對方場上守備表示存在的怪獸全部從游戲中除外。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Banish all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.

name: Key Mace #2
cn_text: 封印心中的良知，使對方成為惡魔的手下。
description: This fiend brings out the worst in everyone.

name: Exploder Dragon
cn_text:
①：這張卡的攻擊發生的雙方的戰斗傷害變成0。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。把讓這張卡破壞的怪獸破壞。
description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the monster that destroyed it. Neither player takes any battle damage from attacks involving this attacking card.

name: Peacock
cn_text: 展開美麗的羽毛，從而變成巨大的孔雀開狀。揚起羽毛作為攻擊手段。
description: A large peacock that launches its feathers in a lethal attack.

name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
cn_text: 自如運用各種武器，屬於光之戰士的元素英雄。神聖光輝電光一閃將切斷邪惡的退路。
description: An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.

name: Disarmament
cn_text: 將場上的裝備卡全部破壞。
description: Destroy all Equip Cards on the field.

name: Mask of Dispel
cn_text: 選1張場上的表側表示的魔法卡。被選的魔法卡的控制者在自己的每次准備階段受到500分的傷害。指定的卡的場上不存在的時候，這張卡破壞。
description: Select 1 face-up Spell Card on the field. The controller of the Spell Card takes 500 points of damage during each of your Standby Phases. When the selected card is removed from the field, destroy this card.

name: Rock Bombardment
cn_text: 選擇自己卡組1只岩石族怪獸送去墓地。給與對方基本分500分的傷害。之后洗切卡組。
description: Send 1 Rock-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Lizard Soldier
cn_text: 從龍派生出來的獸人種。在龍族之中體形小而敏捷。戰略性丰富。
description: A beast soldier derived from dragons, it is small for a Dragon-Type. Moving very quickly, this monster is an excellent strategist.

name: Wetlands
cn_text: 全部的水族·水屬性·2星以下怪獸的攻擊力上升1200。
description: All Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 2 or lower monsters gain 1200 ATK.

name: Ice Water
cn_text: 攻擊性美人魚。使用生長在身體表面的荊刺進行攻擊。
description: A very aggressive mermaid that attacks enemies with the spikes growing from its body.

name: Blue Medicine
cn_text: ①：自己回復400基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 400 points.

name: Shadowslayer
cn_name: 暗之住人 暗影殺手
cn_text: 對方的怪獸卡區域只有守備表示怪獸的場合，這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: If all monsters your opponent controls are in Defense Position, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Hayabusa Knight
cn_text: ①：這張卡在同1次的戰斗階段中可以作2次攻擊。
description: This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Blast Magician
cn_name: 血魔朮師-煉獄的魔朮師-
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置魔力指示物。可以把這張卡放置的魔力指示物任意數量取除，持有取除數量×700的數值以下的攻擊力的場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸破壞。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove any number of Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field with ATK less than or equal to the number of counters you removed x 700; destroy that target.

name: Altar for Tribute
cn_text: 選擇自己場上1只怪獸送去墓地。自己回復與此怪獸原本攻擊力數值相同的基本分。
description: Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send it to the Graveyard. Increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the original ATK of the monster.

name: XY-Dragon Cannon
cn_text:
「X-首領加農」＋「Y-龍頭」
把自己場上的上記卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚。這張卡不能作從墓地的特殊召喚。
①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1張表側表示的魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的表側表示的卡破壞。
description: "X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head"Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Goggle Golem
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡的原本攻擊力變成2100。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? The original ATK of this card becomes 2100.

name: St. Joan
cn_text: 「大慈大悲的修女」＋「墮天使 瑪麗」
description: "The Forgiving Maiden" + "Darklord Marie"

name: Hyosube
cn_text: 河童的首領，攻擊力意外的高，守備力偏低。
description: This amphibian is strong on the attack, but leaves much to be desired when defending.

name: The Wicked Avatar
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。把自己場上3只怪獸解放的場合才能通常召喚。
①：這張卡召喚成功的場合發動。用對方回合計算的2回合內，對方不能把魔法·陷阱卡發動。
②：這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成「邪神 神之化身」以外的場上的攻擊力最高的怪獸的攻擊力＋100的數值。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set except by Tributing 3 monsters. Your opponent cannot activate Spell or Trap Cards until the end of their 2nd turn after this card is Normal Summoned. The ATK and DEF of this card are each 100 points higher than the highest face-up monster's ATK on the field (except "The Wicked Avatar").

name: Destruction Ring
cn_text: 破壞自己場上1只表側表示的怪獸，雙方各受1000點傷害。
description: Destroy 1 face-up monster on your side of the field to inflict 1000 points of damage to both player's Life Points.

name: Trap Reclamation
cn_text: 自己把陷阱卡發動時，丟棄1張手卡連鎖發動。連鎖發動的陷阱卡被送去墓地時，那張卡回到手卡。
description: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Trap Card you activated. Whenever that Trap Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

name: Type Zero Magic Crusher
cn_text: 每把1張魔法卡從手卡丟棄，給與對方基本分500分的傷害。
description: Discard 1 Spell Card from your hand to inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Bone Mouse
cn_text: 被貓殺死的老鼠。為了報仇雪恨化為不死形態。
description: A mouse that has returned as a zombie to seek revenge on cats.

name: Pale Beast
cn_text: 青白色的皮膚，讓人感覺惡心的不明怪獸。
description: With skin tinged a bluish-white, this strange creature is a fearsome sight to behold.

name: Hysteric Fairy
cn_text: 用自己場上2只怪獸做祭品，自己的基本分回復1000分。
description: Tribute 2 monsters on your side of the field to increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Numinous Healer
cn_text: 自己因戰斗或者卡的效果受到傷害時才能發動。自己回復1000基本分。自己墓地有「白衣天使」存在的場合，再回復那個數量的500基本分。
description: You can only activate this card when you take damage to your Life Points. Increase your Life Points by 1000 points. Also, increase your Life Points by 500 points for each "Numinous Healer" card in your Graveyard.

name: Acid Rain
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的機械族怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all face-up Machine-Type monsters on the field.

name: Boar Soldier
cn_text: 被召喚的場合，這張卡破壞。對方控制?即使只有1只怪獸的場合，攻擊力下降1000。
description: If this card is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls 1 or more monsters, decrease the ATK of this card by 1000 points.

name: Asura Priest
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。召喚·反轉回合的結束階段時回到主人的手卡。可以對對方場上的全部怪獸攻擊1次。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

name: Dark Elf
cn_text: 這張卡不支付1000基本分不能攻擊。
description: This card requires a cost of 1000 of your own Life Points to attack.

name: Blasting the Ruins
cn_text: 當自己墓地里存在30張以上卡的場合這張卡才能發動。給與對方基本分3000分的傷害。
description: You can only activate this card if there are 30 or more cards in your Graveyard. Inflict 3000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Radiant Mirror Force
cn_text: 對方場上攻擊表示怪獸有3只以上存在的場合，對方的攻擊宣言時才能發動。對方場上的攻擊表示怪獸全部破壞。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control 3 or more Attack Position monsters: Destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.

name: Jam Defender
cn_text: 對方的怪獸對自己的怪獸攻擊的時候，自己的場上的「再生史萊姆」表側表示存在的場合，攻擊對象移去「再生史萊姆」。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a monster you control: You can target 1 "Revival Jam" you control; switch the attack target to that target.

name: Cyber Prima
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚的場合發動。場上的表側表示的魔法卡全部破壞。
description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Destroy all face-up Spell Cards on the field.

name: Makyura the Destructor
cn_text:
這個卡名的效果1回合只能使用1次。
①：這張卡從怪獸區域送去墓地的場合才能發動。這個回合只有1次，自己可以把陷阱卡從手卡發動。
description: During the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard, you can activate Trap Cards from your hand.

name: A Hero Emerges
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。自己1張手卡由對方隨機選。那是怪獸的場合，在自己場上特殊召喚，不是的場合送去墓地。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card from your hand, then if it is a monster that can be Special Summoned, Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.

name: Fairy Box
cn_text:
這張卡的控制者在每次自己准備階段支付500基本分。或者不支付基本分讓這張卡破壞。
①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時發動。進行1次投擲硬幣，對里表作猜測。猜中的場合，那只攻擊怪獸的攻擊力只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在直到戰斗階段結束時變成0。
description: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, the attacking monster's ATK becomes 0 until the end of the Battle Phase. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 500 Life Points or destroy this card.

name: Jam Breeding Machine
cn_text: 每次自己的准備階段，在自己場上把1只「史萊姆怪獸衍生物」（水族·水·1星·攻/守500）攻擊表示特殊召喚。只要這張卡在場上存在，自己不能把「史萊姆怪獸衍生物」以外的怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
description: During each of your Standby Phases: Special Summon 1 "Slime Token" (Aqua-Type/WATER/LEVEL 1/ATK 500/DEF 500) in Attack Position. You cannot Summon any monsters, except "Slime Tokens" (but you can Set).

name: Mega Thunderball
cn_text: 在地止旋轉，向周圍發出電擊的球。
description: Rolls along the ground releasing bolts of electricity to attack its enemies.

name: Hidden Spellbook
cn_text: 這張卡在自己回合才能發動。選擇自己墓地存在的2張魔法卡，加入卡組洗切。
description: During your turn: Target 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle those targets into the Deck.

name: Elemental HERO Avian
cn_text: 擁有操縱風在天空飛舞之翼的元素英雄。以來自天空的一擊羽翼擊破來審判邪惡。
description: A winged Elemental HERO who wheels through the sky and manipulates the wind. His signature move, Featherbreak, gives villainy a blow from sky-high.

name: Fenrir
cn_text: 這張卡不能進行通常召喚。從自己墓地里除外2只水屬性怪獸進行特殊召喚。這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸時，略過對方的下一個抽卡階段。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard from play. When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips his/her next Draw Phase.

name: Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce
cn_text: 從手卡送去墓地1張卡，這張卡才能進行裝備。裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力下降500點。裝備這張卡的怪獸在同1個戰斗階段中可以進行2次攻擊。
description: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; equip this card to a monster. It loses 500 ATK, but it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Gambler of Legend
cn_text:
進行3次投擲硬幣。
●3次都是表的場合，對方場上怪獸全部破壞。
●2次表的場合，對方手卡隨機丟棄1張。
●1次表的場合，自己場上存在的1張卡破壞。
●3次都是里的場合，自己手卡全部丟棄。
這個效果1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段才能使用。
description: Once per turn, you can toss a coin 3 times and apply the appropriate effect: ? 3 Heads: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. ? 2 Heads: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand. ? 1 Head: Destroy 1 card you control. ? 3 Tails: Discard your entire hand.

name: Curtain of the Dark Ones
cn_text: 魔朮師制作的窗簾。據說可以提升魔法師的力量。
description: A curtain that a spellcaster made, it is said to raise a dark power.

name: Book of Life
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只不死族怪獸和對方墓地1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只自己的不死族怪獸特殊召喚。那只對方怪獸除外。
