description: Target 1 Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard and 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon the first target, also banish the second target.

name: Megamorph
cn_text: ①：自己基本分比對方少的場合，裝備怪獸的攻擊力變成原本攻擊力的2倍。自己基本分比對方多的場合，裝備怪獸的攻擊力變成原本攻擊力的一半。
description: While your LP is lower than your opponent's, the equipped monster's ATK becomes double its original ATK. While your LP is higher, the equipped monster's ATK becomes half its original ATK.

name: Vampire Genesis
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上存在的1只「吸血鬼領主」從游戲中除外的場合才能特殊召喚。1回合1次，可以通過從手卡把1只不死族怪獸丟棄去墓地，從自己墓地選擇1只比丟棄的不死族怪獸等級低的不死族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Vampire Lord" you control, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 Zombie-Type monster to the Graveyard, then target 1 Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard with a Level less than the discarded Zombie-Type monster's; Special Summon that target.

name: Mirror Wall
cn_text:
這張卡的控制者在每次自己准備階段支付2000基本分。或者不支付基本分讓這張卡破壞。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，對方的攻擊怪獸的攻擊力變成一半。
description: Each of your opponent's monsters that conducted an attack while this card was face-up on the field has its ATK halved as long as this card remains on the field. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 2000 LP or destroy this card.

name: Aquarian Alessa
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地時，對方手卡隨機丟棄1張。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, they discard 1 random card.

name: Ultra Evolution Pill
cn_text: 祭掉自己場上1只爬蟲類族怪獸。從手卡特殊召喚1只恐龍族怪獸上場。
description: Tribute 1 Reptile-Type monster; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your hand.

name: Multiplication of Ants
cn_text: 祭掉自己場上1只昆蟲族怪獸發動。在自己場上特殊召喚2只「兵隊衍生物」（地·4星·昆蟲族·攻500·守1200）。（不能用作上級召喚的祭品）
description: Tribute 1 Insect-Type Monster on your side of the field. Special Summon 2 "Army Ant Tokens" (Insect-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 500/DEF 1200) on your side of the field. The tokens cannot be used as a Tribute for a Tribute Summon.

name: Mechanical Hound
cn_text: 只要自己手卡數目是0張，對方不能發動魔法卡。
description: While you have no cards in your hand, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards.

name: Sebek's Blessing
cn_text: ①：自己怪獸直接攻擊給與對方戰斗傷害時才能發動。自己基本分回復那個數值。
description: Activate only when a monster you control has attacked your opponent directly. Gain Life Points equal to the Battle Damage that the monster inflicted to your opponent.

name: Nimble Momonga
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，自己回復1000基本分。并且可以再從卡組把「迅捷鼯鼠」任意數量里側守備表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 Life Points, then you can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momongas" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

name: Hydrogeddon
cn_text: ①：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只「氫素龍」特殊召喚。
description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

name: Reload
cn_text: 將自己的全部手卡放回卡組。那之后，抽與放回卡組的卡數量相同的卡。
description: Add all cards in your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your Deck.

name: Mataza the Zapper
cn_text: 這張卡在同1個戰斗階段中可以進行2次攻擊。這張卡在場上以表側表示存在時，控制權不能被變更。
description: This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. Control of this face-up card on the field cannot switch.

name: The Mask of Remnants
cn_text:
①：這張卡回到持有者卡組。
②：這張卡用「假面魔獸 死亡護法師」的效果裝備中的場合，得到裝備怪獸的控制權。
description: Shuffle this card into its owner's Deck, OR if this card was put into play by the effect of "Masked Beast Des Gardius", this card is treated as an Equip Card. Control of the equipped monster is switched.

name: Umi
cn_text: 全部魚族·海龍族·雷族·水族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力上升200。機械族·炎族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力下降200。
description: Increase the ATK and DEF of all Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua-Type monsters by 200 points. Decrease the ATK and DEF of all Machine and Pyro-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚的場合發動。給這張卡放置3個指示物。
②：這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。
③：1回合1次，以對方場上1只表側攻擊表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側攻擊表示怪獸變成表側守備表示。
④：這張卡進行戰斗的傷害步驟結束時發動。這張卡1個指示物取除。不能取除的場合，這張卡破壞。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

name: Archfiend's Oath
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，支付500基本分，宣言1個卡名才能發動。自己卡組最上面的卡翻開，宣言的卡的場合，那張卡加入手卡。不是的場合，翻開的卡送去墓地。
description: Once per turn: You can pay 500 Life Points, then declare 1 card name; excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, send it to the Graveyard.

name: Fiend Sword
cn_text: 據說戰勝施加在身上的詛咒的人就可以以此獲得力量。
description: Whoever resists the curse of this blade will gain untold power.

name: Green Phantom King
cn_text: 居住在被綠樹包圍的地方，統治森林的年輕國王。
description: This youthful king of the forests lives in a green world, abundant with trees and wildlife.

name: Dimensionhole
cn_text: 選自己場上的1只怪獸，在自己的下次的准備階段之前除外。除外的時候，被選擇的怪獸的怪獸區的位置不能使用。
description: Select 1 monster on your side of the field and remove it from play until your next Standby Phase. While the monster is removed from play, the Monster Card Zone of the selected monster cannot be used.

name: Behemoth the King of All Animals
cn_text:
這張卡可以把1只怪獸解放作上級召喚。
①：這個方法上級召喚的這張卡的原本攻擊力變成2000。
②：這張卡上級召喚時，以為這張卡的上級召喚而解放的怪獸數量的自己墓地的獸族怪獸為對象才能發動。那些獸族怪獸加入手卡。
description: This card can be Normal Summoned or Set with 1 Tribute. In that case, the original ATK of this card becomes 2000. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can return from your Graveyard to the owner's hand a number of Beast-Type monsters equal to the number of Tributed monsters.

name: Overdrive
cn_text: 裝備?重型機槍的裝甲車，再惡劣的地形都能逾越。
description: An all-terrain armored vehicle armed with a heavy-duty machine gun.

name: Element Doom
cn_text:
這只怪獸在場上有特定的屬性的怪獸存在的場合，得到以下的效果。
●地屬性：這張卡戰斗破壞的效果怪獸的效果無效化。
●風屬性：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，只有1次可以再度攻擊。
description: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: ? EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle. ? WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

name: Dark Magic Attack
cn_text: ①：自己場上有「黑魔朮師」存在的場合才能發動。對方場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: If you control "Dark Magician": Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

name: Limiter Removal
cn_text: ①：自己場上的全部機械族怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時變成2倍。這個回合的結束階段，這個效果適用中的怪獸破壞。
description: Double the ATK of all Machine monsters you currently control, until the end of this turn. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy those monsters.

name: Spirit Reaper
cn_text:
①：這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。
②：這張卡直接攻擊給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。對方手卡隨機選1張丟棄。
③：場上的表側表示的這張卡成為效果的對象的場合破壞。
description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After resolving a card effect that targets this face-up card, destroy this card. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

name: Cost Down
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡才能發動。這個回合，自己手卡的怪獸的等級下降2星。
description: Discard 1 card; until the End Phase, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

name: Heavy Mech Support Platform
cn_name: 強化支援機械·重裝武器
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●以自己場上1只機械族怪獸為對象，把這張卡當作裝備卡使用給那只怪獸裝備。裝備怪獸被戰斗·效果破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。
●裝備的這張卡特殊召喚。
②：裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升500。
description: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 500 ATK and DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

name: Des Lacooda
cn_text:
①：自己主要階段才能發動。這張卡變成里側守備表示（1回合只有1次）。
②：這張卡反轉召喚成功的場合發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Draw 1 card.

name: Karate Man
cn_text: 1回合1次，自己的主要階段時才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力直到結束階段時變成原本攻擊力2倍的數值。這個效果使用的場合，這張卡在結束階段時破壞。
description: You can double the original ATK of this card once per turn. If you used this effect, destroy this card during the End Phase.

name: Infernal Incinerator
cn_name: 炎獄魔人 地獄焚魔
cn_text: 不把除這張卡外的自己手卡全部丟棄去墓地，并用自己場上1只攻擊力2000以上的怪獸作為祭品不能通常召喚。對方場上每存在1只怪獸，這張卡的攻擊力上升200。自己場上這張卡以外的怪獸每存在1只，這張卡的攻擊力下降500。
description: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.

name: Senju of the Thousand Hands
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚時才能發動。從卡組把1只儀式怪獸加入手卡。
description: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Wasteland
cn_text: 全部恐龍族·不死族·岩石族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力上升200。
description: Increases the ATK and DEF of all Dinosaur, Zombie, and Rock-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Solomon's Lawbook
cn_text: 下次的自己的准備階段跳過。
description: Skip your next Standby Phase.

name: Summon Limit
cn_text: ①：這個回合中對怪獸的召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚已有合計2次以上成功的玩家只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，不能把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
description: Neither player can Summon more than two times per turn. (Negated Summons count toward this limit. Negated cards/effects that would Summon do not count.)

name: Dimension Fusion
cn_text: 支付2000基本分。雙方將各自被除外的怪獸盡可能特殊召喚上場。
description: Pay 2000 Life Points. Both players Special Summon as many of their removed from play monsters as possible.

name: Great Long Nose
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。召喚·反轉回合的結束階段時回到主人的手卡。這張卡給與對方玩家戰斗傷害的場合，跳過下次的對方回合的戰斗階段。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent skips their next Battle Phase.

name: Insect Barrier
cn_text: 對方場上存在的全部昆蟲族的怪獸不能宣言攻擊。
description: Insect-Type monsters your opponent controls cannot declare an attack.

name: Light of Redemption
cn_text: ①：支付800基本分，以除外的1只自己的光屬性怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸加入手卡。
description: Pay 800 Life Points, then target 1 of your banished LIGHT monsters; add that target to your hand.

name: Jerry Beans Man
cn_text: 名叫軟糖的豆戰士。雖堅信自己就是世界最強的戰士，其實力不得而知。
description: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

name: Sea King Dragon
cn_text: 海之王。長有堅硬的貝殼，從口中吐出水泡攻擊。
description: Protected by a tough shell, this master of the sea attacks its enemies with toxic bubbles.

name: Steel Shell
cn_text: 水屬性怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升400，守備力下降200。
description: A WATER monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

name: Allure Queen LV5
cn_text:
①：這張卡是已用「魅惑的女王 LV3」的效果特殊召喚的場合，1回合1次，以對方場上1只5星以下的怪獸為對象才能發動。那只5星以下的對方怪獸當作裝備魔法卡使用給這張卡裝備（只有1只可以裝備）。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡的效果裝備的怪獸破壞。
③：自己准備階段，把用這張卡的效果把怪獸裝備的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「魅惑的女王 LV7」特殊召喚。
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Allure Queen LV3", you can select 1 Level 5 or lower monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card. (Only 1 card at a time can be equipped due to this effect.) If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead. During your Standby Phase, by sending this card to the Graveyard while it's equipped due to its effect, Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen LV7" from your hand or Deck.

name: 7 Colored Fish
cn_text: 非常珍奇的七色魚，要捕捉它非常困難。
description: A rare rainbow fish that has never been caught by mortal man.

name: Nitro Unit
cn_text: 對方場上的怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，給與對方基本分裝備怪獸攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: Equip only to a monster on your opponent's side of the field. When the equipped monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the equipped monster.

name: Fossil Excavation
cn_text:
①：丟棄1張手卡，以自己墓地1只恐龍族怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只恐龍族怪獸特殊召喚。
②：這張卡的①的效果特殊召喚的怪獸只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在效果無效化，這張卡從場上離開時破壞。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by discarding 1 card, then target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. Its effects are negated. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
cn_text: 「青眼白龍」＋「青眼白龍」＋「青眼白龍」
description: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"

name: Just Desserts
cn_text: ①：給與對方為對方場上的怪獸數量×500傷害。
description: Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Polymerization
cn_text: ①：自己的手卡·場上的怪獸作為融合素材，把1只融合怪獸融合召喚。
description: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials.

name: Double Spell
cn_text: 從手卡丟棄1張魔法卡，選擇對方墓地1張魔法卡才能發動。選擇的魔法卡在自己場上的正確卡區域放置并使用。
description: Discard 1 Spell Card, then target 1 Spell Card in your opponent's Graveyard; place that target in the appropriate Zone on your side of the field, and as this card's effect resolution, follow its card text as if you had used it yourself.

name: Deepsea Warrior
cn_text: 只要「海」在場上存在，這張卡不會受到魔法的效果。
description: As long as "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

name: A Cat of Ill Omen
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。從卡組選1張陷阱卡在卡組最上面放置。「王家長眠之谷」在場上存在的場合，那張陷阱卡可以作為在卡組最上面放置的代替而加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck. If "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add the selected card to your hand instead.

name: Dorover
cn_text: 粘呼呼的令人感到惡心的怪獸。吐出劇毒的瓦斯進行攻擊。
description: This ugly monster emits a highly poisonous gas.

name: Ballista of Rampart Smashing
cn_text: 裝備怪獸攻擊里側守備怪獸的場合，裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升1500。
description: If the equipped monster attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, it gains 1500 ATK during damage calculation only.

name: Protector of the Sanctuary
cn_text: 當這張卡在場上以表側表示存在時，對方不能在抽卡階段以外進行抽卡。
description: Your opponent cannot draw cards except during Draw Phases.

name: Burning Land
cn_text: 這張卡的發動時，場上的場地魔法卡全部破壞。此外，雙方的准備階段時，回合玩家受到500分傷害。
description: When this card is activated: If there are any Field Spell Cards on the field, destroy them. During each player's Standby Phase: The turn player takes 500 damage.

name: Zoa
cn_text: 據說會通過金屬化來發揮真正力量的怪獸。
description: A monster whose full potential can be achieved when outfitted with "Metalmorph".

name: The Bewitching Phantom Thief
cn_text: 披?黑色披風裝模作樣的怪盜。揮?手杖迷惑對方。
description: An elegant thief with a black cloak that charms its enemies.

name: Pendulum Machine
cn_text: 大型單擺刀刃把對方劈成兩半！很恐怖的拷問機械。
description: A horrible torture machine with a large pendulum blade.

name: Mermaid Knight
cn_text: ①：只要場上有「海」存在，這張卡在同1次的戰斗階段中可以作2次攻擊。
description: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

name: Master Kyonshee
cn_text: 一直在尋找強大對方的僵尸。傳說是一個武朮高手。
description: A wandering Kyonshee searching for a strong rival to defeat. They say he was known as the master of all martial arts.

name: Marauding Captain
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚成功時才能發動。從手卡把1只4星以下的怪獸特殊召喚。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方不能選擇其他的戰士族怪獸作為攻擊對象。
description: Your opponent cannot target Warrior monsters for attacks, except this one. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand.

name: Ryu-Kishin Powered
cn_text: 得到黑暗力量而被強化的石像怪。注意?爪！
description: A gargoyle enhanced by the powers of darkness. Very sharp talons make it a worthy opponent.

name: Disappear
cn_text: 選擇對方墓地的1張卡從游戲中除外。
description: Remove from play 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard.

name: Ojamagic
cn_text: ①：這張卡從手卡·場上送去墓地的場合發動。從卡組把「擾亂·綠」「擾亂·黃」「擾亂·黑」各1只加入手卡。
description: When this card is sent from the hand or the field to the Graveyard, add 1 each of "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Germ Infection
cn_text: 機械族以外的怪獸裝備可能。裝備怪獸的攻擊力在每次的自己的准備階段攻擊力下降300。
description: The ATK of a non Machine-Type monster equipped with this card is decreased by 300 points at each of its Standby Phases.

name: Sealmaster Meisei
cn_text: 少數會使用封印符咒的人物。其來曆至今還都是個謎團。
description: One of the few people who has a good command of Talismans. His history is a mystery.

name: Water Omotics
cn_text: 從瓶中不斷流淌的水，變成龍的形狀發動攻擊。
description: Transforms the water overflowing from a jar into attacking dragons.

name: Van'Dalgyon the Dark Dragon Lord
cn_text:
對方控制的卡的發動用反擊陷阱無效的場合，這張卡可以從手卡特殊召喚。這個方法特殊召喚成功時，把無效的卡種類的以下效果發動。
●魔法：給與對方基本分1500分傷害。
●陷阱：選擇對方場上1張卡破壞。
●效果怪獸：從自己墓地選擇1只怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: If you negate the activation of an opponent's Spell/Trap Card(s), or opponent's monster effect(s), with a Counter Trap Card (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If Summoned this way, activate these effects and resolve in sequence, depending on the type of card(s) negated by that Counter Trap:? Spell: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.? Trap: Target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.? Monster: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

name: Fiend's Sanctuary
cn_text: ①：在自己場上把1只「金屬惡魔衍生物」（惡魔族·暗·1星·攻/守0）特殊召喚。這衍生物不能攻擊，這衍生物的戰斗發生的對控制者的戰斗傷害由對方代受。這衍生物的控制者在每次自己准備階段支付1000基本分。或者不支付基本分讓這衍生物破壞。
description: Special Summon 1 "Metal Fiend Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). It cannot attack. Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving it. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 1000 LP or destroy this Token.

name: Skull Knight
cn_text: 「惡魔的智慧」＋「魔天老」
description: "Tainted Wisdom" + "Ancient Brain"

name: The Little Swordsman of Aile
cn_text: 每用自己場上存在的這張卡以外的1只怪獸做祭品，這張卡的攻擊力在回合結束前加700。
description: Offer 1 monster on your side of the field as a Tribute to increase this monster's ATK by 700 points until the end of the turn.

name: YZ-Tank Dragon
cn_text:
「Y-龍頭」＋「Z-金屬履帶」
把自己場上的上記卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚。這張卡不能作從墓地的特殊召喚。
①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1只里側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的里側表示怪獸破壞。
description: "Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Straight Flush
cn_text: 對方場上的魔法與陷阱卡區域全部有卡存在的場合才能發動。對方的魔法與陷阱卡區域存在的卡全部破壞。
description: Activate only when all of your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones are occupied. Destroy all cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones.

name: Rare Metal Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚，用卡的效果才能特殊召喚。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set.

name: Level Up!
cn_text: 把場上表側表示存在的名字有「LV」的怪獸送去墓地發動。那張卡上面記述的怪獸，無視召喚條件從手卡·卡組特殊召喚。
description: Send 1 face-up "LV" monster you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is listed in the sent monster's text, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

name: Spirit of the Pharaoh
cn_text: 這張卡不能進行通常召喚。這張卡只能通過「第一之棺」的效果進行特殊召喚。這張卡特殊召喚成功時，可以從自己的墓地里特殊召喚至多4只2星以下的不死族通常怪獸上場。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus". When this card is Special Summoned, you can Special Summon up to 4 Level 2 or lower Zombie-Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard.

name: After the Struggle
cn_text: 只能在主要階段一發動。這個回合經過了戰斗傷害計算的自己·對方怪獸在結束步驟時全部破壞。
description: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. All monsters on both sides of the field that have been involved in damage calculation are destroyed during the End Step of the turn.

name: Blowback Dragon
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，以對方場上1張卡為對象才能發動。進行3次投擲硬幣，那之內2次以上是表的場合，那張對方的卡破壞。
description: Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times, and destroy that target if at least 2 of the results are Heads.

name: Transcendent Wings
cn_text: 把自己場上存在的1只「羽翼栗子球」和2張手卡送到墓地。從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「羽翼栗子球 LV10」上場。
description: Send 1 "Winged Kuriboh" you control and 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Winged Kuriboh LV10" from your hand or Deck.

name: Two-Man Cell Battle
cn_text: 雙方在各自的回合的結束階段只有1次，可以從手卡特殊召喚1只4星的通常怪獸上場。
description: During each player's End Phase, the turn player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 Normal Monster from their hand.

name: Queen's Knight
cn_text: 用優美的動作愚弄敵人，抓住對方的空隙快速發出攻擊。
description: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

name: Bickuribox
cn_text: 「殺人小丑」＋「夢幻小丑」
description: "Crass Clown" + "Dream Clown"

name: Machine Conversion Factory
cn_text: 機械族怪獸可以裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: A Machine-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Legendary Jujitsu Master
cn_text: 與守備表示的這張卡進行戰斗的怪獸在傷害步驟終了時彈回其持有者的卡組的最上面。
description: If this Defense Position card battled a monster, at the end of the Damage Step: Place that monster on the top of the Deck.

name: Mystic Box
cn_text: ①：以自己以及對方場上的怪獸各1只為對象才能發動。那只對方怪獸破壞。那之后，那只自己怪獸的控制權移給對方。
description: Target 1 monster your opponent controls and 1 monster you control; destroy the first target, then give control of the second target to your opponent.

name: Gate Guardian
cn_name: 門之守護神 雷·風·水魔獸
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上的「雷魔神-桑迦」「風魔神-修迦」「水魔神-斯迦」各1只解放的場合可以特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Sanga of the Thunder", "Kazejin", and "Suijin".

name: Block Attack
cn_text: 指定的對方場上的1只表側表示的怪獸轉為守備表示。
description: Select 1 face-up Attack Position monster on your opponent's side of the field and change it to Defense Position.

name: Dokuroizo the Grim Reaper
cn_text: 使用地獄一擊奪取靈魂的死神。
description: A messenger of doom that steals a soul with a single blow.

name: Sanga of the Thunder
cn_text: ①：只在這張卡在場上表側表示存在才有1次，這張卡被攻擊的傷害計算時，以1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸的攻擊力變成0。
description: During damage calculation in your opponent's turn, if this card is being attacked: You can target the attacking monster; make that target's ATK 0 during damage calculation only (this is a Quick Effect). This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Enervating Mist
cn_text: 對方手卡數量限制變成最多5張。
description: Your opponent's hand size limit becomes 5.

name: Vengeful Shinobi
cn_text: 場上表側攻擊表示存在的這張卡被選擇作為攻擊對象時，從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: When this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Draw 1 card.

name: Invasion of Flames
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，陷阱卡不能發動。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

name: Super Double Summon
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只二重怪獸，變成再度召喚的狀態。這個回合的結束階段時，選擇的二重怪獸回到手卡。
description: Select 1 Gemini monster you control and Normal Summon it. During the End Phase of this turn, return it to your hand.

name: Pinch Hopper
cn_text: ①：這張卡從自己場上送去墓地時才能發動。從手卡把1只昆蟲族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When this card you control is sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster from your hand.

name: Sangan
cn_text:
這個卡名的效果1回合只能使用1次。
①：這張卡從場上送去墓地的場合發動。從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的怪獸加入手卡。這個回合，自己不能把這個效果加入手卡的卡以及那些同名卡的效果發動。
description: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand, but you cannot activate cards, or the effects of cards, with that name for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Sangan" once per turn.

name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚成功的場合發動。對方手卡隨機選1張丟棄。丟棄的卡是怪獸卡的場合，給與對方那只怪獸的等級×100傷害。
description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 100.

name: Gemini Lancer
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當成通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡變成當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡攻擊守備表示怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Blast Sphere
cn_text:
①：里側守備表示的這張卡被對方怪獸攻擊的傷害計算前發動。這張卡當作裝備卡使用給那只攻擊怪獸裝備。
②：用這張卡的效果把這張卡裝備的下次的對方准備階段發動。裝備怪獸破壞，給與對方那個攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: If this face-down Defense Position card was attacked by an opponent's monster, before damage calculation: Equip this card to the attacking monster. Then, during your opponent's next Standby Phase: Destroy the monster this card is equipped to, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK the destroyed monster had on the field.

name: Copycat
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時，選擇對方場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸發動。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成和選擇的怪獸的原本的攻擊力·守備力相同數值。
description: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; this card's ATK and DEF become equal to that monster's original ATK and DEF.

name: Rude Kaiser
cn_text: 雙手持有的魔人之斧的破壞力相當強大！
description: With an axe in each hand, this monster delivers heavy damage.

name: Hammer Shot
cn_text: ①：場上的攻擊表示怪獸之內攻擊力最高的1只怪獸破壞。
description: Destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster with the highest ATK. (If it is a tie, you get to choose.)

name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，卡名當作「電子龍」使用。
description: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field.

name: Vampire Lady
cn_text: 每當這張卡對對方造成戰斗傷害時，宣言1個卡的種類（怪獸·魔法·陷阱），對方從其卡組中選擇1張此種類的卡送去墓地。
description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Fiend Scorpion
cn_text: 寄宿?惡魔靈魂的巨大蠍子。平時蘊存?力量，但是潛在的能力很高。
description: A huge scorpion inhabited by the soul of a fiend. Usually it holds back, but has untapped potential.

name: Sage of Silence
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，對方玩家在下個回合不能發動魔法卡。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards during the next turn.

name: Card Ejector
cn_text: 選擇對方墓地存在的1張卡從游戲中除外。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn: You can target 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard; banish that target.

name: Hyper Hammerhead
cn_text: 與這張卡進行戰斗且未被破壞的對方怪獸，在傷害步驟終了時彈回其持有者手卡。
description: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

name: Exile of the Wicked
cn_text: 場上的惡魔族怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all face-up Fiend-Type monsters on the field.

name: Fusion Sage
cn_text: 選1張自己的卡組的「融合」加入手卡。之后洗切卡組。
description: Add 1 "Polymerization" card from your Deck to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Metal Reflect Slime
cn_text:
①：這張卡發動后變成效果怪獸（水族·水·10星·攻0/守3000）在怪獸區域守備表示特殊召喚（也當作陷阱卡使用）。
②：這張卡的效果特殊召喚的這張卡不能攻擊。
description: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua-Type/WATER/Level 10/ATK 0/DEF 3000). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) This card cannot attack.

name: Formation Union
cn_text:
從下面效果選擇1個發動：
●選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只同盟怪獸，給自己場上表側表示存在的可以裝備的怪獸裝備。
●把自己場上存在的1只當作裝備卡使用的同盟怪獸的裝備解除，在自己場上表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: Select and activate 1 of the following effects:? Equip 1 Union Monster on your side of the field to an appropriate monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card.? Unequip 1 of your equipped Union Monsters and Special Summon it to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position.

name: Javelin Beetle
cn_text: 借由「標槍甲蟲的契約」降臨。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為8個以上的卡。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Javelin Beetle Pact".

name: Medusa Worm
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合1次可以變成里側守備表示。這張卡反轉召喚成功時，對方場上1只怪獸破壞。
description: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Release from Stone
cn_text: 選擇1只被除外的自己的岩石族怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時，那只怪獸破壞。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: Select 1 of your removed from play Rock-Type monsters and Special Summon it. When this card is removed from the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Atlantean Pikeman
cn_text: 服侍?據說為海底支配者的海皇的長槍兵。從深暗海底襲擊過來的長槍的連續攻擊為深海魚類們所畏懼。
description: The Great Ocean Lord, who reigns over the depths, is served by these lancers. Deep-sea creatures exist in fear of facing the stream of attacks their lances are capable of.

name: Secret Barrel
cn_text: ①：給與對方為對方的手卡·場上的卡數量×200傷害。
description: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand and for each card they control.

name: Firewing Pegasus
cn_text: 展開顏色鮮艷的真紅之翼，從天上飛馳而過的天馬。
description: A heavenly stallion soaring through the skies on crimson wings.

name: Graveyard and the Hand of Invitation
cn_text: 給予死者進一步提升的力量，引誘生者步向死亡的墓場。
description: A graveyard that serves as a power source for zombies.

name: Thousand-Eyes Idol
cn_text: 操縱人心的邪神。千只邪眼會看透人的負面之心并使其增大。
description: A wicked entity that controls the hearts of men, its thousand eyes are able to see and expand the negative influences in an individual's soul.

name: Fire Sorcerer
cn_text: 反轉：自己的手卡隨機選2張除外。對方受到800分的傷害。
description: FLIP: Randomly select 2 cards from your hand and remove them from play to inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Master of Oz
cn_text: 「巨大樹熊」＋「死亡袋鼠」
description: "Big Koala" + "Des Kangaroo"

name: Return from the Different Dimension
cn_text: 把基本分支付一半才能發動。從游戲中除外的自己怪獸盡可能在自己場上特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸在結束階段時從游戲中除外。
description: Pay half your Life Points; Special Summon as many of your banished monsters as possible. During the End Phase, banish all monsters that were Special Summoned by this effect.

name: Mokey Mokey
cn_text: 一點也搞不明白究竟在想什么的孤僻天使。偶爾生起氣來很恐怖。
description: An outcast angel. Nobody knows what he is thinking at all. Sometimes he gets mad and that is dreadful.

name: Decoy Dragon
cn_text: ①：這張卡被選擇作為攻擊對象的場合，以自己墓地1只7星以上的龍族怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚，攻擊對象轉移為那只怪獸進行傷害計算。
description: If this card is targeted for an attack: Target 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it, and if you do, change the attack target to it and perform damage calculation.

name: Wattkid
cn_text: 雷屬性攻擊異常厲害，若輕視它則會遭到電擊。
description: A creature that electrocutes opponents with bolts of lightning.

name: Golden Homunculus
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升從游戲中除外的自己的卡數量×300的數值。
description: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each of your banished cards.

name: Limit Reverse
cn_text: 從自己墓地選擇1只攻擊力1000以下的怪獸，攻擊表示特殊召喚。那只怪獸變成守備表示時，那只怪獸和這張卡破壞。這張卡從場上離開時，那只怪獸破壞。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: Target 1 monster with 1000 or less ATK in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Attack Position. If the target is changed to Defense Position, destroy it and this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the target. When the target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: The Unhappy Girl
cn_text: 以表側攻擊表示存在的這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。只要這張卡以表側攻擊表示存在於場上，與這張卡進行過戰斗的怪獸不能再攻擊及改變表示形式。（傷害計算適用）
description: While this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field, this card is not destroyed as a result of battle. (Damage calculation is applied normally.) A monster that battled with this card cannot change its battle position, except with a card effect, or attack while this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field.

name: Lightning Conger
cn_text: 傳說中由小電鰻能夠進化而成為雷電鰻。
description: This massive eel generates huge charges of electricity and unleashes them as thunderbolts.

name: Absolute End
cn_text: 只能在對方回合發動。這個回合對方怪獸的攻擊，全部變成對玩家的直接攻擊。
description: Activate only during your opponent's turn. This turn, the attacks from your opponent's monsters become direct attacks.

name: Super Rejuvenation
cn_text: ①：這張卡發動的回合的結束階段，自己從卡組抽出這個回合從自己手卡丟棄的龍族怪獸以及這個回合從自己的手卡·場上解放的龍族怪獸的數量。
description: During the End Phase of the turn this card was activated, draw a number of cards equal to the combined number of Dragon-Type monsters you discarded or Tributed from your hand or your side of the field this turn.

name: Makiu, the Magical Mist
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能進行戰斗階段。
①：以自己的怪獸區域1只「惡魔召喚」或者雷族怪獸為對象才能發動。持有那只怪獸的攻擊力以下的守備力的對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Target 1 "Summoned Skull" or Thunder-Type monster you control; destroy all monsters your opponent controls with DEF less than or equal to the ATK of that monster. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

name: Parasite Paracide
cn_text: 反轉：把這張卡表面向上混進對方卡組洗切。對方抽到這張卡時，這張卡在對方場上表側守備表示特殊召喚，給與對方基本分1000分傷害。之后，只要這張卡表側表示在場上存在，對方場上表側表示存在的怪獸全部變成昆蟲族。
description: FLIP: Put this card face-up in your opponent's Deck and shuffle it. When your opponent draws this card, it is Special Summoned to their side of the field in face-up Defense Position, and inflicts 1000 damage to them. Then, while this card is face-up on the field, all monsters your opponent controls become Insect-Type monsters.

name: Servant of Catabolism
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Harpie Lady 2
cn_text: 這張卡的卡名當作「鷹身女郎」使用。這只怪獸戰斗破壞的反轉效果怪獸的效果無效化。
description: (This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)Negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters this card destroys by battle.

name: Fusion Weapon
cn_text: 6星以下的融合怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升1500。
description: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Fusion Monster. The equipped monster gains 1500 ATK and DEF.

name: The Judgement Hand
cn_text: 用寄宿?神靈的手作最后的判決，給予敵人以猛烈的攻擊。
description: An all-powerful hand that delivers ruthless attacks.

name: Cestus of Dagla
cn_text: 只有天使族怪獸能裝備這張卡。裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力上升500點。裝備這張卡的怪獸對對方造成戰斗傷害時，自己回復與傷害數值相同的基本分。
description: Equip only to a Fairy-Type monster. It gains 500 ATK. If it inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Gain LP equal to the damage inflicted.

name: Really Eternal Rest
cn_text: 破壞場上所有裝備了裝備卡的怪獸。
description: Destroy all monsters equipped with an Equip Card(s).

name: Roc from the Valley of Haze
cn_text: 這張卡從手卡送去墓地時，這張卡加入卡組并且洗切。
description: When this card is sent directly from your hand to the Graveyard, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it.

name: Curse of Dragon
cn_text: 邪惡之龍。使用黑暗力量的攻擊強而有力。
description: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

name: Necroface
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚成功的場合發動。除外的雙方的卡全部回到持有者卡組。這張卡的攻擊力上升這個效果回到卡組的數量×100。
②：這張卡被除外的場合發動。雙方玩家各自從自身卡組上面把5張卡除外。
description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Shuffle all banished cards into the Deck. This card gains 100 ATK for each card shuffled into the Main Deck by this effect. If this card is banished: Each player banishes 5 cards from the top of their Deck (or their entire Deck, if less than 5).

name: Flame Viper
cn_text: 敏捷的行動、從口中吐出火焰的蛇。
description: A fire-breathing snake whose speed makes it a difficult target.

name: D. Tribe
cn_text: 自己場上所有怪獸，直到結束階段時為止全部變成龍族。
description: All monsters on your side of the field are treated as Dragon-Type until the End Phase of this turn.

name: Hade-Hane
cn_text: 反轉：可以選擇場上最多3只怪獸回到手卡。
description: FLIP: You can return up to 3 monsters on the field to the owner's hand.

name: Crimson Sentry
cn_text: 表側表示的這張卡做祭品。1只這個回合被戰斗破壞送去墓地的自己的怪獸回到卡組的最下面。
description: Tribute this face-up card to return 1 of your monsters destroyed as a result of battle during this turn to the bottom of your Deck.

name: Damage Condenser
cn_text: 自己受到戰斗傷害時，丟棄1張手卡才能發動。持有那個時候受到的傷害數值以下的攻擊力的1只怪獸從卡組攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When you take battle damage: Discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to the battle damage you took, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Invader from Another Dimension
cn_text: 從銀河系以外來到地球的外星人。
description: An extraterrestrial monster that came from a distant galaxy.

name: Bladefly
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，全部風屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500。地屬性的怪獸攻擊力下降400。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all WIND monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all EARTH monsters by 400 points.

name: Reflect Bounder
cn_name: 魔鏡導士 限界反射者
cn_text: 場上表側攻擊表示存在的這張卡被對方怪獸攻擊的場合，那次傷害計算前給與對方基本分攻擊怪獸的攻擊力數值的傷害，那次傷害計算后這張卡破壞。
description: Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was in face-up Attack Position at the start of the Damage Step: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the attacking monster's ATK. If you do, after damage calculation: Destroy this card.

name: Illusionist Faceless Mage
cn_text: 施展幻影，輕快地躲開攻擊。
description: Manipulates enemy attacks with the power of illusion.

name: Magical Dimension
cn_text: ①：自己場上有魔法師族怪獸存在的場合，以自己場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只自己怪獸解放，從手卡把1只魔法師族怪獸特殊召喚。那之后，可以選場上1只怪獸破壞。
description: If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster: Target 1 monster you control; Tribute that target, then Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand, then you can destroy 1 monster on the field.

name: Dragon Seeker
cn_text: 這張卡在場上召喚·反轉召喚時，破壞表側表示的1只龍族怪獸。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned, destroy 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster on the field.

name: Last Turn
cn_text: 自己的基本分1000分以下時，在對方的回合才能發動。選擇自己的場上的1只怪獸，雙方的其他的場上和手上的卡全部送去墓地。之后，對方從卡組選擇1只怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚并進行戰斗（玩家的戰斗傷害為0）。回合結束時場上還存在怪獸的玩家獲得決斗的勝利。其他的情況算平局。
description: This card can only be activated during your opponent's turn when your Life Points are 1000 or less. Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send all other cards on the field and in their respective owner's hands to their respective Graveyards. After that, your opponent selects and Special Summons 1 monster from their Deck in face-up Attack Position and attacks your selected monster. (Any Battle Damage from this battle is treated as 0.) The player whose monster remains alone on the field at the End Phase of this turn wins the Duel. Any other case results in a DRAW.

name: Deepsea Shark
cn_text: 「神魚」＋「舌魚」
description: "Bottom Dweller" + "Tongyo"

name: A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon
cn_text: ①：選自己場上1只5星以上的龍族怪獸回到持有者手卡，場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: Return 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster you control to the hand, and if you do, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Fiend Reflection #2
cn_text: 能夠從手里的鏡子中召喚出同伴的鳥怪。
description: A bird-beast that summons reinforcements with a hand mirror.

name: Embodiment of Apophis
cn_text: ①：自己·對方的主要階段才能把這張卡發動。這張卡變成通常怪獸（爬蟲類族·地·4星·攻1600/守1800）在怪獸區域特殊召喚（也當作陷阱卡使用）。
description: During either player's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Reptile-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1600/DEF 1800). (This card is also still a Trap Card.)

name: Tainted Wisdom
cn_text: 這張卡的表示形式從攻擊表示變成守備表示時，洗自己的卡組。
description: When this card is changed from Attack Position to Defense Position, shuffle your own Deck.

name: Mask of Darkness
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以自己墓地1張陷阱卡為對象發動。那張卡加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Target 1 Trap Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Armageddon Knight
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時才能發動。從卡組把1只暗屬性怪獸送去墓地。
description: When this card is Summoned: You can send 1 DARK monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Storming Wynn
cn_text: 可以把自己場上除這張卡以外的1只風屬性怪獸做祭品，從手卡特殊召喚1只風屬性怪獸。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸，在「猛吹之薇茵」從自己場上離開的場合破壞。
description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 WIND monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 WIND monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Storming Wynn" is removed from your side of the field.

name: Tribute Doll
cn_text: 祭掉自己場上1只怪獸發動。從手卡特殊召喚1只可以通常召喚的7星怪獸。特殊召喚出的怪獸本回合不能攻擊。
description: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your hand that can be Normal Summoned or Normal Set. It cannot attack this turn.

name: Grappler
cn_text: 狡猾的蛇。用又粗又長的身體勒緊對手的攻擊必須注意！
description: A devious snake with a thick body that wraps around an enemy monster and squeezes the life out of it.

name: Avalanching Aussa
cn_text: 可以把自己場上除這張卡以外的1只地屬性怪獸做祭品，從手卡特殊召喚1只地屬性怪獸。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸，在「荒狂之奧絲」從自己場上離開的場合破壞。
description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 EARTH monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 EARTH monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Avalanching Aussa" is removed from your side of the field.

name: Pumpking the King of Ghosts
cn_text: 只要「暗晦之城」在場上表側表示存在，這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升100。此外，每次自己的准備階段再上升100。這個效果持續到自己的第4個准備階段。
description: If "Castle of Dark Illusions" is face-up on the field, increase the ATK and DEF of this card by 100 points. As long as this "Castle of Dark Illusions" remains face-up on the field, the ATK and DEF of this card continues to increase by 100 points during each of your Standby Phases. This effect continues until your 4th turn after the card is activated.

name: Steel Ogre Grotto #1
cn_text: 據域是被機械帝國所祭奠?的鋼鐵的巨神像。
description: A steel idol worshipped in the Land of Machines.

name: Gravitic Orb
cn_text: 反轉：對方場上存在的表側表示怪獸全部的表示形式改變。
description: FLIP: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Spell Reproduction
cn_text: 將自己手卡中的2張魔法卡送去墓地。從自己墓地里選擇1張魔法卡加入手卡。
description: Send 2 Spell Cards from your hand to the Graveyard, then target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Curse of Royal
cn_text: ①：只以場上的魔法·陷阱卡1張為對象并要讓那張卡破壞的魔法·陷阱卡發動時才能發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
description: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that includes the effect of destroying 1 Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.

name: Shadow Spell
cn_text:
以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。
①：作為對象的怪獸的攻擊力下降700，不能攻擊，也不能作表示形式的變更。那只怪獸從場上離開時這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

name: Yado Karu
cn_text: 這張卡的表示形式從攻擊表示變成表側守備表示時，可以從自己手卡把任意數量的卡回到卡組最下面。
description: When this card is changed from Attack Position to Defense Position, you can place any number of cards from your hand at the bottom of your Deck in any order you desire.

name: Nutrient Z
cn_text: ①：自己要受到2000以上的戰斗傷害的場合，那次傷害計算時才能發動。自己回復4000基本分。
description: This card can only be activated during your opponent's Damage Step. During this turn, if you take Battle Damage of 2000 points or more, increase your Life Points by 4000 points before the damage is subtracted from your Life Points.

name: Bottomless Trap Hole
cn_text: ①：對方把攻擊力1500以上的怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚時才能發動。那些攻擊力1500以上的怪獸破壞并除外。
description: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

name: Rainbow Marine Mermaid
cn_text: 空中出現彩虹橋時才會出現的珍奇美麗人魚。
description: A reticent mermaid who appears only on very rare occasions. She emerges only when a large rainbow arches across the sky.

name: Diabolos, King of the Abyss
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。這張卡上級召喚的場合，解放的怪獸必須是暗屬性怪獸。
①：這張卡只要在怪獸區域存在，不能用效果解放。
②：對方抽卡階段的抽卡前發動。把對方卡組最上面的卡確認，回到卡組最上面或者最下面。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. If you Tribute Summon this card, the Tributes must be DARK. This card cannot be Tributed by a card's effect. During your opponent's Draw Phase, before their draw, look at the top card of their Deck, then put that card on the top or bottom of their Deck.

name: Dark Eradicator Warlock
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上存在的1只「黑魔朮師」解放的場合才能特殊召喚。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己或者對方把通常魔法卡發動，給與對方基本分1000分傷害。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Dark Magician", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Each time a Normal Spell Card is activated, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent immediately after it resolves.

name: The Snake Hair
cn_text: 頭發滿是毒蛇的怪獸。一旦被她的目光盯上，就會被石化。
description: A monster with a head of poison snakes. One look from this monster can turn an opponent to stone.

name: Mask of Restrict
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，雙方不能把卡解放。
description: Neither player can Tribute cards.

name: A Legendary Ocean
cn_name: 傳說之都 亞特蘭蒂斯
cn_text:
這個卡名在規則上當作「海」使用。
①：場上的水屬性怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升200。
②：只要這張卡在場地區域存在，雙方的手卡·場上的水屬性怪獸的等級下降1星。
description: (This card's name is always treated as "Umi".)All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.

name: Wicked Dragon with the Ersatz Head
cn_text: 長有兩個頭的龍。用兩張嘴咬碎敵人。
description: A two-headed dragon with a pair of jaws that can tear an enemy to shreds.

name: Beautiful Beast Trainer
cn_text: 平常難得一見的女性魔物使。鞭子一到手上性格就立即改變。
description: A rare female beast-master with a very dangerous whip.

name: Gray Wing
cn_text: 在主要階段一丟棄1張手卡。這張卡在那個回合的戰斗階段中可以2次攻擊。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand during your Main Phase 1. This monster can attack twice during the Battle Phase of this turn.

name: Ryu-Ran
cn_text: 被蛋殼包圍的龍。如果認為只是個小鬼的話會吃苦頭的哦。
description: A vicious little dragon sheltered in an egg that looks deceptively harmless.

name: The Regulation of Tribe
cn_text: 發動時宣言1個種族。那個種族的怪獸不能攻擊宣言。每次自己的准備階段若不把1只怪獸作為祭品這張卡破壞。
description: Declare 1 Type of monster. Monsters of the declared Type cannot attack. Tribute 1 monster from your side of the field during each of your Standby Phases. If you do not, this card is destroyed.

name: Twin Long Rods #2
cn_text: 揮舞?兩根像鞭子一般的尾巴攻擊，水中的生物。
description: An amphibious creature with two whip-like tails.

name: Orion the Battle King
cn_text: 被譽為戰神的天使。不過誰也沒見過那場戰事。
description: None have lived to tell tales of this powerful battle fairy.

name: Spell Vanishing
cn_text: 丟棄2張手卡。使魔法卡的發動無效，并且將其破壞。確認對方的手卡及卡組，若存在與被破壞的魔法卡同名的卡，將其全部送去墓地。
description: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it. Also, look at your opponent's hand and Deck and if you find any Spell Cards of the same name as the destroyed Spell Card, send all of them to the Graveyard.

name: Temple of the Kings
cn_text:
這個卡名的①②的效果1回合各能使用1次。
①：自己可以把1張陷阱卡在蓋放的回合發動。
②：把自己場上的表側表示的1只「聖獸 塞勒凱特」和這張卡送去墓地才能發動。手卡·卡組1只怪獸或者額外卡組1只融合怪獸特殊召喚。
description: You can activate 1 Trap Card the turn it was Set. You can send 1 "Mystical Beast of Serket" in your Monster Zone and this card you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck, or 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Temple of the Kings" once per turn.

name: Snakeyashi
cn_text: 許多的蛇聚集在一起。一旦敵人靠近就分散進行攻擊。
description: This monster is formed by several serpents that break off to individually attack nearby enemies.

name: Ojama Trio
cn_text: ①：在對方場上把3只「擾亂衍生物」（獸族·光·2星·攻0/守1000）守備表示特殊召喚。這衍生物不能為上級召喚而解放。「擾亂衍生物」被破壞時那控制者受到每1只300傷害。
description: Special Summon 3 "Ojama Tokens" (Beast-Type/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, and each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

name: Dig Beak
cn_text: 卷起蛇一樣長的身體，一邊回轉一邊用嘴攻擊。
description: This beast coils like a snake, and strikes quickly with its snapping beak.

name: Cyber Ouroboros
cn_text: 這張卡從游戲中除外時，可以把手卡1張卡送去墓地，從卡組抽1張卡。
description: When this card is removed from play, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to draw 1 card.

name: Zanki
cn_text: 喜好單挑，能抓住一瞬間的機會發動反擊。
description: His swiftly drawn blade delivers quick and fatal damage.

name: Judge Man
cn_text: 是個不喜歡比賽不分勝負的戰士。棍棒的攻擊很強！
description: This club-wielding warrior battles to the end and will never surrender.

name: Spirit Message "L"
cn_text: 這張卡不用「通靈槃」的效果不能在場上出現。
description: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board."

name: Gear Golem the Moving Fortress
cn_text: 這個效果在主要階段一才能發動。支付800基本分。本回合這張卡可以對對方進行直接攻擊。
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can pay 800 Life Points; this card can attack your opponent directly this turn.

name: Magician of Black Chaos
cn_text: 「混沌-黑魔朮的儀式」降臨
description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Magic Ritual".

name: Macro Cosmos
cn_text:
①：作為這張卡的發動時的效果處理，可以從手卡·卡組把1只「原始太陽 赫利俄斯」特殊召喚。
②：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，被送去墓地的卡不去墓地而除外。
description: When this card resolves: You can Special Summon 1 "Helios - The Primordial Sun" from your hand or Deck. While this card is face-up on the field, any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

name: Hungry Burger
cn_text: 「漢堡的食譜」降臨
description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Hamburger Recipe". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Fake Trap
cn_text: 把自己場上的陷阱卡破壞的魔法·陷阱·效果怪獸的效果對方發動時才能發動，把這張卡作為代替破壞，其他的自己的陷阱卡不破壞。蓋放的卡破壞的場合，那些卡全部翻開確認。
description: You can only activate this card when your opponent uses an effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster to destroy Trap Card(s) on your side of the field. Destroy this card as a substitute of those Trap Card(s) and the other Trap Card(s) are not destroyed. If a Set card(s) would have been destroyed, pick up and see the Set card(s).

name: Phantom of Chaos
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，以自己墓地1只效果怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸除外，這張卡直到結束階段當作和那只怪獸同名卡使用，得到相同的原本攻擊力和效果。
②：這張卡的戰斗發生的對對方的戰斗傷害變成0。
description: Any Battle Damage your opponent takes from battles involving this card becomes 0. Once per turn: You can target 1 Effect Monster in your Graveyard; banish that target, and if you do, until the End Phase, this card's name and ATK become that monster's name and ATK, and it gains that monster's effects. You must control this face-up card to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Element Dragon
cn_text:
①：場上的怪獸屬性讓這張卡得到以下效果。
●炎屬性：這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
●風屬性：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸時才能發動。這張卡只再1次可以繼續攻擊。
description: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: ? FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK. ? WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

name: Dokuroyaiba
cn_text: 確定目標后，無論敵人逃到哪里都會追腦瓜，帶有意識的回旋鏢。
description: A boomerang with brains that will pursue a target to the ends of the earth.

name: Human-Wave Tactics
cn_text: 在每1個回合的結束階段時，自己從卡組中選擇2星以下的通常怪獸特殊召喚上場，其數量等於在同1回合中自己被戰斗破壞的2星以下的通常怪獸的數量。
description: During the End Phase of each turn, select a number of Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed as a result of battle during that turn, and Special Summon them to your side of the field. The Deck is then shuffled.

name: Amplifier
cn_text:
「人造人-念力震懾者」才能裝備。這張卡的發動和效果不會被無效化。
①：裝備怪獸持有的「雙方不能把場上的陷阱卡的效果發動，場上的陷阱卡的效果無效化」效果作為「對方不能把場上的陷阱卡的效果發動，對方場上的陷阱卡的效果無效化」適用。
②：這張卡從場上離開時裝備怪獸破壞。
description: You can only equip this card to "Jinzo". As long as this card is equipped, the effects of Trap Cards controlled by the equipped monster's controller are not negated by the effect of the equipped monster. When this card is removed from the field, the equipped monster is destroyed. This card's activation and effect cannot be negated by any other card.

name: Mystical Sheep #1
cn_text: 這張卡可以作為1只融合素材怪獸的代替。那個時候，其他的融合素材怪獸必須是正規品。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion-Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion-Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s).

name: Legacy of Yata-Garasu
cn_text:
從下面效果選擇1個發動。
●從自己卡組抽1張卡。
●對方場上有靈魂怪獸表側表示存在的場合才能發動。從自己卡組抽2張卡。
description: Activate 1 of these effects:? Draw 1 card.? Activate only if your opponent controls a face-up Spirit monster. Draw 2 cards.

name: Enchanting Fitting Room
cn_text: 支付800基本分。翻開自己卡組最上面4張卡，將其中3星以下的通常怪獸特殊召喚到自己場上，將翻開的其它卡回到卡組。
description: Pay 800 Life Points. Pick up 4 cards from the top of your Deck and Special Summon to your side of the field all Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters among the picked-up cards. Return all the other picked-up cards to your Deck and the Deck is then shuffled.

name: Sky Scout
cn_text: 以5馬赫飛行的鳥人。他的目光比鷹還銳利。
description: With eyes like a hawk and a flying speed exceeding Mach 5, this monster is a master of the sky.

name: Branch!
cn_text: 融合怪獸在場上被破壞送去墓地時，可以把自己墓地存在的那只融合怪獸進行融合時所使用過的1只融合素材怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

name: Trap of Board Eraser
cn_text: 給與戰斗傷害以外傷害的效果發動時才能發動。使自己所受的效果傷害無效，對方從手卡中選擇1張丟棄。
description: You can only activate this card when an effect that inflicts damage to your Life Points is activated (except Battle Damage). Negate the Effect Damage you receive and your opponent then selects 1 card from his/her hand and discards it.

name: Invader of the Throne
cn_text: 反轉：選擇對方場上存在的1只怪獸，那只怪獸和這張卡的控制權交換。這個效果在戰斗階段不能發動。
description: FLIP: Select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and switch control of it with this card. This effect cannot be activated during the Battle Phase.

name: The Dark Door
cn_text: ①：雙方玩家在戰斗階段只能用1只怪獸攻擊。
description: Only 1 monster can attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Strike Slash
cn_text: 自己場上存在的怪獸攻擊宣言時才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力直到結束階段時上升700。那只怪獸攻擊守備表示怪獸的場合，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: When a monster you control declares an attack: Until the End Phase, that monster gains 700 ATK, also, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Blessings of the Nile
cn_text: 每當因對方所控制的卡的效果使自己的手卡被棄進墓地時，自己回復1000基本分。
description: Each time card(s) are discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Cyber Falcon
cn_text: 裝備了噴氣式引擎的鷹，能夠超音速飛行。
description: A jet-powered hawk that travels at the speed of sound.

name: Shield Crush
cn_text: ①：以場上1只守備表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只守備表示怪獸破壞。
description: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Maximum Six
cn_text: 這張卡祭品召喚成功時，丟1個骰子。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，這張卡的攻擊力上升丟出骰子數×200的攻擊力。
description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: Roll a six-sided die, and this card gains ATK equal to the result x 200.

name: Shadow Ghoul
cn_text: 自己的墓地每存在1只怪獸，這張卡的攻擊力上升100。
description: This card gains 100 ATK for each monster in your Graveyard.

name: Yata-Garasu
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。下次的對方抽卡階段跳過。
②：這張卡召喚·反轉的回合的結束階段發動。這張卡回到手卡。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they skip their next Draw Phase.

name: Rocket Warrior
cn_text:
①：自己戰斗階段中，這張卡不會被戰斗破壞，這張卡的戰斗發生的對自己的戰斗傷害變成0。
②：這張卡向怪獸攻擊的傷害計算后發動。攻擊對象怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時下降500。
description: During your Battle Phase, this card cannot be destroyed by battle and you take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. If this card attacks a monster, after damage calculation: That attack target loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Sacred Crane
cn_text: ①：這張卡特殊召喚成功的場合發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: If this card is Special Summoned: Draw 1 card.

name: Conscription
cn_text: 檢視對方卡組最上面的1張卡，如果那張卡是可以通常召喚的怪獸的場合，在自己場上特殊召喚。是其他卡的場合，那張卡加到對方的手卡。
description: Excavate the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, Special Summon it to your side of the field. Otherwise, add that card to your opponent's hand.

name: Mad Reloader
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。選2張手卡送去墓地，自己從卡組抽2張。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Send 2 cards from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 2 cards.

name: Creature Swap
cn_text: ①：雙方玩家各自選自身場上1只怪獸。那2只怪獸的控制權交換。這個回合，那些怪獸不能把表示形式變更。
description: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: The First Sarcophagus
cn_text: 在對方的每1個結束階段時，按照「第二之棺」「第三之棺」的順序將其中1張卡從自己的手卡·卡組以表側表示放到自己場上。當其中任意1張離場時，將這些卡全部送去墓地。當自己場上湊齊所有卡時，將這些卡全部送去墓地，從自己的手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「法老之靈」上場。
description: During each of your opponent's End Phases, place 1 card face-up on your side of the field from your hand or Deck in this order: "The Second Sarcophagus", "The Third Sarcophagus". If 1 Sarcophagus card is removed from your side of the field, all of them on your side of the field are sent to the Graveyard. When you have all 3 Sarcophagus cards on your side of the field, send all Sarcophagus cards on your side of the field to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Spirit of the Pharaoh" from your hand or Deck.

name: Gyakutenno Megami
cn_text: 用神聖之力守護弱者，給予逆轉之力的女神。
description: This fairy uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

name: Souleater
cn_text: 一切都是迷的超生命體。
description: A living wonder of mystery.

name: Marshmallon
cn_text:
①：這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。
②：里側表示的這張卡被攻擊的傷害計算后發動。給與攻擊的玩家1000傷害。
description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After damage calculation, if this card was attacked, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: The attacking player takes 1000 damage.

name: Zombie Warrior
cn_text: 「白骨」＋「格斗戰士 阿提米特」
description: "Skull Servant" + "Battle Warrior"

name: Flying Kamakiri #2
cn_text: 擁有飛行能力的螳螂，非常喜歡吃昆蟲。
description: A flying mantis that feeds primarily on insects.

name: Level Limit - Area B
cn_text: 場上的4星以上的怪獸變成守備表示。
description: Change all face-up Level 4 or higher monsters to Defense Position.

name: Divine Sword - Phoenix Blade
cn_text: 戰士族才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升300。這張卡在自己的主要階段存在於自己的墓地時，可以把自己墓地的2只戰士族從游戲中除外，這張卡加入手卡。
description: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 300 ATK. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard you can remove from play 2 Warrior-Type monsters in your Graveyard to add this card to your hand.

name: Rafflesia Seduction
cn_text: 反轉：直到回合結束前，得到對方場上的1只表側表示的怪獸的控制權。
description: FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn.

name: Wingweaver
cn_text: 六翼天使操縱?人的自由和希望。
description: A six-winged fairy who prays for peace and hope.

name: Dust Barrier
cn_text: 場上所有以表側表示存在的通常怪獸不受對方魔法卡效果的影響。在這張卡發動后的第2個自己的准備階段時，這張卡被破壞。
description: Face-up Normal Monsters on the field are unaffected by your opponent's Spell Cards. This card is destroyed during your second Standby Phase after activation.

name: Mr. Volcano
cn_text: 操縱火焰的紳士，平常很和藹但發起怒來很恐怖。
description: This seemingly mild-mannered creature has an extremely volatile temper.

name: Tutan Mask
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的1只不死族怪獸為對象的魔法·陷阱卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets exactly 1 Zombie-Type monster on the field (and no other cards): Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Escape from the Dark Dimension
cn_text: ①：以除外的1只自己的暗屬性怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞并除外。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: Target 1 of your banished DARK monsters; Special Summon that target. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target, and if you do, banish it. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Spear Dragon
cn_text:
①：這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
②：這張卡攻擊的場合，傷害步驟結束時變成守備表示。
description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Magician of Faith
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以自己墓地1張魔法卡為對象發動。那張卡加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand.

name: Takuhee
cn_text: 這鳥出現的時候，就是什么不幸之事發生前的徵兆。
description: This bird is known far and wide as a harbinger of doom.

name: Revival Jam
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，支付1000基本分才能發動。下次的自己准備階段這張卡從墓地守備表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can pay 1000 Life Points; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position during your next turn's Standby Phase.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Wynn
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以把自己場上的表側表示的1只「風靈使 薇茵」和1只風屬性怪獸送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚。
②：這張卡的①的方法特殊召喚的這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: You can send 1 "Wynn the Wind Charmer" and 1 WIND monster you control to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from your hand or Deck. If you do, this card gets the following effect: ? During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Thunder Dragon
cn_text: ①：把這張卡從手卡丟棄才能發動。從卡組把最多2只「雷龍」加入手卡。
description: You can discard this card to add up to 2 "Thunder Dragons" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Stone Statue of the Aztecs
cn_text: ①：這張卡被攻擊的場合，那次戰斗發生的對對方的戰斗傷害變成2倍。
description: Double any Battle Damage your opponent takes when they attack this monster.

name: Dark Necrofear
cn_name: 暗黑人偶 妮可羅菲婭
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把3只惡魔族怪獸除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：怪獸區域的這張卡被對方破壞送去墓地的回合的結束階段，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象發動。墓地的這張卡當作裝備卡使用給那只對方怪獸裝備。
②：這張卡的效果讓這張卡裝備中的場合，得到裝備怪獸的控制權。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 Fiend-Type monsters from your Graveyard. During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was destroyed by an opponent's card this turn (by battle or card effect) and sent to your Graveyard while it was a Monster Card under your control: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip this card to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster by this effect, take control of that monster.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Aussa
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以把自己場上的表側表示的1只「地靈使 奧絲」和1只地屬性怪獸送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚。
②：這張卡的①的方法特殊召喚的這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: You can send 1 "Aussa the Earth Charmer" and 1 EARTH monster you control to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from your hand or Deck. If you do, this card gets the following effect: ? During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Fiend's Mirror
cn_text: 「惡魔鏡的儀式」降臨。
description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Beastly Mirror Ritual".

name: Spirit Message "I"
cn_text: 這張卡不用「通靈槃」的效果不能在場上出現。
description: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Regenerating Rose
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以在自己場上把2只「魔界薔薇衍生物」（植物族·暗·3星·攻/守1200）特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 2 "Regenerating Rose Tokens" (Plant-Type/DARK/Level 3/ATK 1200/DEF 1200).

name: Flying Fish
cn_text: 據說誰看見它在空中飛翔的姿態，就能實現三個願望。
description: Three wishes are granted to those fortunate enough to see this monster in flight.

name: Millennium Shield
cn_text: 據說是從古埃及王家傳下來的傳說之盾。傳聞說再怎么強的攻擊也能防住。
description: A famous shield said to belong to an ancient Egyptian Pharaoh. Legends tell of its power to block any strong attack.

name: Blind Destruction
cn_text: 每次自己的准備階段丟1次骰子。和投出來的數目一樣等級的怪獸全部破壞。（投出來的數目是6的場合包括6星以上的怪獸）
description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Roll a six-sided die. If the result is 1-5, destroy all monsters on the field with the same Level as the number rolled. If it is 6, destroy all Level 6 and higher monsters on the field.

name: Gravity Axe - Grarl
cn_text: 裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力上升500點。只要這張卡在場上存在，對方場上的怪獸不能改變表示形式。
description: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

name: Mega Ton Magical Cannon
cn_text: 把自己場上存在的10個魔力指示物取除發動。對方場上存在的卡全部破壞。
description: Remove 10 Spell Counters on your side of the field. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Ultimate Obedient Fiend
cn_text: 當自己場上只有這張卡存在且自己手卡數為零時這張卡才能進行攻擊。被這張卡破壞的效果怪獸的效果無效化。
description: This card can only attack if this card is the only card on your side of the field and if you also have no cards in your hand. Negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by this card.

name: Salamandra
cn_text:
炎屬性怪獸才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。
description: Equip only to a FIRE monster. It gains 700 ATK.

name: The All-Seeing White Tiger
cn_text: 對有些人來說感到恐怖，對有些人來說卻是尊敬的對象，孤傲的叢林之王。
description: A proud ruler of the jungle that some fear and others respect.

name: Skull Servant
cn_text: 任何地方都會出現的骸骨怪。攻擊很弱但聚集起來非同小可。
description: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

name: Bountiful Artemis
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次自己或者對方把反擊陷阱卡發動，自己從卡組抽1張。
description: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, draw 1 card immediately after it resolves.

name: Triangle Power
cn_text: 自己場上所有以表側表示存在的1星通常怪獸（衍生物除外）的原本的攻擊力·守備力上升2000點。結束階段時，自己場上存在的1星通常怪獸全部破壞。
description: Increase the original ATK and DEF of all face-up Level 1 Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field by 2000 points until the End Phase. Destroy all Level 1 Normal Monsters on your side of the field during the End Phase.

name: Dark Chimera
cn_text: 生息在魔界的怪獸。吐出暗炎攻擊。
description: A fire-breathing monster that dwells in the netherworld.

name: Skelgon
cn_text: 「美杜莎的亡靈」＋「暗黑之龍王」
description: "The Snake Hair" + "Blackland Fire Dragon"

name: Magical Merchant
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。直到魔法·陷阱卡出現為止從自己卡組上面翻卡，那張魔法·陷阱卡加入手卡。剩下的翻開的卡全部送去墓地。
description: FLIP: Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a Spell/Trap Card. Add that card to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the Graveyard.

name: Dragonic Attack
cn_text: 只有戰士族可以裝備。裝備怪獸的種族變龍族，攻擊力守備力上升500。
description: This card can only be used to equip Warrior-Type monsters. The equipped monster is treated as a Dragon-Type and increases the ATK and DEF of the equipped monster by 500 points.

name: Shield Spear
cn_text: ①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力·守備力直到回合結束時上升400。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 400 ATK and DEF until the End Phase.

name: Beaver Warrior
cn_text: 身體雖小，但在草原上具備高強的守備力。
description: What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.

name: Rose Spectre of Dunn
cn_text: 「小精怪」＋「蛇椰樹」
description: "Feral Imp" + "Snakeyashi"

name: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上3張表側表示的永續魔法卡送去墓地的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域守備表示存在，對方怪獸不能選擇這張卡以外的怪獸作為攻擊對象。
②：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地的場合發動。給與對方1000傷害。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Continuous Spell Cards you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. While this card is in face-up Defense Position, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one.

name: Minar
cn_text: 這張卡被對方的卡的效果從手卡丟棄去墓地時，給與對方基本分1000分傷害。
description: When this card is discarded directly from your hand to the Graveyard by an effect of a card controlled by your opponent, inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: The Portrait's Secret
cn_text: 寄宿?作者的詛咒的畫，據說持有它的人都將陷入不幸之中。
description: A portrait cursed by the artist, it is said to bring ill fortune to anyone who owns it.

name: Korogashi
cn_text: 可以推動比自己身體大几倍的糞便，壓倒對方。
description: A high-powered dung beetle that can roll dung larger than itself. It crushes its foes with its massive ball of dung.

name: Spiral Serpent
cn_text: 傳聞會制造海龍旋渦襲擊人們的海龍。巨大的鰭所放出的螺旋形波浪能吞噬一切。
description: When huge whirlpools lay cities asunder, it is the hunger of this sea serpent at work. No one has ever escaped its dreaded Spiral Wave to accurately describe the terror they experienced.

name: Hero Kid
cn_text: 這張卡特殊召喚成功時，可以從卡組特殊召喚任意數量的「英雄小子」。
description: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of "Hero Kid"(s) from your Deck.

name: Mystical Sand
cn_text: 「岩石巨兵」＋「古代精靈」
description: "Giant Soldier of Stone" + "Ancient Elf"

name: Sixth Sense
cn_text: 自己在1至6的范圍里宣言2個數字。對方丟出1個「骰子」，丟出的數目是宣言的數字的其中1個，自己就抽相等數目的卡。猜不中的場合，自己卡組從上面丟棄「骰子」丟出數目的卡去墓地。
description: Declare 2 numbers from 1 to 6, then your opponent rolls a six-sided die, and if the result is one of the numbers you declared, you draw that many cards. Otherwise, send a number of cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard equal to the result.

name: Reinforcement of the Army
cn_text: ①：從卡組把1只4星以下的戰士族怪獸加入手卡。
description: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Jinzo #7
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This monster can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: The 13th Grave
cn_text: 原本沒有任何人的一零三號墓地突然出現的喪尸。
description: A zombie that suddenly appeared from plot #13 - an empty grave.

name: Falling Down
cn_text:
可以給對方場上的怪獸裝備。
①：得到裝備怪獸的控制權。
②：對方准備階段發動。自己受到800傷害。
③：自己場上沒有「惡魔」卡存在的場合這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by targeting an opponent's monster; equip this card to it. Take control of it. Destroy this card unless you control an "Archfiend" card. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: You take 800 damage.

name: One-Eyed Shield Dragon
cn_text: 身上的盾不僅能保護身體，還能用來突擊。
description: This dragon wears a shield not only for its own protection, but also for ramming its enemies.

name: Reaper of the Cards
cn_text: 反轉：選擇場上存在的1張陷阱卡破壞。選擇的卡是蓋放的場合，把那張卡翻開確認，是陷阱卡則破壞。魔法卡的場合回到原狀。
description: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.

name: Metalsilver Armor
cn_text: ①：只要裝備怪獸在自己場上存在，對方不能把裝備怪獸以外的雙方的場上·墓地·除外狀態的怪獸作為效果的對象。
description: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot use the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster that targets 1 monster, except the equipped monster.

name: Misairuzame
cn_text: 全身長?針的魚，從腹部下面發射導彈。
description: A missile-launching fish protected by deadly spikes.

name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，宣言1個種族才能發動。場上的宣言種族的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand and declare 1 Type of monster. Destroy all face-up monsters of the declared Type on the field.

name: Contract with Exodia
cn_text: ①：自己墓地有「被封印的艾克佐迪亞」「被封印者的右腕」「被封印者的左腕」「被封印者的右足」「被封印者的左足」存在的場合才能發動。從手卡把1只「艾克佐迪亞的亡靈」特殊召喚。
description: If you have all 5 of "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" in your Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Exodia Necross" from your hand.

name: Option Hunter
cn_text: 自己場上的怪獸被戰斗破壞送去墓地時發動。自己回復破壞怪獸的原本攻擊力的數值的基本分。
description: Activate only when a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Exodia the Forbidden One
cn_text: 這張卡和「被封印者的右腕」「被封印者的左腕」「被封印者的右足」「被封印者的左足」在手卡全部齊集時，自己決斗勝利。
description: If you have "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", "Left Leg of the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One" and "Left Arm of the Forbidden One" in addition to this card in your hand, you win the Duel.

name: Cockroach Knight
cn_text: 這張卡送去墓地時，這張卡回到卡組最上面。
description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard, it is returned to the top of the Deck.

name: Maniacal Servant
cn_text: 對方的准備階段時只有1次，可以把自己墓地存在的暗屬性怪獸任意數量從游戲中除外。直到結束階段時，這張卡的守備力上升這個效果除外的怪獸數量×500的數值。
description: Once per turn during your opponent's Standby Phase, you can remove from play any number of DARK monsters from your Graveyard. This monster gains 500 DEF for each monster you removed, until the End Phase.

name: Morphing Jar
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。有手卡的玩家把那些手卡全部丟棄。雙方從卡組抽5張。
description: FLIP: Both players discard their entire hands, then draw 5 cards.

name: Fusion Gate
cn_text: ①：雙方玩家在自己主要階段才能發動。從自己的手卡·場上把融合怪獸卡決定的融合素材怪獸除外，把那1只融合怪獸從額外卡組融合召喚。
description: While this card is on the field: The turn player can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from their Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from their hand or field.

name: Giganto
cn_text: 振舞?帶刺的鐵球進行攻擊。
description: A massive steel ball that mows down anything in its path.

name: Belial - Marquis of Darkness
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方不能選擇「暗之侯爵 彼列」以外的自己場上表側表示存在的怪獸作為攻擊對象，也不能作為魔法·陷阱卡的效果的對象。
description: Your opponent cannot target any face-up monster you control, except "Belial - Marquis of Darkness", for an attack, or with Spell/Trap effects.

name: Alligator's Sword Dragon
cn_text:
「寶貝龍」＋「翼龍戰士」
①：對方場上的表側表示怪獸只有地·水·炎屬性怪獸的場合，這張卡可以直接攻擊。
description: "Baby Dragon" + "Alligator's Sword"This card can attack your opponent directly if the only face-up monsters they control are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE.

name: Pragtical
cn_text: 「虎紋龍」＋「火焰毒蛇」
description: "Trakodon" + "Flame Viper"

name: Three-Legged Zombies
cn_text: 瘦子和胖子，友好的骸骨二人組，走起路來很艱難。
description: A pair of friendly skeletons, lean and fat, that travel with extreme difficulty.

name: Graverobber's Retribution
cn_text: 每次自己的准備階段，每存在1只除外的對方怪獸，對方受到100分的傷害。
description: During each of your Standby Phases, inflict 100 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each of your opponent's monsters that have been removed from play.

name: Meteor of Destruction
cn_text: 給與對方基本分1000分傷害。對方基本分是3000以下的場合這張卡不能發動。
description: If your opponent's Life Points are higher than 3000: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Dark Catapulter
cn_text: 自己的准備階段時這張卡守備表示的場合，這張卡放置1個指示物。可以從自己墓地除外和指示物同數量的卡，破壞場上和除外的卡片數同數量的魔法·陷阱卡。之后這張卡的指示物全部取除。
description: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in Defense Position, put 1 counter on this card. You can remove from play a number of card(s) in your Graveyard equal to the number of counters on this card to destroy that many Spell or Trap Card(s) on the field. Then remove all counter(s) from this card.

name: Togex
cn_text: 動作意外地敏捷，把身體卷成圓形進行撞擊。
description: An agile monster that rolls up to ram its opponents.

name: Royal Command
cn_text: 全部的反轉效果的怪獸的發動和效果無效化。
description: Flip monsters' effects cannot be activated, also their effects are negated.

name: Super War-Lion
cn_text: 「獅子的儀式」降臨。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "War-Lion Ritual".

name: Thousand Needles
cn_text: 守備表示的這張卡受到攻擊時，若這張卡的守備力超過對方攻擊怪獸的攻擊力，傷害步驟結束時那只攻擊怪獸破壞。
description: When this Defense Position card is attacked and if the DEF of this card is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Riryoku
cn_text: ①：以場上2只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。直到回合結束時，作為對象的1只怪獸的攻擊力變成一半，另1只怪獸的攻擊力上升那個數值。
description: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field; halve the ATK of 1 monster, and if you do, add that lost ATK to the other monster. These effects last until the End Phase.

name: Pitch-Black Power Stone
cn_text:
這張卡發動的場合，給這張卡放置3個魔力指示物來發動。
①：自己回合1次，以這張卡以外的場上1張可以放置魔力指示物的卡為對象才能發動。這張卡1個魔力指示物取除，給那張卡放置1個魔力指示物。
②：這張卡的魔力指示物全部被取除的場合這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by placing 3 Spell Counters on this card. Once per turn, during your turn: You can target 1 other face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, and if you do, place 1 Spell Counter on that target. When the last Spell Counter(s) is removed from this card, destroy it.

name: Ultimate Insect LV3
cn_text: 「究極昆蟲 LV1」的效果特殊召喚的場合，只要這張卡在場上存在，對方全部怪獸的攻擊力下降300。自己回合的准備階段時，可以把表側表示的這張卡送去墓地，從卡組·手卡特殊召喚1只「究極昆蟲 LV5」。（召喚·特殊召喚·反轉的回合不能使用此效果）
description: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV1", while it remains on the field all of your opponent's monsters lose 300 ATK. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV5" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

name: Harpie Girl
cn_text: 夢想有一天能以美麗的姿態華麗飛舞、敏銳攻擊的鷹身少女。
description: A Harpie chick who aspires to flit about beautifully and gorgeously, but attack sharply.

name: Cyber Jar
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。場上的怪獸全部破壞。那之后，雙方從卡組上面把5張卡翻開，那之中的4星以下而可以特殊召喚的怪獸全部表側攻擊表示或里側守備表示特殊召喚。剩下的翻開的卡全部加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Destroy all monsters on the field, then both players reveal the top 5 cards from their Decks, then Special Summon all revealed Level 4 or lower monsters in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, also add any remaining cards to their hand. (If either player has less than 5 cards in their Deck, reveal as many as possible.)

name: Fear from the Dark
cn_text: 當這張卡被對方的效果從手卡或卡組送去墓地時，這張卡特殊召喚上場。
description: When this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

name: Magical Scientist
cn_text: 支付1000基本分，就可以從自己的融合卡組中特殊召喚1只6星以下的融合怪獸。這只融合怪獸不能對對方進行直接攻擊，回合結束時回到融合卡組。
description: Pay 1000 Life Points to Special Summon 1 level 6 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck in face-up Attack or Defense Position. That Fusion Monster cannot attack your opponent's Life Points directly, and is returned to your Extra Deck at the end of the turn.

name: Ante
cn_text: 雙方各自選擇1張手卡并展示，相互確認等級。選擇等級較高卡的一方將選出的卡放回手卡，選擇等級較低卡的一方受到1000點傷害，將選出的卡送去墓地。選擇怪獸卡以外的卡時，等級強制計為0。雙方選擇的卡等級相同時，各自將選出的卡放回手卡。
description: Each Player reveals 1 card from their hand. If one card is higher Level than the other, the card with the lower Level is sent to the Graveyard, and the player who revealed it takes 1000 damage. (Non-Monster Cards are treated as Level 0.)

name: Corroding Shark
cn_text: 在海里彷徨的鯊魚，遇上它的人都會被施與詛咒。
description: A zombie shark that can deliver its lethal curse with a spell.

name: Vampire's Curse
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，支付500基本分才能發動。下個回合的准備階段時，這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。此外，這個效果特殊召喚成功時發動。這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 Life Points; Special Summon it during the Standby Phase of the next turn. When you do: It gains 500 ATK.

name: Living Vase
cn_text: 利用花散發花粉并咬向對方的活花瓶。
description: A living vase that bites enemies and blinds them with a blast of its flower.

name: Gryphon's Feather Duster
cn_text: 破壞自己場上所有魔法·陷阱卡。自己回復被破壞的卡數量×500基本分。
description: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on your side of the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of destroyed cards x 500 points.

name: Mechanical Snail
cn_text: 機器改造的蝸牛，但是速度卻沒什么變化。
description: A cyborg snail that still travels at a slow pace.

name: Generation Shift
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸破壞。那之后，從卡組把1張和破壞的卡同名的卡加入手卡。
description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy that target, then add 1 card with the same name as the destroyed card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Flame Manipulator
cn_text: 游刃有余地穿梭在火海中發動攻擊。
description: This Spellcaster attacks enemies with fire-related spells such as "Sea of Flames" and "Wall of Fire".

name: Ganigumo
cn_text: 長有鉗子的蜘蛛。用蜘蛛絲封住對方的動作用螃蟹鉗子殺死對方。
description: A crab that binds its enemies with a sticky web and attacks them with its sharp claws.

name: Kaibaman
cn_name: 正義的同伴 海馬俠
cn_text: 把這張卡解放才能發動。從手卡把1只「青眼白龍」特殊召喚。
description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand.

name: Stumbling
cn_text: 召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功的怪獸成為守備表示。
description: Any monster that is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned is changed to Defense Position.

name: Spirit of the Mountain
cn_text: 據說聽了它的笛音的人會失去力量。
description: An elderly magician that raises mountains with his flute.

name: The Eye of Truth
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，對方把手卡持續公開。對方的准備階段時對方手卡有魔法卡的場合，對方回復1000基本分。
description: Your opponent must keep their hand revealed. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, if they have a Spell Card in their hand: They gain 1000 LP.

name: Blocker
cn_text: 身體部件各為武器，分裂發動襲擊。
description: Constructed from several components, this monster can launch them in a pincer attack.

name: Ultimate Insect LV5
cn_text: 「究極昆蟲 LV3」的效果特殊召喚的場合，只要這張卡在場上存在，對方場上的全部怪獸攻擊力下降500。自己回合的准備階段時，可以把表側表示的這張卡送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「究極昆蟲 LV7」上場。（召喚·特殊召喚·反轉的回合不能使用此效果）
description: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV3", while it remains on the field all of your opponent's monsters lose 500 ATK. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV7" from your hand or Deck.
