(You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

name: Tsukuyomi
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡召喚·反轉的場合，以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸變成里側守備表示。
②：這張卡召喚·反轉的回合的結束階段發動。這張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return it to the hand.

name: Mass Driver
cn_text: 每祭掉自己場上1只怪獸，給與對方基本分400分的傷害。
description: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field to inflict 400 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Insect Armor with Laser Cannon
cn_text:
昆蟲族怪獸才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。
description: Equip only to an Insect-Type monster. It gains 700 ATK.

name: Phantom Beast Thunder-Pegasus
cn_text: 對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，把墓地的這張卡從游戲中除外，選擇自己場上1只名字帶有「幻獸」的怪獸才能發動。這個回合，選擇的自己怪獸不會被戰斗破壞。
description: When your opponent's monster declares an attack, you can remove from play this card from your Graveyard to make the Battle Damage taken by 1 "Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts" or "Phantom Beast" monster 0. When this happens, that monster is not destroyed by battle.

name: Insect Knight
cn_text: 在昆蟲戰士之中，屬於精英中的精英的「無死蟲團」的精銳騎士。不能無視它們強大的戰斗能力。
description: Of all Insect fighters, he is the paragon of the Indestructible Insect Invaders, which only the elite of the elite can join. We can no longer ignore their unmatched battle prowess.

name: Kaiser Colosseum
cn_text: ①：只要自己場上有怪獸存在，對方不能讓要變到比那個數量多的怪獸在自身場上出現。
description: If there is 1 or more monster(s) on the field of the controller of this card, his/her opponent cannot place a monster on the field if his/her number of monsters would exceed the number of monsters that are on the field of this card's controller. The cards that are already on the field before this card's activation are unaffected by this effect.

name: Stealth Bird
cn_text:
①：自己主要階段才能發動。這張卡變成里側守備表示（1回合只有1次）。
②：這張卡反轉召喚成功的場合發動。給與對方1000傷害。
description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Beast Soul Swap
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的1只獸族怪獸回手卡，從手卡特殊召喚1只和回手怪獸等級相同的獸族怪獸上場。
description: Target 1 Beast-Type monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Beast-Type monster from your hand with the same Level as the monster that was returned to the hand.

name: Blindly Loyal Goblin
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，控制權不會被轉移。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, control of this card cannot switch.

name: Blue-Eyed Silver Zombie
cn_text: 據說可以從眼睛里射出怪異的光線，據說能讓對方變成僵尸。
description: The beams from the eyes of this creature are said to turn enemies into zombies.

name: Time Seal
cn_text: ①：下次的對方抽卡階段跳過。
description: Skip the Draw Phase of your opponent's next turn.

name: Woodborg Inpachi
cn_text: 謎之大木人18號，由魔界尖端技朮改造后的姿態。由於重點放在了堅固的裝甲上，因此犧牲了機動性。
description: The new form of the enigmatic Inpachi, remodeled by cutting-edge Dark World technology. Maneuverability has been sacrificed for strong armor, which is considered more important.

name: Solemn Wishes
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，每次自己抽卡，自己回復500基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 500 points each time you draw a card (or cards).

name: Pixie Knight
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，由對方選擇自己墓地里的1張魔法卡，放在自己卡組的最上面。
description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent selects 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard, and places that card on the top of your Deck.

name: Dice Jar
cn_text: 反轉：雙方各自投擲1個骰子。投擲出來的數目比另一方低的玩家，受到（另一方投擲出的數目×500）的基本分的傷害。如果輸給投擲出數目6的場合，輸的玩家受到的是6000分的傷害。平局的場合再擲1次。
description: FLIP: Both players roll a six-sided die. The player with the lowest result takes damage equal to their opponent's roll x 500. However, if the winner rolled a 6, the loser takes 6000 damage. If the rolls are the same, both players roll again.

name: Birthright
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只通常怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。那只怪獸從場上離開時這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

name: Mystical Refpanel
cn_text: 玩家1人為對象的魔法的效果移給其他玩家。
description: Activate only when a Spell Card that targets 1 player is activated. The effect of that Spell Card is applied to the other player instead.

name: Dark Witch
cn_text: 在神話里出現的戰斗天使，用手中的槍處以天罰。
description: A popular creature in mythology that delivers fatal attacks with a sharp spear.

name: Tragedy
cn_text: 對方場上表側攻擊表示存在的怪獸的表示形式變更為表側守備表示時才能發動。對方場上守備表示存在的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When a face-up Attack Position monster(s) your opponent controls is changed to face-up Defense Position: Destroy all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.

name: Monstrous Bird
cn_text: 很少見的大鳥。從空中急速下除襲擊。
description: Few have set eyes on this dive-bombing bird and lived to tell the tale.

name: Swordsman of Landstar
cn_text: 雖然劍朮不太成熟，但卻有不可思議力量的妖精劍士。
description: An amateur with a sword, this fairy warrior relies on its mysterious powers.

name: Vermillion Sparrow
cn_text: 「赤劍之萊蒙多斯」＋「炎之魔神」
description: "Rhaimundos of the Red Sword" + "Fireyarou"

name: Heart of the Underdog
cn_text: 當抽卡階段抽到的卡是通常怪獸的場合，向對方展示抽到的卡，就可以再抽1張卡。
description: During your Draw Phase, when you draw a Normal Monster(s): You can reveal it; draw 1 more card.

name: Jinzo - Lord
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上1只表側表示的「人造人-念力震懾者」送去墓地的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不能把場上的陷阱卡的效果發動，場上的陷阱卡的效果無效化。
②：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。場上的表側表示的陷阱卡全部破壞，給與對方破壞數量×300傷害。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 1 face-up "Jinzo" you control to the Graveyard. Trap Cards cannot be activated and the effects of all Trap Cards on the field are negated. Once per turn, you can destroy all face-up Trap Cards. Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed by this effect.

name: Acidic Downpour
cn_text: 全部地屬性怪獸的攻擊力下降500，守備力上升400。
description: All EARTH monsters lose 500 ATK and gain 400 DEF.

name: King of the Skull Servants
cn_text:
①：這張卡的原本攻擊力變成自己墓地的「白骨王」「白骨」數量×1000。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，從自己墓地把1只其他的「白骨王」或「白骨」除外才能發動。這張卡特殊召喚。
description: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your Graveyard x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your Graveyard; Special Summon this card.

name: Penguin Knight
cn_text: 這張卡被對方的效果從卡組送去墓地時，把自己墓地存在的全部卡回到卡組。
description: When this card is sent directly from your Deck to the Graveyard by an effect of a card controlled by your opponent, unite your Graveyard cards and your own Deck, shuffle them and form a new Deck.

name: Babycerasaurus
cn_text: ①：這張卡被效果破壞送去墓地的場合發動。從卡組把1只4星以下的恐龍族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck.

name: Magicians Unite
cn_text: ①：自己場上有攻擊表示的魔法師族怪獸2只以上存在的場合，以那之內的1只為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時變成3000。這張卡的發動后，直到回合結束時那只怪獸以外的魔法師族怪獸不能攻擊。
description: If you control 2 or more Attack Position Spellcaster-Type monsters: Target 1 of them; its ATK becomes 3000 until the end of this turn, also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, other Spellcaster-Type monsters you control cannot attack.

name: One Who Hunts Souls
cn_text: 據說被其用劍斬殺之人的魂魄會離身體而去。
description: This dangerous creature brandishes a soul-sucking sword.

name: Space Mambo
cn_text: 在廣大的銀河中漂流的宇宙飛船。從外太空-四號的超文明遺跡中被發現的活化石。
description: A Space Mambo floating in the vast universe. This living relic was found in the ruins of a super civilization on Alphard 4.

name: Monster Egg
cn_text: 蛋殼保衛全身的迷之戰士，用殼飛射攻擊。
description: A warrior hidden within an egg that attacks enemies by flinging eggshells.

name: Arma Knight
cn_text: 從很久以前就守護?大海的騎士。
description: An ammonite warrior that has protected the seas throughout history.

name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter
cn_text: ①：以自己場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只自己的表側表示怪獸直到結束階段除外。
description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish that target until the End Phase.

name: Black Dragon's Chick
cn_text: 把自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡把1只「真紅眼黑龍」特殊召喚。
description: You can send this face-up card you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" from your hand.

name: Skull Guardian
cn_text: 借由「法理的祈禱」降臨。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為7個以上的卡。
description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Magic Card, "Novox's Prayer". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 7 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: Venom Serpent
cn_text: 1回合只有1次，可以給對方場上1只怪獸放置1個毒指示物。
description: Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls.

name: Backup Soldier
cn_text: 自己的墓地的怪獸卡5張以上存在時才能發動。最多選擇3張自己的墓地效果怪獸以外的攻擊力1500以下的怪獸卡加入手卡。
description: While there are 5 or more monsters in your Graveyard: Target up to 3 non-Effect Monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add them to your hand.

name: Witty Phantom
cn_text: 穿?融入黑暗的黑色燕尾服，操縱?死亡的惡魔。
description: Dressed in a night-black tuxedo, this creature presides over the darkness.

name: Gilford the Lightning
cn_name: 閃電戰士 吉爾弗德
cn_text:
這張卡也能把3只怪獸解放作召喚。
①：把3只怪獸解放對這張卡的上級召喚成功的場合發動。對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

name: Threatening Roar
cn_text: ①：這個回合對方不能攻擊宣言。
description: Your opponent cannot declare an attack this turn.

name: The Legendary Fisherman
cn_text:
①：只要場上有「海」存在，場上的這張卡不受魔法卡的效果影響。
②：只要場上有「海」存在，這張卡不會被作為攻擊對象（自己場上只有被這個效果適用的怪獸存在的狀態中對方的攻擊變成對自己的直接攻擊）。
description: While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

name: Ceasefire
cn_text: ①：場上有效果怪獸或者里側守備表示怪獸存在的場合才能發動。場上的里側守備表示怪獸全部變成表側守備表示。這個時候，反轉怪獸的效果不發動。給與對方為場上的效果怪獸數量×500傷害。
description: If a face-down Defense Position monster or an Effect Monster is on the field: Change all face-down Defense Position monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position (Flip monsters' effects are not activated at this time), also inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Effect Monster on the field.

name: Second Coin Toss
cn_text:
這個卡名的①的效果1回合只能適用1次。
①：自己進行投擲硬幣的效果適用之際，可以從最初開始重新投擲硬幣。
description: When a coin toss is performed, you can choose to redo the coin toss. (If the toss involved multiple coin flips, redo all of them.) You can only use the effect of "Second Coin Toss" once per turn.

name: Gren Maju Da Eiza
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成自己的除外狀態的卡數量×400。
description: This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of your removed from play cards x 400.

name: Overload Fusion
cn_text: ①：自己的場上·墓地的怪獸作為融合素材除外，把1只機械族·暗屬性的融合怪獸融合召喚。
description: Fusion Summon 1 DARK Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

name: Mystical Moon
cn_text: 獸戰士族怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: Equip only to a Beast-Warrior-Type monster. It gains 300 ATK and DEF.

name: Dimensional Alchemist
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。自己卡組最上面的卡除外，這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升500。
②：自己場上的這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，以除外的1只自己怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸加入手卡。
description: Once per turn, you can activate this effect to remove from play the top card of your Deck and give this card 500 ATK until the End Phase. When this card is destroyed and sent from your side of the field to your Graveyard, you can select 1 of your removed from play monsters and return it to your hand.

name: Double Snare
cn_text: 破壞場上表側表示存在的含有（陷阱的效果無效化的效果）的1張卡。
description: Destroy 1 face-up card on the field that has an effect that negates Trap Cards' effects.

name: Ancient Sorcerer
cn_text: 拿?許多手杖。各自分別使用多樣的攻擊。
description: Armed with an array of magic wands, this creature is capable of multiple attacks.

name: Armored Glass
cn_text: 裝備卡給怪獸裝備時才能發動。直到回合結束時場上的全部裝備卡的效果無效。
description: You can only activate this card when a monster is equipped with an Equip Card. Negate the effects of all Equip Cards on the field during the turn this card is activated.

name: Akihiron
cn_text: 潛在水中形狀不明的怪獸。
description: This strange creature hides in the deep, dark corners of the seven seas.

name: Dark Cure
cn_text: 對方把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚時，對方回復那些怪獸的攻擊力一半數值的基本分。
description: When your opponent Summons a monster(s), they gain Life Points equal to half the ATK of 1 of the Summoned monsters of your choice.

name: D.D. Warrior
cn_text: ①：這張卡和怪獸進行戰斗的傷害計算后發動。那些進行戰斗的各自怪獸除外。
description: After damage calculation, when this card battles a monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.

name: Astral Barrier
cn_text: 對方怪獸攻擊自己場上怪獸的場合，可以把那個攻擊變成對自己基本分的直接攻擊。
description: If your opponent's monster attacks a monster you control: You can make the attack a direct attack instead.

name: Cross Counter
cn_text: 受攻擊的守備表示怪獸的守備力，比對方攻擊怪獸的攻擊力高的場合，給與對方的戰斗傷害變成2倍。傷害計算后那只攻擊怪獸破壞。
description: If the DEF of an attacked Defense Position monster is higher than the ATK of your opponent's attacking monster, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent is doubled. Destroy the attacking monster after damage calculation.

name: Sword of Dark Destruction
cn_text: 暗屬性的怪獸才能裝備。裝備的怪獸攻擊力上升400，守備力下降200。
description: A DARK monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

name: Fairywitch
cn_text: 背負?成為天使的命運，但卻成為了向往中的魔女。
description: Though destined to be a fairy, this creature chose the way of the witch instead.

name: Lighten the Load
cn_text: 將手卡1只7星以上的怪獸加入卡組并且洗切，之后抽1張卡。這個效果1回合只能發動1次。
description: Once per turn, you can add 1 Level 7 or higher monster from your hand to your Deck and shuffle it, then draw 1 card.

name: Weather Control
cn_text: 可以自由操縱天氣。山里的天氣無常就是這家伙的杰作。
description: This creature controls weather and is often the cause of mountain storms.

name: Silent Swordsman LV7
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。「沉默劍士 LV5」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，場上的魔法卡的效果無效化。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Silent Swordsman LV5", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Negate all Spell effects on the field.

name: Turtle Tiger
cn_text: 身披甲殼的虎，堅硬的甲殼作守備，尖銳的牙齒作攻擊。
description: A tiger encased in a protective shell that attacks with razor-sharp fangs.

name: Gamble
cn_text:
對方的手卡6張以上，自己的手卡2張以下的時候才可以發動。猜硬幣的正反。
●猜中：自己的手卡抽到5張。
●猜不中：跳過下次的自己的整個回合。
description: You can only activate this card when your opponent's hand is 6 or more cards and your hand is 2 or less. Toss a coin and call heads or tails. If you call it right, draw until your hand has 5 cards. If you call it wrong, skip your next turn.

name: Water Element
cn_text: 住在水里的精靈。將四周用霧包圍妨礙敵人的視線。
description: A sea-dwelling spirit that takes away sight by clouding the area in fog.

name: Soul Rope
cn_text: ①：自己場上的怪獸被效果破壞送去墓地時，支付1000基本分才能發動。從卡組把1只4星怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When a monster you control is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your Deck.

name: Kunai with Chain
cn_text:
①：從以下效果選擇1個或者兩方才能把這張卡發動。
●對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，以那1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸變成守備表示。
●以自己場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。這張卡當作攻擊力上升500的裝備卡使用給那只自己怪獸裝備。
description: Activate 1 or both of these effects (simultaneously).? When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; change that target to Defense Position.? Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK.

name: Fengsheng Mirror
cn_text: 看對方手卡。對方手卡有靈魂怪獸存在的場合，選擇1只靈魂怪獸丟棄去墓地。
description: Look at your opponent's hand. Select and discard 1 Spirit monster to the Graveyard if Spirit monsters exist in his/her hand.

name: Charubin the Fire Knight
cn_text: 「怪獸蛋」＋「史汀」
description: "Monster Egg" + "Hinotama Soul"

name: Relieve Monster
cn_text: 對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。自己場上存在的1只怪獸回到手卡，那之后從手卡把1只4星怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target 1 monster you control; return that target to the hand, then Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your hand.

name: Mind Control
cn_text: ①：以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的控制權直到結束階段得到。這個效果得到控制權的怪獸不能攻擊宣言，不能解放。
description: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, take control of that target, but it cannot declare an attack or be Tributed.

name: Ribbon of Rebirth
cn_text: 裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合，那個回合的結束階段時把那只怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: During the End Phase, if the equipped monster was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon it from the Graveyard to your side of the field.

name: Reckless Greed
cn_text: ①：自己從卡組抽2張，那之后的自己抽卡階段跳過2次。
description: Draw 2 cards and skip your next 2 Draw Phases.

name: Michizure
cn_text: ①：怪獸被戰斗破壞送去自己墓地時或者場上的怪獸被送去自己墓地時，以場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: Activate only when a monster is sent from the field to your Graveyard. Select and destroy 1 monster on the field. (You can activate this card during the Damage Step.)

name: Shadow Tamer
cn_text: 反轉：在回合結束前得到對方場上的1只表側表示存在的惡魔族怪獸。
description: (This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)FLIP: Target 1 Fiend-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: Power Bond
cn_text: ①：自己的手卡·場上的怪獸作為融合素材，把1只機械族融合怪獸融合召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸的攻擊力上升那個原本攻擊力數值。這張卡發動的回合的結束階段讓自己受到這個效果上升的數值的傷害。
description: Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Materials, and it gains ATK equal to its original ATK. During the End Phase of the turn this card is activated, you take damage equal to the amount of ATK gained from this effect at the time of the Summon.

name: Bone Crusher
cn_text: 這張卡被不死族怪獸的效果從自己墓地特殊召喚時，可以把對方場上存在的1張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。這張卡在特殊召喚的回合的結束階段時破壞。
description: When this card is Special Summoned from your Graveyard by the effect of a Zombie-Type monster: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. During the End Phase of the turn this card was Special Summoned: Destroy it.

name: Fusion Sword Murasame Blade
cn_text:
戰士族怪獸才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升800。
②：給怪獸裝備的這張卡不會被效果破壞。
description: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK. While equipped to a monster, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1張表側表示的「海」送去墓地才能發動。這張卡以外的場上的卡全部破壞。
description: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the Graveyard; destroy all other cards on the field.

name: D.D. Scout Plane
cn_text: ①：這張卡被除外的回合的結束階段發動。除外的這張卡攻擊表示特殊召喚（1回合只有1次）。
description: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is currently banished, and was banished this turn: Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position.

name: Honest
cn_text:
①：自己主要階段才能發動。場上的表側表示的這張卡回到手卡。
②：自己的光屬性怪獸進行戰斗的從傷害步驟開始時到傷害計算前，把這張卡從手卡送去墓地才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升進行戰斗的對方怪獸的攻擊力數值。
description: During your Main Phase: You can return this face-up card from the field to the hand. During either player's Damage Step, when a LIGHT monster you control battles: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; that monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the end of this turn.

name: Wynn the Wind Charmer
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1只風屬性怪獸為對象發動。這只怪獸表側表示存在期間，得到作為對象的怪獸的控制權。
description: FLIP: While this card is face-up on the field, take control of 1 WIND monster your opponent controls.

name: Cup of Ace
cn_text: ①：進行1次投擲硬幣。表的場合，自己從卡組抽2張。里的場合，對方從卡組抽2張。
description: Toss a coin: ? Heads: Draw 2 cards. ? Tails: Your opponent draws 2 cards.

name: Rampaging Rhynos
cn_text: 1回合1次，指定沒有使用的相鄰的怪獸卡區域才能發動。自己場上的這張卡向那個怪獸卡區域移動。向這張卡的正對面的對方怪獸攻擊的場合，傷害步驟內這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
description: Once per turn, this card can move to an adjacent unoccupied Monster Card Zone. If this card attacks the monster in its same column, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step.

name: Insect Princess
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方場上所有以表側表示存在的昆蟲族怪獸全部變成攻擊表示。這張卡每戰斗破壞1只昆蟲族怪獸，攻擊力上升500點。
description: While this card is face-up on the field, battle positions of all face-up Insect-Type monsters on your opponent's side of the field are changed into Attack Position. Each time this card destroys an Insect-Type monster as a result of battle, increase the ATK of this card by 500 points.

name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1只地屬性怪獸為對象發動。這只怪獸表側表示存在期間，得到作為對象的怪獸的控制權。
description: FLIP: While this card is face-up on the field, take control of 1 EARTH monster your opponent controls.

name: Slot Machine
cn_text: 據說根據插件集齊的數量能力會發生變化的機器。
description: The machine's ability is said to vary according to its slot results.

name: Dark Magician Girl
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力上升雙方墓地的「黑魔朮師」「黑混沌之魔朮師」數量×300。
description: This card gains 300 ATK for every "Dark Magician" or "Magician of Black Chaos" in either player's Graveyard.

name: Akakieisu
cn_text: 施放死亡詛咒的魔法師。聽到咒文的敵人將變得神智不清。
description: A sorcerer who utters spells that render monsters unconscious.

name: Dark Nephthys
cn_text: 自己的主要階段時自己墓地的暗屬性怪獸是3只以上的場合，可以通過把那之內2只從游戲中除外，這張卡從手卡送去墓地。下次的自己的准備階段時，這個效果送去墓地的這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。此外，這張卡特殊召喚成功時，選擇場上1張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。
description: If you have 3 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard and this card in your hand: You can banish 2 of them from your Graveyard; send this card from your hand to the Graveyard. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent to the Graveyard by this effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Dragonic Knight
cn_text: 要讓自己場上的卡破壞的效果由對方怪獸發動時，把成為對象的自己的卡全部送去墓地才能發動。這張卡從手卡特殊召喚。
description: When the effect of an opponent's monster is activated that targets and destroys a card(s) you control, you can send the targeted card(s) to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from your hand.

name: Machine Attacker
cn_text: 特攻用的機械。以突擊之力打倒敵人。
description: This machine, created to lead charges into enemy territory, mows down enemies by rushing.

name: Trade-In
cn_text: ①：從手卡丟棄1只8星怪獸才能發動。自己抽2張。
description: Discard 1 Level 8 monster; draw 2 cards.

name: Petit Angel
cn_text: 依靠靈活的行動躲避攻擊的小天使。
description: A quick-moving and tiny fairy that's very difficult to hit.

name: Dark Spirit Art - Greed
cn_text: 把自己場上1只暗屬性怪獸解放才能發動。對方可以從手卡把1張魔法卡給人觀看讓這張卡的效果無效。沒給觀看的場合，自己從卡組抽2張卡。
description: Tribute 1 DARK monster. Draw 2 cards. Your opponent can negate this effect by revealing 1 Spell Card in their hand.

name: Seven Tools of the Bandit
cn_text: ①：陷阱卡發動時，支付1000基本分才能發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
description: When a Trap Card is activated: Pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Red Medicine
cn_text: 自己的基本分回復500。
description: Increase your Life Points by 500 points.

name: Dark-Eyes Illusionist
cn_text: 反轉：這張卡場上存在的時候，指定的1只怪獸永續不能攻擊。
description: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; it cannot attack while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Spell Shield Type-8
cn_text:
從下列效果中選擇1項發動：
●使1張以場上1只怪獸為對象的魔法卡的發動與效果無效，并且把它破壞。
●從手卡把1張魔法卡送去墓地。使1張魔法卡的發動與效果無效，并且把它破壞。
description: Activate 1 of these effects.? When a Spell Card is activated that targets exactly 1 monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.? When a Spell Card is activated: Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Mikazukinoyaiba
cn_text: 據說來自月亮，手持新月狀之刀的龍戰士。
description: A dragon warrior of the moon armed with a crescent sword.

name: Crawling Dragon #2
cn_text: 什么都能咬碎的恐龍，攻擊力十分恐怖。
description: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.

name: Needle Wall
cn_text: 自己的准備階段時投擲1個骰子。對方的主要怪獸區域，這張卡的控制者從右面看起對應的怪獸區的怪獸算1至5，投擲出的數目對應的怪獸破壞。投擲出6的場合再投擲1次。
description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Roll a six-sided die. Treat your opponent's Monster Card Zones as numbers 1-5, counting from your right, and destroy the monster that is in the same Monster Card Zone as the result. If the result is 6, roll again.

name: Needle Ceiling
cn_text: 全場上的怪獸4只以上存在的場合才能發動。表側表示的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When there are 4 or more monsters on the field: Destroy all face-up monsters.

name: Gil Garth
cn_text: 身穿鋼鐵鎧甲的殺戮機器。使用巨刀攻擊。
description: This steel-armored terror machine ruthlessly strikes down enemies with its giant katana.

name: The Trojan Horse
cn_text: 作為地屬性怪獸祭品召喚的場合，這只怪獸1只可以作為2只份的祭品使用。
description: When Tribute Summoning an EARTH monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Lady Panther
cn_text: 表側表示的這張卡做祭品。1只這個回合被戰斗破壞送去墓地的自己的怪獸回到卡組的最上面。
description: Tribute this face-up card to return 1 of your monsters destroyed as a result of battle during this turn to the top of your Deck.

name: Horn of Light
cn_text: 裝備怪獸的守備力上升800。這張卡從場地送入墓地時，若支付500基本分則回到卡組最上面。
description: Increase the DEF of a monster equipped with this card by 800 points. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, if you pay 500 Life Points, this card returns to the top of your Deck.

name: Black Tyranno
cn_text: 當對方場上僅有守備表示的怪獸存在時，這張卡可以對對方進行直接攻擊。
description: If the only cards your opponent controls are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Book of Taiyou
cn_text: ①：以場上1只里側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只里側表示怪獸變成表側攻擊表示。
description: Flip 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position.

name: Question
cn_text: 這張卡發動中，對方不能確認墓地里的卡。對方玩家猜發動「謎題」的玩家墓地最下面1張怪獸卡的名字。如果猜中，將被猜的怪獸卡除外。如果猜錯，將此怪獸卡在其持有者的場上特殊召喚。
description: When activating this card, your opponent cannot check cards in the Graveyard. Your opponent calls the name of the first monster found at the bottom of your Graveyard. If he/she calls it right, the monster is removed from play. If he/she calls it wrong, the monster is Special Summoned to your side of the field.

name: The Agent of Wisdom - Mercury
cn_name: 英知之代行者 墨丘利
cn_text: ①：對方回合結束時，這張卡在自己的怪獸區域表側表示存在，自己手卡是0張的場合，下次的自己准備階段發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: During your Standby Phase, if you controlled this face-up card and had no cards in your hand at the end of the opponent's last End Phase: Draw 1 card.

name: Frontier Wiseman
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己的場上存在，以自己場上的表側表示存在的戰士族怪獸為對象的魔法卡的效果無效并破壞。
description: Negate any Spell effects that target a Warrior-Type monster you control, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Roboyarou
cn_text: 全身覆蓋?金屬裝甲的戰士。與「稀有金屬女郎」融合將提升力量。
description: A warrior fully covered with metal. It upgrades by fusing with "Robolady".

name: Sonic Maid
cn_text: 擅長操縱聲音的少女，能使音符變成鐮刀攻擊敵人。
description: A maiden that uses sound to her advantage, she wields a scythe that's shaped like a musical note.

name: Hyo
cn_text: 全身用冰做的戰士。將一切與其解觸者冰凍起來。
description: None can survive the cold touch of this sub-zero warrior.

name: Wave-Motion Cannon
cn_text: ①：把魔法與陷阱區域的表側表示的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。給與對方這張卡的發動后經過的自己准備階段次數×1000傷害。
description: During your Main Phase, you can send this card to the Graveyard to inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent for each of your Standby Phases that have passed since this card was activated.

name: Cosmo Queen
cn_text: 統治?宇宙中存在的所有星球的女王。
description: Queen of the galaxies and mistress of the stars.

name: Root Water
cn_text: 潛伏在海里的半魚人，掀起黑暗浪潮襲擊。
description: An amphibian capable of calling up a massive tidal wave from the dark seas to wipe out enemy monsters.

name: Order to Smash
cn_text: 選擇自己場上存在的1只2星以下的通常怪獸（衍生物除外）發動。發動之后，祭掉被選擇的通常怪獸，破壞對方場上至多2張魔法·陷阱卡。
description: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field when you activate this card. When this card resolves, you can Tribute the selected Normal Monster and destroy 1 or 2 Spell or Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Tri-Horned Dragon
cn_text: 以頭上生長的3只角為特徵的惡魔龍。
description: An unworthy dragon with three sharp horns sprouting from its head.

name: Des Counterblow
cn_text: 進行直接攻擊并對玩家造成戰斗傷害的怪獸被破壞。
description: Destroy any monster that inflicts Battle Damage to a player's Life Points by attacking directly.

name: Berserk Gorilla
cn_text: 當這張卡在場上以表側守備表示存在時，這張卡被破壞。當這張卡處於可以進行攻擊的狀態時，這張卡的控制者必須讓這張卡進行攻擊。
description: If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. This card must attack if able.

name: Winged Cleaver
cn_text: 揮動如鐮刀般發達的手臂進行攻擊。
description: Few can withstand the scythe-like arms of this dangerous creature.

name: Rigorous Reaver
cn_text:
①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。雙方玩家各自選自己1張手卡丟棄。
②：這張卡被和怪獸的戰斗破壞的場合發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力·守備力下降500。
description: FLIP: Each player discards 1 card.If this card is destroyed by battle: The monster that destroyed it loses 500 ATK and DEF.

name: Storm Shooter
cn_text:
1回合只有1次，可以從下面的效果選擇1個發動。
●移動到沒有使用的相鄰的怪獸卡區域。
●這張卡的正對面存在的1張對方的怪獸·魔法·陷阱卡回到持有者手卡。
description: Once per turn, you can select and activate 1 of these effects: ? Move this card to an adjacent unoccupied Monster Card Zone. ? Return 1 Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field in the same column as this card to its owner's hand.

name: Masked Dragon
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的龍族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

name: Royal Guard
cn_text: 為了守護王座而開發的，且擁有意志的機械部隊。
description: A mechanized soldier created to protect royalty.

name: Beta The Magnet Warrior
cn_text: 用α、β、γ來變形合體。
description: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

name: Darkblaze Dragon
cn_text:
①：這張卡從墓地的特殊召喚成功的場合發動。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成原本數值的2倍。

cn_text: 「查克拉」的降臨必要。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為7個以上的卡。

description: While you have 1 or less cards in your hand, this card gains 400 ATK. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

name: Ordeal of a Traveler
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時1次，可以把這個效果發動。自己1張手卡由對方隨機選，對方對那張卡的種類（怪獸·魔法·陷阱）作猜測。猜錯的場合，那只攻擊怪獸回到持有者手卡。

cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。滿足條件的「大神官 迪·扎德」做祭品特殊召喚。這張卡1個回合可以有1次變成里側守備表示。場上表側表示存在的這張卡為對象的魔法·陷阱卡的發動和效果無效并破壞。這張卡反轉時，選擇自己的墓地的1只不死族怪獸特殊召喚上場。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand or your Deck by Tributing 1 "Great Dezard" that has fulfilled the condition. You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them. When this card is flipped face-up, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your Graveyard.

name: Cry Havoc!
cn_text: 可以把自己墓地1張怪獸卡從游戲中除外，從手卡把1只通常怪獸通常召喚。這個效果在自己回合的主要階段時才能發動。

description: You can only activate this card while there are 3 Normal Monsters of the same name (except Tokens) on your side of the field. The 3 Normal Monsters of the same name can attack your opponent's Life Points directly during the turn that this card is activated.

cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。召喚·反轉回合的結束階段時回到主人的手卡。這張卡召喚·反轉時，可以選擇對方場上的1只表側表示的怪獸改變表示形式。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

name: Vile Germs

name: Lucky Trinket
cn_text: 雖然搖搖晃晃的，但被聖之力保護?。

name: Cyber Raider
cn_text:
這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚時，從下列效果中選擇1項發動：
●選擇場上1張裝備在怪獸身上的裝備卡并將其破壞。
●選擇場上1張裝備在怪獸身上的裝備卡并將其裝備在這張卡身上。
description: When this card is Summoned: Activate 1 of these effects.? Target 1 Equip Card equipped to a monster on the field; destroy that target.? Target 1 Equip Card equipped to a monster on the field; equip that target to this card.

name: Chain Material
cn_text: 這張卡的發動回合自己融合召喚的場合，可以把融合怪獸卡決定的融合素材怪獸從自己的手卡·卡組·場上·墓地選出從游戲中除外，用這些作為融合素材。這張卡發動的回合，自己不能攻擊，這個效果融合召喚的怪獸在結束階段時破壞。

You cannot attack during the turn this card is activated. If you used this effect for a Fusion Summon, the Summoned Fusion Monster is destroyed during the End Phase.

cn_text: 「陸戰型戰斗艇」＋「守衛海洋的戰士」

name: Dark Scorpion Burglars
cn_text: 這張卡給與對方玩家戰斗傷害時，對方從卡組選擇1張魔法卡送去墓地，之后卡組洗切。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Your opponent sends 1 Spell Card from their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Grave Ohja
cn_text: 只要自己場上存在里側守備表示的怪獸，這張卡不能被選擇為攻擊對象。每次自己場上的怪獸反轉召喚，給與對方300分傷害。
description: While there is a face-down Defense Position monster(s) on your side of the field, no player can select this card as an attack target. Each time a monster on your side of the field is Flip Summoned, inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

name: The Lady in Wight
cn_text: 這張卡的卡名只要在墓地存在當作「白骨」使用。此外，只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，「白骨夫人」以外的場上的3星以下的不死族怪獸不會被戰斗破壞，也不受魔法·陷阱卡的效果影響。
description: Face-up Level 3 or lower Zombie-Type monsters on the field, except "The Lady in Wight", cannot be destroyed by battle and are unaffected by Spell/Trap effects. This card's name becomes "Skull Servant" while it is in the Graveyard.

name: Strike Ninja
cn_text:
這個卡名的效果1回合只能使用1次。
①：從自己墓地把2只暗屬性怪獸除外才能發動。表側表示的這張卡直到結束階段除外。這個效果在對方回合也能發動。
description: Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can banish 2 DARK monsters from your Graveyard; banish this face-up card until the End Phase.

name: Yashinoki
cn_text: 有意志的椰子樹。以落下的果實進行攻擊。果實中的椰汁味道鮮美。
description: An intelligent palm tree that drops a hail of rock-hard coconuts on its enemies.

name: Flame Ruler
cn_text: 祭品召喚炎屬性怪獸的場合，這只怪獸1只作為2只份的祭品使用。
description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a FIRE monster

name: Diskblade Rider
cn_text: 把自己墓地存在的1張通常陷阱卡從游戲中除外，這張卡的攻擊力直到對方回合的結束階段時上升500。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn: You can target 1 Normal Trap Card in your Graveyard; banish that target, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn.

name: The Cheerful Coffin
cn_text: 從自己的手卡中丟棄最多3張怪獸卡送去墓地。
description: Discard up to 3 Monster Cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

name: Green Gadget
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·特殊召喚成功時才能發動。從卡組把1只「紅色零件」加入手卡。
description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Red Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Javelin Beetle Pact
cn_text: 「標槍甲蟲」的降臨必要。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為8個以上的卡。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Javelin Beetle". You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Claw Reacher
cn_text: 手腕能自由的伸縮，尖利的爪子能將敵人刺穿。
description: Stretching arms and razor-sharp claws make this monster a formidable opponent.

name: Acid Trap Hole
cn_text: ①：以場上1只里側守備表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸變成表側守備表示，守備力是2000以下的場合破壞。守備力比2000高的場合回到里側守備表示。
description: Target 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; flip it face-up, then destroy it if its DEF is 2000 or less, or return it face-down if its DEF is more than 2000.

name: Rallis the Star Bird
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力在傷害步驟時上升戰斗的對方怪獸等級×200的數值。這張卡攻擊的場合傷害步驟結束時從游戲中除外，下次自己回合的戰斗階段開始時表側攻擊表示回到自己場上。
description: This card gains ATK equal to the Level of the monster that it battles x 200 during the Damage Step only. If this card attacks, it is removed from play at the end of the Damage Step and returned to your side of the field in face-up Attack Position at the beginning of your next turn's Battle Phase.

name: Feral Imp
cn_text: 喜歡惡作劇的小惡魔，從黑暗中襲來。警惕！
description: A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

name: Blue-Winged Crown
cn_text: 青白色的火鳥，頭上的毛有如皇冠。
description: With hair shaped like a crown and a body encased in bluish white flames, this bird is a formidable sight.

name: Curse of Aging
cn_text: 從手卡丟棄1枚卡，在回合終了前，對方場上所有怪獸攻擊力·守備力下降500點。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Decrease the ATK and DEF of all monsters on your opponent's side of the field by 500 points until the end of the turn this card is activated.

name: Giant Scorpion of the Tundra
cn_text: 不是在沙漠而是分布在冰土帶上的罕見的深藍色的蠍子。
description: An extraordinary blue scorpion found in the tundra, not in the desert.

name: Solemn Judgment
cn_text:
①：可以把基本分支付一半把以下效果發動。
●魔法·陷阱卡發動時才能發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
●自己或對方把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚之際才能發動。那個無效，那些怪獸破壞。
description: When a monster would be Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Pay half your Life Points; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Supporter in the Shadows
cn_text: 從暗處協助他人的可愛小人。
description: A cute little elf that hides in the shadows and provides spiritual support.

name: Black Illusion Ritual
cn_text:
「納祭之魔」的降臨必需。
①：等級合計直到1以上的自己的手卡·場上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「納祭之魔」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Relinquished". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 1 or more.

name: Thousand Dragon
cn_text: 「時間魔朮師」＋「寶貝龍」
description: "Time Wizard" + "Baby Dragon"

name: Mirage of Nightmare
cn_text: 對方的准備階段時，自己抽卡直到4張手卡。自己的准備階段時，隨機丟棄那個效果所抽的卡的數量的手卡。
description: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand. If you do, during your next Standby Phase after that: Randomly discard the same number of cards you drew (or your entire hand, if you do not have enough cards).

name: Goblin Fan
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，2星以下的怪獸在反轉召喚成功時破壞。這個時候，那只怪獸不能把場上發動的效果發動。
description: When a Level 2 or lower monster is Flip Summoned, destroy it. Its effects do not activate at that time.

name: Kamionwizard
cn_text: 「聖精靈」＋「黑魔族的幕簾」
description: "Mystical Elf" + "Curtain of the Dark Ones"

name: Broken Bamboo Sword
cn_text: ①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升0。
description: The equipped monster gains 0 ATK.

name: Tenkabito Shien
cn_text: 這張卡不受陷阱卡的效果影響。
description: This card is unaffected by the effects of Trap Cards.

name: Cyber Laser Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。這張卡只能通過「光子發生裝置」的效果特殊召喚。可以把持有這張卡攻擊力以上的攻擊力·守備力的1只怪獸破壞。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Photon Generator Unit". Once per turn, you can destroy 1 monster with ATK or DEF equal to or higher than the ATK of this card.

name: Sauropod Brachion
cn_text:
這張卡不能從卡組特殊召喚。這張卡可以把1只恐龍族怪獸解放表側表示上級召喚。
①：自己主要階段才能發動。這張卡變成里側守備表示（1回合只有1次）。
②：這張卡反轉召喚成功的場合發動。這張卡以外的場上的怪獸全部變成里側守備表示。
③：這張卡被攻擊的場合，那次戰斗發生的對對方的戰斗傷害變成2倍。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 Dinosaur-Type monster. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Change all other monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position. If this card is attacked, any battle damage your opponent takes from that battle is doubled.

name: Giant Flea
cn_text: 攻擊力高強的巨型吸血跳蚤，輕視它會非常危險。
description: A massive flea that feeds on the blood of its enemies.

name: Raigeki Break
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以場上1張卡為對象才能發動。那張卡破壞。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

name: Queen of Autumn Leaves
cn_text: 生活在被紅葉圍繞的地方，綠樹靈王的妃子。
description: Queen of the Emerald Forest and wife of the Spirit King, she lives surrounded by vivid red leaves.

name: Jowgen the Spiritualist
cn_text: 把手卡隨機1張丟棄去墓地才能發動。場上的特殊召喚的怪獸全部破壞。此外，只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，雙方不能把怪獸特殊召喚。
description: You can discard 1 random card from your hand to the Graveyard; destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field. Neither player can Special Summon monsters.

name: Burning Algae
cn_text: 當這張卡被送去墓地時，對方回復1000基本分。
description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard, increase your opponent's Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Swarm of Locusts
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合可以有1次變回里側守備表示。這張卡反轉召喚成功時，破壞對方場上1張魔法·陷阱卡。
description: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Bark of Dark Ruler
cn_text: 自己場上存在的惡魔族怪獸進行戰斗的場合，那個傷害步驟時支付100的倍數的基本分發動。直到這個回合的結束階段時，進行戰斗的1只對方怪獸的攻擊力·守備力下降支付的數值。
description: If a Fiend-Type monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP (in multiples of 100 points), then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.

name: Dark Assailant
cn_text: 持有精神之劍、君臨魔界的暗殺者。
description: Armed with the Psycho Sword, this sinister assassin rules the bad land.

name: Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo
cn_text:
①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。場上的特殊召喚的怪獸全部破壞。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不能把怪獸特殊召喚。
description: If this card is flipped face-up: Destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field. Neither player can Special Summon monsters.

name: Panther Warrior
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，這張卡的攻擊宣言之際，自己必須把這張卡以外的自己場上1只怪獸解放。
description: This card cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster.

name: Trap Hole
cn_text: ①：對方對攻擊力1000以上的怪獸的召喚·反轉召喚成功時，以那1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊力1000以上的怪獸破壞。
description: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons 1 monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.

name: Sea Serpent Warrior of Darkness
cn_text: 守護暗黑之海的戰士。在水中的戰斗力就不用多說了，即使是在陸地上也同時擁有很高的戰斗能力。
description: A warrior who defends the world of the Sea of Darkness. He prides himself on his fighting prowess both on the ground and, of course, in the water.

name: Big Koala
cn_text: 非常巨大的一種死亡樹熊。性格溫順，但因為擁有非常強大的力量而被畏懼。
description: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

name: Volcanic Eruption
cn_text: 自己場上有「侏羅紀世界」存在的場合，自己的結束階段時才能發動。場上的卡全部破壞。
description: During your End Phase, if you control "Jurassic World": Destroy all cards on the field.

name: Counter Counter
cn_text: 反擊陷阱卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: Negate the activation of a Counter Trap Card, and destroy it.

name: Trakodon
cn_text: 虎型恐龍。跑過曠野的速度相當快。
description: A tiger-striped dragon that is often seen racing across the wasteland at tremendous speeds.

name: Summoner Monk
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚的場合發動。這張卡變成守備表示。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，這張卡不能解放。
③：1回合1次，從手卡丟棄1張魔法卡才能發動。從卡組把1只4星怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸在這個回合不能攻擊。
description: While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed. If this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: Change this card to Defense Position. Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell; Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your Deck, but that monster cannot attack this turn.

name: Arsenal Bug
cn_text: 自己的場上沒有這張卡以外的昆蟲族存在，這張卡的攻擊力守備力變成1000。
description: If you control no other Insect-Type monsters, this card's ATK and DEF become 1000.

name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
cn_name: 鐵騎士 基亞·弗里德
cn_text: ①：這張卡有裝備卡被裝備的場合發動。那些裝備卡破壞。
description: When an Equip Card(s) is equipped to this card: Destroy that Equip Card(s).

name: Winged Egg of New Life
cn_text: 據說它能知道女性腹部是否存在?生命。
description: Legend has it that this creature can foretell the birth of children.

name: Ancient Brain
cn_text: 被天界放逐的墮天使，在暗域中的戰斗很出色。
description: A fallen fairy that is powerful in the dark.

name: Silent Doom
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只通常怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸守備表示特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸不能攻擊。
description: Target 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position, but it cannot attack.

name: Coach Goblin
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上以表側表示存在，在自己回合的結束階段時，可以將1張通常怪獸卡從手卡放回卡組最下方，再從卡組抽1張卡。此效果每回合只能使用1次。
description: While this card is face-up on your side of the field, you can return 1 Normal Monster Card in your hand to the bottom of your Deck during your End Phase to draw 1 card from your Deck. You can only use this effect once per turn.

name: Eatgaboon
cn_text: 對方召喚·反轉召喚的怪獸的攻擊力在500以下的場合，可以把那1只怪獸破壞。
description: If the ATK of a monster summoned by your opponent (excluding Special Summon) is 500 points or less, the monster is destroyed.

name: Spell Economics
cn_text: 發動魔法卡時不需支付基本分。
description: You do not pay Life Points to activate Spell Cards.

name: Laughing Flower
cn_text: 總是在笑?的花。如果持續聽它的笑聲的話，頭腦就會變得混亂。
description: A flower whose laugh can confuse the minds of enemies.

name: Goblin of Greed
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上以表側表示存在，雙方都不能發動「通過丟棄手卡來發動」的效果。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, neither player can activate an effect by discarding from his/her hand.

name: Special Hurricane
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。破壞場上存在的所有特殊召喚的怪獸。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field.

name: Flame Champion
cn_text: 使用火焰盾的劍士，之盾能無視任何攻擊。
description: A warrior protected by a flaming shield that nullifies any attack.

name: Little D
cn_text: 恐龍的孩子。性格極其凶暴。
description: Yo, this tyrannosaurus tot's got a terrible temper.

name: Ryu-Kishin Clown
cn_text: 這張卡片召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚時可以使對方1只表側表示的怪獸的表示形式改變。
description: When this card is Summoned (including Flip Summon and Special Summon), select 1 face-up monster on the field and change its battle position.

name: Card of Sanctity
cn_text: ①：把自己的手卡·場上的卡全部除外才能發動。自己直到手卡變成2張為止從卡組抽卡。
description: Banish all other cards you control and in your hand (min.1 from each); draw until you have 2 cards in your hand.

name: Kiseitai
cn_text: 場上里側守備表示存在的這張卡被對方怪獸攻擊的場合，那次傷害計算前這張卡變成攻擊怪獸的裝備卡。每次對方的准備階段，自己基本分回復這張卡的裝備怪獸的攻擊力一半的數值。
description: When your opponent's monster attacks this card in face-down Defense Position, this card becomes an Equip Spell Card equipped to the attacking monster (No damage calculation is conducted). During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, increase your Life Points by half of the ATK of the monster equipped with this card.

name: Giant Trunade
cn_text: 場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部回到持有者手卡。
description: Return all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the hand.

name: The Forceful Sentry
cn_text: 把對方手卡確認，從那之中選1張卡回到卡組。
description: Look at your opponent's hand. Select 1 card among them and return it to his/her Deck. The Deck is then shuffled.

name: Gora Turtle of Illusion
cn_text: 以場上表側表示的這張卡為對象的，由對方所控制的魔法·陷阱卡的效果無效。
description: Negate the effect of Spell and Trap Cards controlled by your opponent that target this face-up card on the field.

name: Wodan the Resident of the Forest
cn_text: 場上每存在1只表側表示的植物族怪獸，這張卡的攻擊力上升100。
description: Increase this card's ATK by 100 points for every Plant-Type monster that is face-up on the field.

name: Ojama Yellow
cn_text: 據說能使盡一切手段去搗亂的擾亂三人組一員。據說若三人到齊了將會有什么事情發生。
description: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只炎屬性怪獸解放才能發動。給與對方解放的怪獸的原本攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

name: Wandering Mummy
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合可以有1次變回里側守備表示。這個效果使用后，把自己的主要怪獸區域的全部里側守備表示的怪獸洗切，再次重新里側守備表示按自己的順序安排到場上的位置。
description: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters on your side of the field, then return them in face-down Defense Position.

name: Monster Gate
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只怪獸解放才能發動。直到可以通常召喚的怪獸出現為止從自己卡組上面翻卡，那只怪獸特殊召喚。剩下的翻開的卡全部送去墓地。
description: Tribute 1 monster; excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set. Special Summon it, also send the other excavated cards to the Graveyard.

name: Phantom Dragonray Bronto
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡的原本攻擊力變成2300。這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示。直到下次的自己回合結束時這張卡不能把表示形式改變。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? The original ATK of this card becomes 2300. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

name: Ancient Lizard Warrior
cn_text: 遠古的保持?昔日姿態的蜥蜴戰士，意外的強悍。
description: Before the dawn of man, this lizard warrior ruled supreme.

name: Draining Shield
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，以1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸的攻擊無效，自己回復那只怪獸的攻擊力數值的基本分。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate that attack, and if you do, gain LP equal to that target's ATK.

name: Forced Back
cn_text: 怪獸的召喚·反轉召喚無效，那只怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: Negate the Normal Summon or Flip Summon of a monster and return the monster to its owner's hand.

name: Nekogal #2
cn_text: 用敏捷的動作躲避攻擊、用鋒利的?爪襲擊對方。
description: A fast and lethal creature with very dangerous claws.

name: Newdoria
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合，以場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Armityle the Chaos Phantom
cn_name: 混沌幻魔 阿米泰爾
cn_text:
「神炎皇 烏利亞」＋「降雷皇 哈蒙」＋「幻魔皇 拉比艾爾」
把自己場上的上記卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚（不需要「融合」）。
①：這張卡的攻擊力在自己回合內上升10000。
②：這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。
description: "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" + "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder" + "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms"Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be destroyed by battle. This card gains 10,000 ATK during your turn only.

name: Commencement Dance
cn_text: 「舞蹈戰士」的降臨必需。若不從場地和手卡把等級直到6以上的卡作為祭品，則「舞蹈戰士」不能降臨。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Performance of Sword". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Double Summon
cn_text: ①：這個回合自己可以進行通常召喚最多2次。
description: You can conduct 2 Normal Summons/Sets this turn, not just 1.

name: The Shallow Grave
cn_text: 雙方玩家選擇各自墓地1只怪獸在各自場上里側守備表示蓋放。
description: Each player selects 1 monster in their Graveyard and Special Summons it in face-down Defense Position.

name: Darkworld Thorns
cn_text: 棲息在魔界的有刺灌木，將硬闖的人牢牢纏住。
description: A thorny plant found in the darklands that wraps itself around any unwary traveler.

name: Toon Defense
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸向自己的4星以下的卡通怪獸攻擊宣言時才能把這個效果發動。那只對方怪獸的攻擊變成對自己的直接攻擊。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a face-up Level 4 or lower Toon Monster you control: You can make the attack a direct attack instead.

name: Emes the Infinity
cn_text: ①：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地的場合發動。這張卡的攻擊力上升700。
description: Each time this card destroys an opponent's monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase the ATK of this card by 700 points.

name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
cn_text:
這個卡名的效果在決斗中只能使用1次。
①：場上的這張卡被破壞送去墓地的回合的結束階段才能發動。這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成1000。
description: During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK and DEF become 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

name: Tailor of the Fickle
cn_text: 把怪獸裝備的1張裝備卡，轉換給1只別的能變成正確對象的怪獸。
description: Switch 1 Equip Card equipped to a monster to another correct target.

name: Novox's Prayer
cn_text: 「法理守護者」的降臨必要。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為7個以上的卡。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Skull Guardian". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 7 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: Prohibition
cn_text:
宣言1個卡名才能把這張卡發動。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，宣言的卡名為原本卡名的雙方的卡受以下所適用（對從這個效果的適用前開始在場上存在的卡不適用）。
●不能在場上出現。
●不能作卡的發動以及效果的發動和適用。
●不能通常召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
●不能作攻擊以及表示形式的變更。
●不能作為要為需要素材的特殊召喚而用的素材。
description: Activate by declaring 1 card name. Cards with that name, and their effects, cannot be used. Cards already on the field are not affected (including face-down cards).

name: Man-Thro' Tro'
cn_text: 每祭掉自己場上1只通常怪獸（衍生物除外），給與對方基本分800分的傷害。
description: By Tributing 1 Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Poison Mummy
cn_text: 反轉：給與對方500基本分傷害。
description: FLIP: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Giga Gagagigo
cn_text: 為了對抗強大的邪惡，各種肉體改造的結果得到了驚人的力量，但作為其代價喪失了正義之心。
description: In order to fight tremendous evil, he gained formidable power through body reconstruction, but lost his heart and his redemption.

name: Warrior of Atlantis
cn_text: ①：把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地才能發動。從卡組把1張「傳說之都 亞特蘭蒂斯」加入手卡。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "A Legendary Ocean" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Madjinn Gunn
cn_text: 從口中能夠發射子彈攻擊的生物兵器。
description: A living weapon that spits projectiles.

name: Leo Wizard
cn_text: 披?黑披風的魔朮師。其正體是只能說話的獅子。
description: A mysterious magician that cloaks itself with a black cape. Its identity is a talking lion beast.

name: The Flute of Summoning Dragon
cn_text: ①：從手卡把最多2只龍族怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果在場上有「龍之支配者」存在的場合才能發動和處理。
description: Special Summon up to 2 Dragon-Type monsters from your hand. "Lord of D." must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Supply
cn_text: 反轉：通過「融合」而送去自己的墓地的2只融合素材怪獸加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Return 2 Fusion-Material monsters that were sent to the Graveyard as a result of a Fusion Summon to your hand.

name: Takriminos
cn_text: 身體有鰭，在水中也能自由活動的海龍同類。
description: A member of a race of sea serpents that freely travels through the sea.

name: Mirror Force
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。對方場上的攻擊表示怪獸全部破壞。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

name: Samsara
cn_text: 作為儀式召喚的祭品的怪獸卡不去墓地，回到持有者的卡組。之后卡組洗切。
description: Monster Cards Tributed for a Ritual Summon are returned to the owner's Deck instead of being sent to the Graveyard.

name: Robotic Knight
cn_text: 侍從機械王的機械族的司令官。統率機械部隊的攻擊性用兵而很有名。
description: The Commander of Machine-Types, he serves the Machine King. He is famous for the way he controls his troops.

name: Castle Walls
cn_text: 選擇場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸發動。選擇的怪獸的守備力直到結束階段時上升500。
description: Increase the DEF of 1 face-up monster on the field by 500 points until the end of this turn.

name: Abyssal Kingshark
cn_text: 這張卡1回合只有1次不會被不指定對象的卡的效果破壞。
description: Once per turn, if this card would be destroyed by an effect that does not target it, it is not destroyed.

name: Masaki the Legendary Swordsman
cn_text: 據說是完成了百人斬的傳說中的劍豪。
description: Legendary swordmaster Masaki is a veteran of over 100 battles.

name: Drastic Drop Off
cn_text: ①：對方從卡組把卡加入手卡時才能發動。對方把加入手卡的那1張卡丟棄。
description: When your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand, including drawing: They must discard 1 of those cards.

name: Double Coston
cn_text: ①：暗屬性怪獸上級召喚的場合，這張卡可以作為2只的數量解放。
description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster.

name: Solar Ray
cn_text: 對對方造成數值與自己場上存在的光屬性怪獸數量×600點等同的傷害。
description: Inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each face-up LIGHT monster on your side of the field.

name: Left Leg of the Forbidden One
cn_text: 被封印的左足。假若解開封印，能得無限之力。
description: A forbidden left leg sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

name: Light of Judgment
cn_text:
①：場上有「天空的聖域」存在的場合從手卡把1只光屬性怪獸丟棄去墓地才能發動。從以下效果選1個適用。
●把對方手卡確認，從那之中選1張卡送去墓地。
●選對方場上1張卡送去墓地。
description: If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field, you can activate this card by discarding 1 LIGHT monster from your hand to the Graveyard. Choose 1 card your opponent controls or 1 in their hand (you can look at their hand), and send it to the Graveyard.

name: Messenger of Peace
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的攻擊力1500以上的怪獸不能攻擊宣言。這張卡的控制者在每次自己的准備階段支付100基本分。或者不支付100基本分讓這張卡破壞。
description: Monsters with 1500 or more ATK cannot declare an attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 100 LP or destroy this card.

name: Bitelon
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊守備表示怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Delinquent Duo
cn_text: 支付1000基本分發動。對方隨機把1張手卡丟棄，再選1張手卡丟棄。
description: Pay 1000 Life Points. Your opponent randomly selects and discards 1 card from his/her hand and then selects and discards another card from his/her hand.

name: Cyber Soldier
cn_text: 護衛機械王的兵隊。圓圓的身體到處轉動?進行巡邏。
description: Guardian of the Machine Master, it crushes opposition by rolling over them.

name: Timeater
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，下次的對方回合的主要階段1跳過。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Your opponent skips their next Main Phase 1.

name: B.E.S. Tetran
cn_text: 這張卡召喚時放置3個指示物。這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。進行戰斗的場合，在傷害步驟結束時取除1個指示物。沒有指示物放置的狀態進行戰斗的場合，傷害步驟結束時這張卡破壞。此外，可以把這張卡的1個指示物取除，破壞場上1張魔法·陷阱卡。這個效果1個回合只能使用1次。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Tripwire Beast
cn_text: 強大的電磁波不停的向周圍發射。
description: This creature attacks with electromagnetic waves.

name: Ocean's Keeper
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊守備表示怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。這張卡被戰斗破壞的場合，從自己卡組把1只「千眼卵魚」或「母腦魚」加入手卡。
description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card is destroyed by battle, add 1 "Thousand-Eyes Jellyfish" or 1 "Cranium Fish" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Ogre of the Black Shadow
cn_text: 被黑影附體的惡鬼。用驚人的速度突擊。
description: An ogre possessed by the powers of the dark. Few can withstand its rapid charge.

name: Old Vindictive Magician
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只對方怪獸破壞。
description: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Flame Swordsman
cn_text: 「火焰操縱者」＋「傳說的劍豪 正樹」
description: "Flame Manipulator" + "Masaki the Legendary Swordsman"

name: Mark of the Rose
cn_text:
從自己墓地把1只植物族怪獸除外，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。
①：得到裝備怪獸的控制權。
②：自己結束階段發動。這張卡的①的效果直到下次的自己准備階段無效。
description: Activate this card by banishing 1 Plant-Type monster from your Graveyard; equip this card to a monster your opponent controls. Take control of the equipped monster. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Give control of the equipped monster to your opponent. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take control of the equipped monster.

name: Goblin Thief
cn_text: ①：給與對方500傷害。自己回復500基本分。
description: Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points and increase your Life Points by 500 points.

name: Fairy King Truesdale
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域守備表示存在，自己場上的植物族怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升500。
description: While this card is in Defense Position, all Plant-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF.

name: Yellow Luster Shield
cn_text: 自己場上存在的所有怪獸守備力上升300點。
description: Increase the DEF of all monsters on your side of the field by 300 points.

name: Dark Red Enchanter
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，這張卡放置2個魔力指示物。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物。這張卡放置的魔力指示物每有1個，這張卡的攻擊力上升300。1回合1次，可以把這張卡放置的2個魔力指示物取除，對方手卡隨機丟棄1張。
description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 2 Spell Counters on it. Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. This card gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. Once per turn: You can remove 2 Spell Counters from this card; Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Birdface
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，從卡組選1張「鷹身女郎」加入手卡。之后洗切卡組。
description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can add 1 "Harpie Lady" from your Deck to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Karakuri Spider
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊的怪獸是暗屬性的場合，那只怪獸破壞，傷害的計算適用。
description: If this card attacks a DARK monster, destroy the attack target after damage calculation.

name: Rising Air Current
cn_text: 全部的風屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500，守備力下降400。
description: All WIND monsters gain 500 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

name: Lost Guardian
cn_text: 這張卡原本的守備力，是自己除外的岩石族怪獸數×700。
description: The original DEF of this card equals the number of your banished Rock-Type monsters x 700.

name: Gilasaurus
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以從手卡特殊召喚。
②：這張卡的①的方法特殊召喚成功的場合發動。對方可以選自身墓地1只怪獸特殊召喚。
description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way: Activate this effect; your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their Graveyard.

name: Dark-Piercing Light
cn_text: 對方場上里側表示的怪獸全部表側表示。
description: Flip all face-down monsters on your opponent's side of the field face-up.

name: Bonding - H2O
cn_text: ①：把自己場上2只「氫素龍」和1只「氧素龍」解放才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地把1只「水龍」特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Moon Envoy
cn_text: 侍奉月之女神的戰士。使用像新月一樣的戈進行攻擊！
description: Many have fallen victim to this lunar warrior's crescent pike.

name: Twister
cn_text: 支付500基本分才能發動。選擇場上表側表示存在的1張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。
description: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Cycroid
cn_text: 眾多交通工具機人中，和人最親近而深受喜愛的交通工具機人。還可以裝備輔助輪喔！
description: The most lovable and friendly of all the Vehicroids. It can arm itself with training wheels!

name: Solar Flare Dragon
cn_text: 若自己場上有除這張卡以外的炎族怪獸存在，則這張卡不能被攻擊。在自己的每回合的結束階段，給與對方基本分500分的傷害。
description: While you control another Pyro-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked. During each of your End Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Snatch Steal
cn_text:
可以給對方場上的怪獸裝備。
①：得到裝備怪獸的控制權。
②：對方准備階段發動。對方回復1000基本分。
description: Equip only to a monster your opponent controls. Take control of the equipped monster. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: They gain 1000 Life Points.

name: Beast Fangs
cn_text: 獸族才能裝備。1只裝備怪獸的攻擊力和守備力上升300。
description: A Beast-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Guardian Tryce
cn_text: 當自己場上存在「閃光之雙劍-雷震」時才能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，將墓地里存在的這張卡祭牲召喚時作為祭品的怪獸特殊召喚到自己場上。
description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce". When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon the monster from the Graveyard that was used for its Tribute Summon.

name: Advanced Ritual Art
cn_text: ①：等級合計直到變成和儀式召喚的怪獸相同為止，把卡組的通常怪獸送去墓地，從手卡把1只儀式怪獸儀式召喚。
description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

name: Hinotama
cn_text: ①：給與對方500傷害。
description: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Dark Energy
cn_text:
惡魔族怪獸才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: Increase the ATK and DEF of a Fiend-Type monster equipped with this card by 300 points.

name: Barrier Statue of the Heavens
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不是光屬性怪獸不能特殊召喚。
description: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for LIGHT monsters.

name: Fires of Doomsday
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能用這張卡的效果以外把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
①：在自己場上把2只「黑焰衍生物」（惡魔族·暗·1星·攻/守0）守備表示特殊召喚。這衍生物不能為暗屬性以外的怪獸的上級召喚而解放。
description: Special Summon 2 "Doomsday Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, unless it is for a DARK monster. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

name: Frontline Base
cn_text: 1回合1次，自己的主要階段時可以從手卡把1只4星以下的同盟怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Union monster from your hand.

name: Tao the Chanter
cn_text: 侵蝕陰與陽的力量、產生出邪惡力量的魔導師。
description: Master of Yin and Yang, this wizard handles a delicate balance of spells and counter spells.

name: Roulette Barrel
cn_text: 在自己的每回合的主要階段可以擲2次骰子，在擲出的點數中選擇1個，破壞場上1只表側表示的與此點數相同等級的怪獸。
description: Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die twice, choose 1 result, and destroy 1 monster on the field whose Level is equal to that result.

name: Skilled White Magician
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物（最多3個）。此外，把有3個魔力指示物放置的這張卡解放才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地選1只「破壞之劍士」特殊召喚。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Buster Blader" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Armed Dragon LV5
cn_text:
①：從手卡把1只怪獸送去墓地，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。持有為這個效果發動而送去墓地的怪獸的攻擊力以下的攻擊力的作為對象的對方怪獸破壞。
②：這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的回合的結束階段，把場上的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「武裝龍 LV7」特殊召喚。
description: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the sent monster's ATK; destroy that target. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV7" from your hand or Deck.

name: Metamorphosis
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只怪獸解放才能發動。等級和那只怪獸相同的1只融合怪獸從額外卡組特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.

name: Ruin, Queen of Oblivion
cn_text:
「世界末日」降臨。
①：這張卡的攻擊破壞對方怪獸時才能發動。這張卡只再1次可以繼續攻擊。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "End of the World". If this card destroys your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

name: Tomozaurus
cn_text: 體形雖然小，但性格凶暴。經常和同伴相爭。
description: Small but vicious, this monster even attacks its own kind.

name: Trap Master
cn_text: 反轉：場上1張陷阱卡破壞。里側表示翻開確認后破壞。
description: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.

name: Magical Ghost
cn_text: 向對方施展法朮，使敵人陷入混亂和恐懼，從而胡亂攻擊。
description: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.

name: Dweller in the Depths
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力上升自己的魔法與陷阱區域的永續魔法卡數量×300。
description: This card gains 300 ATK for each Continuous Spell Card in your Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Fire Kraken
cn_text: 在水里仍然被火焰熊熊包圍?的章魚。
description: A squid that thrives on fire and heat.

name: Vampire Orchis
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，可以從手卡特殊召喚1只「死亡石斛」。
description: When this monster is Normal Summoned successfully, you can Special Summon 1 "Des Dendle" from your hand.

name: The Transmigration Prophecy
cn_text: ①：以雙方墓地的卡合計2張為對象才能發動。那些卡回到持有者卡組。
description: Target 2 cards in the Graveyard(s); shuffle those targets into the Deck(s).

name: Muka Muka
cn_text: 只要這張卡表側表示在場上存在，控制者手上每有1張卡，這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each card in your hand.

name: Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest
cn_text: ①：這張卡在手卡·墓地存在，自己場上的表側表示的獸族怪獸被效果破壞送去墓地時，支付1000基本分才能發動。這張卡特殊召喚。
description: If this card is in your hand or Graveyard when a face-up Beast-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 1000 Life Points; Special Summon this card.

name: Crimson Sunbird
cn_text: 「聖鳥」＋「天空獵手」
description: "Faith Bird" + "Skull Red Bird"

name: Machine King
cn_text: 每1只在場上表側表示存在的機械族怪獸，這張卡的攻擊力上升100。
description: This card gains 100 ATK for each Machine-Type monster on the field.

name: Hitodenchak
cn_text: 被污染的水源侵蝕而狂暴化的海星。從口中吐出溶解液攻擊敵人。
description: A rabid starfish that spits a lethal acid that can melt almost anything.

name: Mefist the Infernal General
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方那個數值的戰斗傷害。這張卡對對方造成戰斗傷害時，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, discard 1 card randomly from your opponent's hand.

name: Humanoid Slime
cn_text: 人形的史萊姆。混有人類的基因。
description: This slime apparently has some human genes in its genetic makeup.

name: Minomushi Warrior
cn_text: 岩石戰士。揮舞?非常重的石頭劍。
description: A rock warrior that wields a heavy blade carved from stone.

name: Chthonian Alliance
cn_text: 場上每有1只表側表示存在的和裝備怪獸同名的怪獸，裝備怪獸攻擊力上升800。
description: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

name: Tremendous Fire
cn_text: 對方受到1000分的傷害，自己受到500分的傷害。
description: Inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points and 500 points of damage to your Life Points.

name: Dark Magician
cn_text: 作為魔法師，攻擊力·守備力都是最高級別。
description: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

name: Helping Robo for Combat
cn_text: 這張卡每次戰斗破壞對方怪獸，自己抽1張卡，之后從手卡選擇1張卡放回卡組最下面。
description: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card, then return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.

name: Mystic Clown
cn_text: 用狂暴的力量攻擊，一旦暴走無人能擋。
description: Nothing can stop the mad attack of this powerful creature.

name: Vanity's Fiend
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不能把怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Neither player can Special Summon monsters.

name: Guardian Grarl
cn_text: 當自己場上存在「重力之斧-咆哮」時才能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。當手卡僅有這張卡1張時，這張卡可以從手卡直接特殊召喚上場。
description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Gravity Axe - Grarl". If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand).

name: Dark Snake Syndrome
cn_text: 每到自己的准備階段，這張卡對雙方玩家造成200點傷害。2個回合以后，每到自己的准備階段，這個傷害都會加倍。
description: During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict damage to both players. This damage begins at 200 and is doubled during each of your following Standby Phases.

name: Cybernetic Zone
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只機械族的融合怪獸，直到發動回合的結束階段時從游戲中除外。從游戲中除外的怪獸回到場上時，那只怪獸的攻擊力變成2倍。下次的自己回合的准備階段時，成為這張卡的對象的1只機械族的融合怪獸破壞。
description: Select 1 face-up Machine-Type Fusion Monster you control and remove it from play until the End Phase of this turn. When that monster is returned to the field, double its ATK. During your next Standby Phase, destroy it.

name: Light and Darkness Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。這張卡的屬性也當作「暗」使用。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，效果怪獸的效果·魔法·陷阱卡的發動無效。每次這個效果把卡的發動無效，這張卡的攻擊力·守備力下降500。這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，選擇自己墓地存在的1只怪獸發動。自己場上的卡全部破壞。選擇的1只怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. While face-up on the field, this card is also DARK-Attribute. Once per Chain, during either player's turn, when a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated: This card loses exactly 500 ATK and DEF and that activation is negated. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard (if possible); destroy all cards you control, also Special Summon that monster (if any).

name: Wing Eagle
cn_text: 從高空尋找獵物，一旦看上絕不讓其逃走。
description: This flying creature never misses its intended target.

name: Molten Zombie
cn_text: 這張卡從墓地的特殊召喚成功時，自己從卡組抽1張卡。
description: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

name: Fossil Dig
cn_text: ①：從卡組把1只6星以下的恐龍族怪獸加入手卡。
description: Add 1 Level 6 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Driving Snow
cn_text: 自己的陷阱卡被對方控制的卡的效果破壞，從場地送去墓地時才能發動。場上的1張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。
description: You can only activate this card when 1 or more of your Trap Cards are destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard by a card effect your opponent controls. Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Acrobat Monkey
cn_text: 用超尖端技朮所開發的猴子型自律機器人。行動像做雜技一般。
description: An autonomous monkey type robot which was developed with cutting-edge technology. It moves very acrobatically.

name: Pitch-Dark Dragon
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「暗魔界的戰士 暗黑之劍」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升400點。裝備怪獸攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方那個數值的戰斗傷害。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 400 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Back to Square One
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。場上1只怪獸回到持有者卡組最上面。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

name: Mystic Swordsman LV2
cn_text: 攻擊里側守備表示怪獸的場合，不進行傷害計算，那只怪獸以里側守備表示的狀態直接破壞。這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的回合的結束階段，可以把這張卡送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「謎之劍士 LV4」
description: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV4" from your hand or Deck.

name: Mist Body
cn_text: 裝備怪獸不會被戰斗破壞。
description: The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Gigantes

這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把1只地屬性怪獸除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 EARTH monster from your Graveyard. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Zombie Tiger
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「腐朽的武將」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升500點。裝備怪獸每次戰斗破壞對方怪獸時，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Decayed Commander" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 500 points, and each time it destroys 1 of your opponent's monsters, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Candle of Fate
cn_text: 指尖的火焰消失時，將決定對方的命運。
description: Decides the fate of an opponent when the candle on its fingertip burns out.

name: Mei-Kou, Master of Barriers
cn_text: 把這張卡解放發動。場上表側表示存在的1張永續魔法或者永續陷阱卡破壞。
description: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 face-up Continuous Spell or Continuous Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Infernal Dragon
cn_text:
①：這張卡攻擊的回合的結束階段發動。這張卡破壞。

description: If this card attacks, it is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard from the field, you can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 monster.

name: Chaosrider Gustaph
cn_name: 混沌騎手 古斯塔夫
cn_text: 從自己墓地里除外至多2張魔法卡。以此效果每除外1張卡，這張卡的攻擊力就上升300點直到對方回合結束。此效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn, you can remove from play up to 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard. This card gains 300 ATK for each card removed, until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Soul of the Pure
cn_text: 自己回復800點的基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 800 points.

name: Guardian of the Throne Room
cn_text: 守護王室的機械士兵。窮追不舍地使用導彈進行攻擊。
description: A robot guard built to protect throne rooms, it is armed with homing missiles.

name: Tatsunootoshigo
cn_text: 半馬半魚的怪獸。以風一般的速度在海中奔馳。
description: A bizarre monster with the torso of a horse and a fish's tail. It gallops through the sea as if it were the wind.

name: Great Maju Garzett
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力變成祭品召喚時作為祭品的1只怪獸的原本攻擊力2倍的數值。
description: The ATK of this card becomes twice the original ATK of 1 monster that you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

name: Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast
cn_text:
「幻獸王 加澤爾」＋「巴風特」
①：這張卡被破壞時，以自己墓地1只「幻獸王 加澤爾」或「巴風特」為對象才能發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚。
description: "Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts" + "Berfomet"(This card is always treated as a "Phantom Beast" card.)When this card is destroyed: You can target 1 "Berfomet" or 1 "Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts" in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: Barrier Statue of the Inferno
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不是炎屬性怪獸不能特殊召喚。
description: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except FIRE monsters.

name: Millennium Golem
cn_text: 千年間一直在守護?王家財寶的石像。
description: For nearly a millennium, this golem has served as guardian of an ancient treasure trove.

name: Mirage Tube
cn_text: 這張卡不能從手卡發動。自己場上表側表示存在的怪獸被選擇作為攻擊對象時才能發動。給與對方基本分1000分傷害。
description: This card cannot be activated from your hand. Activate only when a face-up monster you control is selected as an attack target. Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: D.D. Survivor
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡從游戲中除外的場合，這張卡在結束階段時特殊召喚到場上。
description: During the End Phase, if this card was banished while face-up, on your side of the field, this turn: Special Summon this banished card. This effect can only activate once per turn.

name: Battle Footballer
cn_text: 以高守備能力自豪的電子人。據說原本是作為橄欖球機器開發的。
description: A cyborg with high defense power. Originally it was invented for a football machine.

name: Kappa Avenger
cn_text: 被同伴殺害，為了復仇而將心靈賣給邪惡的河童。
description: An amphibian that sold his soul for unlimited power to avenge his late friend.

name: D.D. Crazy Beast
cn_text: 被這張卡戰斗破壞的怪獸從游戲中除外。
description: A monster that this card destroys as a result of battle is removed from play.

name: Aitsu
cn_text: 雖然樣子不可靠，其實隱藏?驚人的潛在能力。
description: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

name: Fulfillment of the Contract
cn_text: 支付800基本分。從自己墓地選擇1只儀式怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚，并裝備上這張卡。這張卡破壞時，裝備怪獸從游戲中除外。
description: Pay 800 Life Points. Select 1 Ritual Monster from your Graveyard, Special Summon it, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, remove the equipped monster from play.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。只能通過「荷魯斯之黑炎龍 LV6」的效果特殊召喚。只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，可以把魔法的發動和效果無效并且破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Spell Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. You must control this face-up card to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Chain Burst
cn_text: 給與發動陷阱卡的玩家基本分1000分的傷害。
description: Each time a player activates a Trap Card, they take 1000 damage immediately after it resolves.

name: Axe Raider
cn_text: 持斧的戰士。單手揮舞斧頭的攻擊相當強勁。
description: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

name: Mystical Cards of Light
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，自己的魔法與陷阱卡區域1處變成不能使用。這張卡以外的「閃光之寶札」在自己場上表側表示存在的場合，自己的抽卡階段時的通常抽卡可以抽2張卡。

name: Ansatsu
