cn_text: 用雙臂的電擊鞭麻痺對手，勒脖子進行攻擊。
description: With each arm forming an electric whip, this monster paralyzes its enemies with electric shocks.

name: Appropriate
cn_text: 對方在抽卡階段以外抽卡時才能發動。那之后，每次對方在抽卡階段以外抽卡，從自己卡組抽2張卡。
description: Activate only when your opponent draws a card(s), except during their Draw Phase. Draw 2 cards.

name: Omega Goggles
cn_text: 這張卡只有自己場上的怪獸才能裝備。1回合1次，對方手卡隨機選擇1張確認。這個效果發動的回合，裝備怪獸不能攻擊。
description: Equip only to a monster you control. Once per turn, you can look at 1 random card in your opponent's hand. The equipped monster cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

name: Necklace of Command
cn_text:
自己場上這張卡的裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞，這張卡送去墓地時，選擇下面1個效果發動。
●從卡組抽1張卡。
●對方隨機丟棄1張手卡去墓地。
description: When a monster you control that's equipped with this card is destroyed by battle, and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can either:? Draw 1 card. OR? Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把有「進化之繭」裝備的狀態用自己回合計算經過6回合以上的自己場上1只「飛蛾寶寶」解放的場合可以特殊召喚。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This monster can only be Special Summoned by Tributing "Petit Moth" on the 6th of your turns after "Petit Moth" has been equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: Call of the Mummy
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。從手卡把1只不死族怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果在自己場上沒有怪獸存在的場合才能發動和處理。
description: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Mesmeric Control
cn_text: ①：下次的對方回合，對方不能把怪獸的表示形式變更。
description: During your opponent's next turn after you activate this card, your opponent cannot change the battle positions of monsters, except with a card effect.

name: Ushi Oni
cn_text: 通過黑魔朮蘇醒的牛之惡魔。從壺中現身。
description: A bull fiend restored by the dark arts, this monster appears out of a jar.

name: Guard Penalty
cn_text: 選擇場上1只怪獸。這個回合選擇的怪獸變成守備表示的場合，從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: Select 1 monster on the field. If it is changed to Defense Position this turn, draw 1 card.

name: Spirit Caller
cn_text: 反轉：從自己墓地里特殊召喚1只3星以下的通常怪獸上場。
description: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your side of the field.

name: Archfiend General
cn_text: 把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地。從卡組把1張「萬魔殿-惡魔的巢窟-」加入手卡。場上沒有「萬魔殿-惡魔的巢窟-」存在的場合，場上的這張卡破壞。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 "Pandemonium" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is on the field but "Pandemonium" is not on the field, destroy this card.

name: Lonefire Blossom
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，把自己場上1只表側表示的植物族怪獸解放才能發動。從卡組把1只植物族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 face-up Plant-Type monster; Special Summon 1 Plant-Type monster from your Deck.

name: Judgment of the Desert
cn_text: 表側表示的怪獸不能變更其表示形式。
description: The Battle Position of face-up monsters that are flipped face-up after activation of this card cannot be changed, except with a card effect.

name: Memory Crusher
cn_text: 這張卡對對方玩家直接攻擊造成傷害的場合，給與對方基本分對方額外卡組的卡數×100分數值的傷害。
description: If this card successfully attacks directly, inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Extra Deck.

name: Card Trader
cn_text: 自己的准備階段時可以讓1張手卡回到卡組，從自己卡組抽1張卡。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck; draw 1 card.

name: Cyber-Tech Alligator
cn_text: 機械技朮強化的翼龍。被龍打敗而瀕死之際讓飼主給半機械化了。
description: Originally a pterodactyl, he was viciously attacked by a dragon. Using the newest technologies, his keeper saved him from near-fatal wounds and brought him back as a powerful Cyborg.

name: Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong
cn_text:
這張卡對對方造成戰斗傷害時，可以從下列效果中選擇1項發動：
●將對方場上1張怪獸卡彈回對方卡組最上面。
●將對方卡組最上面1張卡送去墓地。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:? Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the top of the Deck.? Send the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Nova Summoner
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的天使族·光屬性怪獸特殊召喚。場上有「天空的聖域」存在的場合，可以作為代替把1只「天空騎士 珀耳修斯」特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is face-up on the field, you can Special Summon 1 "Airknight Parshath" instead.

name: Demise of the Land
cn_text: ①：對方對怪獸的特殊召喚成功時才能發動。從卡組選1張場地魔法卡發動。
description: Activate this card when your opponent Special Summons a monster. Select 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck and activate it.

name: Masked Beast Des Gardius
cn_name: 假面魔獸 死亡護法師
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把包含「假面咒朮師 詛咒之喉」「梅爾基多四面獸」之內任意種的自己場上2只怪獸解放的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：這張卡從場上送去墓地的場合，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象發動。從卡組把1張「遺言之假面」當作裝備卡使用給作為對象的怪獸裝備。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 2 monsters, including at least 1 "Grand Tiki Elder" or "Melchid the Four-Face Beast". When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, equip 1 "The Mask of Remnants" from your Deck to 1 monster on the field.

name: Athena
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，把「雅典娜」以外的自己場上1只表側表示的天使族怪獸送去墓地，以「雅典娜」以外的自己墓地1只天使族怪獸為對象才能發動。那只天使族怪獸特殊召喚。
②：這張卡已在怪獸區域存在的狀態，這張卡以外的天使族怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚的場合發動。給與對方600傷害。
description: Each time a Fairy-Type monster(s) is Summoned: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent. Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up Fairy-Type monster you control to the Graveyard, except "Athena", then target 1 Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard, except "Athena"; Special Summon that target.

name: Spirit of the Pot of Greed
cn_text: ①：「強欲之壺」發動的場合發動。那個把「強欲之壺」發動的玩家可以從卡組抽1張。這個效果在這張卡在怪獸區域表側攻擊表示存在的場合進行發動和處理。
description: While this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field, if a player activates "Pot of Greed", they can draw 1 more card.

name: Burial from a Different Dimension
cn_text: ①：從除外的自己以及對方的怪獸之中以合計最多3只為對象才能發動。那些怪獸回到墓地。
description: Target up to 3 banished monsters; return them to the Graveyard.

name: Gagagigo
cn_text: 雖然曾經擁有邪惡的心靈，但是由於遇見某個人物而覺醒了正義之心的年輕惡魔。
description: This young evildoer used to have an evil heart, but by meeting a special person, he discovered justice.

name: Divine Wrath
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡發動。效果怪獸的效果的發動無效并破壞。
description: When a monster effect is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

name: Necro Gardna
cn_text: ①：對方回合把墓地的這張卡除外才能發動。這個回合，對方怪獸的攻擊只有1次無效。
description: During your opponent's turn: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the next attack this turn from a monster your opponent controls (this is a Quick Effect).

name: The Masked Beast
cn_name: 假面魔獸 鬼面修道士
cn_text: 「假面魔獸的儀式」降臨。
description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Curse of the Masked Beast".

name: Man-Eating Plant
cn_text: 食肉花。讓人覺得是漂亮的花，然后猛地一口吃掉接近它的人。
description: A meat-eating plant that is attractive to the eye but dangerous when approached.

name: A Feather of the Phoenix
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡，選擇自己墓地1張卡才能發動。選擇的卡回到卡組最上面。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card in your Graveyard; return that target to the top of your Deck.

name: Souls of the Forgotten
cn_text: 懷恨而死的人的意識集成的惡靈，襲擊人的意識在不斷的變大。
description: A wicked spirit created by the hateful souls of those who fell in battle. It grows by assimilating the souls of its enemies.

name: Mirage Knight
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚，用「黑炎之騎士」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡的攻擊力只在和對方怪獸進行戰斗的傷害計算時上升那只對方怪獸的原本攻擊力數值。
②：這張卡進行戰斗的回合的結束階段發動。這張卡除外。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Dark Flare Knight" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During damage calculation only, this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling. During the End Phase of a turn this card attacked or was attacked: Banish this card.

name: Sorcerer of the Doomed
cn_text: 擅長死亡魔法的魔法師，和黑暗訂下了契約。
description: A slave of the dark arts, this sorcerer is a master of life-extinguishing spells.

name: Chaos Burst
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時把自己場上1只怪獸解放，以那1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸破壞。那之后，給與對方1000傷害。
description: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Tribute 1 monster, then target the attacking monster; destroy that target, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Gate Deeg
cn_text: 肚子上長?通向地獄的門，也可以被召喚的怪獸。
description: This weird monster has a portal in its belly that brings reinforcements from the farthest reaches of the netherworld.

name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚成功時，以場上最多2張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那些卡破壞。
description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

name: Mountain Warrior
cn_text: 在處於不利的情況下也可以隨意活動的強健戰士。
description: A tough warrior that can move smoothly on even the roughest terrain.

name: Spiral Spear Strike
cn_text:
①：自己的「暗黑騎士 蓋亞」「疾風之暗黑騎士 蓋亞」「龍騎士 蓋亞」向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
②：這張卡的①的效果適用讓「龍騎士 蓋亞」給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。自己從卡組抽2張，那之后選1張手卡丟棄。
description: If "Gaia The Fierce Knight", "Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight", or "Gaia the Dragon Champion" you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If "Gaia the Dragon Champion" inflicts battle damage with this effect: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.

name: Genin
cn_text: 使用像戲法般的魔法打倒對方。也會放出鴿子攻擊。
description: A creature that defeats its enemies using sleight-of-hand.

name: Cyber Tutu
cn_text: ①：對方場上的怪獸只有持有比這張卡高的攻擊力的怪獸的場合，這張卡可以向對方直接攻擊。
description: If the ATK of each monster your opponent controls is higher than the ATK of this card, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Serial Spell
cn_text: 自己發動通常魔法時才能發動。手卡全部丟棄去墓地。這張卡的效果，變成和那張通常魔法的效果相同。
description: Activate only when you activate one of your Normal Spell Cards. Discard all the cards in your hand to the Graveyard. The effect of this card becomes the same as the Normal Spell Card.

name: Wolf
cn_text: 比較難見到的狼。用靈敏的鼻子尋找獵物。
description: Dis alpha wolf yoozes his sense a smell ta find da enemy. 'ey, quit sniffin at my socks!

name: Ultimate Insect LV1
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡不會受到魔法的效果影響。自己回合的准備階段時，可以把表側表示的這張卡送到墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「究極昆蟲 LV3」。（召喚·特殊召喚·反轉的回合不能使用此效果）
description: While this card is on the field, it is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV3" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

name: Beelze Frog
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力上升自己墓地存在的「惡魂邪苦止」的數量×300的數值。
description: This card gains 300 ATK for each "T.A.D.P.O.L.E." in your Graveyard.

name: Lightforce Sword
cn_text: ①：對方手卡隨機選1張里側表示除外。這張卡的發動后，用對方回合計算的第4回合的對方准備階段，那張卡回到對方手卡。
description: Banish 1 random card from your opponent's hand, face-down. During your opponent's 4th Standby Phase after this card's activation, return that card to their hand.

name: Ancient Tool
cn_text: 在古代文明遺跡里發現的機器。破壞是它的唯一目的。
description: A destructive machine discovered in the Ruins of the Ancients.

name: Saber Beetle
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Freed the Matchless General
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，這張卡為對象的魔法卡的效果無效并破壞。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，可以作為自己的抽卡階段時進行通常抽卡的代替，從自己卡組把1只4星以下的戰士族怪獸加入手卡。
description: Negate any Spell effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Absorbing Kid from the Sky
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸并將其送去墓地時，自己回復被破壞的怪獸等級×300基本分。
description: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by the Level of the destroyed monster x 300 points.

name: Tiger Axe
cn_text: 手持斧子的獸戰士。敏捷動作下所發的攻擊很強。
description: A fast and powerful axe-wielding beast-warrior.

name: Ryu Senshi
cn_text:
「戰士 戴·格雷法」＋「靈魂龍」
融合召喚這只怪獸，必須用上面所寫的卡融合召喚。只要這張卡在場上存在，可以支付1000分使通常陷阱的效果無效化。以這張卡為對象的魔法卡的效果無效并破壞。
description: "Warrior Dai Grepher" + "Spirit Ryu"A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the effect of a Normal Trap Card by paying 1000 Life Points. Negate the effects of a Spell Card that targets this card and destroy it.

name: Archfiend Soldier
cn_text: 隸屬於只招集惡魔中精兵的部隊的戰斗專家。被交付了任務就會確實地完成它而因此出名。
description: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

name: Garnecia Elefantis
cn_text: 擁有可怕的力量，因體形臃腫，行走時會發生地震。
description: A monster so heavy that each step rocks the earth.

name: Meltiel, Sage of the Sky
cn_name: 天空聖者 莫提烏斯
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次自己或者對方把反擊陷阱卡發動，自己回復1000基本分，場上有「天空的聖域」存在的場合，再選對方場上1張卡破壞。
description: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, gain 1000 Life Points, and if "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is face-up on the field, destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

name: Fruits of Kozaky's Studies
cn_text: 自己卡組最上面3張卡確認，并且把那些卡按照自己的意願交換順序放回卡組最上面。
description: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck and return those cards to the top of the Deck in any order.

name: Swordstalker
cn_text: 宿有被干掉的同伴怨念的怪獸。
description: A monster formed by the vengeful souls of those who passed away in battle.

name: Dragon Capture Jar
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，場上表側表示存在的龍族怪獸全部變成守備表示，不能把表示形式變更。
description: Change all face-up Dragon-Type monsters on the field to Defense Position, also they cannot change their battle positions.

name: Magnetic Mosquito
cn_text: 反轉：場上表側表示存在的機械族怪獸全部破壞。
description: FLIP: Destroy all face-up Machine-Type monsters on the field.

name: Allure Queen LV7
cn_text:
①：這張卡是已用「魅惑的女王 LV5」的效果特殊召喚的場合，1回合1次，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方怪獸當作裝備魔法卡使用給這張卡裝備（只有1只可以裝備）。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡的效果裝備的怪獸破壞。
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Allure Queen LV5", you can select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card. (Only 1 card at a time can be equipped due to this effect.) If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead.

name: Paralyzing Potion
cn_text: 機械族以外的怪獸裝備可能。裝備怪獸不能攻擊宣言。
description: A non Machine-Type monster equipped with this card cannot attack.

name: Mech Bass
cn_text: 以背后附?的炮台發射閃光粒子加農炮。
description: A mechanized bass with a large mouth and a cannon on its back. The cannon fires blinding plasma rays.

name: Versago the Destroyer
cn_text: 這張卡可以代替融合怪獸素材的其中1只來融合。這個時候，其他的融合素材必須是指定的融合素材。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s).

name: Archfiend of Gilfer
cn_name: 暗黑魔族 基爾法惡魔
cn_text: ①：這張卡被送去墓地時，以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。墓地的這張卡當作攻擊力下降500的裝備卡使用給那只怪獸裝備。
description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip that target with this card. That monster loses 500 ATK while equipped with this card.

name: Black Horn of Heaven
cn_text: ①：對方只把怪獸1只特殊召喚之際才能發動。那次特殊召喚無效，那只怪獸破壞。
description: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster: Negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Satellite Cannon
cn_text: 這張卡不會被7星以下的怪獸戰斗破壞。每次的自己的結束階段，這張卡的攻擊力上升1000。這張卡進行攻擊的場合，用這個效果上升的攻擊力在傷害計算后回到0。
description: This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Level 7 or lower monster. During each of your End Phases: This card gains 1000 ATK. If this card attacks, this increased ATK returns to 0, after damage calculation.

name: The Paths of Destiny
cn_text: 雙方玩家各自進行1次投擲硬幣。出現表側的場合回復2000基本分，出現里側的場合基本分受到2000分傷害。
description: Both players toss a coin once. If a player's result is Heads, they gain 2000 Life Points, and if their result is Tails, they take 2000 damage.

name: Battle Ox
cn_text: 擁有驚人力量的牛形怪物。斧頭一揮橫掃一切。
description: A monster with tremendous power, it destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

name: Sand Gambler
cn_text: 進行3次投擲硬幣。3次都是表的場合，對方場上怪獸全部破壞。3次都是里的場合，自己場上怪獸全部破壞。這個效果1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段才能使用。
description: Toss a coin 3 times. If all 3 results are Heads, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If all 3 results are Tails, destroy all monsters on your side of the field. You can only activate this effect once per turn, during your Main Phase.

name: Metalzoa
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把有「金屬化·魔法反射裝甲」裝備的自己場上1只「惡魔獸靈」解放的場合可以從卡組特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your Deck) by Tributing "Zoa" equipped with "Metalmorph".

name: Dark Magician Knight
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。「騎士的稱號」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡特殊召喚成功的場合，以場上1張卡為對象發動。那張卡破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Knight's Title" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Magician's Circle
cn_text: ①：自己或者對方的魔法師族怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。雙方玩家各自從自己卡組把1只攻擊力2000以下的魔法師族怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When a Spellcaster-Type monster declares an attack: Each player Special Summons 1 Spellcaster-Type monster with 2000 or less ATK from their Deck in Attack Position.

name: Piranha Army
cn_text: 這張卡對對方進行直接攻擊時戰斗傷害加倍。
description: The Battle Damage this card inflicts by attacking your opponent's Life Points directly is doubled.

name: Mountain
cn_text: 全部龍族·鳥獸族·雷族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力上升200。
description: Increase the ATK and DEF of all Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Chthonian Soldier
cn_text: 這張卡因對方怪獸的攻擊破壞送去墓地時，也給與對方基本分這次戰斗讓自己受到的戰斗傷害。
description: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

name: Neo the Magic Swordsman
cn_text: 精通武朮和劍的奇特魔法師。在異空間旅行?。
description: A dimensional drifter who not only practices sorcery, but is also a sword and martial arts master.

name: Different Dimension Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不會被不指定對象的魔法、陷阱卡的效果破壞。這張卡不會被攻擊力1900以下的怪獸戰斗破壞。
description: This card cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects that do not target it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or less ATK.

name: Raging Earth
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，場上表側表示存在的地屬性怪獸以外的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-EARTH monsters.

name: Puppet Plant
cn_text: 把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地。直到這個回合的結束階段時，得到對方場上表側表示存在的1只戰士族或者魔法師族怪獸的控制權。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: The Calculator
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力變成自己場上的怪獸的等級合計×300。
description: The ATK of this card is the combined Levels of all face-up monsters you control x 300.

name: Dungeon Worm
cn_text: 潛在迷路者的地下，捕食經過此處迷路的生物。
description: Hidden under the floors of a labyrinth, it swallows any who pass above.

name: Raise Body Heat
cn_text: 恐龍族怪獸可以裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: A Dinosaur-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Sword Hunter
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的戰斗階段結束時，墓地存在的那些怪獸作為攻擊力上升200點的裝備卡裝備在這張卡上。
description: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed a monster(s) by battle and sent it to the Graveyard this Battle Phase: Equip all those monsters from the Graveyard to this card as an Equip Spell Card(s) with this effect.? The equipped monster gains 200 ATK.

name: A Man with Wdjat
cn_text: 這張卡通常召喚時和每到自己准備階段時，選擇對方場上1張蓋放的卡，確認后回復原狀。
description: When you Normal Summon this card, and during each of your Standby Phases, select 1 Set card on your opponent's side of the field. Pick it up and look at it, then return it to its original position.

name: Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective
cn_name: 爆炎集合體 地球之魂
cn_text: 可以把自己場上最多2只炎族怪獸做祭品。因這個效果使用祭品的場合，這張卡的攻擊力上升祭品數量×1000的數值。這張卡攻擊守備表示怪獸時，若這張卡的攻擊力超過守備表示怪獸的守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。結束階段時這張卡破壞。
description: Once per turn: You can Tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters; this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. During the End Phase: Destroy this card.

name: Princess of Tsurugi
cn_text: 反轉：對方場上每存在1張魔法·陷阱，對方受到500分的傷害。
description: FLIP: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Spell and Trap Card on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Cemetary Bomb
cn_text: 對方受到對方墓地卡數×100的傷害。
description: Inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Graveyard.

name: Royal Decree
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，場上的其他的陷阱卡的效果無效化。
description: Negate all other Trap effects on the field.

name: Spell Absorption
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，自己回復500基本分。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, gain 500 Life Points immediately after it resolves.

name: Remove Trap
cn_text: 破壞表側表示的場上的存在的1張陷阱卡。
description: Select 1 face-up Trap Card on the field and destroy it.

name: Yomi Ship
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。把讓這張卡破壞的怪獸破壞。
description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy the monster that destroyed this card.

name: Big Wave Small Wave
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的水屬性怪獸全破壞。之后，可以從手卡特殊召喚最多和破壞數同等數量的水屬性怪獸上場。
description: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters you control, then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

name: Nubian Guard
cn_text: 這張卡對對方造成戰斗傷害時，可以將自己墓地里的1張永續魔法卡彈回卡組最上面。
description: If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, you can return 1 Continuous Spell Card from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

name: Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以不用解放作通常召喚。
②：這張卡的①的方法通常召喚的這張卡的原本的攻擊力·守備力變成一半。
description: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK and DEF become halved.

name: V-Tiger Jet
cn_text: 擅長空中戰，具備合體能力的怪獸。驅使合體和分離施展立體攻擊。
description: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

name: Giltia the D. Knight
cn_name: 魔導騎士 基爾提亞
cn_text: 「冥界的番人」＋「王座守護者」
description: "Guardian of the Labyrinth" + "Protector of the Throne"

name: Amulet of Ambition
cn_text: 通常怪獸才能裝備。和比裝備怪獸等級高的怪獸進行戰斗的場合，裝備怪獸的攻擊力只在傷害計算時上升等級差×500的數值。這張卡被送去墓地時，這張卡可以回到卡組最上面。
description: Equip only to a Normal Monster. If it battles a monster with a higher Level, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK x the difference in Levels (during that battle only). When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can return it to the top of your Deck.

name: Theban Nightmare
cn_text: ①：自己手卡和自己的魔法與陷阱區域沒有卡存在的場合，這張卡的攻擊力上升1500。
description: While you have no cards in your hand nor in your Spell & Trap Zones, this card gains 1500 ATK.

name: Kabazauls
cn_text: 擁有巨大身體的河馬怪獸。從其巨大的身體打出的噴嚏，可以匹敵台風。
description: A huge monster in the shape of a hippopotamus. The sneezing from his gigantic body is so fierce that people mistake it for a hurricane.

name: Zaborg the Thunder Monarch
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚成功的場合，以場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Hunter Owl
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的風屬性怪獸每有1只，這張卡的攻擊力上升500。此外，只要自己場上有其他的風屬性怪獸表側表示存在，對方不能選擇這張卡作為攻擊對象。
description: This card gains 500 ATK for each face-up WIND monster you control. While you control another face-up WIND monster, your opponent cannot select this card as an attack target.

name: The Immortal Bushi
cn_text:
①：這張卡只要在怪獸區域存在，不能為戰士族怪獸的上級召喚以外而解放。
②：自己准備階段有這張卡在墓地存在，自己墓地沒有戰士族怪獸以外的怪獸存在的場合才能發動。這張卡特殊召喚。這個效果在自己場上沒有怪獸存在的場合才能發動和處理。
description: While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of a Warrior-Type monster. During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and all the monsters in your Graveyard are Warrior-Type: You can Special Summon this card. You must also control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Harpie's Pet Dragon
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升場上的「鷹身女郎」數量×300。
description: This card gains 300 ATK and DEF for each "Harpie Lady" on the field.

name: Obnoxious Celtic Guard
cn_text: ①：這張卡不會被和攻擊力1900以上的怪獸的戰斗破壞。
description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or more ATK.

name: Bowganian
cn_text: ①：自己准備階段發動。給與對方600傷害。
description: During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

name: Shield & Sword
cn_name: 右手換盾  左手換劍
cn_text: 這張卡的發動時場上表側表示存在的全部怪獸的原本攻擊力與原本守備力直到結束階段時交換。
description: Switch the original ATK and DEF of all face-up monsters currently on the field, until the End Phase.

name: The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以作為融合怪獸卡有卡名記述的1只融合素材怪獸的代替。那個時候，其他的融合素材怪獸必須是正規品。
②：把暗屬性融合怪獸卡決定的一組融合素材怪獸（這張卡作為那之內的1只）從自己場上解放才能發動。把以那些解放的怪獸為融合素材的1只暗屬性融合怪獸從額外卡組特殊召喚。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

name: Spherous Lady
cn_text: 以為是美女而隨便靠近的話，便會被吸干全身的血液。
description: Many have been deceived by the beauty of this vampire.

name: Black Veloci
cn_text: 這張卡向對方怪獸攻擊的場合，傷害步驟內攻擊力上升400。這張卡被對方怪獸攻擊的場合，傷害步驟內攻擊力下降400。
description: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 400 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: That Which Feeds on Life
cn_text: 嗜食所有生物的靈魂，將將其作為自己的能量。
description: A monster that feeds on the energy of other creatures.

name: Heavy Slump
cn_text: 對方的手卡在8張以上時發動。對方把手卡加入卡組洗切，之后抽2張卡。
description: If your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand: They shuffle their entire hand into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Final Attack Orders
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，場上的表側表示怪獸變成攻擊表示，不能把表示形式變更。
description: All face-up monsters on the field are changed to Attack Position and their battle positions cannot be changed.

name: Pharaoh's Servant
cn_text: 據域是曾經侍奉過法老的人們的亡靈。擁有絲毫不會動搖的忠誠之心。
description: An apparition of those said to formerly serve the Pharaoh. It has tremendous loyalty that does not waiver.

name: Creeping Doom Manta
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，陷阱卡不能發動。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

name: Jowls of Dark Demise
cn_text: 反轉：在回合結束前得到對方場上1只怪獸的控制權。得到控制權的那只怪獸攻擊的場合，可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: FLIP: Take control of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of the turn that this card's effect is activated. When the controlled monster attacks, it can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Hercules Beetle
cn_text: 巨大獨角仙。尖角的攻擊和堅硬身體的防御強而有力。
description: A massive beetle with a tough carapace and a dangerous horn.

name: Peten the Dark Clown
cn_text: ①：這張卡被送去墓地時，把墓地的這張卡除外才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「暗道化師 彼得」特殊召喚。
description: When this card is sent to your Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Peten the Dark Clown" from your hand or Deck.

name: Gorgon's Eye
cn_text: 結束階段結束前，場上存在的守備表示的怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Until the end of this turn, all effects of Defense Position monsters are negated.

name: Skull Mariner
cn_text: 船頭仿照紅色骸骨的海盜船。在所有海域神出鬼沒地出現，襲擊客船和貨船。
description: A pirate ship that appears out of the mist and sinks any seagoing vessels.

name: Invitation to a Dark Sleep
cn_name: 誘發暗黑長眠的路西法
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚成功的場合，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象發動。這張卡得到以下效果。
●只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，作為對象的怪獸不能攻擊。
description: When this monster is summoned (excluding Special Summon), select 1 of your opponent's monsters. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, the selected monster cannot attack.

name: Inferno Fire Blast
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，「真紅眼黑龍」不能攻擊。
①：以自己的怪獸區域1只「真紅眼黑龍」為對象才能發動。給與對方那只「真紅眼黑龍」的原本攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: Target 1 "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" in your Monster Zone; inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK. "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

name: D.D. Guide
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，這張卡的控制權轉移給對方。每次結束階段，對方選擇這張卡的控制者的墓地里的1張卡從游戲中除外。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, give control of it to your opponent. During each player's End Phase, your opponent selects 1 card from the Graveyard of this card's controller and removes it from play.

name: KA-2 Des Scissors
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸并將其送去墓地時，對對方基本分造成數值等同於被破壞怪獸等級×500點的傷害。
description: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the monster x 500 points.

name: Fiend's Hand
cn_text: 從混沌沼澤中伸出手腕，將生者拖入其中。
description: Arms that reach out from the Swamp of Chaos to drag down the damned.

name: Mind Wipe
cn_text: 對方手卡3張以下的場合才能發動。對方把手卡加入到卡組洗切。之后對方抽出和加入卡組的卡數量相同的卡。
description: Activate only if your opponent has 3 or less cards in their hand. Your opponent adds their hand to the Deck and shuffles it, then draws the same of number of cards they added to the Deck.

name: Kaiser Glider
cn_text:
①：這張卡不會被和相同攻擊力的怪獸的戰斗破壞。
②：這張卡被破壞送去墓地的場合，以場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: Cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

name: Possessed Dark Soul
cn_text: 這張卡做祭品。得到對方場上的全部3星以下的怪獸的控制權。
description: You can Tribute this face-up card; take control of all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters your opponent currently controls.

name: Emergency Provisions
cn_text: ①：把這張卡以外的自己場上的魔法·陷阱卡任意數量送去墓地才能發動。自己回復因為這張卡發動而送去墓地的卡數量×1000基本分。
description: Send any number of other Spell/Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard; gain 1000 LP for each card sent to the Graveyard this way.

name: Anti-Spell
cn_text: 把自己場上存在的2個魔力指示物取除發動。魔法卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: Remove 2 Spell Counters on your side of the field to negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

name: Magical Thorn
cn_text: 對方的手卡丟棄去墓地時，每丟棄1張卡就給與對方基本分500分的傷害。
description: When your opponent's card(s) in their hand are discarded to the Graveyard, inflict 500 points of damage to their Life Points for each card that was discarded.

name: Dark Hole
cn_text: ①：場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Armaill
cn_text: 有?劍狀尾的怪異戰士。用雙手和尾巴進行三連攻擊。
description: A strange warrior who manipulates three deadly blades with both hands and his tail.

name: Mystical Space Typhoon
cn_text: ①：以場上1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張卡破壞。
description: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Spirit Barrier
cn_text: 只要自己場上存在怪獸，對這張卡的控制者的戰斗傷害變為0。
description: While you control a monster, you take no battle damage.

name: Gigaplant
cn_text:
①：這張卡只要在場上·墓地存在，當作通常怪獸使用。
②：可以把場上的當作通常怪獸使用的這張卡作為通常召喚作再1次召喚。那個場合這張卡變成當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。從自己的手卡·墓地選1只昆蟲族或者植物族的怪獸特殊召喚。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:?Once per turn, you can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type or Plant-Type monster from your hand or Graveyard.

name: Firegrass
cn_text: 在火山附近生存的草。從花內吹出來火焰攻擊。
description: A fire-breathing plant found growing near volcanoes.

name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，場上·墓地發動的光屬性怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Negate all LIGHT monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

name: Blue-Eyes Shining Dragon
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上1只「青眼究極龍」解放的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡的攻擊力上升自己墓地的龍族怪獸數量×300。
②：這張卡為對象的魔法·陷阱·怪獸的效果發動時才能發動。那個效果無效。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by Tributing 1 "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard. During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that targets this card (except during the Damage Step): You can negate that effect.

name: Dark King of the Abyss
cn_text: 冥界之王，聽說以前有?支配所有黑暗力量的能力。
description: It's said that this King of the Netherworld once had the power to rule over the dark.

name: Earth Effigy
cn_text: 地屬性的通常怪獸祭品召喚的場合，這1只怪獸可以作為2只的數量的祭品。
description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an EARTH Normal Monster.

name: Goddess with the Third Eye
cn_text: 這張卡可以代替融合怪獸素材的其中1只來融合。這個時候，其他的融合素材必須是指定的融合素材。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s).

name: Spirit of the Breeze
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側攻擊表示存在，每次自己的准備階段回復1000基本分。
description: As long as this card remains in face-up Attack Position on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 1000 points during each of your Standby Phases.

name: Icarus Attack
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只鳥獸族怪獸解放，以場上2張卡為對象才能發動。那些卡破壞。
description: Tribute 1 Winged Beast-Type monster, then target 2 cards on the field; destroy them.

name: Pyramid of Light
cn_text: 自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡從場上離開的場合，自己場上存在的「斯芬克斯·安德魯」和「斯芬克斯·迪蕾雅」破壞并從游戲中除外。
description: If this face-up card is removed from your side of the field, destroy "Andro Sphinx" and "Sphinx Teleia" on your side of the field and remove them from play.

name: Fire Reaper
cn_text: 手持炎之箭的死神，被其箭擊中的話就會變成火人。
description: A reaper with a flaming arrow that burns an enemy to a crisp.

name: Torrential Tribute
cn_text: ①：怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚時才能發動。場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Big Insect
cn_text: 住在密林里的巨大螞蟻。攻擊和守備都意外的強。
description: A giant ant that dwells in the jungle, it is powerful whether attacking or defending.

name: Eagle Eye
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，陷阱卡不能發動。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

name: Crazy Fish
cn_text: 利用尖銳的頭刺撞過來攻擊敵人。
description: A flying fish that attacks with its pointed head.

name: Sword of the Soul-Eater
cn_text: 這張卡只能裝備在自己場上存在的3星以下的通常怪獸身上。這張卡發動時，祭掉自己場上除裝備這張卡的怪獸以外的所有通常怪獸（衍生物除外）。每祭掉1只通常怪獸，裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力上升1000點。
description: You can only equip this card to a Level 3 or lower Normal Monster on your side of the field. When you activate this card, Tribute all Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field, except the equipped monster. Increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 1000 points for each Normal Monster that you Tributed.

name: Gigobyte
cn_text: 現在雖然還擁有溫和的心，但卻背負?被邪惡之心侵蝕的命運。
description: He has a tranquil soul, but carries a destiny that one day his heart shall be tainted by evil....

name: Adhesive Explosive
cn_text: 里側守備表示的這張卡被對方怪獸攻擊的場合，不進行傷害計算讓這張卡變成攻擊怪獸的裝備卡。下次的對方回合的准備階段時，那只裝備怪獸破壞。
description: Before damage calculation, if this card was attacked by your opponent's monster and was in face-down Defense Position card at the start of Damage Step: Equip this card to the attacking monster. Then, during your opponent's next Standby Phase, destroy the monster this card is equipped to.

name: Griffore
cn_text: 善於用堅固的身體守備。將對方的攻擊反彈。
description: This monster's tough hide deflects almost any attack.

name: Fungi of the Musk
cn_text: 從割面發出強力的酸液融化接近的人。
description: Melts away anything that dares to stand before it.

name: Meotoko
cn_text: 長有獨眼的巨大怪獸。從眼睛之中發出光線攻擊。
description: Dis big ol' guy wit' a big ol' eye shoots a nasty ray beam right atcha!

name: Vampire Lord
cn_text:
①：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的場合，宣言1個卡的種類（怪獸·魔法·陷阱）發動。對方把宣言的種類的1張卡從自身卡組送去墓地。
②：這張卡被對方的效果破壞送去墓地的場合，下次的自己准備階段發動。這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。
description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the Graveyard. Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card in your possession was destroyed and sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

name: Darkfire Soldier #1
cn_text: 熱烈燃燒的特種部隊工作者，火藥專家。
description: An explosive expert from a special elite force.

name: Rocket Jumper
cn_text: 當對方場上只有守備表示的怪獸存在時，這張卡可以對對方進行直接攻擊。
description: If the only cards on your opponent's side of the field are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
cn_name: 冥界的魔王 哈·迪斯
cn_text:
這張卡不能作從墓地的特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，自己的惡魔族怪獸戰斗破壞怪獸的場合，那破壞的怪獸只要在場上·墓地存在效果無效化。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend-Type monsters you control.

name: Black Luster Soldier
cn_text: 「混沌的儀式」降臨。
description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Luster Ritual".

name: Mysterious Puppeteer
cn_text: 怪獸召喚·反轉召喚成功時，自己回復500基本分。
description: Each time you or your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster, increase your Life Points by 500 points.

name: Infinite Dismissal
cn_text: 3星以下的怪獸召喚·反轉召喚的回合的結束階段破壞。
description: Level 3 or lower monsters are destroyed during the End Phase of the turn that they are Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned.

name: Dragon's Rage
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，自己場上的龍族怪獸向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: Dragon-Type monsters you control inflict piercing Battle Damage when they attack a Defense Position monster.

name: Power Capsule
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只「勝利蛇XX03」發動。從「勝利蛇XX03」的效果選擇1個，作為這張卡的效果適用。
description: Select 1 face-up "Victory Viper XX03" on your side of the field to activate this card. Select 1 effect of "Victory Viper XX03", and apply the effect as this card's effect.

name: Headless Knight
cn_text: 被判決為反叛者遭處刑的騎士的亡靈，為尋找失去的東西，無論遇到誰都會受到他的攻擊。
description: A haunted spirit of a falsely accused knight who wanders in search of truth and justice.

name: Ritual Weapon
cn_text: 6星以下的儀式怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升1500。
description: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Ritual Monster. It gains 1500 ATK and DEF.

name: Warrior Lady of the Wasteland
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的戰士族·地屬性怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH Warrior-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Harpie Lady 3
cn_text: 這張卡的卡名當作「鷹身女郎」使用。和這張卡發生戰斗的對方怪獸，此怪獸在對方的2個回合內攻擊宣言不能。
description: (This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)An opponent's monster that battles this card cannot declare an attack during your opponent's next 2 turns.

name: Helios - The Primordial Sun
cn_name: 原始太陽 赫利俄斯
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成除外狀態的怪獸數量×100。
description: This card's ATK and DEF are each equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 100.

name: War-Lion Ritual
cn_text: 「超級戰獅」的降臨必需。必須從手卡·自己場上把等級合計直到7以上的怪獸解放。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Super War-Lion". You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal 7 or more.

name: Karbonala Warrior
cn_text: 「磁力戰士1號」＋「磁力戰士2號」
description: "M-Warrior #1" + "M-Warrior #2"

name: High Tide Gyojin
cn_text: 能在水中自由游動的半人魚戰士，攻擊力強勁。
description: A very agile half-fish warrior known for its relentless attacks.

name: Spirit of the Winds
cn_text: 自在飛翔的風之精靈。心情不好的時候就會變成狂風。
description: A free-spirited wind elemental that flits about as it desires. It brings storms when it becomes upset.

name: Great Mammoth of Goldfine
cn_text: 「美杜莎的亡靈」＋「龍僵尸」
description: "The Snake Hair" + "Dragon Zombie"

name: Blazing Inpachi
cn_text: 全身被灼熱火焰吞沒的巨木化身。火焰攻擊雖然強力，但由於自身?火所以時日不多了。
description: A wicked wooden spirit now burning in flames. Its fire attack is powerful, but it will soon be nothing but ashes.

name: Man-Eater Bug
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Nightmare Wheel
cn_text:
以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，作為對象的怪獸不能攻擊，也不能作表示形式的變更。那只怪獸從場上離開時這張卡破壞。
②：自己准備階段發動。給與對方500傷害。這個效果在作為對象的怪獸在怪獸區域存在的場合進行發動和處理。
description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Twin-Headed Thunder Dragon
cn_text: 「雷龍」＋「雷龍」
description: "Thunder Dragon" + "Thunder Dragon"

name: Light Effigy
cn_text: 光屬性的通常怪獸祭品召喚的場合，這1只怪獸可以作為2只的數量的祭品。
description: If you Tribute Summon a LIGHT Normal Monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Skull Stalker
cn_text: 行動敏捷、用鉗子捕捉對方，帶有劇毒刺針的蠍子戰士。
description: Foist he's gonna grab yer monstah wit' his claws, den attack again wit' his poizin stingah!

name: Kelbek
cn_text: 向這張卡攻擊的怪獸回到持有者手卡。傷害計算適用。
description: A monster that attacks this card returns to its owner's hand. Damage calculation is applied normally.

name: Ancient Lamp
cn_text:
①：自己主要階段才能發動。這張卡在場上表側表示存在的場合，從手卡把1只「燈之魔精」特殊召喚。
②：里側守備表示的這張卡被對方怪獸攻擊的傷害計算前，以攻擊怪獸以外的1只對方怪獸為對象才能發動。攻擊對象轉移為那只對方怪獸進行傷害計算。
description: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon "La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp" from your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls, except the attacking monster; the attacking monster attacks it instead, and you proceed to damage calculation.

name: Prevent Rat
cn_text: 毛像硬皮一樣聚集在一起，守備力非常的高。
description: This creature is shielded with a tough hide of hair and is excellent at defending itself.

name: Cyclon Laser
cn_text: 只有「超時空戰斗機 V形蛇」可以裝備。攻擊力上升300點。裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: You can only equip this card to "Gradius". Increase the ATK of "Gradius" by 300 points. When the equipped "Gradius" attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Eradicator Epidemic Virus
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只攻擊力2500以上的暗屬性怪獸解放，宣言卡的種類（魔法·陷阱）才能發動。對方場上的魔法·陷阱卡，對方手卡，用對方回合計算的3回合內對方抽到的卡全部確認，那之內的宣言種類的卡全部破壞。
description: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 2500 or more ATK, and declare 1 card type (Spell or Trap); check your opponent's hand, all Spell/Trap Cards they control, and all cards they draw until the end of their 3rd turn after this card's activation, and destroy all cards of that type.

name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
cn_text: 若自己場上有植物族怪獸存在，則這張卡不能被攻擊。每祭掉自己場上1只植物族怪獸，就能破壞場上1張魔法·陷阱卡。
description: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By Tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: The League of Uniform Nomenclature
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只2星以下的通常怪獸發動。從自己卡組把和選擇的卡同名的卡盡可能在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster on your side of the field to activate this card. Special Summon from your Deck to your side of the field as many cards as possible with the same name as the selected monster.

name: Troop Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合，從卡組選1張「軍隊龍」在自己的場上特殊召喚。之后卡組洗切。
description: If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, select and Special Summon 1 "Troop Dragon" from your Deck to your side of the field. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Water Girl
cn_text: 用水像冰箭般攻擊的美麗姐姐。
description: A lovely lady who can launch water projectiles that turn into lethal ice spikes before they reach an opponent.

name: Pot of Greed
cn_text: ①：自己從卡組抽2張。
description: Draw 2 cards.

name: Lisark
cn_text: 藍寶石眼睛的野獸。制造幻影，趁敵人混亂的時候進行攻擊。
description: A creature with sapphire eyes that mesmerizes and confuses enemies.

name: Lightning Blade
cn_text: 戰士族才可以裝備。裝備的怪獸的攻擊力上升800。場上的全部水屬性怪獸的攻擊力下降500。
description: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK. All WATER monsters lose 500 ATK.

name: Judgment of Anubis
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。對方控制的持有「把場上的魔法·陷阱卡破壞」效果的魔法卡的發動和效果無效并破壞。那之后，可以把對方場上1只表側表示的怪獸破壞，給與對方玩家那只怪獸的攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: When your opponent activates a Spell Card that would destroy a Spell/Trap Card(s) on the field: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then you can destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and if you do that, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.

name: Succubus Knight
cn_text: 詠唱起魔法，給予對方血的祭禮的惡魔魔法戰士。
description: A warrior wizard adept in casting bone-chilling spells.

name: Gust Fan
cn_text: 風屬性的怪獸才能裝備。裝備的怪獸攻擊力上升400，守備力下降200。
description: A WIND monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

name: Job-Change Mirror
cn_text: 惡魔鏡。受到攻擊也不會破裂、守備損傷。
description: A wicked mirror that blocks off the damaging effects of an attack.

name: Lesser Dragon
cn_text: 不怎么強，連吐息攻擊都不會的低級龍。
description: A minor dragon incapable of breathing fire.

name: Battle Warrior
cn_name: 格斗戰士 阿提米特
cn_text: 不使用任何武器，空手戰斗的格斗戰士。
description: A warrior that fights with his bare hands!!!

name: Exchange
cn_text: 雙方玩家把手卡公開，各自選1張對方的卡加入自己手卡。
description: Both players reveal their hands and add 1 card from each other's hand to their hand.

name: Pot the Trick
cn_text: 根據魔朮師的命令行動的使魔。不是很強。
description: A not-so-powerful servant, he is an errand boy of a master sorcerer.

name: Frost and Flame Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己墓地2只水屬性怪獸和1只炎屬性怪獸從游戲中除外的場合才能特殊召喚。1回合1次，丟棄1張手卡才能發動。選擇場上1只怪獸破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE and 2 WATER monsters from your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Dark Illusion
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的暗屬性怪獸為對象的效果怪獸的效果·魔法·陷阱卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets a DARK monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Great Bill
cn_text: 擁有可以吞下一切的大嘴。
description: Nothing escapes from this beast's massive mouth.

name: Plague Wolf
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時變成原本攻擊力的2倍。
②：這張卡的①的效果發動的場合，結束階段發動。這張卡破壞。
description: Once per turn: You can make this card's ATK become double its original ATK, until the End Phase. During the End Phase, if this effect of this card was used: Destroy this card.

name: Shrink
cn_text: ①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的原本攻擊力直到回合結束時變成一半。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; the original ATK of that monster is halved until the end of this turn.

name: Exxod, Master of The Guard
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上存在的1只名字帶有「斯芬克斯」的怪獸解放的場合才能特殊召喚。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，地屬性怪獸反轉召喚成功時，給與對方基本分1000分傷害。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "sphinx" monster. Each time an EARTH monster is Flip Summoned while this card remains face-up on the field, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Black Luster Ritual
cn_text:
「混沌戰士」的降臨必需。
①：從自己的手卡·場上把等級合計直到8以上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「混沌戰士」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Black Luster Soldier". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Dragon Piper

description: Choose 1 player; that player gains 200 Life Points.

name: Flame Ogre
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。這張卡的召喚成功時，從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Normal Summoned, draw 1 card.

name: Toy Magician
cn_text: 這張卡可以當作魔法卡使用從手卡到魔法與陷阱卡區域蓋放。自己的魔法與陷阱卡區域蓋放的這張卡被對方的卡的效果破壞送去墓地的場合，那個回合的結束階段時這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。此外，這張卡反轉召喚成功時，把場上表側表示存在的「玩具魔朮師」的數量的場上存在的魔法·陷阱卡破壞。
description: You can Set this card face-down in your Spell & Trap Card Zone as a Spell Card. If this face-down card in your Spell & Trap Card Zone is destroyed by an opponent's card effect and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase. When this card is Flip Summoned, destroy Spell or Trap Cards on the field equal to the number of "Toy Magicians" on the field.

name: Giant Kozaky
cn_text: 場上沒有「平庸鬼」表側表示存在的場合，這張卡破壞。場上表側表示存在的這張卡被破壞的場合，給與那個時候的控制者基本分為這張卡的原本攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: If there is no face-up "Kozaky" on the field, destroy this card. If this face-up card is destroyed, inflict damage equal to the original ATK of this card to its current controller.

name: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
cn_text: 奔跑起來的速度太快，身姿看似幻影的野獸。
description: This monster moves so fast that it looks like an illusion to mortal eyes.(This card is always treated as a "Phantom Beast" card.)

name: Petit Moth
cn_text: 不清楚成長后會變成什么樣的小幼蟲。
description: This small but deadly creature is better off avoided.

name: Dark Lucius LV8
cn_text: 用「漆黑之魔王 LV6」的效果特殊召喚的場合，這張卡戰斗破壞的對方怪獸的效果無效化，并且從游戲中除外。
description: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV6", your opponent's monsters that this card destroys by battle are removed from play, and their effects are negated.

name: Blade Rabbit
cn_text: 這張卡的表示形式從攻擊表示變成表側守備表示時，破壞對方場上1只怪獸。
description: When this card is changed from Attack Position to face-up Defense Position, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Ground Attacker Bugroth
cn_text: 陸地戰斗機器人，總有一天能在海里使用。
description: A surface battle robot that was once used for sea warfare.

name: Mispolymerization
cn_text: 融合怪獸特殊召喚時發動。場上存在的融合怪獸全部回到融合卡組。
description: Activate only when a Fusion Monster is Special Summoned. Return all face-up Fusion Monsters to their respective Extra Decks.

name: Survival Instinct
cn_text: 把自己墓地存在的任意數量的恐龍族怪獸從游戲中除外。每除外1只恐龍族怪獸，自己回復400基本分。
description: Banish any number of Dinosaur-Type monsters from your Graveyard; gain 400 Life Points for each Dinosaur-Type monster banished to activate this card.

name: Flame Ghost
cn_text: 「白骨」＋「岩漿人」
description: "Skull Servant" + "Dissolverock"

name: Oppressed People
cn_text: 堅信?一定會在某一天重新獲得自由而暫時忍受?每日痛苦生活的民眾。
description: They are oppressed, but believe they will have their freedom someday.

name: Spear Cretin
cn_text: 反轉：這張卡被送去墓地時，雙方玩家選擇各自墓地存在的1只怪獸，表側攻擊表示或者里側守備表示特殊召喚。
description: FLIP: When this card is sent to the Graveyard after being flipped, each player selects 1 monster from their Graveyard, and Special Summons it in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

name: Reasoning
cn_text: ①：對方宣言1～12的任意等級。直到可以通常召喚的怪獸出現為止從自己卡組上面翻卡，那只怪獸的等級和宣言的等級相同的場合，翻開的卡全部送去墓地。不是的場合，那只怪獸特殊召喚，剩下的翻開的卡全部送去墓地。
description: Your opponent declares a monster Level. Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set. If that monster is the same Level as the one declared by your opponent, send all excavated cards to the Graveyard. If not, Special Summon the excavated monster, also send the remaining cards to the Graveyard.

name: Fiend's Hand Mirror
cn_text: 使對方發動的以1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象的魔法移向另外1個正確的對象。
description: Switch the opponent's Spell Card effect that targets 1 Spell or Trap Card to another correct target.

name: Shadow of Eyes
cn_text: 對方場上有怪獸被蓋放時才能發動。那1只蓋放的怪獸變成表側攻擊表示。（這個時候，反轉效果怪獸的效果不發動。）
description: When a monster(s) is Set on your opponent's side of the field: Target 1 of those Set monsters; change that Set monster to face-up Attack Position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

name: Ring of Defense
cn_text: 陷阱卡的效果的傷害為0。
description: When a Trap effect that inflicts damage is activated: Make that effect damage 0.

name: Bio-Mage
cn_text: 最新生物工藝產生的僧侶，掌握?無數的秘密。
description: A mysterious priest created as a result of the latest advances in biotechnology.

name: Nightmare's Steelcage
cn_text:
這張卡發動后繼續留在場上，用對方回合計算的2回合后的對方結束階段破壞。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，怪獸不能攻擊。
description: This card remains on the field for 2 of your opponent's turns. While this card is face-up on the field, no monsters can attack.

name: Empress Mantis
cn_text: 領導力卓越的巨大螳螂女王。無論移動還是狩獵，螳螂大軍都聽從她的命令。
description: Queen of an army of giant mantises whose command moves legions.

name: Giant Red Seasnake
cn_text: 居住在海洋里的蛇型怪獸，它會去咬任何接近的物體。
description: A sea-dwelling snake that attacks passing enemies with its sharp teeth.

name: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
cn_text: 從自己手卡中丟棄1張魔法卡。使魔法卡的發動及效果無效，并且將其破壞。對方在本次決斗中不能再發動因這張卡效果而被破壞的魔法卡及其同名卡。
description: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 Spell Card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, and if you do that, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards with that name for the rest of this Duel.

name: VW-Tiger Catapult
cn_text:
「V-噴氣虎」＋「W-彈射飛翼」
把自己場上的上記卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚（不需要「融合」）。
①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方怪獸的表示形式變更。這個時候，反轉怪獸的效果不發動。
description: "V-Tiger Jet" + "W-Wing Catapult"This card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by removing from play the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization"). You can discard 1 card from your hand to change the battle position of 1 monster your opponent controls. (Flip Effects are not activated at this time.)

name: Ooguchi
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，雙方魔法卡若不蓋放則不能發動，直到從蓋放的玩家來看的下次的自己回合到來不能發動。
description: Both players must Set Spell Cards before activating them, and cannot activate them until their next turn after Setting them.

name: Queen's Double
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Mavelus
cn_text: 「大炮鳥」＋「邪炎之翼」
description: "Tyhone" + "Wings of Wicked Flame"

name: Turu-Purun
cn_text: 一只眼的奇妙怪獸。拿起手里的魚叉，朝向對手一刺。
description: A strange, one-eyed monster that can fell an enemy with a single stab of its spear.

name: Yami
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的惡魔族·魔法師族怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升200。場上表側表示存在的天使族怪獸的攻擊力·守備力下降200。
description: Increases the ATK and DEF of all Fiend and Spellcaster-Type monsters by 200 points. Also decreases the ATK and DEF of all Fairy-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Destruction Cyclone
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，場上表側表示存在的風屬性怪獸以外的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-WIND monsters.

name: Shifting Shadows
cn_text: 支付300基本分，自己的主要怪獸區域的里側守備表示怪獸洗切，再以里側守備表示重新排列。這個效果1個回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn, by paying 300 Life Points, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters on your side of the field, then return them in face-down Defense Position.

name: Nightmare Horse
cn_text: 這張卡在對方場上存在怪獸的狀態下也能對對方進行直接攻擊。
description: This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly even if there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Magic Drain
cn_text: 對方的魔法發動的時候才可以發動。對方從手卡丟棄1張魔法卡就可以使這張卡無效化。如果對方不丟棄的場合，對方的魔法卡的發動無效化并破壞。
description: When your opponent activates a Spell Card: They can discard 1 Spell Card to negate this card's effect, otherwise negate the activation of their Spell Card, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Burning Beast
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「冰岩魔獸」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸對對方造成戰斗傷害的場合，破壞場上1張表側表示的魔法或者陷阱卡。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Freezing Beast" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-up Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Big-Tusked Mammoth
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方場上怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚的回合不能攻擊。
description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.

name: Toon Alligator
cn_text: 從美國卡通世界中出現的鱷魚型怪獸。
description: An alligator monster straight from the cartoons.

name: Armed Dragon LV10
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上1只「武裝龍 LV7」解放的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：把1張手卡送去墓地才能發動。對方場上的表側表示怪獸全部破壞。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Armed Dragon LV7". You can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Shift
cn_text: 自己場上的怪獸1只成為對方的魔法·陷阱卡的效果的對象時或者成為對方怪獸的攻擊對象時才能發動。那個對象轉移為自己場上1只作為正確對象的其他怪獸。
description: When your opponent targets exactly 1 monster you control (and no other cards) for an attack, or with a Spell/Trap effect: Target another monster you control that would be an appropriate target; that attack/Spell/Trap now targets the new target.

name: Snake Fang
cn_text: 選擇場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸發動。選擇的怪獸的守備力直到結束階段時下降500。
description: Decrease 1 selected monster's DEF by 500 points during the turn this card is activated.

name: Windstorm of Etaqua
cn_text: ①：對方場上的全部表側表示怪獸的表示形式變更。
description: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Dark Zebra
cn_text: 自己的准備階段時，自己控制的怪獸只有這張卡的場合，這張卡變成守備表示。那個回合表示形式不能變更。
description: If this is the only Monster Card in your control during your Standby Phase, it is changed to Defense Position. You cannot change the position of this card during the same turn.

name: Reversal Quiz
cn_text: 將自己手卡和場上的卡全部送去墓地。猜自己卡組最上面1張卡的種類（魔法/陷阱/怪獸），若猜對，則將自己與對方的基本分值互換。
description: Send all cards in your hand and on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Call the type of card (Spell, Trap, or Monster) on top of your Deck. If you call it right, exchange your current Life Points with your opponent's current ones.

name: Dancing Elf
cn_text: 配合音樂飛天起舞的精靈。身體的羽毛是銳利的刀具。
description: An elf that dances across the sky with wings of razor-sharp blades.

name: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上3張表側表示的陷阱卡送去墓地的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡的攻擊力上升自己墓地的永續陷阱卡數量×1000。
②：1回合1次，以對方場上1張里側表示的魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動（不能對應這個發動讓魔法·陷阱卡發動）。那張里側表示卡破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap Card in your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards in response to this effect's activation.

name: Dust Tornado
cn_text: ①：以對方場上1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的卡破壞。那之后，可以從手卡把1張魔法·陷阱卡蓋放。
description: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap Card from your hand.

name: Maji-Gire Panda
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，每次場上的獸族怪獸被破壞，這張卡攻擊力上升500。
description: Each time a Beast-Type monster(s) on the field is destroyed, this card gains 500 ATK.

name: Granmarg the Rock Monarch
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚成功的場合，以場上蓋放的1張卡為對象發動。蓋放的那張卡破壞。
description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Soitsu
cn_text: 雖然時常擺?一副相當無助的姿態，卻總讓人覺得其實還隱藏?什么驚人潛在能力的樣子。
description: Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.

name: No Entry!!
cn_text: 場上存在的攻擊表示怪獸全部變成守備表示。
description: Change all Attack Position monsters to Defense Position.

name: Shinato's Ark
cn_text: 「天界王 志那都」降臨所必需。特殊召喚時，必須以場上或手卡中合計8顆星以上的怪獸作為祭品。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Senri Eye
cn_text: 1回合1次，在自己的准備階段支付100基本分，就可以確認對方卡組最上面的1張卡，之后將其放回。對方不能確認這張卡。
description: Once per turn, during each of your Standby Phases, you can pay 100 Life Points to look at 1 card on the top of your opponent's Deck and return it to its original position. Your opponent cannot look at the card.

name: Union Attack
cn_text: ①：以自己場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。這個回合的戰斗階段開始時，那只怪獸的攻擊力直到戰斗階段結束時上升其他的自己場上的攻擊表示怪獸的攻擊力的合計數值。這個回合，作為對象的怪獸給與對方的戰斗傷害變成0，其他的自己怪獸不能攻擊。
description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; add up the total ATK of all other face-up Attack Position monsters you currently control, then during the Battle Phase of this turn only, the monster gains that much ATK, but cannot inflict battle damage to your opponent, also other face-up Attack Position monsters cannot attack.

name: Mystic Swordsman LV6
cn_text: 這張卡通常召喚的場合，必須以里側守備表示的形式出場。攻擊里側守備表示的怪獸時，不進行傷害計算，那只怪獸以里側守備表示的狀態直接破壞。此效果破壞的怪獸可以不送去墓地，放到對方卡組的最上面。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set). At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster, and if you do, you can place it on top of your opponent's Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

name: Kishido Spirit
cn_text: 自己場上的怪獸和攻擊力相同的怪獸戰斗時不會被破壞。
description: Monsters on your side of the field cannot be destroyed in a battle if the monsters' ATK are equal.

name: Twin Long Rods #1
cn_text: 用像鞭子一般長的手臂進行攻擊。稍遠的地方也可以攻擊的到。
description: With whip-like arms, this creature can attack enemies from a distance.

name: Cold Wave
cn_text: 主要階段1的開始時才能發動。直到下次的自己的抽卡階段時，雙方不能有魔法·陷阱卡的效果使用以及發動·蓋放。
description: This card can only be activated at the start of Main Phase 1. Until your next turn, you and your opponent cannot play or Set any Spell or Trap Cards.

name: Skelengel
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: FLIP: Draw 1 card.

name: Tentacle Plant
cn_text: 當附近有會動的東西時，就會伸出藍色的絲線攻擊。
description: A carnivorous plant that has an outgrowth of tentacles. It attacks someone nearby by extending its tentacles.

name: Stray Lambs
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能用這張卡的效果以外把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
①：在自己場上把2只「羔羊衍生物」（獸族·地·1星·攻/守0）守備表示特殊召喚。
description: Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

name: Kuwagata a
cn_text: 凶暴的鍬甲。要注意直取對方首級的斷頭切割。
description: A very vicious stag beetle that goes for the head.

name: UFO Turtle
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的炎屬性怪獸表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Flame Cerebrus
cn_text: 全身被火包圍的魔獸，給予對方地獄之炎的處刑。
description: Known to many as the "Burning Executioner", this monster is capable of burning enemies to cinders.

name: Earthshaker
cn_text: 自己選擇2個屬性。對方從那之中選擇1個。場上表側表示存在的選擇的屬性的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Select 2 Monster Card Attributes. Your opponent then selects 1 of the 2 Attributes and destroys all face-up monsters with that Attribute on the field.

name: Beaked Snake
cn_text: 用長長的身體把對方纏起來，用大嘴進行攻擊。
description: This monster wraps itself around an opponent and pecks away with its huge beak.

name: Chaos End
cn_text: 當自己的卡有7張以上被除外時這張卡才能發動。破壞場上存在的所有怪獸卡。
description: You can only activate this card if 7 or more of your cards are currently removed from play. Destroy all Monster Cards on the field.

name: Tornado
cn_text: 對方的魔法與陷阱卡區域卡有3張以上存在時才能發動。對方的魔法與陷阱卡區域存在的1張卡破壞。
description: Activate only when there are 3 or more cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone. Destroy 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone.

name: Big Bang Shot
cn_text: 裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升400。裝備怪獸攻擊守備表示怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。這張卡從場上離開時，裝備怪獸從游戲中除外。
description: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster.

name: Wild Nature's Release
cn_text: 選擇場上1只獸族·獸戰士族怪獸才能發動。選擇的獸族·獸戰士族怪獸的攻擊力上升那只怪獸的守備力數值。受到這個效果影響的怪獸在結束階段時破壞。
description: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior-Type monster; it gains ATK equal to its current DEF until the End Phase. During the End Phase, destroy it.

name: Phantom Ghost
cn_text: 由這個世界上不能成佛的靈魂，慢慢聚集而成的怨靈。
description: A vengeful spirit made up of many restless souls.

name: Mazera DeVille
cn_text: 這張卡不能進行通常召喚。這張卡僅當場上存在「萬魔殿-惡魔的巢窟-」時，祭掉自己場上1只以表側表示存在的「杰拉的戰士」才能特殊召喚。這張卡特殊召喚成功時，對方隨機丟棄3張手卡。此效果僅當自己場上存在「萬魔殿-惡魔的巢窟-」時才適用。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "Pandemonium" is on the field. If "Pandemonium" is on your side of the field when you Special Summon this card, your opponent discards 3 random cards from their hand. If "Pandemonium" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

name: Skull Archfiend of Lightning
cn_text: 這張卡的控制者在自己的每1個准備階段支付500基本分。當這張卡成為對方所控制的卡的效果對象時，在效果處理時擲1次骰子，若擲出1·3·6，則使此效果無效并將其破壞。
description: During each of your Standby Phases, you must pay 500 Life Points (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. Before resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die, negate the effect if you roll 1, 3 or 6, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Sword of Dragon's Soul
cn_text:
戰士族怪獸才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。
②：裝備怪獸和龍族怪獸進行戰斗的傷害計算后發動。和裝備怪獸進行戰斗的那只怪獸在那次戰斗階段結束時破壞。
description: This card can only be equipped to a Warrior-Type monster. A monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 700 points. A Dragon-Type monster that battles with the monster equipped with this card is destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

name: Elemental Burst
cn_text: 自己場上存在的風·水·炎·地屬性的怪獸各1只作為祭品才能發動。對方場上存在的卡全部破壞。
description: Tribute 1 each of WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH monsters to activate this card. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
cn_text:
①：這張卡被效果破壞送去墓地的場合，下次的自己准備階段發動。這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。
②：這張卡的①的效果特殊召喚的場合發動。場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: During your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When you do: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Necrolancer the Time-lord
cn_name: 時間魔人 獨眼死靈師
cn_text: 從時空環出來的可以去任何自己想去的地方的獨眼魔人。
description: The one-eyed Necrolancer launches his onslaught from a dimensional ring that can appear out of thin air.

name: Arcana Knight Joker
cn_text:
「王后騎士」＋「衛兵騎士」＋「國王騎士」
這張卡的融合召喚不用上記的卡不能進行。
①：1回合1次，場上的這張卡為對象的怪獸的效果·魔法·陷阱卡發動時，把和那張卡相同種類（怪獸·魔法·陷阱）的1張手卡丟棄才能發動。那個效果無效。
description: "Queen's Knight" + "Jack's Knight" + "King's Knight"A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets this face-up card on the field: You can discard the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); negate the effect.

name: The Creator
cn_text: 選擇自己墓地的1張怪獸卡。將1張手卡送去墓地，選擇的那張怪獸卡特殊召喚。這個效果1個回合只能使用1次。這張卡不能從墓地特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your Graveyard; send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon that target.

name: Banisher of the Light
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，被送去墓地的卡不去墓地從游戲中除外。
description: Any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

name: Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow
cn_text:
這張卡對對方造成戰斗傷害時，從下列效果中選擇1項發動：
●將場上1張卡彈回持有者手卡。
●檢視對方卡組最上面1張卡（對方不能確認這張卡），并選擇將其放回對方卡組最上面或最下面。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:? Target 1 card on the field; return that target to the hand.? Look at the top card of their Deck, then return it to the top or bottom of the Deck.

name: Bubble Crash
cn_text: 手卡·場上的卡合計有6張以上的玩家，直到合計變成5張為止，把卡送去墓地。
description: This card can only be activated when any player has 6 or more cards on the field and/or in their hand. The player(s) then select and send cards to their respective Graveyards until the amount remaining on the field and in their hand is 5.

name: Dark World Grimoire
cn_text: 自己的結束階段時手卡數量限制把手卡丟棄去墓地的場合，若那之中包含有怪獸卡可以只把1只在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: During your End Phase, if you discard a monster(s) to the Graveyard because you had more cards than your hand size limit: You can target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon that target.

name: Graverobber
cn_text: 選擇對方墓地的1張魔法卡，直到回合結束時可以作為自己的手卡使用。使用那張魔法卡的場合，受到2000分傷害。
description: Select 1 Spell Card from your opponent's Graveyard. You can use it as your hand until the end of the turn. If you use it, you take 2000 points of damage.

name: Imperial Order
cn_text:
這張卡的控制者在每次雙方的准備階段支付700基本分。不能支付700基本分的場合這張卡破壞。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，場上的全部魔法卡的效果無效化。
description: Negate all Spell effects on the field. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase, you must pay 700 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed.

name: Greenkappa
cn_text: 反轉：選擇場上蓋放的2張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。
description: FLIP: Target 2 Set Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

name: Magic Reflector
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1張魔法卡才能發動。給選擇的卡放置1個指示物。選擇的卡被破壞的場合，作為代替把1個指示物取除。
description: Target 1 face-up Spell Card you control; place 1 counter on it. If it would ever be destroyed, remove the counter instead.

name: Level Modulation
cn_text: 對方抽2張卡。自己墓地存在的名字中帶有「LV」的1只怪獸，無視召喚條件特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸，這個回合不能攻擊也不能效果發動以及適用。
description: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

name: Legendary Sword
cn_text: 戰士族才能裝備。1只裝備怪獸的攻擊力和守備力上升300。
description: A Warrior-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Sage of Stillness
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，對方玩家在下個回合不能發動陷阱卡。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the next turn.

name: Divine Dragon Ragnarok
cn_text: 被傳為神使的傳說之龍。觸犯了它的怒火之時，據說世界會沉入海中。
description: A legendary dragon sent by the gods as their instrument. Legends say that if provoked, the whole world will sink beneath the sea.

name: Castle of Dark Illusions
cn_text: 反轉：場上表側表示的全部不死族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力加200。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，自己的每個准備階段不死族的攻守力都會加200。這個效果持續到自己的第4個准備階段。
description: FLIP: All Zombie-Type monsters gain 200 ATK and DEF. During each of your next 4 Standby Phases, each of those Zombie-Type monsters gains 200 more ATK and DEF. These effects last as long as this card is face-up on the field.

name: The Wicked Dreadroot
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。把自己場上3只怪獸解放的場合才能通常召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，這張卡以外的場上的怪獸的攻擊力·守備力變成一半。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set except by Tributing 3 monsters. Halve the ATK and DEF of all monsters on the field, except this card.

name: Rock Ogre Grotto #2
cn_text: 岩石聚集而成的石像。將對方石化后破壞。
description: A golem formed by boulders, this monster turns its enemies to stone and crushes them to dust.

name: Lunar Queen Elzaim
cn_name: 月之女神 艾露塞姆
cn_text: 守護月亮的美麗女神。使用月光屏障守備攻擊。
description: A lovely creature guarded by the moon. Her lunar curtain can block just about any attack.

name: Justi-Break
cn_text: 自己場上的通常怪獸為攻擊對象的對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。表側攻擊表示存在的通常怪獸以外的場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack against a face-up Normal Monster you control. Destroy all monsters on the field, except face-up Attack Position Normal Monsters.

name: Magic Cylinder
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，以1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸的攻擊無效，給與對方那個攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

name: Adhesion Trap Hole
cn_text: 對方對怪獸的召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時才能發動。那怪獸只要在場上表側表示存在，原本攻擊力變成一半數值。
description: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

name: Mighty Guard
cn_text: 警衛用開發的機械戰士。全身釆用不鏽鋼金屬制造。
description: A machine soldier that was developed as a guard. It is made of rust-proof metal.

name: Fortress Whale
cn_text: 借由「要塞鯨的誓言」降臨。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為7個以上的卡。
description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Fortress Whale's Oath".

name: Kazejin
cn_text: ①：只在這張卡在場上表側表示存在才有1次，這張卡被攻擊的傷害計算時，以1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸的攻擊力變成0。
description: During damage calculation in your opponent's turn, if this card is being attacked: You can target the attacking monster; make that target's ATK 0 during damage calculation only (this is a Quick Effect). This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Hyozanryu
cn_text: 全身由鑽石搆成的龍。用耀眼的光來蒙蔽敵人的雙眼。
description: A dragon created from a massibe diamond that sparkles with blinding light.

name: Rhaimundos of the Red Sword
cn_text: 持有赤紅炎劍的戰士。利用火焰束縛來封住行動。
description: Armed with the Sword of Crimson Flames, this warrior can bind a monster with fiery restraints.

name: Reshef the Dark Being
cn_text: 「大邪神的儀式」降臨。從手卡丟棄1張魔法卡。結束階段前獲得對方場上1只怪獸的控制權。這個效果1個回合只能使用1次。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Final Ritual of the Ancients". Once per turn, by discarding 1 Spell Card from your hand, take control of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn.

name: Lekunga
cn_text: 從自己墓地里除外2只水屬性怪獸，在自己場上以攻擊表示特殊召喚1只「裂蕈牙衍生物」（水·2星·植物族·攻/守700）。
description: You can banish 2 WATER monsters from your Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Lekunga Token" (Plant-Type/WATER/Level 2/ATK 700/DEF 700) in Attack Position.

name: X-Head Cannon
cn_text: 裝備強力加農炮，具備合體能力的怪獸。驅使合體和分離施展各種攻擊。
description: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.

name: Toad Master
cn_text: 活了几千年的青蛙仙人。用蝌蚪進行攻擊。
description: A hermit frog that has been in existence for thousands of years, it attacks with tadpoles.

name: Parrot Dragon
cn_text: 美國喜劇中的龍，不要被可愛的外表所迷惑。
description: A dragon from the cartoons that's more dangerous than it appears to be.

name: Mystery Hand
cn_text: 弄歪空間，從次元的狹間中伸出手腕進行攻擊。
description: This monster twists reality and reaches between dimensions to attack its enemies.

name: The Wicked Worm Beast
cn_text: ①：自己結束階段發動。場上的表側表示的這張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: This face-up card on the field is returned to the owner's hand during the End Phase of your turn.

name: Light of Intervention
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，不能把怪獸蓋放。此外，把怪獸蓋放的場合必須變成表側守備表示。
description: While this card is on the field, Monster Cards cannot be Set or flipped face-down. If a Monster Card would be Set, it must be Normal Summoned in face-up Defense Position.

name: Dragon Master Knight
cn_text:
「混沌戰士」＋「青眼究極龍」
這張卡不用融合召喚不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡的攻擊力上升自己場上的其他的龍族怪獸數量×500。
description: "Black Luster Soldier" + "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon"Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 500 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster you control, except this card.

name: Convulsion of Nature
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，雙方玩家把卡組上下翻轉過來進行決斗。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, both players must turn their respective Decks upside down and proceed with the current Duel.

name: Burglar
cn_text: 奸詐狡猾的老鼠。使用左手的大?爪進行攻擊。
description: A sly rat. He will come at you with his huge left claw.

name: Destruction of Destiny
cn_text: 從自己卡組的最上面把3張卡送去墓地。這個效果送去墓地的魔法·陷阱卡每有1張，自己受到1000分傷害。
description: Send 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard, and take 1000 damage for each Spell or Trap Card sent to the Graveyard this way.

name: Soul-Absorbing Bone Tower
cn_text: 若自己場上有除這張卡以外的不死族怪獸存在，則這張卡不能被攻擊。每當不死族怪獸特殊召喚成功時，將對方卡組最上面2張卡送去墓地。
description: If you control another Zombie-Type monster, your opponent cannot target this card for attacks. Each time a Zombie-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned: Send the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Dragon Manipulator
cn_text: 反轉：在回合結束前得到對方場上的1只表側表示存在的龍族怪獸。
description: FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of the End Phase.

name: Stop Defense
cn_text: ①：以對方場上1只守備表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方怪獸變成表側攻擊表示。
description: Select 1 Defense Position monster on your opponent's side of the field and change it to Attack Position.

name: Orca Mega-Fortress of Darkness
cn_text: 祭掉自己場上1只「魚雷魚」，破壞對方場上1只怪獸。祭掉自己場上1只「炮彈槍貝」，破壞對方場上1張魔法·陷阱卡。
description: By Tributing 1 "Torpedo Fish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 monster on the field. By Tributing 1 "Cannonball Spear Shellfish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: The Shadow Who Controls the Dark
cn_text: 溶入黑暗之中的影子。用金網封住對方的行動。
description: A shadow that dwells in the dark, paralyzing its opponents and rendering them harmless.

name: Wall Shadow
cn_text: 不用「迷宮變化」的效果不能特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Magical Labyrinth".

name: Cyber Shield
cn_text:
「鷹身女郎」或「鷹身女郎三姐妹」才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升500。
description: Equip only to "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters". It gains 500 ATK.

name: Miracle Jurassic Egg
cn_text:
①：場上的表側表示的這張卡不能除外。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次恐龍族怪獸被送去自己墓地，給這張卡放置2個指示物。
③：把這張卡解放才能發動。把持有這張卡放置的指示物數量以下的等級的1只恐龍族怪獸從卡組特殊召喚。
description: While face-up on the field, this card cannot be banished. Each time a Dinosaur-Type monster(s) is sent to your Graveyard, place 2 counters on this card. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the number of counters that were on this card.

name: Terra the Terrible
cn_text: 住在沼澤地的惡魔手下，看起來不怎么強，但絕不能對他輕心大意。
description: Known as a swamp dweller, this creature is a minion of the dark forces.

name: Phoenix Wing Wind Blast
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1張卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的卡回到持有者卡組最上面。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place that target on the top of the Deck.

name: Rapid-Fire Magician
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己發動通常魔法卡，給與對方基本分400分的傷害。
description: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent each time you activate a Normal Spell Card.

name: Thousand Knives
cn_text: ①：自己場上有「黑魔朮師」存在的場合，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方怪獸破壞。
description: If you control "Dark Magician": Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Senet Switch
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，以自己的主要怪獸區域1只怪獸為對象，指定那相鄰的沒有使用的怪獸區域1處才能發動。那只自己怪獸的位置向相鄰的指定的區域移動。
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can move 1 monster on your side of the field to an adjacent unoccupied Monster Card Zone.

name: Stone Armadiller
cn_text: 身體被像石頭般堅固的毛覆蓋?、守備堅固。
description: Dis stone crittah's got rock-hahd fur. Dat gives him some really good dee-fense!

name: Physical Double
cn_text: 對方回合才能發動。把1只持有和指定的對方怪獸相同等級·種族·屬性·攻擊力·守備力的「幻覺衍生物」特殊召喚。回合結束時這只衍生物破壞。
description: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 "Mirage Token" with the same Level, Type, Attribute, ATK, and DEF as that target. Destroy this Token during the End Phase.

name: Cyber Summon Blaster
cn_text: ①：這張卡已在魔法與陷阱區域存在的狀態，每次機械族怪獸特殊召喚成功發動。給與對方300傷害。

①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，反轉怪獸的效果無效化。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，這張卡為對象的陷阱卡的效果無效化并破壞。
description: "Cave Dragon" + "Lesser Fiend"(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Material Monsters. Negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters. Negate any Trap effects that target this card on the field, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card.

name: Herald of Creation
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，丟棄1張手卡，以自己墓地1只7星以上的怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸加入手卡。
description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Level 7 or higher monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: The Fiend Megacyber
cn_text: ①：自己場上的怪獸數量比對方場上的怪獸少2只以上的場合，這張卡可以從手卡特殊召喚。
description: If your opponent controls at least 2 more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

name: Serpent Night Dragon
cn_text: 宿於邪惡騎士心中之龍的實體化形。
description: A dragon created from the soul of a wicked knight.

name: Labyrinth of Nightmare
cn_text: 在每1個回合的結束階段時，變更該回合行動玩家場上所有以表側表示存在的怪獸的表示形式。
description: Once per turn, during each player's End Phase: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters the turn player controls.

name: Saggi the Dark Clown
cn_text: 不知從哪里出現的道化師。用不可思議的動作來躲開攻擊。
description: This clown appears from nowhere and executes very strange moves to avoid enemy attacks.

name: Photon Generator Unit
cn_text: 把自己場上2只「電子龍」作為祭品才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地特殊召喚1只「電子鐳射龍」。
description: Tribute 2 "Cyber Dragons". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Laser Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Dragon Zombie
cn_text: 被魔力喚醒的龍，吐出的氣息能使物體腐爛。
description: A dragon revived by sorcery. Its breath is highly corrosive.

name: Mind on Air
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方必須永續公開手卡。
description: Your opponent must play with their hand revealed.

name: Goblin Black Ops
