cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示。直到下次的自己回合結束時這張卡不能把表示形式改變。
description: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

name: Element Soldier
cn_text:
這只怪獸在場上有特定屬性的怪獸存在的場合，得到以下的效果。
●水屬性：這張卡的控制權不能變更。
●地屬性：這張卡戰斗破壞的怪獸的效果無效化。
description: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:? WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.? EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle.

name: Rain of Mercy
cn_text: 雙方的基本分回復1000分。
description: Increases the Life Points of both players by 1000 points.

name: Curse of Anubis
cn_text: ①：場上的攻擊表示的效果怪獸全部變成守備表示。這個回合，這個效果變成守備表示的怪獸原本守備力變成0，不能把表示形式變更。
description: Change all Effect Monsters on the field to Defense Position. Until the end of this turn, the original DEF of those monsters becomes 0, also their battle positions cannot be changed.

name: Fissure
cn_text: ①：對方場上1只攻擊力最低的怪獸破壞。
description: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied).

name: Waterdragon Fairy
cn_text: 在水中搖搖晃晃漂浮的妖精。好像可以召喚水龍。
description: A water fairy that is said to be able to summon a giant sea serpent.

name: Marshmallon Glasses
cn_text: 只要自己的怪獸卡區域上有「棉花糖」存在，對方不能選擇「棉花糖」以外作為攻擊對象。
description: While "Marshmallon" is in your Monster Zone, your opponent cannot target monsters other than "Marshmallon" for attacks.

name: Gaia the Dragon Champion
cn_text: 「暗黑騎士 蓋亞」＋「詛咒之龍」
description: "Gaia The Fierce Knight" + "Curse of Dragon"

name: Oni Tank T-34
cn_text: 被移植了鬼的靈魂，對有意識的敵人窮追不舍。
description: An armored tank possessed by a fiend that will pursue enemies until they're crushed.

name: Boss Rush
cn_text:
自己沒有把怪獸通常召喚的回合才能把這張卡發動。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，自己不能把怪獸通常召喚。
②：這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在的狀態，自己場上的表側表示的「巨大戰艦」怪獸被破壞送去墓地的場合，那個回合的結束階段才能發動。從卡組把1只「巨大戰艦」怪獸特殊召喚。
description: You cannot Normal Summon or Set. During the End Phase of the turn that a "B.E.S." monster or a "Big Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster or 1 "Big Core" from your Deck.

name: Dreadscythe Harvester
cn_text: ①：把這張卡以外的自己場上1只昆蟲族怪獸解放才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升500。
description: You can Tribute 1 Insect-Type monster to have this card gain 500 ATK until the end of the turn.

name: The Earl of Demise
cn_text: 魔界的伯爵，外表很紳士，但本性卻十分邪惡，不只是人類，連低級的惡魔們都對他感到恐懼。
description: This gentlemanly creature is extremely wicked, feared by man and fiend alike.

name: Gemini Trap Hole
cn_text: ①：再1次召喚狀態的二重怪獸被戰斗破壞時才能發動。對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Activate only when a Gemini monster that is treated as an Effect Monster is destroyed by battle. Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

cn_text: 當自己場上湊齊3張以表側表示存在的「7」時，自己抽3張卡。之后，所有的「7」被破壞。當這張卡從場上被送去墓地時，自己回復700基本分。
description: When there are 3 face-up "7" cards on your side of the field, draw 3 cards from your Deck. Then destroy all "7" cards. When this card is sent directly from the field to your Graveyard, increase your Life Points by 700 points.

name: Dark Bat
cn_text: 住在暗世界用精神波動找尋敵人的蝙蝠。
description: Bats from the netherworld that use their hyper senses to detect their enemies.

name: Dimension Wall
cn_text: 對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。這次戰斗讓自己受到的戰斗傷害，作為代替由對方承受。
description: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Instead of you, your opponent takes the Battle Damage you would have taken from this battle.

name: Earthbound Spirit
cn_text: 戰死沙場的士兵們的靈魂所聚集而產生的怨靈，踏入這片土地的人將被牽引入地底深處。
description: A vengeful creature formed by the spirits of fallen warriors, it drags any who dare approach it into the deepest bowels of the earth.

name: Pot of Avarice
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地5只怪獸為對象才能發動。那5只怪獸回到卡組。那之后，自己抽2張。
description: Target 5 monsters in your Graveyard; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Magic Formula
cn_text: 「黑魔朮師」「黑魔朮少女」才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。這張卡從場上送去墓地時，自己回復1000基本分。
description: Equip only to "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl". It gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 LP.

name: Labyrinth Wall
cn_text: 出現結界般的厚壁，制造出沒有出口的迷宮。
description: These walls form a labyrinth with no exit for enemies.

name: Spirit Message "N"
cn_text: 這張卡不用「通靈槃」的效果不能在場上出現。
description: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Darklord Nurse Reficule
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方基本分回復的效果變成給與對方基本分傷害的效果。
description: Any effect that would make your opponent gain LP inflicts the same amount of damage to them, instead.

name: Skull Lair
cn_text: 除外自己的墓地存在的任意數目的怪獸，破壞1只場上的和這個數目相同等級的表側表示的怪獸。
description: Remove from play any number of Monster Cards in your Graveyard to destroy 1 face-up monster on the field whose Level is equal to the number of the cards you removed from play.

name: Amphibian Beast
cn_text: 在陸地像獸一樣，在海里像魚一樣都能快速攻擊。
description: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

name: Seiyaryu
cn_text: 用神聖之炎燒盡邪惡，擁有神聖之力的龍。
description: A mystical dragon that burns away the unworthy with its mystic flames.

name: Dark Eruption
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只攻擊力1500以下的暗屬性怪獸為對象才能發動。那只暗屬性怪獸加入手卡。
description: Target 1 DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Layard the Liberator
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次自己或者對方把反擊陷阱卡發動，選除外的2只自己的天使族怪獸加入手卡。
description: Add 2 of your removed from play Fairy-Type monsters to your hand each time a Counter Trap Card is activated.

name: Crawling Dragon
cn_text: 力量弱小無法飛天的龍，但攻擊還是很強的。
description: This weakened dragon can no longer fly, but is still a deadly force to be reckoned with.

name: Science Soldier
cn_text: 為對抗未知生物，裝備?最新科學武器的士兵。背后的集裝箱里藏?各種各樣的兵器。
description: Soldiers equipped with state-of-the-art weaponry to face unknown creatures.

name: Hoshiningen
cn_text: ①：場上的光屬性怪獸的攻擊力上升500，暗屬性怪獸的攻擊力下降400。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all LIGHT monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all DARK monsters by 400 points.

name: Koumori Dragon
cn_text: 凶惡的龍。吐出邪惡的火焰使人變得邪惡。
description: A vicious, fire-breathing dragon whose wicked flame corrupts the souls of its victims.

name: Barrel Lily
cn_text: 所謂的鐵炮百合。就是射出花粉攻擊。
description: This wicked flower attacks enemies with pollen projectiles.

name: Ultimate Baseball Kid
cn_text: 場上有這張卡以外的炎屬性怪獸存在的場合，每有1張，這張卡的攻擊力上升1000。每把這張卡以外的1只炎屬性怪獸送去墓地，給與對方基本分500分的傷害。
description: This card gains 1000 ATK for each face-up FIRE monster on the field, except this card. You can send 1 other face-up FIRE monster you control to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Spirit Ryu
cn_text: 這張卡進行戰斗的自己的戰斗步驟時，從手卡把1只龍族怪獸丟棄去墓地才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力直到戰斗階段結束時上升1000。
description: You can only activate this effect during your Battle Step, if this card battles during your turn. Discard 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard to increase the ATK and DEF of this card by 1000 points until the End Step.

name: Goddess of Whim
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。進行1次投擲硬幣，對里表作猜測。猜中的場合，這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時變成2倍。猜錯的場合，這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時變成一半。
description: Once per turn: You can toss a coin and call Heads or Tails. If you call it right, double this card's ATK during this turn. If you call it wrong, halve its ATK during this turn.

name: Soul Exchange
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能進行戰斗階段。
①：以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。這個回合，自己把怪獸解放的場合，必須作為自己場上1只怪獸的代替而把作為對象的對方怪獸解放。
description: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that monster, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

name: Guardian Angel Joan
cn_text: ①：這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸送去墓地的場合發動。自己基本分回復那只怪獸的原本攻擊力的數值。
description: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of that destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

name: The Gross Ghost of Fled Dreams
cn_text: 進入熟睡者的夢中吸取其生命力的惡魔，被附身的人無法自己醒來。
description: This monster feeds on the dreams of an unwary sleeper, dragging the victim into eternal slumber.

name: Continuous Destruction Punch
cn_text: 若被攻擊的守備怪獸的守備力比對方攻擊怪獸的攻擊力高，則這只攻擊怪獸被破壞。
description: If the DEF of the attacked Defense Position monster on your side of the field is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster on your opponent's side of the field, destroy the attacking monster. Damage calculation is applied normally.

name: Soul Absorption
cn_text: 將卡從游戲中除外時，每除外1張，這張卡的控制者自己回復500基本分。
description: If a card(s) is banished: Gain 500 LP for each.

name: A Feint Plan
cn_text: 這個回合，雙方不能向里側表示怪獸攻擊。
description: A player cannot attack face-down monsters during this turn.

name: Stone Dragon
cn_text: 完全由岩石組成的龍。岩石的攻擊很強。
description: A dragon formed by huge boulders that are also used to attack the enemy.

name: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions
cn_text: 當自己場上存在表側表示的「首領 扎魯格」時這張卡才能發動。可以從手卡里將名稱中含有「黑蠍」字樣的怪獸全部特殊召喚上場。（同名怪獸只能特殊召喚1只）
description: If you control a face-up "Don Zaloog": You can Special Summon any number of "Dark Scorpion" monsters from your hand, but only 1 copy of each.

name: Royal Knight
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸送去墓地時，自己基本分回復破壞怪獸的守備力的數值。
description: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, gain Life Points equal to the DEF of the destroyed monster.

name: Precious Cards from Beyond
cn_text: ①：自己作把怪獸2只以上解放的上級召喚成功的場合發動。自己從卡組抽2張。
description: When you Tribute Summon a monster using 2 or more Tributes: Draw 2 cards.

name: Miracle Restoring
cn_text: 把自己場上2個魔力指示物取除才能發動。從自己墓地選擇1只「黑魔朮師」或者「破壞之劍士」特殊召喚。
description: Remove 2 Spell Counters from your side of the field, then target 1 "Dark Magician" or "Buster Blader" in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: Metal Guardian
cn_text: 守護魔界寶物的惡魔在黑暗中守備相當強。
description: A fiend guarding the treasures of the netherworld, it's most at home in the dark.

name: Fairy's Gift
cn_text: 據說能使任何人幸福的魔法一邊飛一邊散發?。
description: This flying monster is known for delivering happiness to all.

name: Barox
cn_text: 「殺人熊貓」＋「石像怪」
description: "Frenzied Panda" + "Ryu-Kishin"

name: Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou
cn_text: 把手卡1張卡送去墓地裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升500。這張卡裝備的怪獸戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，那只怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; equip this card to a monster. It gains 500 ATK. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with the equipped monster.

name: A Deal with Dark Ruler
cn_text: 這張卡只能在有8星以上的怪獸從自己場上被送去墓地的回合發動。從自己的手卡或卡組特殊召喚「狂暴死龍」上場。
description: (This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)If a Level 8 or higher monster under your control was sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon 1 "Berserk Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

name: Mystic Horseman
cn_text: 人和馬合為一體的怪物。跑得很快，誰都追不上。
description: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme speed.

name: Metalmorph
cn_text:
①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。這張卡當作攻擊力·守備力上升300的裝備卡使用給那只怪獸裝備。
②：用這張卡的效果把這張卡裝備的怪獸的攻擊力只在向怪獸攻擊的傷害計算時上升那只攻擊對象怪獸的攻擊力一半數值。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 300 ATK and DEF. If it attacks, it gains ATK equal to half the ATK of the attack target, during damage calculation only.

name: Slime Toad
cn_text: 蛙頭形狀的史萊姆。呱呱叫唱?難聽的歌來攻擊。
description: A slime with the head of a frog, it attacks by croaking terribly.

name: Little Chimera
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，場上的炎屬性怪獸的攻擊力上升500，水屬性怪獸的攻擊力下降400。
description: All FIRE monsters on the field gain 500 ATK. All WATER monsters on the field lose 400 ATK.

name: Lucky Pied Piper
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地時，從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

name: Cyber Barrier Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。這張卡只能通過「攻擊反射裝置」的效果特殊召喚。這張卡攻擊表示的場合，1回合1次，可以把1只對方怪獸的攻擊無效。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Attack Reflector Unit". Once per turn, while this card is in Attack Position, your opponent's next attack is negated.

name: Rock Ogre Grotto #1
cn_text: 岩石之軀成就高強的守備力。揮起巨腕時務必警惕。
description: Protected by a solid body of rock, this monster throws a bone-shattering punch.

name: Fiend Reflection #1
cn_text: 可以將對方吸入鏡中世界。
description: This monster can draw its enemies into a mirror world that renders them helpless.

name: Hard-sellin' Goblin
cn_text: 每次自己場上的怪獸給與對方玩家戰斗傷害，對方的魔法與陷阱卡區域存在的1張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, return 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone to its owner's hand.

name: Kamakiriman
cn_text: 用兩把鐮刀襲擊對方的一種人型螳螂怪獸。
description: A man-shaped mantis with two razor-sharp scythes.

name: Boo Koo
cn_text: 書形的魔法師。寫有各種各樣的魔法。
description: A book-like wizard with a wealth of magic written inside.

name: Cyber-Stein
cn_text: ①：支付5000基本分才能發動。從額外卡組把1只融合怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: Pay 5000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the field in Attack Position.

name: Contract with the Abyss
cn_text:
暗屬性儀式怪獸的降臨必需。
①：等級合計直到變成和儀式召喚的怪獸相同為止，把自己的手卡·場上的怪獸解放，從手卡把1只暗屬性儀式怪獸儀式召喚。
description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any DARK Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

name: Introduction to Gallantry
cn_text: 對方手卡有5張以上時才能發動。對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: Activate only when your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Deal of Phantom
cn_text: 選擇場上的表側表示存在的1只怪獸。在回合結束前，每有1只自己墓地存在的怪獸，選擇的那只怪獸的攻擊力上升100。
description: Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Increase the selected monster's ATK by 100 points for each monster in your Graveyard during the turn this card is activated. The number of monsters is applied when this card is activated.

name: Zera the Mant
cn_text: 「杰拉的儀式」降臨。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Zera Ritual".

name: Gemini Elf
cn_text: 交替發動攻擊的精靈雙子姐妹。
description: Elf twins that alternate their attacks.

name: Lightning Vortex
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡才能發動。對方場上的表側表示怪獸全部破壞。
description: Discard 1 card; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Butterfly Dagger - Elma
cn_text: 裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力上升300點。裝備在怪獸身上的這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，這張卡可以彈回持有者手卡。
description: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard while equipped: You can return this card to the hand.

name: Harpie's Pet Baby Dragon
cn_text:
這張卡追加自己場上存在的除「鷹身女妖的寵物仔龍」以外的名字帶有「鷹身」的怪獸的數量的效果。
●1只：只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方不能選擇自己場上存在的除「鷹身女妖的寵物仔龍」以外的名字帶有「鷹身」的怪獸作為攻擊對象。
●2只：這張卡的原本攻擊力·守備力變成2倍。
●3只：1回合1次，可以把對方場上的1張卡破壞。
description: This card gains effects based on the number of "Harpie" monsters you control, except "Harpie's Pet Baby Dragon".? 1 or more: Your opponent cannot target "Harpie" monsters you control for attacks, except "Harpie's Pet Baby Dragon".? 2 or more: Double the original ATK and DEF of this card.? 3 or more: Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: My Body as a Shield
cn_text: 支付1500基本分發動。對方發動的持有「把場上的怪獸破壞的效果」的卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field (except during the Damage Step): Pay 1500 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Array of Revealing Light
cn_text: 宣言1個種族。宣言的種族的全部怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚的回合不能進行攻擊宣言。
description: Declare 1 Type of monster. Any monster of the declared Type cannot declare an attack during the turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned.

name: Bunilla
cn_text: 非常喜歡甜食的甜食派兔子。在找據說是世界第一甜的甘糖胡蘿卜，無論今天還是明天都想要啃胡蘿卜。
description: This rabbit's got a sweet tooth! He's on a quest for the world's sweetest carrot, and just wants to nibble carrots all day today, tomorrow, and the day after that!

name: King of Yamimakai
cn_text: 使用強大的暗之力量，破壞周圍的一切。
description: Wields the power of darkness to destroy its enemies.

name: Koitsu
cn_text: 1回合只有1次，在自己的主要階段，場上的這張卡可以當作裝備卡使用給「彼者」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升3000點。裝備怪獸攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張，裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Aitsu" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 3000 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Dedication through Light and Darkness
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只「黑魔朮師」解放才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地選1只「混沌之黑魔朮師」特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 1 "Dark Magician"; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician of Chaos" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Tongyo
cn_text: 用長舌頭抓住其他的魚，吸取能量。
description: This monster captures other fish with its long tongue and sucks the energy out of them.

name: Des Koala
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。給與對方為對方手卡數量×400傷害。
description: FLIP: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand.

name: Goblin Out of the Frying Pan
cn_text: 支付500基本分。魔法卡的發動無效，那張卡回到持有者的手卡。
description: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and return it to the owner's hand.

name: Horn Imp
cn_text: 住在黑暗的小鬼。攻擊意外的強。要注意它頭上的角。
description: A small fiend that dwells in the dark, its single horn makes it a formidable opponent.

name: Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover
cn_name: 黑蠍-拆除陷阱的克里夫
cn_text:
①：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害時，可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●以場上1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張卡破壞。
●從對方卡組上面把2張卡送去墓地。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:? Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.? Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Terrible Deal
cn_text: 對方的魔法卡發動時支付1000基本分才能發動。對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: Activate only by paying 1000 Life Points when your opponent activates a Spell Card. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Wow Warrior
cn_text: 擁有手和腳的魚人獸，用尖銳的牙齒撕咬敵人。
description: A fish with arms, legs, and some very sharp teeth.

name: Garvas
cn_text: 惡之化身。樣子如同長?羽毛的獅子。
description: A wicked beast that resembles a winged lion.

name: Woodland Sprite
cn_text: 裝備在這張卡上的1張裝備卡送去墓地。對方玩家受到500分的傷害。
description: Send 1 Equip Card equipped to this card to the Graveyard. Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Piercing Moray
cn_text: 1回合1次，自己的主要階段時把這張卡以外的自己場上1只魚族·海龍族·水族怪獸解放才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力上升600。此外，這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster; this card gains 600 ATK. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

name: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上3只惡魔族怪獸解放的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：1回合1次，把這張卡以外的自己場上1只怪獸解放才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升解放的怪獸的原本攻擊力數值。
②：對方對怪獸的召喚成功的場合發動。在自己場上把1只「幻魔衍生物」（惡魔族·暗·1星·攻/守1000）特殊召喚。這衍生物不能攻擊宣言。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 Fiend-Type monsters, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. If your opponent Normal Summons a monster(s): Special Summon 1 "Phantasm Token" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) for each monster Summoned, but it cannot declare an attack. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster until the end of this turn.

name: Dice Armadillo
cn_text: 卷起身子就像骰子一樣的犰狳。
description: An armadillo monster that rolls up to form a dice-like shape.

name: Gilford the Legend
cn_name: 傳說的戰士 吉爾福德
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。這張卡召喚成功時，可以把自己墓地存在的裝備卡盡可能裝備到自己場上的戰士族怪獸上。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can equip as many Equip Spell Cards from your Graveyard as possible to a Warrior-Type monster(s) you control.

name: Muse-A
cn_text: 藝朮家的天使。尤其琴技無人能出其右。
description: A fairy of the arts that is unbeatable on the harp.

name: Rush Recklessly
cn_text: ①：以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升700。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Twin-Barrel Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時，選擇對方場上存在的1張卡發動。進行2次投擲硬幣，2次都是表的場合，選擇的卡破壞。
description: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 card your opponent controls; toss a coin twice, and if the result is 2 Heads, destroy it.

name: D.D. Assailant
cn_text: ①：這張卡被和對方怪獸的戰斗破壞的傷害計算后發動。那些進行戰斗的各自怪獸除外。
description: After damage calculation, when this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.

name: Neck Hunter
cn_text: 揮舞?大鐮刀的惡魔。從大眼睛中還會發出光柱。
description: A fiend that wields a mean sickle and fires devastating beams from its eyes.

name: Cyber Dragon
cn_text: ①：只有對方場上才有怪獸存在的場合，這張卡可以從手卡特殊召喚。
description: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

name: Blast Juggler
cn_text: 在自己的准備階段時發動。表側表示的這張卡作為祭品，選擇2只表側表示的攻擊力1000以下的怪獸破壞。
description: You can only activate this effect during your Standby Phase. Tribute this face-up card to select and destroy 2 face-up monsters with an ATK 1000 or less.

name: Spiritual Earth Art - Kurogane
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只地屬性怪獸解放，以那只怪獸以外的自己墓地1只4星以下的地屬性怪獸為對象才能發動。那只地屬性怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 1 EARTH monster. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower EARTH monster from your Graveyard, except the Tributed monster.

name: Insect Soldiers of the Sky
cn_text: 攻擊風屬性的怪獸時，傷害階段時攻擊力上升1000。
description: The ATK of this card increases by 1000 points whenever it attacks a WIND monster.

name: Dark Core
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。將場上1只表側表示的怪獸從游戲中除外。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that target.

name: Mucus Yolk
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。這張卡給與對方玩家戰斗傷害的場合，下次的自己的准備階段時這張卡的攻擊力上升1000。
description: This card may attack your opponent's Life Points directly. Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, increase the ATK of this card by 1000 points during your next Standby Phase. The ATK increase lasts as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

name: Dimensional Prison
cn_text: 對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，選擇1只攻擊怪獸才能發動。選擇的攻擊怪獸從游戲中除外。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target that attacking monster; banish that target.

name: Riryoku Field
cn_text: 以場上的1只怪獸為對象的魔法的發動無效并破壞。
description: When a Spell Card that targets exactly 1 monster on the field (and no other cards) is activated: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Yamadron
cn_text: 用三個頭不斷地噴火，使周圍一帶變成火海！
description: This monster has three fire-breathing heads and can form a sea of blazing flames.

name: Upstart Goblin
cn_text: ①：自己從卡組抽1張。那之后，對方回復1000基本分。
description: Draw 1 card, then your opponent gains 1000 Life Points.

name: Il Blud
cn_name: 地獄的門番 伊爾·布拉德
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●1回合1次，可以把手卡·自己或者對方墓地存在的1只不死族怪獸特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時，這個效果特殊召喚的不死族怪獸破壞。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.? Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your hand or from either player's Graveyard. When this card leaves the field, destroy all Zombie-Type monsters Special Summoned by this card's effect.

name: Dark General Freed
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。自己場上表側表示存在的暗屬性怪獸為對象的魔法卡的效果無效并破壞。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，可以作為自己的抽卡階段時進行通常抽卡的代替，從自己卡組把1只4星的暗屬性怪獸加入手卡。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. Negate any Spell effects that target a face-up DARK monster(s) you control and if you do, destroy that Spell Card. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 Level 4 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Dragoness the Wicked Knight
cn_name: 魔裝騎士 德拉格尼斯
cn_text: 「鎧甲劍尾戰士」＋「獨眼盾龍」
description: "Armaill" + "One-Eyed Shield Dragon"

name: Next to be Lost
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸。從自己卡組選1張和選擇的卡同名的卡送去墓地。
description: Select 1 face-up monster you control. Send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard with the same name as the selected card.

name: Summoned Skull
cn_text: 使用黑暗力量，迷惑人心的惡魔。在惡魔族中以相當強大的力量著稱。
description: A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend-Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)

name: Royal Magical Library
cn_text:
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物（最多3個）。
②：把這張卡3個魔力指示物取除才能發動。自己從卡組抽1張。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves (max. 3). You can remove 3 Spell Counters from this card; draw 1 card.

name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
cn_text: 自己場上存在光屬性以外的表側表示怪獸的場合，表側表示的這張卡破壞。
description: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

name: Premature Burial
cn_text: ①：支付800基本分，以自己墓地1只怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚，把這張卡裝備。這張卡破壞時那只怪獸破壞。
description: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Ninjitsu Art of Transformation
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只表側表示的「忍者」怪獸解放才能把這張卡發動。把持有解放的怪獸的等級＋3以下的等級的1只獸族·鳥獸族·昆蟲族怪獸從手卡·卡組特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。
description: Activate this card by Tributing 1 face-up "Ninja" monster; Special Summon 1 Beast, Winged Beast, or Insect-Type monster from your hand or Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the Level the Tributed monster had on the field +3. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster.

name: Full Salvo
cn_text: 這張卡發動后，把手卡全部送去墓地。給與對方基本分送去墓地的卡數量×200數值的傷害。
description: When this card resolves, send your entire hand to the Graveyard. Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card you sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

name: Hane-Hane
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: FLIP: Select 1 monster on the field and return it to its owner's hand.

name: Right Arm of the Forbidden One
cn_text: 被封印的右腕。假若解開封印，能得無限之力。
description: A forbidden right arm sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

name: Alinsection
cn_text: 大甲蟲。除了頭上的鋸子，手腕也變成了鋸子。
description: A stag beetle with saw-like head and arms.

name: Phantom Beast Rock-Lizard
cn_text: 把名字帶有「幻獸」的怪獸作為祭品的場合，這張卡可以用1只祭品作召喚。這張卡每戰斗破壞1只怪獸，給與對方基本分500分傷害。對方控制的卡效果把這張卡破壞送去墓地時，給與對方基本分2000分傷害。
description: If you're Tributing a "Phantom Beast" monster or "Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts", this card can be Normal Summoned with 1 Tribute. When this card destroys a monster by battle, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, inflict 2000 damage to your opponent.

name: Nobleman of Crossout
cn_text: ①：以場上1只里側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只里側表示怪獸破壞并除外。除外的怪獸是反轉怪獸的場合，再讓雙方把雙方卡組確認，從那之中由自己把除外的怪獸的同名怪獸全部除外。
description: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

name: Stuffed Animal
cn_text: 看起來是個可愛的布娃娃，用拉鏈的嘴巴蒙上敵人并加以攻擊。
description: It may look like a harmless stuffed animal, but its zipper mouth deals a deadly bite.

name: The Bistro Butcher
cn_text: 這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害時，對方在卡組最上面抽2張卡。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent draws 2 cards from their Deck.

name: Phantom Beast Cross-Wing
cn_text: 只要這張卡在墓地存在，場上的名字帶有「幻獸」的怪獸的攻擊力上升300。
description: While this card is in the Graveyard, "Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts" and all "Phantom Beast" monsters on the field gain 300 ATK.

name: Despair from the Dark
cn_text: ①：這張卡被對方的效果從手卡·卡組送去墓地的場合發動。這張卡特殊召喚。
description: When this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

name: Yaranzo
cn_text: 突襲企圖打開寶箱的盜賊。
description: A treasure box containing a monster that attacks any unwary bandit.

name: Tornado Bird
cn_text: 反轉：場上的魔法·陷阱卡2張回主人的手卡。
description: FLIP: Return 2 Spell or Trap Cards on the field to their owners' hands.

name: Man Beast of Ares
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次有連鎖發生這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
description: After a Chain (of 2 or more Links) resolves, this card gains 500 ATK.

name: Fireyarou
cn_text: 被吞沒在火中的魔人。運用自如地操縱周圍的火焰攻擊。
description: A malevolent creature wrapped in flames that attacks enemies with intense fire.

name: Queen's Bodyguard
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，自己場上存在的名字帶有「魅惑的女王」的怪獸不能被選擇作為攻擊對象。
description: "Allure Queen" monsters on your side of the field cannot be selected as an attack target.

name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚的場合發動。給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物（最多1個）。
②：這張卡的攻擊力上升這張卡的魔力指示物數量×300。
③：把這張卡1個魔力指示物取除，以場上1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張卡破壞。
description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). This card gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Autonomous Action Unit
cn_text: ①：支付1500基本分，以對方墓地1只怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸在自己場上攻擊表示特殊召喚，把這張卡裝備。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。
description: Pay 1500 Life Points, then target 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; Special Summon that target on your side of the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Maryokutai
cn_text: 對方把魔法卡發動時，可以把自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡解放，那個發動無效并破壞。這個效果在對方回合才能發動。
description: You can only activate this card's effect during your opponent's turn. When your opponent activates a Spell Card, Tribute this face-up card to negate the activation of the Spell Card and destroy it.

name: Dragon's Mirror
cn_text: ①：從自己的場上·墓地把龍族融合怪獸卡決定的融合素材怪獸除外，把那1只融合怪獸從額外卡組融合召喚。
description: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon-Type Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or Graveyard.

name: Field Barrier
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，雙方不能把場地魔法卡破壞，也不能作場地魔法卡的發動。「場地防護罩」在自己場上只能有1張表側表示存在。
description: Field Spell Cards on the field cannot be destroyed. Neither player can activate a new Field Spell Card. You can only control 1 "Field Barrier".

name: Megarock Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己墓地存在的岩石族怪獸除外才能特殊召喚。這張卡的原本攻擊力·守備力變成特殊召喚時所除外的岩石族怪獸數×700的數值。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play a Rock-Type monster(s) in your Graveyard. The original ATK and DEF of this card become the number of Rock-Type monsters you removed from play when you Special Summoned this card x 700 points.

name: Thunder King Rai-Oh
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，雙方不能用抽卡以外的方法從卡組把卡加入手卡。此外，可以把自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡送去墓地，讓1只對方怪獸的特殊召喚無效并破壞。
description: Neither player can add cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them. During either player's turn, when your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Karma Cut
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側表示怪獸除外。這個效果除外的卡的同名卡在對方墓地存在的場合，再把那些同名卡全部除外。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; banish that target, then banish all cards with the same name as that monster from your opponent's Graveyard.

name: Time Wizard
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。進行1次投擲硬幣，對里表作猜測。猜中的場合，對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。猜錯的場合，自己場上的怪獸全部破壞，自己受到表側表示破壞的怪獸的攻擊力合計數值一半的傷害。
description: Once per turn: You can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, destroy all monsters your opponent controls. If you call it wrong, destroy as many monsters you control as possible, and if you do, take damage equal to half the total ATK those destroyed monsters had on the field.

name: Bait Doll
cn_text: 選擇魔法與陷阱卡區域蓋放的1張卡發動。選擇的卡翻開確認，那張卡是陷阱卡的場合，強制發動。發動時機不正確的場合，那個效果無效并破壞。那張卡是陷阱卡以外的場合，回到原狀。這張卡發動后，不送去墓地回到卡組。
description: Target 1 Set card in the Spell & Trap Card Zone; reveal that target, force its activation if it is a Trap Card, then negate its effect if the activation timing is incorrect, and if you do, destroy it. (If it is not a Trap Card, return it face-down.) When this card resolves, shuffle it into the Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

name: Sea Kamen
cn_text: 以銳利的?爪撕裂對方的殘忍怪獸。
description: A merciless monster that tears opponents to shreds with razor-like claws.

name: Guardian of Order
cn_text: 自己場上有光屬性怪獸表側表示2只以上存在的場合，這張卡可以從手卡特殊召喚。「秩序守護者」在自己場上只能有1只表側表示存在。
description: If you control 2 or more LIGHT monsters, you can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only control 1 "Guardian of Order".

name: Armor Exe
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚的回合不能進行攻擊。在自己與對方的每1個准備階段，從自己場上除去1個魔力指示物，如果不除去魔力指示物，則這張卡被破壞。
description: This card cannot attack in the same turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. During each of your and your opponent's Standby Phases, remove 1 Spell Counter on your side of the field. If you do not, destroy this card.

name: Serpentine Princess
cn_text: ①：表側表示的這張卡從場上回到卡組的場合發動。從卡組把1只3星以下的怪獸特殊召喚。
description: If this face-up card is returned from the field to your Deck, select and Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower monster from your Deck to your side of the field. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Shovel Crusher
cn_text: 善於破壞一切。要注意其雙手的大鏟。
description: Armed with a pair of shovels, this monster will destroy anything that stands in its way.

name: Talisman of Spell Sealing
cn_text: 這張卡僅當自己場上存在「封印師 明晴」時才能發動。這張卡在場上存在時，魔法卡不能發動，場上所有魔法卡的效果無效化。「封印師 明晴」不在自己場上存在時，這張卡破壞。
description: You can only activate this card while there is a face-up "Sealmaster Meisei" on your side of the field. While this card is face-up on the field, Spell Cards cannot be activated and the effects of face-up Spell Cards on the field are negated. When "Sealmaster Meisei" is removed from the field, destroy this card.

name: Weather Report
cn_text: 反轉：對方場上表側表示存在的「光之護封劍」全部破壞。破壞成功的場合，下次的自己的戰斗階段可以進行2次。
description: FLIP: Destroys all of your opponent's face-up "Swords of Revealing Light" on the field. If "Swords of Revealing Light" is destroyed, you can perform your Battle Phase twice this turn (or your next turn, if activated during your opponent's turn).

name: Bat
cn_text: 投下左右翅膀里搭載的爆彈的機械蝙蝠。
description: A mechanical bat that drops blasts from its wings.

name: Desrook Archfiend
cn_text: 這張卡的控制者在自己的每1個准備階段支付500基本分。當這張卡成為對方所控制的卡的效果對象時，在效果處理時擲1次骰子，若擲出3，則使此效果無效并將其破壞。當自己場上的「滅絕國王惡魔」被破壞送去墓地時，可以從手卡將這張卡送去墓地，將此「滅絕國王惡魔」特殊召喚上場。
description: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases (this is not optional). When this card is targeted by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, when resolving the effect, roll a six-sided die. If the result is 3, negate the effect and destroy the opponent's card. When a "Terrorking Archfiend" on your side of the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon the "Terrorking Archfiend".

name: Samsara Kaiser
cn_text: 這張卡為祭品的祭品召喚成功時，這張卡回到手卡。
description: When you Tribute Summon a monster by Tributing this card, return this card to your hand.

name: Mon Larvas
cn_text: 進化過的野獸。力量有相當的提高。
description: A further step in the evolutionary chain, it is much more powerful than "Larvas".

name: Stone Ghost
cn_text: 激怒它的話，頭上的火山可是會爆發的哦。
description: With a head that erupts when angered, this monster launches a dangerous shower of boulders.

name: Giant Mech-Soldier
cn_text: 巨斧的一擊可以割開大地。
description: This monster swings an earth-shaking axe that cannot be blocked by a common sword.

name: Swords of Revealing Light
cn_text:
這張卡發動后繼續留在場上，用對方回合計算的3回合后的對方結束階段破壞。
①：作為這張卡的發動時的效果處理，對方場上有里側表示怪獸存在的場合，那些全部變成表側表示。
②：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，對方怪獸不能攻擊宣言。
description: Flip all monsters your opponent controls face-up. This card remains on the field for 3 of your opponent's turns. While this card is face-up on the field, monsters your opponent controls cannot declare an attack.

name: Royal Tribute
cn_text: 當自己場上有「王家長眠之谷」存在時才能發動。雙方玩家把手卡中的怪獸卡全部丟棄去墓地。
description: If you control "Necrovalley": Both players discard any monsters in their hands.

name: Demise, King of Armageddon
cn_text:
「世界末日」降臨。
①：支付2000基本分才能發動。場上的其他卡全部破壞。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "End of the World". You can pay 2000 Life Points to destroy all cards on the field, except this card.

name: Silent Magician LV8
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚，用「沉默魔朮師 LV4」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡只要在怪獸區域存在，不受對方的魔法卡的效果影響。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Silent Magician LV4" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects.

name: Dark Artist
cn_text: 受到了光屬性怪獸的攻擊時，這張卡的守備力成為一半。
description: If this card is being attacked by a LIGHT monster, its DEF is halved during damage calculation only.

name: Demotion
cn_text: 裝備怪獸的等級下降2星。
description: Downgrade the monster equipped with this card by 2 Levels.

name: Chaos Command Magician
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，只以這1張卡為對象的怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Negate the effect of a Monster Card that targets this 1 card.

name: Vanity's Ruler
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方不能把怪獸特殊召喚。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. Your opponent cannot Special Summon monsters.

name: Malice Doll of Demise
cn_text: 這張卡因永續魔法的效果從場上送去墓地的場合，自己的回合的准備階段時從墓地特殊召喚。
description: During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the Graveyard by the effect of a Continuous Spell Card: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

name: Tyhone
cn_text: 從口中發射遠程炮彈，在深山里炮擊威力強勁。
description: Capable of firing cannonballs from its mouth for long-range attacks, this creature is particularly effective in mountain battles.

name: Soul Hunter
cn_text: 「神燈魔人」＋「來自異次元的侵略者」
description: "Lord of the Lamp" + "Invader from Another Dimension"

name: Card Destruction
cn_text: ①：有手卡的玩家把那些手卡全部丟棄。那之后，那些玩家抽出自身丟棄的數量。
description: Each player discards their entire hand, then draws the same number of cards they discarded.

name: Magna-Slash Dragon
cn_text: 把自己場上存在的1張表側表示的永續魔法卡送去墓地。對方場上的1張魔法或者陷阱卡破壞。
description: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls.

name: Turtle Bird
cn_text: 主要棲息在水中，也能在空中飛翔的珍奇烏龜。
description: An unusual turtle that not only swims at tremendous speed, but can also sail across the skies.

name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把光·暗屬性怪獸各1只除外的場合可以特殊召喚。這張卡的①②的效果1回合只能有1次使用其中任意1個。
①：以場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動（這個效果發動的回合，這張卡不能攻擊）。那只怪獸除外。
②：這張卡的攻擊破壞對方怪獸時才能發動。這張卡只再1次可以繼續攻擊。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.? Target 1 monster on the field; banish that target face-up. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.? If this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: It can make a second attack in a row.

name: Silpheed
cn_text: 這張卡不能進行通常召喚。從自己墓地里除外1只風屬性怪獸進行特殊召喚。這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard. When this card is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard, your opponent discards 1 random card from their hand.

name: Sand Stone
cn_text: 從地下突然出現在眼前，用觸手做攻擊。
description: Appears from underground and attacks with long, snake-like tentacles.

name: Queen Bird
cn_text: 用巨大的嘴啄擊敵人作為攻擊手段。守備力很高。
description: This monster attacks enemies using its huge beak.

name: Raiza the Storm Monarch
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚的場合，以場上1張卡為對象發動。那張卡回到卡組最上面。
description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

name: Final Flame
cn_text: 給與對方基本分600分的傷害。
description: Inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Cross Porter
cn_text:
①：以自己場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只自己怪獸送去墓地，從手卡把1只「新空間俠」怪獸特殊召喚。
②：這張卡被送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只「新空間俠」怪獸加入手卡。
description: You can send 1 monster you control to the Graveyard and Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your hand. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can add 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Worm Drake
cn_text: 被那修長的身體卷住后插翅難逃。
description: Once this monster wraps itself around a victim, there is no escape.

name: Temple of Skulls
cn_text: 全部由骷髏和骨頭建立而成的寺院。會吸收接近的人的靈魂。
description: A mysterious temple of skulls and bones that pulls in unsuspecting enemies.

name: Barrier Statue of the Stormwinds
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不是風屬性怪獸不能特殊召喚。
description: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for WIND monsters.

name: Paladin of White Dragon
cn_text:
「白龍降臨」降臨。
①：這張卡向里側守備表示怪獸攻擊的傷害步驟開始時發動。那只里側守備表示怪獸破壞。
②：把這張卡解放才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「青眼白龍」特殊召喚。這個回合，自己的「青眼白龍」不能攻擊。
description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "White Dragon Ritual". At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or Deck, but "Blue-Eyes White Dragons" cannot attack for the rest of this turn.

name: Dimension Jar
cn_text: 反轉：雙方均可以從對方墓地中選至多3張卡從游戲中除外。
description: FLIP: Both players can remove from play up to 3 monsters from their opponent's Graveyard.

name: Iron Blacksmith Kotetsu
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。從卡組把1張裝備魔法卡加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Destroyer Golem
cn_text: 巨大右臂為特徵的石人，用右臂進行壓迫攻擊。
description: A golem with a massive right hand for crushing its victims.

name: Guardian Baou
cn_text: 當自己場上存在「破邪之大劍-黃昏」時才能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。這張卡每戰斗破壞對方1只怪獸并將其送去墓地，攻擊力上升1000點。被這張卡戰斗破壞的效果怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou". When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: It gains 1000 ATK. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

name: Unleash Your Power!
cn_text: 這張卡的發動時自己場上表側表示存在的全部二重怪獸變成再度召喚的狀態。這個效果適用的怪獸在結束階段時變成里側守備表示。
description: All Gemini Monsters that were on your side of the field when this card was activated are treated as Effect Monsters, and gain their effect(s). During the End Phase of this turn, Set all monsters affected by this card's effect.

name: Pole Position
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的攻擊力最高的怪獸不受魔法的效果影響。場上不存在「杆位」時，場上表側表示存在的攻擊力最高的怪獸破壞。
description: The face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. When "Pole Position" is removed from the field, destroy the face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field.

name: Mechanicalchaser
cn_text: 聽從機械王的命令，在抓住目標前都會緊追不舍的獵捕。
description: A hunter that relentlessly pursues its target by order of the Machine King.

name: Terraforming
cn_text: ①：從卡組把1張場地魔法卡加入手卡。
description: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

name: Sand Moth
cn_text: 里側守備表示的這張卡被戰斗以外的方式破壞送去墓地時，原本的攻擊力·守備力交換并在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: When this face-down Defense Position card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, switch the original ATK and DEF of this card, and Special Summon it.

name: Silent Magician LV4
cn_text:
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次對方抽卡，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物（最多5個）。
②：這張卡的攻擊力上升這張卡的魔力指示物數量×500。
③：這張卡有第5個魔力指示物被放置的下次的自己回合的准備階段，把有5個魔力指示物放置的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「沉默魔朮師 LV8」特殊召喚。
description: Each time your opponent draws a card(s), place 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 5). This card gains 500 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. During the Standby Phase of your next turn after the 5th Spell Counter is placed on this card: You can send this face-up card with 5 Spell Counters on it to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Magician LV8" from your hand or Deck.

name: The Beginning of the End
cn_text: ①：自己墓地有暗屬性怪獸7只以上存在的場合，把那之內的5只除外才能發動。自己從卡組抽3張。
description: If there are 7 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard: Banish 5 DARK monsters from your Graveyard; draw 3 cards.

name: Giant Orc
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示。直到下次的自己回合結束時這張卡的表示形式不能變更。
description: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. You cannot change this battle position until the end of your next turn.

name: Skilled Dark Magician
cn_text:
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物（最多3個）。
②：把有3個魔力指示物放置的這張卡解放才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地選1只「黑魔朮師」特殊召喚。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

name: Eliminating the League
cn_text: ①：從手卡丟棄1張魔法卡，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側表示怪獸破壞。那之后，有對方手卡的場合，把對方手卡確認，破壞的卡的同名卡全部送去墓地。
description: Discard 1 Spell Card. Destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Check your opponent's hand, and all cards in their hand with the same name as the destroyed card are sent to the Graveyard.

name: Armed Dragon LV7
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚，用「武裝龍 LV5」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：從手卡把1只怪獸送去墓地才能發動。持有送去墓地的怪獸的攻擊力以下的攻擊力的對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Armed Dragon LV5", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can send 1 monster from your hand to the Graveyard; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the sent monster's ATK.

name: White-Horned Dragon
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·特殊召喚成功的場合，以對方墓地最多5張魔法卡為對象發動。那些卡除外，這張卡的攻擊力上升那些除外的卡數量×300。
description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Target up to 5 Spell Cards in your opponent's Graveyard; banish those target(s), and if you do, this card gains 300 ATK for each card banished by this effect.

name: Sword Slasher
cn_text: 揮舞?大彎刀的狂暴殺人機器。
description: A lethal engine of destruction that wields two well-honed blades.

name: Scapegoat
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能用這張卡的效果以外把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
①：在自己場上把4只「羊衍生物」（獸族·地·1星·攻/守0）守備表示特殊召喚。這衍生物不能為上級召喚而解放。
description: Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

name: Golden Bamboo Sword
cn_text: ①：自己場上有「竹光」裝備魔法卡存在的場合才能發動。自己從卡組抽2張。
description: Activate only if you control a "Bamboo Sword" Equip Spell Card. Draw 2 cards.

name: Dark World Dealings
cn_text: ①：雙方各自從卡組抽1張。那之后，抽卡的玩家選自身1張手卡丟棄。
description: Each player draws 1 card, then each player discards 1 card.

name: Exiled Force
cn_text: ①：把這張卡解放，以場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: You can Tribute this card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Graceful Dice
cn_text: ①：擲1次骰子。自己場上的怪獸的攻擊力·守備力直到回合結束時上升出現的數目×100。
description: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters you currently control gain ATK and DEF equal to the result x 100, until the End Phase.

name: Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn
cn_text:
①：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害時，可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●從卡組把1張「黑蠍」卡加入手卡。
●以自己墓地1張「黑蠍」卡為對象才能發動。那張卡加入手卡。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:? Add 1 "Dark Scorpion" card from your Deck to your hand.? Target 1 "Dark Scorpion" card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Cyber Twin Dragon
cn_text:
「電子龍」＋「電子龍」
這張卡的融合召喚不用上記的卡不能進行。
①：這張卡在同1次的戰斗階段中可以作2次攻擊。
description: "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Painful Choice
cn_text: 從卡組選擇5張卡給對方看。對方從這些卡中選擇1張。對方選擇的卡加入自己手卡，其他的卡丟棄去墓地。
description: Select 5 cards from your Deck and show them to your opponent. Your opponent selects 1 card among them. Add that card to your hand and discard the remaining cards to the Graveyard.

name: Brave Scizzar
cn_text: 熟練地利用几個夾子切向對方。
description: Armed with a mass of scissors, this monster can clip an enemy into any desired shape and size.

name: Guardian Elma
cn_text: 當自己場上存在「蝶之短劍-回音」時才能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。這張卡召喚·特殊召喚成功時，可以從自己的墓地里選擇1張裝備魔法卡裝備在這張卡身上。
description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Butterfly Dagger - Elma". When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card.

name: Silent Swordsman LV5
cn_text:
①：這張卡不受對方的魔法卡的效果影響。
②：這張卡直接攻擊給與對方戰斗傷害的場合，下次的自己回合的准備階段把場上的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「沉默劍士 LV7」特殊召喚。
description: Unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects. During your next Standby Phase after this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV7" from your hand or Deck.

name: Spell Chronicle
cn_text:
①：把手卡全部送去墓地才能把這張卡發動。從卡組把5張魔法·陷阱卡除外。
②：每次對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個年代記指示物。
③：把這張卡2個年代記指示物取除才能發動。對方從這張卡的效果除外的卡之中選1張。自己把那張卡加入手卡。
④：魔法與陷阱區域的表側表示的這張卡從場上離開時，自己受到這張卡的效果除外中的卡數量×500傷害。
description: Send all cards in your hand to the Graveyard. Select and remove from play 5 Spell or Trap Cards from your Deck. Each time your opponent activates a Spell Card, place 1 Chronicle Counter on this card. You can remove 2 Chronicle Counters from this card to have your opponent select 1 of the cards removed from play with this card's effect, and add it to your hand. When this card is removed from the field, you take 500 damage for each card that is still removed from play due to this card's effect.

name: Covering Fire
cn_text: 對方怪獸攻擊自己場上怪獸的場合，傷害步驟時發動。被攻擊的自己怪獸的攻擊力上升自己場上表側表示存在的另外1只怪獸的攻擊力的數值。
description: During the Damage Step, while an opponent's monster is attacking a monster you control: Target 1 other face-up monster you control; your attacked monster gains ATK equal to that target's ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: Hand Destruction
cn_text: ①：雙方玩家把2張手卡送去墓地。那之后，各自從卡組抽2張。
description: Each player sends 2 cards from their hand to the Graveyard, then draws 2 cards.

name: Zure, Knight of Dark World
cn_name: 暗黑界的騎士 祖爾
cn_text: 暗黑界里其名無人不知的崇高騎士。絕對不會對弱者出手。
description: The name of this illustrious knight is known by all residents of Dark World. He never oppresses the commoners.

name: Mystic Swordsman LV4
cn_text: 當這張卡在通常召喚的場合時，必須里側守備表示出場。攻擊里側守備表示怪獸的場合，不進行戰斗傷害，那只怪獸以里側守備表示的狀態直接破壞。這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的回合的結束階段，可以把這張卡送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「謎之劍士 LV6」
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set). At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV6" from your hand or Deck.

name: Octoberser
cn_text: 魚的頭，章魚的腳，非常不可思議的生物，用槍發動攻擊。
description: With the head of a fish and the legs of an octopus, this strange creature attacks enemies by flinging spears.

name: Red-Eyes B. Dragon
cn_text: 擁有真紅之眼的黑龍。憤怒的黑炎會把映入其眼者全部燒成灰燼。
description: A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.

name: Re-Fusion
cn_text: ①：支付800基本分，以自己墓地1只融合怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚，把這張卡裝備。這張卡破壞時那只怪獸除外。
description: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

name: DNA Surgery
cn_text: 發動時宣言1個種族。只要這張卡在場上存在，場上的全部表側表示的怪獸變成宣言的種族。
description: Activate this card by declaring 1 Monster Type. All face-up monsters on the field become that Type.

name: Punished Eagle
cn_text: 「蒼翼冠鳥」＋「胖雞」
description: "Blue-Winged Crown" + "Niwatori"

name: Inferno
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把1只炎屬性怪獸除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地的場合發動。給與對方1500傷害。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 FIRE monster in your Graveyard. When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict 1500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Sky Scourge Invicil
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。為這張卡的上級召喚而解放的怪獸的種族和屬性讓這張卡得到以下效果。
●天使族·光屬性：只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，場上的魔法卡的效果無效。
●惡魔族·暗屬性：只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，場上的陷阱卡的效果無效。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 of the following monsters, this card gets the appropriate effect:? LIGHT Fairy-Type monster: Negate the effects of all Spell Cards.? DARK Fiend-Type monster: Negate the effects of all Trap Cards.

name: Monster Reincarnation
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以自己墓地1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸加入手卡。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

name: Milus Radiant
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，全部地屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500。風屬性的怪獸攻擊力下降400。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all EARTH monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all WIND monsters by 400 points.

name: Forced Requisition
cn_text: 自己丟棄手卡時才能發動。那之后每次自己的手卡丟棄，對方選擇相同數量的手卡丟棄。
description: You can activate this card when you discard from your hand. After that, each time you discard from your hand, your opponent must also discard the same number of cards from his/her hand.

name: Harpie Queen
cn_text:
①：這張卡的卡名只要在場上·墓地存在當作「鷹身女郎」使用。
②：把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地才能發動。從卡組把1張「鷹身女妖的狩獵場」加入手卡。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Harpies' Hunting Ground" from your Deck to your hand. This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while it is on the field or in the Graveyard.

name: Cobraman Sakuzy
cn_text: 這張卡1回合只有1次可以變成里側守備表示。這張卡反轉時，對方場上蓋放的魔法·陷阱卡全部翻開，確認后回復原狀。
description: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. When this card is flipped face-up, look at all Set Spell and Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field and then return them to their original position.

name: Gather Your Mind
cn_text: 從卡組中選擇1張「精神統一」加入手卡。這張卡1回合只能使用1張。
description: Add 1 "Gather Your Mind" card from your Deck to your hand. Your Deck is then shuffled. You can only use 1 "Gather Your Mind" per turn.

name: Guardian Statue
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合1次可以變成里側守備表示。這張卡反轉召喚成功時，對方場上1只怪獸回到持有者的手卡。
description: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, return 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field to its owner's hand.

name: Golgoil
cn_text: 從與異次元相通的洞里出來的鋼鐵大魔人。
description: An iron giant that appears from a dimensional rift.

name: Moisture Creature
cn_text: 用3只怪獸做這張卡的召喚祭品召喚的場合，對方場上的全部魔法·陷阱破壞。
description: If you Tribute Summon this monster by Tributing 3 monsters on the field, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior
cn_name: 磁石戰士 電磁武神
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己的手卡·場上把「磁石戰士α」「磁石戰士β」「磁石戰士γ」各1只解放的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：把這張卡解放，以自己墓地的「磁石戰士α」「磁石戰士β」「磁石戰士γ」各1只為對象才能發動。那些怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" from your hand and/or field. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" in your Graveyard; Special Summon them.

name: Petit Dragon
cn_text: 非常小的龍，充分用盡那弱小的身體進行攻擊。
description: A very small dragon known for its vicious attacks.

name: Total Defense Shogun
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚成功的場合守備表示。這張卡可以在守備表示時攻擊。守備表示攻擊時用攻擊力的數值計算傷害。
description: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned successfully. This card can attack while it is in Defense Position. If this card attacks while in Defense Position, apply the ATK of this card for damage calculation.

name: Pandemonium Watchbear
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，自己場上的「萬魔殿-惡魔的巢窟-」不會被對方所控制的卡的效果所破壞。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, "Pandemonium" on your side of the field is not destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

name: Enchanting Mermaid
cn_text: 誘惑在海上航行的人們并將他們淹死的美人魚。
description: A beautiful mermaid that lures voyagers to a watery grave.

name: Megazowler
cn_text: 全身長滿角的恐龍。突擊攻擊很強烈！
description: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur!

name: Mind Haxorz
cn_text: 支付500基本分。對方的手卡和對方場上蓋放的卡全部確認。
description: Pay 500 Life Points. Look at your opponent's hand and all Set cards on their side of the field.

name: Release Restraint
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只「鐵騎士 基亞·弗里德」解放才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「劍聖-赤膊的基亞·弗里德」特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 1 "Gearfried the Iron Knight"; Special Summon 1 "Gearfried the Swordmaster" from your hand or Deck.

name: Mid Shield Gardna
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合1次可以變成里側守備表示。以里側表示的這只怪獸為對象的魔法卡的發動無效。那個時候，這張卡變成表側守備表示。
description: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. Negate the activation of a Spell Card that targets this 1 face-down monster. At that time, flip this card into face-up Defense Position.

name: Master & Expert
cn_text: 怪獸使高手、忠心於主人的怪獸。組合起來相當完美。
description: A deadly duo consisting of a beast master and its loyal servant.

name: Gold Sarcophagus
cn_text: ①：從卡組選1張卡除外。這張卡的發動后第2次的自己准備階段，這個效果除外的卡加入手卡。
description: Banish 1 card from your Deck, face-up. During your second Standby Phase after this card's activation, add that card to your hand.

name: Cyber Soldier of Darkworld
cn_text: 暗之力制造的機器士兵，瘋狂的將敵人破壞。
description: A mechanical soldier that won't stop attacking until all life readings have been extinguished from its sensors.

name: Flint
cn_text: 這張卡裝備的怪獸，不能改變表示形式和攻擊宣言，攻擊力下降300。裝備怪獸破壞的場合，選擇場上1只怪獸，把這張卡裝備在那只怪獸上。
description: A monster equipped with this card loses 300 ATK and cannot change its Battle Position or attack. If the equipped monster is destroyed, select 1 monster on the field and equip this card to that monster.

name: Faith Bird
cn_text: 尾巴非常長的鳥，全身散發出神聖的光芒。
description: This long-tailed bird blinds its enemies with mystical light.

name: Tricky Spell 4
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只表側表示的「詭朮師」送去墓地才能發動。對方場上的怪獸數量的「詭朮師衍生物」（魔法師族·風·5星·攻2000/守1200）在自己場上守備表示特殊召喚。這衍生物不能攻擊宣言。
description: Send 1 face-up "The Tricky" you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon "Tricky Tokens" (Spellcaster-Type/WIND/Level 5/ATK 2000/DEF 1200) in Defense Position, equal to the number of monsters your opponent controls. "Tricky Tokens" cannot declare an attack.

name: Megasonic Eye
cn_text: 來自宇宙盡頭的殺人機器。用不明金屬制作。
description: Made of mysterious metal, this monster is a doomsday machine from the edge of the universe.

name: Synchar
cn_text: 上下都有頭的令人作嘔的怪獸。從口中吐出激光。
description: This two-headed creature spits laser blasts at its enemies.

name: Collected Power
cn_text: 選擇場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸發動。場上存在的全部裝備卡給選擇的怪獸裝備。對象不正確的裝備卡破壞。
description: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip it with all Equip Cards on the field. If any of those Equip Cards is now equipped to an incorrect target, destroy that Equip Card.

name: Doron
cn_text: 分身夾擊的怪獸，要小心！
description: This monster splits in two and attacks from opposite sides.

name: D.D. Warrior Lady
cn_text: ①：這張卡和對方怪獸進行戰斗的傷害計算后才能發動。那些進行戰斗的各自怪獸除外。
description: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

name: Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。召喚·反轉的回合的結束階段時回到持有者手卡。此外，這張卡給與對方玩家戰斗傷害時發動。下個回合的抽卡階段的抽卡前對方把全部手卡丟棄。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, they discard all cards in their hand during the next Draw Phase, before they draw.

name: Harpies' Hunting Ground
cn_text:
①：場上的鳥獸族怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升200。
②：自己或對方把「鷹身女郎」或「鷹身女郎三姐妹」召喚·特殊召喚的場合，那玩家以場上1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象發動。那張卡破壞。
description: All Winged Beast-Type monsters gain 200 ATK and DEF. When any "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" are Normal or Special Summoned: The player who conducted the Summon targets 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，控制權不會被變更。這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的回合的結束階段時，可以把這張卡送去墓地，從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「荷魯斯之黑炎龍 LV6」。
description: Control of this face-up card cannot switch. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.

name: LaMoon
cn_text: 住在月亮上的魔法師。用月之魔力迷惑對方。
description: A sorcerer that draws its power from the lunar landscape.

name: Archfiend Marmot of Nefariousness
cn_text: 擁有惡魔角與翅膀的海狸。投擲橡實果進行攻擊。
description: An air marmot that has a nefarious horn and wings. It attacks by throwing acorns.

name: Super Robolady
cn_text:
「稀有金屬女郎」＋「稀有金屬戰士」
這張卡在給對方直接攻擊的傷害計算時攻擊力上升1000，上場上的這張卡可以和融合區的「稀有金屬騎士」互換（這張卡特殊召喚的回合不可以互換。）
description: "Robolady" + "Roboyarou"You can Special Summon "Super Roboyarou" by returning this card from the field to the Extra Deck. You cannot use this effect during the same turn this monster is Special Summoned. In addition, increase the ATK of this monster by 1000 points during the Damage Step when this monster inflicts Direct Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Hiita the Fire Charmer
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1只炎屬性怪獸為對象發動。這只怪獸表側表示存在期間，得到作為對象的怪獸的控制權。
description: FLIP: Target 1 face-up FIRE monster your opponent controls; take control of that target while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Witch Doctor of Chaos
cn_text: 反轉：從自己或對方的墓地里選擇1張怪獸卡，將被選擇的卡從游戲中除外。
description: FLIP: Select 1 Monster Card from you or your opponent's Graveyard. Remove it from play.

name: Warrior Dai Grepher
cn_text: 隱藏?操縱龍族才能的戰士。其過去被迷所包圍?。
description: The warrior who can manipulate dragons. Nobody knows his mysterious past.

name: Helpoemer
cn_text:
這張卡不能作從墓地的特殊召喚。
①：被戰斗破壞的這張卡在墓地存在的場合，對方戰斗階段結束時發動。這張卡在墓地存在的場合，對方手卡隨機選1張丟棄。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. If this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, this effect activates at the end of each of your opponent's Battle Phases: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand. This card must be in the Graveyard to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Throwstone Unit
cn_text: 自己的場上的1只戰士族怪獸做祭品。持有這張卡的攻擊力以下的守備力的表側表示的1只怪獸破壞。
description: Tribute 1 Warrior-Type monster on your side of the field to destroy 1 face-up monster on the field whose DEF is equal to or less than the ATK of this card.

name: Sparks
cn_text: 給與對方基本分200分傷害。
description: Inflict 200 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Spell Reclamation
cn_text: 自己把魔法卡發動時，丟棄1張手卡連鎖發動。連鎖發動的魔法卡被送去墓地時，那張卡回到手卡。
description: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Spell Card you activated. Whenever that Spell Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

name: Hitotsu-Me Giant
cn_text: 一只眼的巨人。會用粗壯的雙臂攻過來。必須注意。
description: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

name: Golden Flying Fish
cn_text: 把自己場上存在的這張卡以外的1只魚族怪獸解放發動。場上1張卡破壞。
description: You can Tribute 1 other Fish-Type monster, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Meda Bat
cn_text: 惡人創造的眼珠惡魔。用黑暗炸彈進行爆破攻擊。
description: An eyeball fiend created by a servant of the wicked, it uses "Dark Blasts" to blow away its enemies.

name: Sengenjin
cn_text: 無論何時都靠力量硬干到底，擁有千年寶物的原始人。
description: An unstoppable savage that carries Millennium Items.

name: Raregold Armor
cn_text: 只要控制裝備這張卡的怪獸，對方不能攻擊裝備怪獸以外的怪獸。
description: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot attack other monsters other than the equipped monster.

name: Soul Demolition
cn_text: 支付500分，互相選擇對方墓地的1張怪獸卡。選擇的卡從游戲中除外。這個效果在自己的場上有惡魔族存在的場合才能發動。
description: You can only activate this card's effect when you have a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field. Pay 500 Life Points to use this effect. Both players select 1 Monster Card from their opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected cards from play.

name: The Rock Spirit
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。自己墓地1只地屬性怪獸從游戲中除外特殊召喚上場。這只怪獸在對方的戰斗階段攻擊力上升300。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 EARTH monster in your Graveyard. Increase the ATK of this monster by 300 points during your opponent's Battle Phase.

name: Mine Golem
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，給與對方基本分500分傷害。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Power Wall
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊要讓自己受到戰斗傷害的傷害計算時才能發動。直到那次戰斗發生的對自己的戰斗傷害變成0為止，作為受到的傷害的代替而把每500傷害1張卡從自己卡組上面送去墓地。
description: During damage calculation, when you would take battle damage from an opponent's attacking monster: Send 1 card from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard for every 500 damage (round up) you are about to take, also you take no battle damage from that battle.

name: Disk Magician
cn_text: 將自己封印在鐵槃里，攻擊時才露出本體。
description: This monster hides in a saucer and only appears when executing an attack.

name: Krokodilus
cn_text: 有智慧而且狂暴化的鱷魚。以堅硬的鱗片反彈對方的攻擊。
description: A vicious crocodile with great intelligence.

name: Xing Zhen Hu
cn_text: 選擇場上蓋放的2張魔法·陷阱卡才能發動。只要這張卡在場上存在，選擇的魔法·陷阱卡不能發動。
description: Activate by selecting 2 Set Spell or Trap Cards on the field. The selected Spell or Trap Cards cannot be activated.

name: Infinity Dark
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當成通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡變成當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡的攻擊宣言時，可以把對方場上存在的1只表側表示怪獸的表示形式改變。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? When this card declares an attack, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.

name: Bottomless Shifting Sand
cn_text: 對方的回合結束時，全場的最高攻擊力的表側表示的怪獸破壞。自己的准備階段時，自己的手卡4張以下的場合，這張卡破壞。
description: At the end of your opponent's turn, destroy the face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field. During your own Standby Phase, if you have 4 or less cards in your hand, this card is destroyed.

name: Poison Fangs
cn_text: 獸族怪獸每次給與對方戰斗傷害時，給與對方基本分500分的傷害。
description: Each time a Beast-Type monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Kairyu-Shin
cn_text: 被稱為海洋之主的海龍。掀起海嘯吞噬一切。
description: A sea dragon known as the King of the Ocean, it attacks its enemies with huge tidal waves.

name: Yamatano Dragon Scroll
cn_text: 畫卷上的龍實體化后進行攻擊。守備力很低。
description: A dragon conjured from the very scroll in which it was depicted.

name: Bio Plant
cn_text: 地下研究所的試驗大失敗所產生的怪獸。
description: A monster created from a major accident in an underground lab.

name: Spell of Pain
cn_text: ①：給與自己傷害的效果由對方發動時才能發動。那個效果發生的對自己的效果傷害由對方代受。
description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that would inflict effect damage to you: Your opponent takes the effect damage from that card or effect, instead.

name: Shien's Spy
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸發動。直到這個回合的結束階段時，選擇的卡的控制權移給對方。
description: Select 1 face-up monster you control to activate this card. Give control of the selected monster to your opponent until the End Phase of this turn.

name: Pyramid Energy
cn_text:
選擇下面的1個效果發動。
●自己的場上全部表側表示存在的怪獸直到回合結束前攻擊力上升200。
●自己的場上全部表側表示存在的怪獸直到回合結束前守備力上升500。
description: You can select and activate 1 of the following effects:? Increase the ATK of all face-up monsters on your side of the field by 200 points until the End Phase of the turn this card is activated.? Increase the DEF of all face-up monsters on your side of the field by 500 points until the End Phase of the turn this card is activated.

name: Cyber Gymnast
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1只表側攻擊表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側攻擊表示怪獸破壞。
description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Patrol Robo
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，自己的准備階段可以把對方場上蓋放的1張卡確認。
description: During your Standby Phase, you can look at 1 face-down card that's been Set by your opponent as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

name: Black Magic Ritual
cn_text: 「黑混沌之魔朮師」的降臨必需。必須從自己的手卡·場上把等級合計直到8以上的怪獸解放。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Magician of Black Chaos". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Turtle Oath
cn_text: 「蟹龜」的降臨必需。若不從場地和手卡把等級直到8以上的卡作為祭品，則「蟹龜」不能降臨。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Crab Turtle". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 8 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: Harpie Lady
cn_text: 人長出羽毛的魔獸，表演華麗的舞蹈進行快攻。
description: This human-shaped animal with wings is beautiful to watch but deadly in battle.

name: Non Aggression Area
cn_text: 在自己的准備階段才能發動。丟棄1張手卡。在下一個對方的回合中，對方不能進行通常召喚和特殊召喚。
description: You can only activate this card during your Standby Phase. Discard 1 card from your hand. Your opponent cannot Normal Summon, Set and/or Special Summon during his/her next turn.

name: Yamata Dragon
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的場合發動。自己直到手卡變成5張為止從卡組抽卡。
②：這張卡召喚·反轉的回合的結束階段發動。這張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

name: Dangerous Machine Type-6
cn_text:
每次自己的准備階段丟1個骰子，根據丟出的數目決定效果。
●投擲1的場合：自己丟棄1張手卡。
●投擲2的場合：對方丟棄1張手卡。
●投擲3的場合：自己抽1張卡。
●投擲4的場合：對方抽1張卡。
●投擲5的場合：對方的場上1只怪獸破壞。
●投擲6的場合：這張卡破壞。
description: During each of your Standby Phases: Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.? 1: Discard 1 card.? 2: Your opponent discards 1 card.? 3: Draw 1 card.? 4: Your opponent draws 1 card.? 5: Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.? 6: Destroy this card.

name: Enraged Battle Ox
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，自己的獸族·獸戰士族·鳥獸族怪獸向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: If a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Don Zaloog
cn_text:
這張卡給與對方玩家戰斗傷害時，可以選擇下面1個效果發動：
●對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
●對方的卡組最上面的2張卡送去墓地。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:? Discard 1 random card from their hand.? Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Darknight Parshath
cn_name: 暗黑騎士 珀耳修斯
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，可以把自己墓地存在的1只暗屬性怪獸從游戲中除外，從自己卡組抽1張卡。這張卡的攻擊力上升自己墓地存在的暗屬性怪獸數量×100的數值。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can banish 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard; draw 1 card. This card gains 100 ATK for each DARK monster in your Graveyard.

name: Cyber Kirin
cn_text: 把這張卡做祭品。直到這個回合的結束階段，這張卡的控制者受到的因效果造成的傷害變成0。
description: You can Tribute this card to make any effect damage you take this turn 0.

name: Laser Cannon Armor
cn_text: 昆蟲族怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: An Insect-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Power of Kaishin
cn_text: 水族才能裝備。1只裝備怪獸的攻擊力和守備力上升300。
description: An Aqua-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Pyramid Turtle
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只守備力2000以下的不死族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

name: Inaba White Rabbit
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。召喚·反轉的回合的結束階段時回到主人的手卡。對方場上存在怪獸也只能直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. This monster attacks your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Manticore of Darkness
cn_text: 這張卡被送去墓地的回合的結束階段時，從自己的手卡·場上把1只獸族·獸戰士族·鳥獸族怪獸送去墓地才能發動。這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。
description: During the End Phase of the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can send to the Graveyard 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster from your hand or your side of the field; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard.

name: Berfomet
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚時才能發動。從卡組把1只「幻獸王 加澤爾」加入手卡。
description: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 "Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Chainsaw Insect
cn_text: 這張卡進行戰斗的場合，傷害步驟結束時對方玩家抽1張卡。
description: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: Your opponent draws 1 card.

name: Sasuke Samurai #3
cn_text: 這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害時，對方玩家將手卡抽到7張為止。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent draws cards until his/her hand has 7 cards.

name: Magic Jammer
cn_text: ①：魔法卡發動時，丟棄1張手卡才能發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
description: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Fortress Whale's Oath
cn_text: 「要塞鯨」的降臨必要。必須從場上或者手札，犧牲奉獻等級合計為7個以上的卡。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Fortress Whale". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Fiend Kraken
cn_text: 潛在海里的巨大章魚。從海中突然出現并攻擊。
description: A giant squid that drags its enemies to a watery grave.

name: Gale Lizard
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象發動。那只對方怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent's controls; return that target to the hand.

name: Soul of Purity and Light
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把2只光屬性怪獸除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方場上的怪獸的攻擊力在對方戰斗階段內下降300。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Normal Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 2 LIGHT monsters in your Graveyard. All monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK during their Battle Phase only.

name: Dark Bribe
cn_text: ①：對方把魔法·陷阱卡發動時才能發動。那個發動無效并破壞。對方抽1張。
description: When an opponent's Spell/Trap Card is activated: Your opponent draws 1 card, also negate the Spell/Trap activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Disturbance Strategy
cn_text: 對方將手卡加入卡組，再從卡組抽出與原本手卡數一樣數目的卡。
description: Your opponent shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards.

name: Future Fusion
cn_text:
①：這張卡的發動后第1次的自己准備階段發動。額外卡組1只融合怪獸給對方觀看，那只怪獸決定的融合素材怪獸從卡組送去墓地。
②：這張卡的發動后第2次的自己准備階段發動。把1只和這張卡的①的效果給人觀看的怪獸同名的融合怪獸融合召喚。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: During your 1st Standby Phase after this card's activation: Show 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck and send the Fusion Materials listed on it from your Main Deck to the GY. During your 2nd Standby Phase after this card's activation: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same name as the monster you showed, and target it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Acid Crawler
cn_text: 巨大的青蟲。吐出濃烈的酸液、可以溶解任何東西。
description: A giant caterpillar that secretes an acid mist that melts anything.

name: Masked Clown
cn_text: 一邊跳?死亡的舞蹈、一邊用手上的鐮刀切碎敵人的戰士。
description: This warrior's fatal dance is performed with a lethal sickle.

name: Jinzo
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不能把場上的陷阱卡的效果發動，場上的陷阱卡的效果無效化。
description: Trap Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Trap effects on the field.

name: Phantom Dewan
cn_text: 詛咒敵人。可以使人動彈不得的魔法師。
description: A sorcerer that can paralyze an enemy with a single curse.

name: Reverse Trap
cn_text: 直到發動回合的結束階段時，攻擊力·守備力的上升·下降的效果變成相反。
description: Until the End Phase, all effects that add or subtract ATK or DEF are reversed. (Additions now subtract, and subtractions now add, instead. Multiplications and divisions, including halving/doubling, are not affected.)

name: Widespread Ruin
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。對方場上的表側攻擊表示怪獸之內攻擊力最高的1只怪獸破壞。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy the Attack Position monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied).

name: Hysteric Party
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡才能把這張卡發動。從自己墓地把「鷹身女郎」盡可能特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Activate this card by discarding 1 card; Special Summon as many copies of "Harpie Lady" as possible from your Graveyard. When this face-up card leaves the field, destroy those monsters.

name: Trial of Nightmare
cn_text: 將敵人封入棺材里。然后由地獄使者下達判決。
description: This fiend passes judgment on enemies that are locked in coffins.

name: Secret Pass to the Treasures
cn_text: 選擇自己場上的1只表側表示存在的攻擊力1000以下的怪獸。這個回合，選擇的怪獸可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: Select 1 face-up monster with an ATK equal to 1000 points or less on your side of the field. During the turn this card is activated, the selected monster can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Fatal Abacus
cn_text: 每次怪獸從場上送去墓地，每1張卡使那張卡的主人受到500分的傷害。
description: Each time 1 monster is sent from the field to the Graveyard, inflict 500 points of damage per card to the respective card owner's Life Points.

name: Gernia
cn_text: ①：場上的表側表示的這張卡被對方的效果破壞送去墓地的場合，下次的自己准備階段發動。這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。
description: During your next Standby Phase, after this face-up card you control was destroyed and sent to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon it.

name: Crow Goblin
cn_text: 知道各種事的天狗。據說能使用神通之力。
description: A clever long-nosed goblin, he is a force to be reckoned with.

name: Witch of the Black Forest
cn_text:
這個卡名的效果1回合只能使用1次。
①：這張卡從場上送去墓地的場合發動。從卡組把1只守備力1500以下的怪獸加入手卡。這個回合，自己不能把這個效果加入手卡的卡以及那些同名卡的效果發動。
description: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add 1 monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand, but you cannot activate cards, or the effects of cards, with that name for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Witch of the Black Forest" once per turn.

name: Magical Plant Mandragola
cn_text: 反轉：給場上表側表示存在的可以放置魔力指示物的卡全部放置1個魔力指示物。
description: FLIP: Place 1 Spell Counter on each face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on.

name: Niwatori
cn_text: 把敵人整個吞下，并消化作為能量來補充自己。
description: Swallows enemies whole and uses their essence as energy.

name: Dark Designator
cn_text: 宣言1種怪獸卡的名字。當這種怪獸卡在對方的卡組中存在時，那種卡其中1張加入對方手卡。
description: Declare 1 Monster Card name. If the declared card is in your opponent's Deck, add 1 of that card to your opponent's hand.

name: Terrorking Salmon
cn_text: 作為暗黑海之主令人恐懼的巨大鮭魚。它的卵作為暗黑界第一美味而聞名。
description: A feared salmon, master of the Sea of Darkness. Its roe is the best delicacy in the World of Darkness.

name: Alchemist of Black Spells
cn_text: 1回合1次，可以把自己場上表側攻擊表示存在的這張卡變更為表側守備表示，并給自己場上表側表示存在的1張可以放置魔力指示物的卡放置1個魔力指示物。
description: Once per turn, you can change this face-up Attack Position card you control to face-up Defense Position and place 1 Spell Counter on a face-up card you control that you can place a Spell Counter on.

name: Buster Blader
cn_name: 龍破壞劍士-巴斯達 布雷達
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力上升對方的場上·墓地的龍族怪獸數量×500。
description: This card gains 500 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster your opponent controls or is in their Graveyard.

name: Rising Energy
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升1500。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target gains 1500 ATK until the End Phase.

name: The Thing in the Crater
cn_text: 當這張卡從場上被破壞送去墓地時，可以從手卡特殊召喚1只炎族怪獸上場。
description: When this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Pyro-Type Monster from your hand.

name: Giant Axe Mummy
cn_text: 這張卡1個回合可以有1次變回里側守備表示。里側守備表示的這張卡受到攻擊，攻擊的怪獸的攻擊力比這張卡的守備力低的場合，攻擊的怪獸破壞。
description: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. If the ATK of a monster on your opponent's side of the field that attacks this card in face-down Defense Position is lower than the DEF of this monster, the attacking monster is destroyed.

name: Night Lizard
cn_text: 守護?大會、被綠色的鱗片包住身體的蜥蜴戰士。
