description: A lizard warrior protected by a hide of very tough emerald scales.

name: Three-Headed Geedo
cn_text: 有三個頭的怪獸，性格非常凶暴。
description: A three-headed nocturnal monster that is absolutely ruthless when fighting.

name: Vishwar Randi
cn_text: 侍奉黑暗的女戰士。將對方進行血祭是她生存的意義。
description: This lady warrior with unquenchable bloodlust serves the forces of darkness.

name: Garma Sword Oath
cn_text:
「伽瑪劍」的降臨必需。
①：從自己的手卡·場上把等級合計直到7以上的怪獸解放，從手卡把1只「伽瑪劍」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Garma Sword". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Des Kangaroo
cn_text: ①：向守備表示的這張卡進行攻擊的怪獸的攻擊力比這張卡的守備力低的場合，那次傷害步驟結束時發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: If the ATK of a monster that attacks this monster is lower than the DEF of this card, destroy the attacking monster. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

name: Slate Warrior
cn_text:
①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升500。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞的場合發動。讓把這張卡破壞的怪獸的攻擊力·守備力下降500。
description: FLIP: This card gains 500 ATK and DEF.If this card is destroyed by battle: The monster that destroyed it loses 500 ATK and DEF.

name: Beast King Barbaros
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以不用解放作通常召喚。
②：這張卡的①的方法通常召喚的這張卡的原本攻擊力變成1900。
③：這張卡也能把3只怪獸解放作召喚。
④：這張卡用這張卡的③的方法召喚成功的場合發動。對方場上的卡全部破壞。
description: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1900. You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

name: Goblin Attack Force
cn_text: ①：這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示，直到下次的自己回合的結束時不能把表示形式變更。
description: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the End Phase of your next turn.

name: The Third Sarcophagus
cn_text: 這張卡只能通過「第一之棺」的效果上場。
description: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".

name: Doomcaliber Knight
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：怪獸的效果發動時，把這張卡解放發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. During either player's turn, if a monster effect is activated: Tribute this face-up card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

name: Fiber Jar
cn_text: 反轉：雙方把自己場上的卡，手卡，墓地的卡和卡組合在一起洗切。之后各自從卡組抽5張卡。
description: FLIP: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand, field, and Graveyard into the Deck, then draws 5 cards.

name: Trent
cn_text: 還在逐漸成長的大樹，是森林的守護神。
description: A guardian of the woods, this massive tree is believed to be immortal.

name: Barrel Behind the Door
cn_text: 給與戰斗傷害以外的傷害的效果發動時才能發動這張卡。將自己所受的傷害轉給對方。
description: Activate only when a card's effect that would inflict damage to you is activated. Your opponent takes the damage instead.

name: Symbols of Duty
cn_text: 把自己場上1只通常怪獸送去墓地，選擇自己或者對方的墓地1只怪獸才能發動。選擇的怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚，把這張卡裝備。這張卡從場上離開時，裝備怪獸破壞。
description: Send 1 Normal Monster you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon it, and if you do, equip this card to it. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Darkfire Soldier #2
cn_text: 傳說不幸的劍豪跌入了火山，從此便擁有了散發出火焰的能力。
description: A warrior who gained immeasurable power from the heart of a volcano.

name: Soul Reversal
cn_text: 將自己墓地里的1張反轉效果怪獸卡彈回卡組最上面。
description: Return 1 Flip Effect Monster from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

name: Psychic Kappa
cn_text: 能使用多種超能力避開攻擊的河童。
description: An amphibian with a myriad of powers to shield it from enemy attacks.

name: Twin-Headed Fire Dragon
cn_text: 宇宙形成時所誕生的龍，那股沖擊力使雙胞胎龍合體。
description: Two dragons fused as one from the effects of the Big Bang.

name: Order to Charge
cn_text: ①：以衍生物以外的自己場上1只通常怪獸為對象才能發動。那只通常怪獸解放，選對方場上1只怪獸破壞。
description: Select 1 face-up Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field when you activate this card. When this card resolves, Tribute the selected Normal Monster and destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One
cn_text: 被封印的左腕。假若解開封印，能得無限之力。
description: A forbidden left arm sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

name: Morphing Jar #2
cn_text: 反轉：場上的怪獸全部加入持有者卡組洗切。那之后，雙方玩家直到和加入各自卡組的數量相同數量的怪獸出現為止把卡組翻開，從那之中把4星以下的怪獸全部里側守備表示特殊召喚。那以外的翻開的卡全部丟棄去墓地。
description: FLIP: Shuffle all monsters on the field into the Deck. Then, each player excavates cards from the top of their Deck, until they excavate the same number of monsters they shuffled into their Main Deck. Special Summon all excavated Level 4 or lower monsters in face-down Defense Position, also send the remaining cards to the Graveyard.

name: King of the Swamp
cn_text:
①：融合怪獸融合召喚的場合，手卡·場上·墓地的這張卡可以作為那只融合怪獸有卡名記述的1只融合素材怪獸代用（其他的融合素材不能代用）。
②：把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地才能發動。從卡組把1張「融合」加入手卡。
description: This card can be used as a substitute for any 1 Fusion Material whose name is specifically listed on the Fusion Monster Card, but the other Fusion Material(s) must be correct. You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Mad Dog of Darkness
cn_text: 原本曾經是在公園玩耍的普通狗類，但是由於黑暗的力量而凶暴化了。
description: He used to be a normal dog who played around in a park, but was corrupted by the powers of darkness.

name: Chain Energy
cn_text: 雙方玩家若不支付500基本分，則不能從手卡把卡召喚·特殊召喚·發動·蓋放。
description: Each player must pay 500 Life Points per card to Normal Summon, Special Summon, Set or activate cards from his/her respective hand.

name: Spiritual Wind Art - Miyabi
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只風屬性怪獸解放，以對方場上1張卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的卡回到持有者卡組最下面。
description: Tribute 1 WIND monster, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place that card on the bottom of the Deck.

name: Ojama Black
cn_text: 據說能使盡一切手段去搗亂的擾亂三人組一員。據說若三人到齊了將會有什么事情發生。
description: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

name: Black Stego
cn_text: 這張卡被選擇作為對方怪獸的攻擊對象時，這張卡變成守備表示。
description: If this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Change this card to Defense Position.

name: White Night Dragon
cn_text:
①：這張卡為對象的魔法·陷阱卡發動時發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
②：這張卡以外的自己的表側表示怪獸被選擇作為攻擊對象時，把自己場上1張魔法·陷阱卡送去墓地才能發動。攻擊對象轉移為這張卡。
description: During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card that targets this card is activated: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. When another face-up monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can send 1 Spell/Trap Card you control to the Graveyard; change the attack target to this card.

name: Seismic Shockwave
cn_text: 自己場上存在的恐龍族怪獸被破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從對方場上的魔法與陷阱卡區域指定3處。指定的魔法·陷阱卡區域不能使用。這個時候有卡存在的地方不能指定。這張卡發動后第3次的自己准備階段時破壞。因這個效果破壞的場合，可以使自己墓地的1只恐龍族怪獸回到手卡。
description: Destroy this card during your 3rd Standby Phase after activation. Activate this card when a face-up Dinosaur-Type monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): Choose 3 of your opponent's unused Spell & Trap Zones. Those Zones cannot be used. If this card destroys itself: You can target 1 Dinosaur-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Graceful Charity
cn_text: 從卡組抽3張卡，之后從手卡選2張丟棄。
description: Draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards.

name: Injection Fairy Lily
cn_text: ①：這張卡進行戰斗的傷害計算時1次，支付2000基本分才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力只在那次傷害計算時上升3000。
description: If this card attacks or is attacked, during damage calculation (in either player's turn): You can pay 2000 LP once per battle; this card gains 3000 ATK during that damage calculation only.

name: Maiden of the Moonlight
cn_text: 月亮加護的魔導士。神秘的魔法能使人看到幻覺。
description: A sorcerer blessed by lunar light with powers far beyond mortal comprehension.

name: Tribute to The Doomed
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸破壞。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

name: Summoner's Art
cn_text: ①：從卡組把1只5星以上的通常怪獸加入手卡。
description: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Zoma the Spirit
cn_text:
①：這張卡發動后變成效果怪獸（不死族·暗·4星·攻1800/守500）在怪獸區域守備表示特殊召喚。這張卡也當作陷阱卡使用。
②：這張卡的效果特殊召喚的這張卡被戰斗破壞的場合發動。給與對方讓這張卡破壞的怪獸的攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Zombie-Type/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 500). (This card is also still a Trap Card.) If this card is destroyed by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster that destroyed it.

name: Cipher Soldier
cn_text: 這張卡和戰士族怪獸進行戰斗的傷害計算時發動。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力只在那次傷害計算時上升2000。
description: If this card battles a Warrior-Type monster, during damage calculation: This card gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only.

name: Mad Sword Beast
cn_text: 攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，這張卡的攻擊力超過守備表示怪獸的守備力，對方受到這個超過的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Doble Passe
cn_text: ①：對方怪獸向自己場上的表側攻擊表示怪獸攻擊宣言時才能發動。給與對方為攻擊對象怪獸的攻擊力數值的傷害，那只對方怪獸的攻擊變成向自己的直接攻擊。那只自己怪獸在下次的自己回合可以直接攻擊。
description: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a face-up Attack Position monster you control: Make your opponent's attack a direct attack instead and inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the attack target you control. Also, that monster you control can attack your opponent directly during your next turn.

name: Dark Balter the Terrible
cn_text:
「憑依的血魂」＋「邊境的大賢者」
融合召喚這只怪獸，必須用上面所寫的卡融合召喚。通常魔法發動時支付1000分，那個通常魔法的效果無效化。這張卡戰斗破壞的效果怪獸的效果無效化。
description: "Possessed Dark Soul" + "Frontier Wiseman"A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When a Normal Spell Card is activated, negate the effect by paying 1000 Life Points. The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated.

name: Hunter Spider
cn_text: 布置蜘蛛網狩獵，落入網中的東西將被吃掉。
description: This monster feeds on whatever it catches in its web.

name: Mystik Wok
cn_text: 把自己場上1只怪獸作為祭品。選擇祭品怪獸的攻擊力或守備力，自己基本分回復那個數值。
description: Tribute 1 monster. Select either its ATK or DEF and gain that many Life Points.

name: Burst Breath
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只龍族怪獸解放才能發動。持有解放的怪獸的攻擊力以下的守備力的場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster; destroy all face-up monsters on the field whose DEF is less than or equal to the ATK the Tributed monster had on the field.

name: Destroyersaurus
cn_text: 把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地。從卡組把1張「侏羅紀世界」加入手卡。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Jurassic World" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Gora Turtle
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，攻擊力1900以上的怪獸不能進行攻擊宣言。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, monsters with an ATK equal to 1900 or more cannot declare an attack.

name: Prisman
cn_text: 晶瑩剔透的水晶凝固體。收集光線而射出激光。
description: This crystalline monster focuses light to create a lethal laser.

name: Magician's Valkyria
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方怪獸不能選擇其他的魔法師族怪獸作為攻擊對象。
description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target face-up Spellcaster-Type monsters for attacks, except this one.

name: Cyber Harpie Lady
cn_name: 鷹身女郎 電子緊身裝束
cn_text: 這個卡名在規則上當作「鷹身女郎」使用。
description: (This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)

name: Magical Marionette
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物。這張卡放置的魔力指示物每有1個，這張卡的攻擊力上升200。此外，可以把這張卡放置的2個魔力指示物取除，場上存在的1只怪獸破壞。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. This card gains 200 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 2 Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Keldo
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，從對方墓地里選擇2張卡回到對方卡組。
description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, select 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard, add them to your opponent's Deck and the Deck is then shuffled.

name: Rare Fish
cn_text: 「融合體」＋「恍惚的人魚」
description: "Fusionist" + "Enchanting Mermaid"

name: Miraculous Descent
cn_text: ①：以除外的1只自己的天使族怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: Select 1 of your Fairy-Type monsters that is removed from play and Special Summon it. When this card is removed from the field, destroy that monster. When the monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Binding Chain
cn_text: 咯吱咯吱的勒住對方、擁有封印的力量。
description: The mystic links of this chain can rob enemies of their power.

name: Kageningen
cn_text: 用實體和影子襲擊對方。疏忽的話就會受到夾擊的哦。
description: He yoozes both a physical and a shadow form ta attack. So he's a tough monstah ta beat!

name: Ultimate Offering
cn_text: 可以支付500基本分，把1只怪獸通常召喚。這個效果在自己回合的主要階段及對方回合的戰斗階段才能發動。
description: During your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: You can pay 500 Life Points; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster.

name: Giant Trap Hole
cn_text: 同時有2只以上的怪獸特殊召喚成功時才能發動。場上存在的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When 2 or more monsters are Special Summoned at the same time: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Man-eating Black Shark
cn_text: 「深海切割手」＋「殺人污泥」＋「海原的女戰士」
description: "Sea Kamen" + "Gruesome Goo" + "Amazon of the Seas"

name: Witch's Apprentice
cn_text: ①：場上的暗屬性怪獸的攻擊力上升500，光屬性怪獸的攻擊力下降400。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all DARK monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all LIGHT monsters by 400 points.

name: Spirit of the Harp
cn_text: 在天界彈奏豎琴的精靈。那音色使周圍聽眾的心變得平靜。
description: A spirit that soothes the soul with the music of its heavenly harp.

name: Hamburger Recipe
cn_text:
「飢餓的漢堡」的降臨必需。
①：從自己的手卡·場上把等級合計直到6以上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「飢餓的漢堡」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Hungry Burger". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

name: Torike
cn_text: 雖然守備不像外表般高強。但是角的攻擊力還是很強。
description: Although a poor defender, this monster's sharp horn gives it an edge when attacking.

name: Muko
cn_text: 抽卡的效果發動時發動。那張卡的效果所抽的卡雙方確認，并全部丟棄去墓地。
description: Activate only when an effect of drawing card(s) is activated. Both players see the cards drawn by the effect and discard them all to the Graveyard.

name: Helios Duo Megistus
cn_name: 雙子太陽 赫利俄斯
cn_text: 這張卡可以用自己場上的1只「原始太陽 赫利俄斯」作為祭品特殊召喚。這張卡的攻擊力·守備力為從游戲中除外的怪獸卡數量×200的數值。這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合，結束階段時攻擊力·守備力上升300并特殊召喚。
description: You can Special Summon this card by Tributing 1 "Helios - The Primordial Sun". This card's ATK and DEF are equal to the number of removed from play monsters x 200. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase, and it gains 300 ATK and DEF.

name: Mausoleum of the Emperor
cn_text:
①：雙方玩家在自己主要階段可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●支付1000基本分才能發動。不用解放來進行需要1只解放的手卡1只怪獸的通常召喚。
●支付2000基本分才能發動。不用解放來進行需要2只解放的手卡1只怪獸的通常召喚。
description: During any Main Phase: The turn player can pay 1000 LP x the number of monsters normally needed for the Tribute Summon of a monster (max. 2000); that player Normal Summons/Sets that monster without Tributing. (This is their one Normal Summon/Set for that turn. This is not a Tribute Summon.)

name: Time Machine
cn_text: ①：自己或者對方的怪獸1只被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。在那只怪獸被破壞時的控制者場上以相同表示形式把那只怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When exactly 1 monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon that monster to the same side of the field it was on, in the same battle position it was in when destroyed.

name: D. Human
cn_text: 揮動用龍牙打造的劍、擁有龍之力量的戰士。
description: Gifted with the power of dragons, this warrior wields a sword created from a dragon's fang.

name: Des Volstgalph
cn_text:
①：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地的場合發動。給與對方500傷害。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，每次自己或者對方把通常·速攻魔法卡發動，直到回合結束時這張卡的攻擊力上升各200。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Each time a Normal or Quick-Play Spell Card resolves, this card gains 200 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Divine Punishment
cn_text: ①：場上有「天空的聖域」存在，怪獸的效果·魔法·陷阱卡發動時才能發動。那個發動無效并破壞。
description: Activate only if "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is face-up on the field. Negate the activation of a Spell Card, Trap Card, or Effect Monster's effect, and destroy that card.

name: Fiend Comedian
cn_text: ①：進行1次投擲硬幣，對硬幣的里表作猜測。猜中的場合，對方墓地的卡全部除外。猜錯的場合，把對方墓地的卡數量的卡從自己卡組上面送去墓地。
description: Toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, all of your opponent's cards in the Graveyard are removed from play immediately. If you call it wrong, send a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's Graveyard from your Deck to your Graveyard.

name: Kattapillar
cn_text: 吐絲攻擊。不知道以后會長成什么樣子的蟲。
description: Attacks enemies by spitting thin, sticky webs.

name: Magical Hats
cn_text: ①：對方戰斗階段才能發動。從卡組選2張魔法·陷阱卡，那2張卡當作通常怪獸卡（攻/守0）使用，和自己的主要怪獸區域1只怪獸混合洗切并里側守備表示蓋放。這個效果從卡組特殊召喚的卡不在戰斗階段內不能存在，戰斗階段結束時破壞。
description: During your opponent's Battle Phase: Choose 2 Spell/Trap Cards from your Deck and 1 monster you control. Special Summon them as Normal Monsters (ATK 0/DEF 0) in face-down Defense Position, Set the chosen monster if it is face-up, and shuffle them on the field. The 2 cards chosen from your Deck are destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase, and cannot remain on the field except during this Battle Phase.

name: Right Leg of the Forbidden One
cn_text: 被封印的右足。假若解開封印，能得無限之力。
description: A forbidden right leg sealed by magic. Whosoever breaks this seal will know infinite power.

name: Nightmare Penguin
cn_text:
①：這張卡反轉的場合，以對方場上1張卡為對象發動。那張對方的卡回到持有者手卡。
②：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，自己場上的水屬性怪獸的攻擊力上升200。
description: All face-up WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK. When this card is flipped face-up: Target 1 card your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

name: Sinister Serpent
cn_text:
「殺人蛇」的效果1回合只能使用1次。
①：這張卡在墓地存在的場合，自己准備階段才能發動。這張卡回到手卡。下次的對方結束階段選自己墓地1只「殺人蛇」除外。
description: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can add it to your hand, also banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your Graveyard during your opponent's next End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Sinister Serpent" once per turn.

name: Chorus of Sanctuary
cn_text: 全部守備表示的怪獸守備力上升500。
description: Increase the DEF of all Defense Position monsters by 500 points.

name: Stamping Destruction
cn_text: 自己的場上有表側表示的龍族怪獸存在時才能發動。破壞場上的1張魔法·陷阱卡，給與那張被破壞的卡的控制者500分的傷害。
description: If you control a Dragon-Type monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.

name: Bottom Dweller
cn_text: 在水中幽雅游動的魚神，若它發怒會很危險。
description: This is one sea creature whose wrath is something monsters fear to face.

name: Thousand-Eyes Jellyfish
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚，把自己場上存在的1只「海洋怪魚衛士」解放的場合才能特殊召喚。只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，對方必須把手卡持續公開。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Ocean's Keeper". Your opponent must play with their hand revealed.

name: Foolish Burial
cn_text: ①：從卡組把1只怪獸送去墓地。
description: Send 1 monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Barrel Dragon
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。進行3次投擲硬幣，那之內2次以上是表的場合，那只怪獸破壞。
description: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times and destroy it if at least 2 of the results are Heads.

name: Ancient Jar
cn_text: 非常脆弱的太古之壺。里面好像藏?什么東西。
description: A very fragile jar that contains something ancient and dangerous.

name: Soul Taker
cn_text: ①：以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側表示怪獸破壞。那之后，對方回復1000基本分。
description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, then your opponent gains 1000 LP.

name: Fairy of the Fountain
cn_text: 守護泉水的精靈。對任何污濁泉水者殺無赦。
description: This fairy protects a fountain from any who seek to muddy its waters.

name: Lord of Zemia
cn_text: 善於欺騙對方、誘惑其加入破滅之路的邪惡之神。
description: A wicked entity that manipulates enemies towards a path of destruction.

name: Dimensional Fissure
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，被送去墓地的怪獸不去墓地而除外。
description: Any monster sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

name: Ill Witch
cn_text: 能操縱風并能引起強風吹飛所有東西。
description: This monster blasts enemies with unexpected bursts of wind.

name: Dark Effigy
cn_text: 暗屬性的通常怪獸祭品召喚的場合，這1只怪獸可以作為2只的數量的祭品。
description: If you Tribute Summon a DARK Normal Monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Zera Ritual
cn_text: 召喚「杰拉」降臨必要。場上和手卡加起來總共8顆星以上的怪獸作祭品。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Zera the Mant". You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Luminous Spark
cn_text: 全部的光屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500，守備力下降400。
description: All LIGHT monsters gain 500 ATK and lose 400 DEF.

name: Snake Whistle
cn_text: 自己場上存在的爬蟲類族怪獸被破壞時才能發動。從自己卡組把1只4星以下的爬蟲類族怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: Activate only when a Reptile-Type monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Reptile-Type monster from your Deck.

name: The Inexperienced Spy
cn_text: 指定對方的1張手卡進行觀看。
description: Select and see 1 card in your opponent's hand.

name: Needle Worm
cn_text: 反轉：對方卡組最上面的5張卡送去墓地。
description: FLIP: Send the top 5 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Hiro's Shadow Scout
cn_text: 反轉：對方從卡組抽3張卡。這個效果抽到的卡給雙方確認，從那之中把魔法卡全部丟棄去墓地。
description: FLIP: Your opponent draws 3 cards. Both players look at the cards. If there are any Spell Cards among them, discard all those Spell Card(s) to the Graveyard.

name: Swift Birdman Joe
cn_text: 用風屬性怪獸為祭品作祭品召喚成功的場合，場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部回到持有者手卡。
description: If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing a WIND monster, return all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the owners' hands.

name: Brain Crusher
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸送去墓地的場合，可以使破壞的1只怪獸在那個回合的結束階段時從墓地特殊召喚到自己場上。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle and sent it to the Graveyard this turn while you controlled it: You can target 1 of those destroyed monsters in the Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: Desert Twister
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己墓地2只風屬性怪獸和1只地屬性怪獸從游戲中除外才能特殊召喚。可以丟棄1張手卡把場上1張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play 1 EARTH and 2 WIND monsters from your Graveyard. Once per turn, you can discard 1 card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Des Feral Imp
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以自己墓地1張卡為對象發動。那張卡回到卡組。
description: FLIP: Target 1 card in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck.

name: End of the World
cn_text: ①：等級合計直到變成和儀式召喚的怪獸相同為止，把自己的手卡·場上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「破滅之女神 露茵」或「終焉之王 迪米斯」儀式召喚。
description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion", or "Demise, King of Armageddon". You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you are attempting to Ritual Summon.

name: Toll
cn_text: 雙方玩家若不支付500基本分，則不能攻擊宣言。
description: Each player must pay 500 Life Points to declare an attack.

name: Lady Ninja Yae
cn_text: 從手卡將1張風屬性怪獸卡棄到墓地。將對方場上存在的所有魔法·陷阱卡全部彈回其持有者手卡。
description: By discarding 1 WIND monster from your hand to the Graveyard, return all Spell and Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field to the owner's hand.

name: Star Boy
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，全部水屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500。炎屬性的怪獸攻擊力下降400。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all WATER monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all FIRE monsters by 400 points.

name: Twinheaded Beast
cn_text: ①：這張卡在同1次的戰斗階段中可以作2次攻擊。
description: This card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

name: Oscillo Hero
cn_text: 從異世界來到這里，稀里糊塗的戰士。
description: A strange warrior from another dimension.

name: Shining Friendship
cn_text: 即便在決斗中吵架，顯示出友情就能和好。
description: The peacemaker among monsters.

name: Crystal Seer
cn_text: 反轉：從自己卡組上面翻開2張卡，選擇那之內的1張加入手卡。剩下的回到卡組最下面。
description: FLIP: Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, then place the other on the bottom of your Deck.

name: Mudora
cn_text: 自己墓地里每存在1只天使族怪獸，這張卡的攻擊力上升200點。
description: This card gains 200 ATK for each Fairy-Type monster in your Graveyard.

name: D.D.M. - Different Dimension Master
cn_text: 從手卡丟棄1張魔法卡。特殊召喚1只從游戲中除外的持有者為自己的怪獸。這個效果1回合1次，只能在自己的主要階段發動。
description: Once per turn, you can discard 1 Spell Card to Special Summon 1 of your removed from play monsters.

name: Prometheus, King of the Shadows
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚成功的場合發動。選自己墓地的暗屬性怪獸任意數量除外。這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升除外數量×400。
description: If this card is Normal Summoned: Banish any number of DARK monsters from your Graveyard, and if you do, this card gains 400 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

name: Hieracosphinx
cn_name: 斯芬克斯 海爾拉克
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，對方不能選擇里側守備表示的怪獸作為攻擊對象。
description: Your opponent cannot select a face-down Defense Position monster as an attack target.

name: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把光·暗屬性怪獸各1只除外的場合才能特殊召喚。這張卡的效果發動的回合，自己不能把其他的效果發動。
①：1回合1次，支付1000基本分才能發動。雙方的手卡·場上的卡全部送去墓地。那之后，給與對方這個效果送去對方墓地的卡數量×300傷害。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard. You can pay 1000 Life Points; send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, then inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

name: Goblin Recon Squad
cn_text: 這張卡直接攻擊對方玩家成功的場合，可以隨機把對方1張手卡確認。確認的卡是魔法卡的場合，那張卡送去墓地。這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示。直到下次的自己回合結束時這張卡不能把表示形式改變。
description: When this card successfully attacks directly, you can look at 1 random card in your opponent's hand. If it is a Spell Card, send it to the Graveyard. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

name: Mask of Brutality
cn_text: 裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升1000，守備力下降1000。每次的自己的准備階段支付1000分維持。不支付維持這張卡破壞。
description: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK and loses 1000 DEF. During each of your Standby Phases, pay 1000 LP or destroy this card.

name: Millennium Scorpion
cn_text: 每次這張卡戰斗破壞對方場上1只怪獸送去墓地的場合，這張卡攻擊力上升500。
description: Each time this card destroys 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, this card gains 500 ATK.

name: Ojama Delta Hurricane!!
cn_text: 當「擾亂·綠」「擾亂·黃」「擾亂·黑」在自己場上以表側表示存在時這張卡才能發動。破壞對方場上存在的所有卡。
description: You can only activate this card while "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" are face-up on your side of the field. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Ray of Hope
cn_text: 從自己墓地里選擇2張光屬性怪獸卡回到自己卡組。
description: Add 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

name: Gravedigger Ghoul
cn_text: 選擇對方的墓地1張到2張的怪獸卡。選擇的卡從游戲中除外。
description: Select up to 2 Monster Card(s) from your opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected card(s) from play.

name: Kryuel
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，投擲1個硬幣猜正反。猜中的場合破壞對方1只怪獸。
description: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Backfire
cn_text: ①：每次自己場上的表側表示的炎屬性怪獸被破壞送去墓地發動。給與對方500傷害。
description: When a FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Skill Drain
cn_text:
支付1000基本分才能把這張卡發動。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，場上的表側表示怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Activate by paying 1000 Life Points. The effects of all face-up monsters on the field are negated while those monsters are face-up on the field (but their effects can still be activated).

name: Serpent Marauder
cn_text: 獨眼蛇。吐出冷氣冰封對方。
description: A snake with a single eye that blows an icy breath to freeze its opponents.

name: Rock Spirit
cn_text: 指輪般的岩石精靈。攻擊與守備力都很強。
description: A fairy of boulders that looks like an earthenware statue. It is quite strong in terms of both attack and defense.

name: Earthquake
cn_text: 場上存在的表側表示怪獸全部變成守備表示。
description: Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.

name: Shine Palace
cn_text:
光屬性怪獸才能裝備。
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。
description: Equip only to a LIGHT monster. It gains 700 ATK.

name: Umiiruka
cn_text: 全部的水屬性的怪獸攻擊力上升500，守備力下降400。
description: Increase the ATK of all WATER monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

name: Mystic Tomato
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的暗屬性怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Ancient Gear Golem
cn_text:
這張卡不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡攻擊的場合，對方直到傷害步驟結束時魔法·陷阱卡不能發動。
②：這張卡向守備表示怪獸攻擊的場合，給與對方為攻擊力超過那個守備力的數值的戰斗傷害。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

name: Zero Gravity
cn_text: ①：場上的全部表側表示怪獸的表示形式變更。
description: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on the field.

name: Stim-Pack
cn_text: 裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。自己的每次的准備階段裝備怪獸的攻擊力下降200。
description: The equipped monster gains 700 ATK. During each of your Standby Phases, the equipped monster loses 200 ATK.

name: Two Thousand Needles
cn_text: 守備表示的這張卡受到攻擊時，若這張卡的守備力超過對方攻擊怪獸的攻擊力，傷害計算后那只攻擊怪獸破壞。
description: When this Defense Position card is attacked and the ATK of the attacking monster is lower than the DEF of this card, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Tyranno Infinity
cn_text: ①：這張卡的原本攻擊力變成除外的自己的恐龍族怪獸數量×1000。
description: The original ATK of this card is the number of your banished Dinosaur-Type monsters x 1000.

name: Dice Re-Roll
cn_text: ①：這個回合，擲骰子的效果適用之際只有1次，可以重擲骰子。
description: One time, during the rest of this turn, if either player(s) rolls a die (or dice), you can have the player(s) re-roll. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

name: Dark Valkyria
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以當成通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡變成當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●只要這張卡表側表示存在，只有1次可以給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物。這張卡放置的魔力指示物每有1個，這張卡的攻擊力上升300。可以把那1個魔力指示物取除，場上1只怪獸破壞。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.? Once, while this card is face-up on the field: You can place 1 Spell Counter on it. This card gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Skullbird
cn_text: 「橐蜚」＋「骷髏寺院」
description: "Takuhee" + "Temple of Skulls"

name: Mystical Sheep #2
cn_text: 尾巴很長的綿羊，用尾巴使出催眠朮，讓敵人入睡。
description: A monstrous sheep with a long tail for hypnotizing enemies.

name: Air Eater
cn_text: 吸收周圍的空氣，使對方窒息的妖怪。
description: A monster that feeds on oxygen, suffocating any who stand near.

name: Ring of Destruction
cn_text:
這個卡名的卡在1回合只能發動1張。
①：對方回合，以持有對方基本分數值以下的攻擊力的對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只表側表示怪獸破壞，自己受到那只怪獸的原本攻擊力數值的傷害。那之后，給與對方為和自己受到的傷害相同數值的傷害。
description: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to their LP; destroy that face-up monster, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. You can only activate 1 "Ring of Destruction" per turn.

name: Midnight Fiend
cn_text: 出現在深夜的鳥怪。據說必須祭生才能喚它出來。
description: This monster only appears when a midnight tribute is made.

name: Tail Swipe
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只5星以上的恐龍族怪獸發動。選擇對方場上存在的合計最多2只里側表示怪獸或者比選擇的恐龍族怪獸的等級低的怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: Target 1 Level 5 or higher Dinosaur-Type monster you control; if that Dinosaur-Type monster is still face-up on the field, choose up to 2 monsters your opponent controls that have a lower Level than it, or are face-down, and return them to the hand.

name: Attack the Moon!
cn_text: 自己場上的岩石族怪獸的表示形式變更時，可以選擇對方場上1張魔法·陷阱卡破壞。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn, when the battle position of a Rock-Type monster you control is changed: You can target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Mage Power
cn_text: ①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升自己場上的魔法·陷阱卡數量×500。
description: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK and DEF for each Spell/Trap Card you control.

name: Monster Reborn
cn_text: ①：以自己或對方的墓地1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: Target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon it.

name: The Illusory Gentleman
cn_text: 穿?奇特、反復無常的做壞事與幫助人。
description: Wearing odd fashions, this gentleman is very fickle. He sometimes saves people and at other times commits crimes.

name: Foolish Revival
cn_text: 選擇對方墓地1只怪獸才能發動。選擇的怪獸在對方場上表側守備表示特殊召喚。
description: Select 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard, and Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Flint Lock
cn_text: 場上有表側表示的「打火石」存在的場合，可以給這張卡裝備。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。此外，可以把這張卡裝備的1張「打火石」給場上存在的1只表側表示怪獸裝備。這張卡可以裝備的「打火石」最多1張。只要這張卡有「打火石」裝備，這張卡不受「打火石」的效果影響，并且不會被戰斗破壞。
description: Once per turn, you can equip a "Flint" on the field to this card. You can take any "Flint" equipped to this card and equip it to another face-up monster. This card can only be equipped with one "Flint" at a time. While equipped with "Flint", this card is unaffected by "Flint's" effect and cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Two-Pronged Attack
cn_text: 選擇自己場上存在的2只怪獸和對方場上存在的1只怪獸破壞。
description: Select and destroy 2 of your monsters and 1 of your opponent's monsters.

name: Jar of Greed
cn_text: ①：自己從卡組抽1張。
description: Draw 1 card.

name: King Tiger Wanghu
cn_text: ①：這張卡已在怪獸區域存在的狀態，每次攻擊力1400以下的怪獸召喚·特殊召喚發動。這張卡在場上表側表示存在的場合，那些攻擊力1400以下的怪獸破壞。
description: When a monster(s) with 1400 or less ATK is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned: Destroy those monsters with 1400 or less ATK. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom
cn_text: 反轉：對方場上表側表示存在的4星怪獸全部破壞。
description: FLIP: Destroy all Level 4 monsters your opponent controls.

name: Maiden of Macabre
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物。這張卡的攻擊力上升這張卡放置的魔力指示物數量×200的數值。
description: Each time this card destroys a monster by battle, place 1 Spell Counter on this card. This card gains 200 ATK for every Spell Counter on it.

name: The Forgiving Maiden
cn_text: 表側表示的這張卡做祭品。這個回合被戰斗破壞送去墓地的1只自己的怪獸回手卡。
description: Tribute this face-up card to return to your hand 1 of your monsters destroyed as a result of battle during this turn.

name: Kanikabuto
cn_text: 螃蟹怪獸。用雙手的大鉗子切碎對方。
description: A monster crab with huge claws for clipping enemies to little pieces.

name: Monster Eye
cn_text: 支付1000基本分發動。自己墓地存在的1張「融合」回到手卡。
description: You can pay 1000 Life Points; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: The Grave of Enkindling
cn_text: 自己場上存在的怪獸被戰斗破壞送去墓地時發動。自己和對方選擇各自的墓地1只怪獸，守備表示在場上特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸只要在場上表側表示存在，表示形式不能改變。
description: You can only activate this card when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard. You and your opponent each select 1 monster from your respective Graveyards and Special Summon them in Defense Position. Neither monster Special Summoned by this card's effect can change its battle position while it is face-up on the field, except with a card effect.

name: Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示。直到下次的自己回合結束時這張卡不能把表示形式變更。
description: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
cn_text:
「VW-強擊虎」＋「XYZ-神龍炮」
把自己場上的上記卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚（不需要「融合」）。
①：1回合1次，以對方場上1張卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的卡除外。
②：這張卡向對方怪獸攻擊宣言時，以那1只攻擊對象怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊對象怪獸的表示形式變更。這個時候，反轉怪獸的效果不發動。
description: "VW-Tiger Catapult" + "XYZ-Dragon Cannon"This card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by removing from play the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization"). Once per turn, remove from play 1 card your opponent controls. When this card attacks, you can change the battle position of the attack target. (Flip Effects are not activated at this time.)

name: Dian Keto the Cure Master
cn_name: 治療之神 迪安·凱特
cn_text: ①：自己回復1000基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Haniwa
cn_text: 古代王墓中守護寶物的土人偶。
description: An earthen figure that protects the tomb of an ancient ruler.

name: Snipe Hunter
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡，選擇場上1張卡才能發動。擲1次骰子，1·6以外出現的場合，選擇的卡破壞。
description: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; roll a six-sided die, and destroy that target unless you roll a 1 or 6.

name: Level Conversion Lab
cn_text: 選擇自己手卡1張怪獸卡給對方看，投擲1次骰子。出現的數目是1的場合，選擇的怪獸送去墓地。出現的數目是2至6的場合，這個回合的結束階段前，這只怪獸的等級變為投擲的數目。
description: Select 1 monster in your hand and show it to your opponent, then roll a six-sided die. If the result is 1, send the selected monster to the Graveyard. If the result is 2-6, the Level of the selected monster becomes equal to the result until the end of this turn.

name: Armed Samurai - Ben Kei
cn_text: 每次的戰斗階段中，這張卡在通常攻擊之上追加、這張卡裝備的裝備卡數量的攻擊次數。
description: For each Equip Card equipped to this card, it gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Des Frog
cn_text: 這張卡的祭品召喚成功時，可以把最多有自己墓地存在的「惡魂邪苦止」數量的「死亡青蛙」從手卡或者卡組特殊召喚。
description: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can Special Summon "Des Frog"(s) from your hand or Deck up to the number of "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) in your Graveyard.

name: Barrier Statue of the Abyss
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，雙方不是暗屬性怪獸不能特殊召喚。
description: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for DARK monsters.

name: Girochin Kuwagata
cn_text: 棲息在精靈之森的甲蟲，雖不過人的大拇指一般大，但卻有?連鋼鐵都能咬斷的下顎。
description: Despite its small size, this monster has powerful jaws that can rip metal to shreds.

name: Spell Canceller
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，魔法卡不能發動，場上所有魔法卡的效果無效化。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, Spell Cards cannot be activated. The effects of all Spell Cards are also negated.

name: King Fog
cn_text: 潛伏在煙霧中的惡魔，四周被濃煙包圍，毫無蹤跡可循。
description: A fiend that dwells in a blinding curtain of smoke.

name: Sonic Duck
cn_text: 可以以音速步行的鴨子。由於不能適應其驚人的速度而經常失控。
description: A duck which can walk at a sonic speed. Sometimes, he cannot deal with his incredible pace and loses control.

name: Giga-Tech Wolf
cn_text: 全身由鋼鐵制成的狼，用鋒利的牙齒撕咬敵人。
description: An iron wolf with razor-sharp fangs that can penetrate any armor.

name: Buster Rancher
cn_text: 這張卡只能裝備在攻擊力1000以下的怪獸上。傷害計算時，對方怪獸攻擊表示則看攻擊力，守備表示則看守備力，其數值在2500以上時，裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力上升2500。
description: Only a monster with an ATK of 1000 points or less can be equipped with this card. During damage calculation, increase the ATK of the monster equipped with this card by 2500 points if the opponent's monster that battles it is in Attack Position and its ATK is 2500 or more, OR if the opponent's monster that battles it is in Defense Position and its DEF is 2500 or more.

name: Solitude
cn_text: 下半身是鹿，持有吸收靈魂的大鐮刀的獸戰士。
description: This beast-warrior swings a massive scythe that feeds on the souls of the slain.

name: Big Evolution Pill
cn_text:
把自己場上1只恐龍族怪獸解放才能把這張卡發動。這張卡發動后繼續留在場上，用對方回合計算的第3回合的對方結束階段破壞。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，自己在5星以上的恐龍族怪獸召喚的場合需要的解放可以不用。
description: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but destroy it during your opponent's 3rd End Phase. Tribute 1 Dinosaur-Type monster to activate this card; while this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher Dinosaur-Type monsters without Tributing.

name: Kiryu
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「暗魔界的戰士 暗黑之劍」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升900點。可以把裝備狀態的這張卡作為祭品，裝備怪獸在這個回合可以直接攻擊對方玩家。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 900 points, and you can Tribute this card to allow the equipped monster to attack your opponent's Life Points directly this turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Flying Kamakiri #1
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以從自己卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的風屬性怪獸在自己場上表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 WIND monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Axe Dragonute
cn_text: ①：這張卡攻擊的場合，傷害步驟結束時變成守備表示。
description: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Doriado
cn_text: 森之精靈。借助草木之力來封住對手的行動。
description: A spirit of the forest powered by the surrounding trees and wildlife.

name: Needlebug Nest
cn_text: ①：從自己卡組上面把5張卡送去墓地。
description: Send the top 5 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Curse of Darkness
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動給與那個發動的玩家1000傷害。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, the controller of that Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

name: Bean Soldier
cn_text: 使用劍和大豆攻擊的植物戰士，意外的強悍。
description: A plant-warrior that attacks with seeds and sword.

name: Water Dragon
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚，用「結合朮-H2O」的效果才能特殊召喚。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，場上的炎屬性怪獸以及炎族怪獸的攻擊力變成0。
②：這張卡被破壞送去墓地時，以自己墓地2只「氫素龍」和1只「氧素龍」為對象才能發動。那些怪獸特殊召喚。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Bonding - H2O". The ATK of FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field becomes 0. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon" in your GY; Special Summon them.

name: Card Trooper
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，從自己卡組上面把最多3張卡送去墓地才能發動。這張卡的攻擊力直到回合結束時上升因為這個效果發動而送去墓地的卡數量×500。
②：自己場上的這張卡被破壞送去墓地的場合發動。自己抽1張。
description: Once per turn: You can choose a number from 1 to 3, then send that many cards from the top of your Deck to the GY; this card gains 500 ATK for each card sent to the GY this way, until the end of this turn. If this card you control is destroyed and sent to your GY: Draw 1 card.

name: Elephant Statue of Blessing
cn_text: 當這張卡因對方控制的卡的效果從手卡被送去墓地時，自己回復2000基本分。
description: When this card is sent from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: You gain 2000 Life Points.

name: Swordsman from a Distant Land
cn_text: 受到「異國的劍士」攻擊的怪獸，5回合后被破壞。
description: If this card attacked an opponent's monster, after damage calculation: Destroy that monster during the 5th End Phase after the attack.

name: Goblin Elite Attack Force
cn_text: ①：這張卡攻擊的場合，戰斗階段結束時變成守備表示，直到下次的自己回合的結束時不能把表示形式變更。
description: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn.

name: Ray & Temperature
cn_text: 交情深厚的北風和太陽，能發動颶風與熱光線的攻擊。
description: The Sun and the North Wind join hands to deliver a devastating combination of heat and gale-force winds.

name: Dark Lucius LV4
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞的對方怪獸的效果無效化。這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的下次的自己回合的准備階段時，可以把這張卡送去墓地從手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「漆黑之魔王 LV6」。
description: The effects of your opponent's monsters that this card destroys by battle are negated. During your next Standby Phase after this card destroys a monster by battle, by sending this card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV6" from your hand or Deck.

name: Spike Seadra
cn_text: 用身體的刺攻擊敵人，并能放出電流。
description: Using the spikes sprouting from its body, this creature stabs its opponents and floods them with electricity.

name: Freezing Beast
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己的「灼岩魔獸」裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用時，裝備怪獸對對方造成戰斗傷害的場合，破壞場上1張里側表示的魔法或者陷阱卡。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Burning Beast" as an Equip Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-down Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Harvest Angel of Wisdom
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，以自己墓地1張反擊陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張卡加入手卡。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can add 1 Counter Trap Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Sentinel of the Seas
cn_text: 徹底的攻擊玷污大海的家伙、人魚戰士。
description: A merman warrior that relentlessly attacks those who pollute the seas with their presence.

name: Arsenal Summoner
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。從卡組把1張「守護者」卡加入手卡。
description: FLIP: Add 1 "Guardian" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Celtic Guardian", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #2", "Guardian of the Labyrinth", or "The Reliable Guardian".

name: Super Conductor Tyranno
cn_text: ①：1回合1次，把自己場上1只怪獸解放才能發動。給與對方1000傷害。這個效果發動的回合，這張卡不能攻擊宣言。
description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

name: Dark Room of Nightmare
cn_text: ①：每次「噩夢之拷問室」以外的卡的效果讓對方受到傷害發動。給與對方300傷害。
description: Each time your opponent takes damage from a card effect, except "Dark Room of Nightmare", inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

name: Last Will
cn_text: 只要該回合有怪獸從自己場上送入自己墓地就可以從卡組特殊召喚攻擊力1500以下的1只怪獸到場上。
description: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Berserk Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡只能以「與惡魔的暗中交易」的效果進行特殊召喚。這張卡可以對對方場上所有怪獸各進行1次攻擊。在自己每回合的結束階段時，這張卡的攻擊力下降500點。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "A Deal with Dark Ruler" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each. During each of your End Phases, this card loses 500 ATK.

name: Aqua Madoor
cn_text: 操縱水的魔法師。造出厚重的水牆壓垮敵人。
description: A wizard of the waters that conjures a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

name: Reaper on the Nightmare
cn_text:
「削魂的死靈」＋「夢魘馬」
這張卡不會被戰斗破壞。這張卡成為魔法·陷阱·效果怪獸效果的對象時，這張卡破壞。這張卡在對方場上存在怪獸的狀態下也能對對方進行直接攻擊。這張卡對對方進行直接攻擊成功時，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: "Spirit Reaper" + "Nightmare Horse"This card is not destroyed as a result of battle. Destroy this card when it is targeted by the effect of a Spell, Trap or Effect Monster. This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly even if there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field. If this card successfully attacks your opponent's Life Points directly, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

name: Kurama
cn_text: 尾巴很長的鳥，從空中發起攻擊。
description: A vicious bird that attacks from the skies with its whip-like tail.

name: Gravity Bind
cn_text: 場上的4星以上的怪獸不能攻擊。
description: Level 4 or higher monsters cannot attack.

name: Cure Mermaid
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示的存在，每次自己的准備階段回復800基本分。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 800 points during each of your Standby Phases.

name: Magical Mallet
cn_text: ①：自己手卡任意數量回到卡組洗切。那之后，自己抽出回到卡組的數量。
description: Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw that same number of cards.

name: United Resistance
cn_text: 立誓要為了對抗強大力量而集結的人們。革命之日將近。
description: The people that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.

name: Ocubeam
cn_text: 巨大的耳朵和眼睛能監視周圍的一切，相貌可怕的天使。
description: Frightening in appearance, this creature uses its large eyes and ears to keep track of any movement.

name: The Last Warrior from Another Planet
cn_text:
「暗黑英雄 尸魔俠」＋「魔力吸收球體」
這張卡特殊召喚時，其他的自己的場上的怪獸全部破壞。只要這張卡在場上存在，互相的其他的怪獸不能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
description: "Zombyra the Dark" + "Maryokutai"When this card is Special Summoned, destroy all monsters on your side of the field except this card. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, neither player can Normal Summon, Flip Summon, or Special Summon any monster.

name: Zone Eater
cn_text: 受到「區域吞噬者」攻擊的怪獸，5回合后被破壞。
description: A monster attacked by this card will be destroyed during the End Phase of the 5th turn after the attack.

name: Aqua Dragon
cn_text: 「妖精龍」＋「海原的女戰士」＋「區域吞噬者」
description: "Fairy Dragon" + "Amazon of the Seas" + "Zone Eater"

name: 7 Completed
cn_text: 機械族怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力或者守備力上升700。
description: Activate this card by choosing ATK or DEF; equip only to a Machine-Type monster. It gains 700 ATK or DEF, depending on the choice.

name: Stray Asmodian
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，雙方回復800基本分。
description: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players gain 800 Life Points.

name: Umbral Soul
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，場上表側表示存在的暗屬性怪獸以外的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-DARK monsters.

name: Gadget Soldier
cn_text: 為戰斗而制造的機械戰士。用不生鏽金屬制成。
description: A rust-free machine warrior born to battle.

name: D.D. Dynamite
cn_text: 給與對方基本分對方除外的卡數×300的傷害。
description: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each of their removed from play cards.

name: Sogen
cn_text: 全部戰士族·獸戰士族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力上升200。
description: Increases the ATK and DEF of all Beast-Warrior and Warrior-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Baron of the Fiend Sword
cn_text: 操縱?充滿怨念之劍的貴族，對追逐獵物的信念十分的執?。
description: An aristocrat who wields a sword possessed by a malicious spirit that preys on the weak.

name: Shinato, King of a Higher Plane
cn_text: 用「奇跡之方舟」特殊召喚。特殊召喚時，必須以場上或手卡中合計8顆星以上的怪獸作為祭品。這張卡戰斗破壞對方守備表示的怪獸并將其送去墓地時，對方受到數值與被破壞怪獸的原本攻擊力相同的傷害。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Shinato's Ark". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Level equal 8 or more from the field or your hand. When this card destroys a Defense Position monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Dark Cat with White Tail
cn_text: 反轉：將對方場上2只怪獸與自己場上1只怪獸彈回持有者手卡。
description: FLIP: Return 2 Monster Cards on your opponent's side of the field and 1 Monster Card on your side of the field to their owners' hands.

name: Ancient Tree of Enlightenment
cn_text: 運用所有知識、能夠守備各種攻擊的老樹。
description: This ancient arbor uses its extensive knowledge to avoid the damage of enemy attacks.

name: Silent Abyss
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，場上表側表示存在的水屬性怪獸以外的怪獸全部破壞。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-WATER monsters.

name: Red Gadget
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·特殊召喚成功時才能發動。從卡組把1只「黃色零件」加入手卡。
description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Yellow Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Simorgh, Bird of Ancestry
cn_text: 這張卡在手卡的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，風屬性怪獸的祭品召喚需要的祭品變少1只。只用風屬性怪獸作為祭品對這張卡的祭品召喚成功時，對方場上最多2張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: Both players Tribute Summon WIND monsters with 1 less Tribute than required. If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing only WIND monsters, return up to 2 cards your opponent controls to their owner's hand. This card is treated as a Normal Monster while in your hand.

name: D.D. Trainer
cn_text: 被吸入異次元的可憐小矮人。但是現在為了新的目標而每天都在努力?。
description: A poor goblin that was sucked into a different dimension. However, he's doing his best with his new destiny.

name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
cn_text: 一邊變換4張假面，一邊發起4種攻擊的怪物。
description: This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

name: Skull Dog Marron
cn_text: 1000年前與主人不幸走散的迷犬。至今仍在等待?主人能夠回來。
description: A lost dog that wandered off 1000 years ago. He's still waiting for his master to come for him.

name: Ms. Judge
cn_text:
「審判女士」的效果1回合只能使用1次。
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方的卡的效果發動的場合，那次處理進行時進行2次投擲硬幣，2次都是表的場合，那個效果無效。
description: If an opponent's card effect activates, before resolving that effect, toss a coin twice, and if the result is 2 Heads, negate that effect. You can only use this effect of "Ms. Judge" once per turn.

name: Cobra Jar
cn_text: 反轉：在自己場上把1只「毒蛇衍生物」（爬蟲類族·地·3星·攻/守1200）特殊召喚。「毒蛇衍生物」被戰斗破壞的場合，給與對方基本分500分傷害。
description: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Poisonous Snake Token" (Reptile-Type/EARTH/3 Stars/ATK 1200/DEF 1200). When the "Poisonous Snake Token" is destroyed as a result of battle, inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Dark Blade the Dragon Knight
cn_name: 暗魔界的龍騎士 暗黑之劍
cn_text:
「暗魔界的戰士 暗黑之劍」＋「漆黑的斗龍」
每次這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害，可以選擇對方的墓地的最多3張怪獸卡，從游戲中除外。
description: "Dark Blade" + "Pitch-Dark Dragon"Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can select up to 3 Monster Cards from your opponent's Graveyard and remove them from play.

name: Cloning
cn_text: ①：對方對怪獸的召喚·反轉召喚成功時，以那1只怪獸為對象才能發動。把持有那只表側表示怪獸的原本的種族·屬性·等級·攻擊力·守備力的1只「克隆衍生物」在自己場上特殊召喚。那只表側表示怪獸被破壞送去墓地時這衍生物破壞。
description: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster that has a Level: Target that face-up monster; Special Summon 1 "Clone Token", with the same original Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF as that target. When that target is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, destroy this Token.

name: Dreamsprite
cn_text: 這張卡受到從對方怪獸來的攻擊的場合，讓其他的自己場上1只怪獸承受攻擊，進行傷害計算。
description: When attacked by your opponent's monster, select another 1 of your Monster Cards and designate it as the attack's target, then calculate damage.

name: 3-Hump Lacooda
cn_text: 當自己場上存在3只表側表示的「三峰駝」時，祭掉其中2只，就可以抽3張卡。
description: If there are 3 face-up "3-Hump Lacooda" cards on your side of the field, Tribute 2 of them to draw 3 cards.

name: Legacy Hunter
cn_text: 當這張卡戰斗破壞里側守備表示的怪獸并將其送去墓地時，對方隨機將1張手卡彈回其卡組。
description: When this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster and destroys it and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent returns 1 random card from their hand to their Deck. Their Deck is then shuffled.

name: Golden Ladybug
cn_text: 自己的准備階段時，可以把手卡的這張卡給對方玩家觀看，自己回復500基本分。這個效果使用的場合，直到結束階段時把手卡的這張卡公開。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you can reveal this card in your hand to gain 500 Life Points. If you do this, this card remains revealed while it is in your hand, until the End Phase.

name: Bokoichi the Freightening Car
cn_name: 魔貨物車輛 博科伊奇
cn_text: 迪科伊奇專用的貨物車輛。可以運載任何東西。但是到達目的地時大部分貨物都會損壞。
description: A freight car that is exclusively for Dekoichi. It can transport anything, but most cargo arrives broken.

name: Knight's Title
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只表側表示的「黑魔朮師」解放才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組·墓地選1只「黑魔朮騎士」特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 1 face-up "Dark Magician"; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician Knight" from your hand, Deck or Graveyard.

name: Allure Queen LV3
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，以對方場上1只3星以下的怪獸為對象才能發動。那只3星以下的對方怪獸當作裝備魔法卡使用給這張卡裝備（只有1只可以裝備）。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡的效果裝備的怪獸破壞。
③：自己准備階段，把用這張卡的效果把怪獸裝備的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「魅惑的女王 LV5」特殊召喚。
description: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can select 1 Level 3 or lower monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card. (Only 1 card at a time can be equipped due to this effect.) If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead. During your Standby Phase, by sending this card to the Graveyard while it's equipped due to its effect, Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen LV5" from your hand or Deck.

name: Shining Abyss
cn_text: 光與暗之力兼備的怪獸。
description: This monster employs the powers of both Light and Darkness.

name: Launcher Spider
cn_text: 開?火箭炮亂放一通，爆殺對手的機械蜘蛛。
description: A mechanical spider with rocket launchers capable of random fire.

name: Atomic Firefly
cn_text: 戰斗破壞以表側表示存在於場上的這張卡的玩家受到1000點傷害。
description: When this face-up card on the field attacks or is attacked and it is destroyed as a result of battle, the player who destroyed it takes 1000 points of damage.

name: Forest
cn_text: 全部昆蟲族·獸族·植物族·獸戰士族的怪獸攻擊力·守備力上升200。
description: Increases the ATK and DEF of all Insect, Beast, Plant, and Beast-Warrior-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Firebird
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次自己場上的鳥獸族怪獸被破壞，這張卡攻擊力上升500。
description: Each time a Winged Beast-Type monster(s) on your side of the field is destroyed, this card gains 500 ATK.

name: Spikebot
cn_text: 地獄魔朮師制造的機器士兵，不斷地用雙手的鐵球對敵人和友軍發動無差別攻擊。
description: A mechanical soldier created by a wicked sorcerer, it attacks with the two steel balls attached to its arms.

name: Marionette Mite
cn_text: ①：把這張卡從手卡丟棄去墓地，以對方場上1只惡魔族·不死族怪獸為對象才能發動。那只惡魔族·不死族怪獸的控制權直到結束階段得到。
description: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to take control of 1 face-up Fiend or Zombie-Type monster your opponent controls until the End Phase this turn.

name: Winged Sage Falcos
cn_name: 有翼賢者 法爾科斯
cn_text: 被這張卡戰斗破壞并將送去墓地的對方表側攻擊表示的怪獸，可以把其放回對方卡組最上面。
description: When this card destroys an opponent's face-up Attack Position monster by battle and sends it to their Graveyard: You can place that monster on top of their Deck.

name: The Stern Mystic
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。場上蓋放的卡全部確認。
description: FLIP: All face-down cards on the field are turned face-up, and then returned to their original positions. No card effects are activated when cards are turned face-up.

name: Blackland Fire Dragon
cn_text: 黑暗深處棲息的龍。雙眼不太好使。
description: A dragon that dwells in the depths of darkness, its vulnerability lies in its poor eyesight.

name: Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive
cn_name: 魔裝機關車 迪科伊奇
cn_text: 反轉：抽1張卡。若自己場上存在表側表示的「魔貨物車輛 博科伊奇」的場合，再抽「魔貨物車輛 博科伊奇」數量的卡。
description: FLIP: Draw 1 card, then draw 1 additional card for each face-up "Bokoichi the Freightening Car" you control.

name: Sea Koala
cn_text: 這張卡以外的獸族怪獸在自己場上表側表示存在的場合，可以把對方場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸的攻擊力直到結束階段時變成0。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; change its ATK to 0 until the end of this turn. You must control a Beast-Type monster (other than this card) to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Gatling Dragon
cn_text:
「左輪手槍龍」＋「回膛手槍龍」
投擲3個硬幣。其中出現的與表側硬幣的數量同等數量的場上怪獸被破壞。這個效果1個回合1次，在自己的主要階段使用。
description: "Barrel Dragon" + "Blowback Dragon"Once per turn: You can toss a coin 3 times and destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, but not more than the number of Heads.

name: Larvae Moth
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。需要裝備了「進化之繭」2回合（數自己的回合數）的「飛蛾寶寶」做祭品特殊召喚上場。
description: This monster cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by Tributing "Petit Moth" on the 2nd of your turns after "Petit Moth" has been equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1
cn_text: 守護山上城寨的龍。從天空俯沖下來攻擊敵人。
description: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.

name: Armor Breaker
cn_text: 1回合只有1次在自己的主要階段可以當作裝備卡使用給自己場上的戰士族怪獸裝備，或者把裝備解除以表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。只在這個效果當作裝備卡使用的場合，裝備怪獸給與對方基本分戰斗傷害時，場上存在的1張卡破壞。（1只怪獸可以裝備的同盟最多1張。裝備怪獸被戰斗破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。）
description: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a Warrior-Type monster you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this effect, when that monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 card on the field. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, this card is destroyed instead.)

name: Hourglass of Life
cn_text: 掌管生命的天使。通過削減自己的壽命將力量賦予他人。
description: This creature grants power instead of shortening life.

name: Diffusion Wave-Motion
cn_text: ①：對方場上有怪獸存在的場合，支付1000基本分，以自己場上1只7星以上的魔法師族怪獸為對象才能發動。這個回合，那只怪獸以外的怪獸不能攻擊，作為對象的怪獸必須盡可能向對方怪獸全部各作1次攻擊。那些攻擊破壞的怪獸的效果不能發動并無效化。
description: (This card is not treated as a "Fusion" card.)Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster-Type monster you control; this turn, only that monster can attack, and it must attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. The effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by these attacks do not activate and are negated.

name: Brain Control
cn_text: ①：支付800基本分，以對方場上1只可以通常召喚的表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只表側表示怪獸的控制權直到結束階段得到。
description: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: Maju Garzett
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力變成祭品召喚時作為祭品的2只怪獸的原本攻擊力合計的數值。
description: The ATK of this card becomes equal to the combined original ATK of the 2 monsters you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

name: Parasitic Ticky
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力·守備力是場上的衍生物的數量×500的數值。
description: The ATK and DEF of this card are equal to the number of tokens on the field x 500.

name: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
cn_text: 選擇自己墓地存在的2只名字含有「LV」的怪獸，加入到自己卡組并且洗切。
description: Add 2 "LV" monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

name: Twin-Headed Wolf
cn_text: 自己的場上有這張卡以外的其他惡魔族怪獸表側表示存在的場合，這張卡戰斗破壞的反轉效果怪獸的效果無效化。
description: When there is another face-up Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field, negate the effect of Flip Effect Monsters destroyed by this card as a result of battle.

name: Aswan Apparition
cn_text: 這張卡對對方造成戰斗傷害時，可以將自己墓地里的1張陷阱卡彈回卡組最上面。
description: If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, you can return 1 Trap Card from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

name: Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer
cn_text:
①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方不能把雙方墓地的卡除外。
②：這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害時，以對方墓地最多2只怪獸為對象才能發動。那些怪獸除外。
description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target up to 2 monsters in their Graveyard; banish those targets. Your opponent cannot banish cards from either player's Graveyard.

name: Robbin' Goblin
cn_text: 自己場上的怪獸每次造成對方玩家的戰斗傷害時，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Superancient Deepsea King Coelacanth
cn_name: 超古深海王 空棘魚
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，丟棄1張手卡才能發動。從卡組把4星以下的魚族怪獸盡可能特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸不能攻擊宣言，效果無效化。
②：場上的這張卡為對象的魔法·陷阱·怪獸的效果發動時，把這張卡以外的自己場上1只魚族怪獸解放才能發動。那個效果無效并破壞。
description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon as many Level 4 or lower Fish-Type monsters as possible from your Deck, but they cannot attack and their effects are negated. During either player's turn, when this face-up card on the field is targeted by a card effect: You can Tribute 1 other Fish-Type monster; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Poison of the Old Man
cn_text:
①：可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●自己回復1200基本分。
●給與對方800傷害。
description: Activate 1 of these effects;? Gain 1200 LP.? Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

name: Fire Eye
cn_text: 被火炎包圍?的眼球。揮動翅膀就能引起火炎之風。
description: An eye engulfed in flames that flaps its wings to create hot blasts of air.

name: Zombyra the Dark
cn_text:
①：這張卡不能直接攻擊。
②：這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的場合發動。這張卡的攻擊力下降200。
description: This card cannot attack your opponent directly. If this card destroys a monster by battle: This card loses 200 ATK.

name: Sorcerer of Dark Magic
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上2只6星以上的魔法師族怪獸解放的場合才能特殊召喚。
①：陷阱卡發動時才能發動。這張卡在場上表側表示存在的場合，那個發動無效并破壞。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster-Type monsters, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Trap Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Nightmare Scorpion
cn_text: 造出惡夢，并在呻吟的時候用四條有毒的尾巴刺向敵人。
description: A creature that generates nightmares to haunt an opponent, it attacks with four poisonous tails.

name: The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以作為融合怪獸卡有卡名記述的1只融合素材怪獸的代替。那個時候，其他的融合素材怪獸必須是正規品。
②：把地屬性融合怪獸卡決定的一組融合素材怪獸（這張卡作為那之內的1只）從自己場上解放才能發動。把以那些解放的怪獸為融合素材的1只地屬性融合怪獸從額外卡組特殊召喚。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding EARTH Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

name: Drill Bug
cn_text: 這張卡給與對方戰斗傷害的時候，從自己的卡組取出1張「寄生蟲 帕拉賽德」，之后在卡組洗切后放在卡組最上面。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, you can select 1 "Parasite Paracide" card from your Deck, shuffle the Deck, and place "Parasite Paracide" on top of the Deck.

name: Fox Fire
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的回合的結束階段時，這張卡從墓地特殊召喚。這張卡只要在場上表側表示存在，不能為上級召喚而解放。
description: During the End Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard this turn and was face-up at the start of the Damage Step: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. This face-up card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

name: Hallowed Life Barrier
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。這張卡發動的回合，對方造成的傷害全部為0。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. This turn, any damage you take from your opponent's cards and effects becomes 0.

name: Baby Dragon
cn_text: 不可輕視的幼龍，說不定隱藏?什么力量。
description: Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

name: Pitch-Black Warwolf
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在怪獸區域存在，對方在戰斗階段不能把陷阱卡發動。
description: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

name: Killer Needle
cn_text: 巨大的黃蜂，攻擊出乎意料的強，若被群體攻擊則非常危險。
description: A huge bee with exceptional strength that's particularly dangerous in a swarm.

name: Great Dezard
cn_text:
根據戰斗破壞怪獸的次數得到下面的效果：
●1次：只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，以這張卡為對象的魔法·陷阱卡的發動和效果無效并破壞。
●2次：可以把這張卡做祭品，從自己的手卡·卡組選1只「不死王 巫妖」特殊召喚到場上。
description: When this monster destroys the following number of monsters as a result of battle, the following effects are activated in order:One: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them.Two: You can Special Summon 1 "Fushioh Richie" from your hand or your Deck by Tributing this card during your Main Phase.

name: Blast Held by a Tribute
cn_text: ①：上級召喚的對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。對方場上的表側攻擊表示怪獸全部破壞，給與對方1000傷害。
description: When an opponent's monster that was Tribute Summoned declares an attack: Destroy as many face-up Attack Position monsters they control as possible, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Basic Insect
cn_text: 群居生活的昆蟲。森林中是他們的樂園。
description: Usually found traveling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

name: Dark Dust Spirit
cn_text: 這張卡不能特殊召喚。召喚·反轉的回合的結束階段時回到主人的手卡。這張卡召喚·反轉時，場上的這張卡以外的全部表側表示的怪獸破壞。
description: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Destroy all other face-up monsters on the field.

name: Cyber Saurus
cn_text: 「炸彈先生」＋「雙頭恐龍王」
description: "Blast Juggler" + "Two-Headed King Rex"

name: Mystical Beast of Serket
cn_text:
①：自己場上沒有「王家的神殿」存在的場合這張卡破壞。
②：這張卡戰斗破壞的怪獸不去墓地而除外。
③：這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸的場合發動。這張卡的攻擊力上升500。
description: If you do not control "Temple of the Kings", destroy this card. Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card. If this card destroys a monster by battle: It gains 500 ATK.

name: Winged Minion
cn_text: 這張卡做祭品。選擇場上表側表示存在的1只惡魔族怪獸。只要那只怪獸表側表示在場上存在，攻擊力·守備力上升700。
description: Tribute this face-up card. Select 1 face-up Fiend-Type monster on the field. Increase the ATK and DEF of the monster by 700 points as long as it remains face-up on the field.

name: Guardian of the Labyrinth
cn_text: 守護?冥界入口的戰士，對侵略者豪不留情的斬殺。
description: A monster that guards the entrance to the Netherworld.

name: Greed
cn_text: 因卡的效果進行抽卡的玩家，在那個回合的結束階段終了時受到因卡的效果抽的卡的數量×500的傷害。
description: Each time a player draws cards because of a card effect, they take 500 damage during the End Phase for each card drawn by the card effect.

name: The Drdek
cn_text: 眼珠上長?腳的怪獸。高跳?用爪?攻擊。
description: A bipedal eyeball that seldom misses an enemy with its lethal talons.

name: Dark Titan of Terror
cn_text: 據說這個惡魔潛住在夢中，當獵物睡覺時便奪去其生命。
description: A fiend said to dwell in the world of dreams, it attacks enemies in their sleep.

name: Respect Play
cn_text: 雙方玩家必須在各自的回合把手卡全部持續公開。
description: During their respective turns, each player must show their opponent their hand.

name: Field-Commander Rahz
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·特殊召喚成功時，從自己卡組選擇「戰士 拉玆」以外的1只4星以下的戰士族怪獸在卡組最上面放置。
description: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Choose 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck, except "Field-Commander Rahz", and place it on top of your Deck.

name: Dark Prisoner
cn_text: 能巧妙的操縱光的反射來隱藏自己。
description: This monster bends light to hide its image from the eyes of opponents.

name: Ninjitsu Art of Decoy
cn_text: 選擇自己場上的名字有「忍者」字樣的1只怪獸才能發動。只要這張卡在場上存在，被選擇的怪獸不會被戰斗破壞（傷害計算適用）。
description: Target 1 face-up "Ninja" monster you control; it cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
cn_text: 以高攻擊力著稱的傳說之龍。任何對手都能粉碎，其破壞力不可估量。
description: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

name: Combination Attack
cn_text: 有同盟怪獸裝備的怪獸進行過戰斗的戰斗階段時才能發動。選擇1只有同盟怪獸裝備并進行過戰斗的怪獸，把裝備的同盟解除。選擇的怪獸在這個回合可以再1次攻擊。
description: During a Battle Phase, you can use this effect on 1 monster that has attacked this turn and is equipped with a Union Monster. Change the Union Monster back to a monster in face-up Attack or Defense Position. Also, the monster that was equipped with the Union Monster may attack again this turn.

name: Tactical Espionage Expert
cn_text: 這張卡召喚成功時，陷阱卡不能發動。
description: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

name: Abare Ushioni
cn_text:
猜硬幣正反。
●猜中的場合：給與對方基本分1000分的傷害。
●猜錯的場合：自己基本分受到1000分的傷害。這個效果1回合只能1次，在自己回合的主要階段使用。
description: Once per turn, you can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If you call it wrong, you take 1000 damage.

name: Familiar Knight
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。雙方玩家可以從手卡把1只4星怪獸特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from their hand.

name: Abyssal Designator
cn_text: 支付1000基本分。種族和屬性各宣言一樣。對方從手卡·卡組選取宣言的種族和屬性2樣1致的1張怪獸卡送去墓地。
description: Pay 1000 Life Points. Declare a Type and an Attribute. Your opponent must send 1 monster with both the declared Type and Attribute from their hand or Deck to the Graveyard.

name: B. Dragon Jungle King
cn_text: 棲息在密林深處的漆黑龍王。咯吱咯吱的只知道啃食樹木。
description: A jet-black dragon found in the deepest jungles who normally devours trees.

name: Anthrosaurus
cn_text: 人形的恐龍。雖然智慧很高，但攻擊力卻不怎么強勁。
description: Dis man-like dinosawz gotta high I.Q., even tho he's lackin' in da strength depawtment. (Kinda like yooz, if ya had a high I.Q.! Nyaah!)

name: Pharaonic Protector
cn_text: 守護王家几千年的兵士的木乃伊。其靈魂現在也決不饒恕任何入侵者。
description: The mummy of a soldier that has been guarding the royal family for thousands of years. Even now, its spirit does not allow anybody to trespass.

name: Hero of the East
cn_text: 傳說來自遙遠的東方國度的武士。手持的刀相當的鋒利。
description: Feel da strength ah dis sword-swinging samurai from da Far East.

name: Jigen Bakudan
cn_text: 反轉：自己的准備階段把這張卡作為祭品。全部自己的怪獸破壞，給與對方那個總攻擊力一半數值的傷害。
description: FLIP: After this card is flipped, Tribute it during your Standby Phase to destroy all monsters on your side of the field and inflict damage equal to half of the total ATK of the destroyed cards (excluding this monster) to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Ojama King
cn_text:
「擾亂·綠」＋「擾亂·黃」＋「擾亂·黑」
只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，選擇對方最多3個怪獸區域不能使用。
description: "Ojama Green" + "Ojama Yellow" + "Ojama Black"Select up to 3 of your opponent's Monster Card Zones. The selected zones cannot be used.

name: Lady Assailant of Flames
cn_text: 反轉：自己的卡組最上面的3張卡在游戲中除外。對方受到800分的傷害。
description: FLIP: Remove 3 cards from the top of your Deck from play to inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Elegant Egotist
cn_text: ①：場上有「鷹身女郎」存在的場合才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「鷹身女郎」或「鷹身女郎三姐妹」特殊召喚。
description: If "Harpie Lady" is on the field: Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your hand or Deck.

name: Graceful Tear
cn_text: ①：選自己1張手卡加入對方手卡。那之后，自己回復2000基本分。
description: Add 1 card from your hand to your opponent's hand, then gain 2000 LP.

name: Last Day of Witch
cn_text: 場上表側表示的魔法師族的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all face-up Spellcaster-Type monsters on the field.

name: Torpedo Fish
cn_text: 當場上存在「海」時，這張卡不受魔法效果的影響。
description: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

name: Silver Fang
cn_text: 銀光閃閃的狼。外表雖然美，性格卻凶暴。
description: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye, but absolutely vicious in battle.

name: Armed Changer
cn_text: 從自己手卡把1張裝備魔法卡送去墓地發動。裝備怪獸戰斗破壞怪獸的場合，裝備卡的控制者可以從自己墓地選擇裝備怪獸的攻擊力以下的1只怪獸加入手卡。
description: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

name: The Kick Man
cn_text: 這張卡特殊召喚成功時，可以將1張存在於自己墓地里的裝備魔法卡裝備在這張卡身上。
description: When this card is Special Summoned, you can equip 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to this card.

name: Veil of Darkness
cn_text: 自己的抽卡階段抽到的卡是暗屬性怪獸的場合，可以把那張卡給對方觀看，那張卡送去墓地。那之后，可以從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: During your Draw Phase, if you draw a DARK monster(s): You can reveal any number of them; send them to the Graveyard, then you can draw 1 more card.

name: Cyber Shadow Gardna
cn_text: 對方的主要階段時才能發動。這張卡發動后變成怪獸卡（機械族·地·4星·攻/守?）在自己的怪獸卡區域特殊召喚。這張卡為攻擊對象的對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時，這張卡的攻擊力·守備力變成和對方攻擊怪獸相同數值。這張卡在對方的結束階段時在魔法與陷阱卡區域蓋放。這張卡也當作陷阱卡使用。
description: During your opponent's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK ?/DEF ?). (This card is also still a Trap.) When an opponent's monster declares an attack that targets this card: The ATK/DEF of this card become the ATK/DEF of the attacking monster. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Set this card in its Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Obsidian Dragon
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，自己場上表側表示存在的1只暗屬性怪獸為對象的魔法·陷阱卡的效果無效并破壞。
description: Negate the effects of Spell and Trap Cards that target only 1 face-up DARK monster you control, and destroy them.

name: Level Down!?
cn_text: 選擇場上表側表示存在的1只持有「LV」的怪獸發動。選擇的卡回到原本的持有者卡組，從持有者墓地把1只比那張卡的「LV」低的同名怪獸無視召喚條件在持有者場上特殊召喚。
description: Select 1 face-up "LV" on the field to activate this card. Return the selected card to its owner's Deck and Special Summon 1 monster from the owner's Graveyard to their side of the field with the same name but lower "LV" (ignoring the Summoning conditions).

name: Ground Collapse
cn_text:
指定沒有使用的主要怪獸區域2處才能把這張卡發動。
①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，指定的區域不能使用。
description: Select 2 Monster Card Zones on the field. Neither player can use the selected zones. You cannot select a zone that is occupied by a Monster Card.

name: Black Ptera
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞以外的方法從場上送去墓地時，這張卡回到持有者手卡。
description: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, except by being destroyed by battle: Return it to the hand.

name: Meteor B. Dragon
cn_text: 「真紅眼黑龍」＋「流星之龍」
description: "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" + "Meteor Dragon"

name: Taunt
cn_text: 對方回合的主要階段一，選擇自己場上的1只怪獸才能發動。只要選擇怪獸在場上存在，對方這個回合攻擊的場合，必須以選擇的怪獸為攻擊對象。
description: Activate only during your opponent's Main Phase 1; select 1 monster on your side of the field. While the selected card remains on the field, if your opponent attacks with a monster(s) this turn, they must select the selected monster as the attack target.

name: Major Riot
cn_text: 自己的怪獸被對方控制的卡的效果從場地回到手卡時才能發動。場上的全部怪獸回到持有者手卡。那之后，雙方從手卡把回去數量的怪獸里側守備表示特殊召喚。
description: You can activate this card when 1 or more of your monsters are returned from the field to your hand by your opponent's card effect. Return all Monster Cards on the field to your respective hands. Both you and your opponent then Special Summon from your hand the same number of Monster Cards on the field in face-down Defense Position.

name: Armed Ninja
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以場上1張表側表示的魔法卡或者場上蓋放的1張魔法·陷阱卡為對象發動。那張魔法卡破壞（那張卡在場上蓋放中的場合，翻開確認）。
description: FLIP: Target 1 Spell Card on the field; destroy that target. (If the target is Set, reveal it, and destroy it if it is a Spell Card. Otherwise, return it to its original position.)

name: Little-Winguard
cn_text: 這張卡在自己的結束階段時可以變更表示形式1次。
description: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can change the battle position of this card.

name: Raging Flame Sprite
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。這張卡直接攻擊給與對方基本分戰斗傷害時，這張卡的攻擊力上升1000。
description: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: This card gains 1000 ATK.

name: Garma Sword
cn_text: 「伽瑪劍的誓言」降臨。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Garma Sword Oath".

name: Rivalry of Warlords
cn_text: ①：只要這張卡在魔法與陷阱區域存在，雙方場上各自只能有1種類的種族的怪獸表側表示存在。雙方玩家在自身場上的表側表示怪獸的種族是2種類以上的場合直到變成1種類為止必須送去墓地。
description: Each player can only control 1 Type of monster. Send all other face-up monsters they control to the Graveyard.

name: Warrior Elimination
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的戰士族怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all face-up Warrior-Type monsters on the field.

name: Jack's Knight
cn_text: 精通一切劍朮的戰士。正義感非常強烈，為守護弱者而戰。
description: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

name: Steel Ogre Grotto #2
cn_text: 由鋼鐵制成的機械人偶。以驚人的怪力著稱。
description: A mechanized iron doll with tremendous strength.

name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地2只通常怪獸為對象才能發動。那些怪獸加入手卡。
description: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Nemuriko
cn_text: 孩子被夢魔所操控永遠沉睡?不再醒來。
description: A child-like creature that controls a sleep fiend to beckon enemies into eternal slumber.

name: Dark Jeroid
cn_text: 這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功時，選擇場上1只表側表示怪獸。只要那只怪獸在場上表側表示存在，攻擊力下降800。
description: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

name: The Agent of Force - Mars
cn_name: 力之代行者 瑪爾斯
cn_text:
①：場上的這張卡不受魔法卡的效果影響。
②：自己場上有「天空的聖域」存在，自己基本分比對方多的場合，這張卡的攻擊力·守備力上升那個相差數值。
description: This card is unaffected by any Spell Cards. While you control a face-up "The Sanctuary in the Sky" and your Life Points are higher than your opponent's, this card gains ATK and DEF by the difference between your and your opponent's Life Points.

name: Celtic Guardian
cn_text: 學會了劍朮的精靈。以快速的攻擊作弄敵人。
description: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

name: Temple of the Sun
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，自己場上表側表示存在的從墓地特殊召喚的怪獸的攻擊力上升300。
description: Face-up monsters you control that were Special Summoned from the Graveyard gain 300 ATK.

name: Insect Queen
cn_text:
①：這張卡的攻擊力上升場上的昆蟲族怪獸數量×200。
②：這張卡的攻擊宣言之際，自己必須把自己場上1只其他怪獸解放。
③：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的回合的結束階段發動。在自己場上把1只「昆蟲怪獸衍生物」（昆蟲族·地·1星·攻/守100）攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: Cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster. This card gains 200 ATK for each Insect-Type monster on the field. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle this turn: Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

name: Prickle Fairy
cn_text: 對方不破壞這張卡，就不能對昆蟲族怪獸進行攻擊。與這張卡進行戰斗的怪獸，在傷害步驟終了時變成守備表示。
description: While this card is face-up on your side of the field, your opponent cannot attack Insect-Type monsters. The battle position of a monster that battles with this card is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Apprentice Magician
cn_text:
①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚成功的場合，以場上1張可以放置魔力指示物的卡為對象發動。給那張卡放置1個魔力指示物。
②：這張卡被戰斗破壞時才能發動。從卡組把1只2星以下的魔法師族怪獸里側守備表示特殊召喚。
description: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

name: Book of Secret Arts
cn_text: 魔法師族怪獸才能裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: A Spellcaster-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Roll Out!
cn_text: 選擇自己墓地存在的1只同盟怪獸，給自己場上表側表示存在的可以裝備的怪獸裝備。
