description: Target 1 Union monster in your Graveyard; equip that target to a monster you control that would be an appropriate target for that Union monster's effect.

name: Dark Gray
cn_text: 全身灰色的野獸，是非常少見的珍貴品種。
description: Entirely gray, this beast has rarely been seen by mortal eyes.

name: Cyber Esper
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側攻擊表示存在，可以確認對方抽到的卡。
description: While this card is in face-up Attack Position, you can look at every card your opponent draws.

name: Thunder of Ruler
cn_text: 在對方的准備階段發動。對方本回合不能進行戰斗階段。
description: During your opponent's Standby Phase: You can activate this card; there is no Battle Phase this turn.

name: Crab Turtle
cn_text: 「龜的誓言」降臨。必須從場地和手卡把等級直到8以上的卡作為祭品。
description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Turtle Oath". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 8 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: Magical Blast
cn_text:
①：給與對方為自己場上的魔法師族怪獸數量×200傷害。
②：這張卡在墓地存在的場合，自己抽卡階段的抽卡前才能發動。作為這個回合進行通常抽卡的代替，這張卡加入手卡。
description: If you control a Spellcaster-Type monster: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Spellcaster-Type monster you currently control. During your Draw Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add this card from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Harpie Lady 1
cn_text: 這張卡的卡名當作「鷹身女郎」使用。只要這張卡在場上存在，場上的風屬性怪獸攻擊力上升300。
description: (This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)All WIND monsters gain 300 ATK.

name: Rogue Doll
cn_text: 操縱神聖力量的人偶。在黑暗之中攻擊力很強。
description: A deadly doll gifted with mystical power, it is particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

name: Dragon Statue
cn_text: 擁有龍的靈魂的石像戰士。用自豪的劍劈開敵人。
description: A stone warrior with the heart of a dragon.

name: Attack Reflector Unit
cn_text: 把自己場上1只「電子龍」作為祭品才能發動。從自己的手卡·卡組特殊召喚1只「電子障壁龍」。
description: Tribute 1 "Cyber Dragon". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Barrier Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

name: Whiptail Crow
cn_text: 使用鞭子一般長的尾巴，從空中發動攻擊。
description: Attacks from the skies with a whip-like tail.

name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon
cn_text:
「X-首領加農」＋「Y-龍頭」＋「Z-金屬履帶」
把自己場上的上記的卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚。這張卡不能從墓地特殊召喚。
①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1張卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的卡破壞。
description: "X-Head Cannon" + "Y-Dragon Head" + "Z-Metal Tank"Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Unshaven Angler
cn_text: 作為水屬性怪獸祭品召喚的場合，這只怪獸1只可以作為2只份的祭品使用。
description: When Tribute Summoning a WATER monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Dark Sage
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。猜中自己的「時間魔朮師」的擲硬幣效果時，可以把自己場上存在的1只「黑魔朮師」解放從手卡或者卡組中特殊召喚。這個方法特殊召喚成功時，從自己卡組把1張魔法卡加入手卡。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand or Deck) by Tributing 1 "Dark Magician" immediately after applying the effect of "Time Wizard" in which you called the coin toss right. When Special Summoned this way: Add 1 Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Wilmee
cn_text: 相當凶暴的兔子。以銳利的?爪血祭對方。
description: A rabid rabbit that shears through opposition with its sharp skewers.

name: Spirit's Invitation
cn_text: 這張卡的控制者在每次自己的准備階段支付500基本分。或者不支付500基本分讓這張卡破壞。場上表側表示存在的靈魂怪獸回到自己手卡時，由對方選擇對方場上存在的1只怪獸，回到持有者的手卡。
description: Each time your Spirit monster returns to your hand, select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and return it to its owner's hand. Pay 500 Life Points during each of your Standby Phases. If you do not, this card is destroyed.

name: The Dragon's Bead
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。以1只表側表示的龍族怪獸作對象的陷阱卡的效果無效并破壞。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Negate the effect of a Trap Card that targets 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster and destroy the Trap Card.

name: White Dolphin
cn_text: 頭上有角的白色海豚。引起大浪攻擊對方。
description: A white dolphin with a horn that summons huge tidal waves.

name: Robolady
cn_text: 全身覆蓋?金屬裝甲的女戰士。與「稀有金屬戰士」融合將提升力量。
description: A warrior fully covered with metal. It upgrades by fusing with "Roboyarou".

name: Blazing Hiita
cn_text: 可以把自己場上除這張卡以外的1只炎屬性怪獸做祭品，從手卡特殊召喚1只炎屬性怪獸。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸，在「盛燃之希塔」從自己場上離開的場合破壞。
description: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 FIRE monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 FIRE monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Blazing Hiita" is removed from your side of the field.

name: Horus' Servant
cn_text: 只要這張卡在自己場上表側表示存在，對方的魔法·陷阱·怪獸的效果不能以「荷魯斯之黑炎龍（包括全部等級）」的怪獸為對象。
description: Your opponent cannot target face-up "Horus the Black Flame Dragon" monsters with Spells, Traps, or card effects.

name: Clown Zombie
cn_text: 使用黑暗力量重生的小丑，利用搖晃的舞蹈將對方引向死亡。
description: A clown revived by the powers of darkness. Its deadly dance has sent many monsters to their graves.

name: The Dark Creator
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。自己墓地暗屬性怪獸有5只以上存在，自己場上沒有怪獸存在的場合可以特殊召喚。可以把自己墓地1只暗屬性怪獸從游戲中除外，自己墓地1只暗屬性怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 5 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard while you control no monsters. Once per turn: You can banish 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard to target 1 DARK monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: M-Warrior #2
cn_text: 擅長配合的戰士，表面塗有電磁的鎧甲非常堅固。
description: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior is equipped with a tough, magnetically coated armor.

name: Element Saurus
cn_text:
這只怪獸在場上有特定屬性的怪獸存在的場合，得到以下的效果。
●炎屬性：這張卡攻擊力上升500。
●地屬性：這張卡戰斗破壞的怪獸的效果無效化。
description: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: ? FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK. ? EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle.

name: Mezuki
cn_text: ①：把墓地的這張卡除外，以自己墓地1只不死族怪獸為對象才能發動。那只不死族怪獸特殊召喚。
description: You can banish this card from your Graveyard, then target 1 Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

name: Staunch Defender
cn_text: 對方進行攻擊宣言時這張卡才能發動。選擇自己場上1張表側表示的怪獸。這張卡發動回合，對方只能以所選擇的這只怪獸為攻擊對象，且必須用所有表側攻擊表示的怪獸攻擊所選擇的這只怪獸。
description: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field. During this turn, your opponent can only designate the selected monster as an attack target and your opponent must attack the selected monster with all face-up monsters.

name: Metal Dragon
cn_text: 「鋼鐵巨神像」＋「下級龍」
description: "Steel Ogre Grotto #1" + "Lesser Dragon"

name: Wings of Wicked Flame
cn_text: 原形是紅黑色燃燒?的翅膀。從全身噴出火焰進行攻擊。
description: Crimson wings of fire make this a very lethal creature.

name: Maha Vailo
cn_text: ①：這張卡的攻擊力上升這張卡裝備的裝備卡數量×500。
description: This card gains 500 ATK for each Equip Card equipped to this card.

name: Howling Insect
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以從卡組選擇1只攻擊力1500以下的昆蟲族怪獸特殊召喚到自己場上。之后卡組洗切。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

name: Liquid Beast
cn_text: 粘粘糊糊的融化，能在水里自由移動的液態生命體。
description: A liquid life form that thrives on water.

name: Monster Recovery
cn_text: 選擇原本持有者是自己的自己場上1只怪獸才能發動。選擇的怪獸和自己手卡全部加入卡組洗切。那之后，從卡組抽出原本的手卡數量的卡。原本持有者是對方的卡在自己手卡的場合，這張卡不能發動。
description: Target 1 monster you control that is owned by you; if that monster is still on the field, shuffle it and your entire hand into the Deck, also, after that, draw cards equal to the number of cards you shuffled from your hand into the Deck by this effect. (You cannot activate this card if you have a card in your hand that is owned by your opponent.)

name: Victory Viper XX03
cn_text:
①：這張卡戰斗破壞對方怪獸的場合，從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●這張卡的攻擊力上升400。
●以場上1張表側表示的魔法·陷阱卡為對象發動。那張表側表示卡破壞。
●把持有一直和這張卡相同種族·屬性·等級·攻擊力·守備力的1只「子機衍生物」在自己場上特殊召喚。這張卡變成不在怪獸區域表側表示存在時這衍生物破壞。
description: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Activate 1 of these effects.? This card gains 400 ATK.? Target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.? Special Summon 1 "Option Token". Its Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF are always the same as this card, but it leaves the field if this card is no longer face-up on the field.

name: Voltic Kong
cn_text: 這張卡給與對方基本分戰斗傷害時，把自己場上表側表示存在的光屬性怪獸數量的卡從對方卡組上面送去墓地。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Send 1 card from the top of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard for each face-up LIGHT monster you control.

name: Spell Striker
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以把自己墓地1張魔法卡除外，從手卡特殊召喚。
②：這張卡可以直接攻擊。
③：這張卡的戰斗發生的對自己的戰斗傷害變成0。
description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard. This card can attack directly. You take no battle damage from attacks involving this card.

name: Offering to the Snake Deity
cn_text: ①：以自己場上1只爬蟲類族怪獸和對方場上2張卡為對象才能發動。那1只自己的爬蟲類族怪獸和那2張對方的卡破壞。
description: Target 1 face-up Reptile-Type monster you control and 2 cards your opponent controls; destroy all three targets.

name: Cave Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡在自己場上至少有1只其他的怪獸存在不能召喚。自己場上沒有這張卡以外的龍族怪獸存在時，這張卡不能攻擊宣言。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned while you control a monster. This card cannot declare an attack unless you control another Dragon-Type monster.

name: Ancient Elf
cn_text: 活了數千年的妖精，能夠操縱精靈發動攻擊。
description: This elf is rumored to have lived for thousands of years. He leads an army of spirits against his enemies.

name: Phantasmal Martyrs
cn_text: ①：這張卡以外的自己手卡有2張以上存在，自己場上有「神炎皇 烏利亞」或者「降雷皇 哈蒙」存在的場合，把手卡全部送去墓地才能發動。在自己場上把3只「幻魔的殉教者衍生物」（惡魔族·暗·1星·攻/守0）攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: Activate only while you have 2 or more cards in your hand, and control a face-up "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" or "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder". Send your entire hand to the Graveyard to Special Summon 3 "Phantasmal Martyr Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Attack Position.

name: Spell Shattering Arrow
cn_text: ①：對方場上的表側表示的魔法卡全部破壞，給與對方破壞數量×500傷害。
description: Destroy as many face-up Spell Cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each.

name: Water Magician
cn_text: 用水裹住對方并包圍?施以攻擊。
description: This monster swamps an opponent with an almost endless supply of water.

name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
cn_text: 洞穴的巨大潛龍。平時很溫順，但生起氣來很可怕。據傳是在守護財寶。
description: A huge dragon dwelling in a cave. It is horrible when it gets angry, although it is usually quiet. It is said to preserve certain treasures.

name: Rope of Life
cn_text: 當自己的怪獸因戰斗送去墓地時，將手卡全部丟棄發動這張卡，那只怪獸的攻擊力上升800，并且特殊召喚上場。
description: When a monster(s) is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard: Discard your entire hand (min.1), then target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, it gains 800 ATK.

name: Man Eater
cn_text: 吃人的人面花，用有毒的觸手進行攻擊。
description: Man-eating plant with poison feelers for attacking enemies.

name: Dark Spirit of the Silent
cn_text: 對方的戰斗階段才可以發動。1只攻擊怪獸的攻擊無效化，改為對方的其他的表側表示的1只怪獸攻擊。（對象是守備表示的場合變攻擊表示）
description: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Negate that attack, and select another face-up monster your opponent controls. That monster attacks instead. (If it is in face-up Defense Position, change it to Attack Position.)

name: Morale Boost
cn_text: 每當1張裝備魔法卡裝備在怪獸身上時，這張裝備魔法的控制者回復1000基本分。每當1張裝備魔法卡離場時，這張裝備魔法的控制者受到1000點傷害。
description: Each time a player equips an Equip Spell Card, increase the Life Points of the controller of that Equip Spell Card by 1000 points. Each time an Equip Spell Card is removed from the field, the controller of that Equip Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

name: Whirlwind Weasel
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合發動。這個回合，對方不能把魔法·陷阱卡發動。
description: FLIP: Your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards for the rest of this turn.

name: Fuhma Shuriken
cn_text: 名稱中含有「忍者」字樣的怪獸才能裝備這張卡。裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力上升700點。這張卡從場上送去墓地時，給與對方基本分700分的傷害。
description: Equip only to a "Ninja" monster. It gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

name: Desert Sunlight
cn_text: 自己場上的所有怪獸全部變成表側守備表示。
description: All monsters on your side of the field are changed to face-up Defense Position.

name: The Wandering Doomed
cn_text: 因不能成佛，而只能漫無目的徘徊的怪獸。
description: A monster that wanders the edges of the netherworld.

name: Crass Clown
cn_text: 這張卡的表示形式從守備表示變成攻擊表示時，對方場上的1只怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: When this card is changed from Defense Position to Attack Position, return 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field to the owner's hand.

name: Hate Buster
cn_text: ①：自己的惡魔族怪獸被選擇作為攻擊對象時，以1只攻擊怪獸和那1只攻擊對象怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸和那只攻擊對象怪獸2只破壞，給與對方破壞的攻擊怪獸的原本攻擊力數值的傷害。
description: When a Fiend-Type monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target the opponent's attacking monster and that monster you control; destroy both targets, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the opponent's destroyed monster.

name: Mushroom Man #2
cn_text: 每次的自己准備階段受到300分的傷害。可以在自己的結束階段支付500分，把這張卡的控制權轉移給對方。
description: A player controlling this monster loses 300 Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases when this card is face-up on the field. Control of this card is shifted to your opponent by paying 500 Life Points at your own End Phase.

name: Gravi-Crush Dragon
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1張表側表示的永續魔法卡送去墓地，以對方場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方怪獸破壞。
description: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Penguin Soldier
cn_text: ①：這張卡反轉的場合，以場上最多2只怪獸為對象才能發動。那些怪獸回到持有者手卡。
description: FLIP: You can target up to 2 monsters on the field; return those targets to the hand.

name: Behegon
cn_text: 樣子很怪的海蛇。特徵是大口和大牙。
description: With an enormous maw and massive teeth, this monstrosity is one dangerous and strange serpent from the deep.

name: Violent Rain
cn_text: 突然降下傾盆大雨的怪獸。
description: This monster can call forth sudden torrents of battering rain.

name: Two-Headed King Rex
cn_text: 恐龍族中的強力卡。用2個頭同時攻擊。
description: A powerful monster whose two heads attack as one.

name: Infinite Cards
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，雙方沒有手卡數量限制。
description: There is no limit to the number of cards in players' hands.

name: Jinzo - Returner
cn_text:
①：這張卡可以直接攻擊。
②：這張卡被送去墓地時，以自己墓地1只「人造人-念力震懾者」為對象才能發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸在自己結束階段破壞。
description: This card can attack your opponent directly. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Jinzo" from your Graveyard. Destroy it during your End Phase.

name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
cn_text: ①：以場上1只怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸回到手卡。
description: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

name: Destiny Board
cn_text:
這張卡和「死之信息」卡4種類在自己場上齊集時，自己決斗勝利。
①：對方結束階段把這個效果發動。從手卡·卡組讓1張「死之信息」卡以「E」「A」「T」「H」的順序在自己的魔法與陷阱區域出現。
②：自己場上的「通靈槃」或者「死之信息」卡從場上離開時自己場上的「通靈槃」以及「死之信息」卡全部送去墓地。
description: When this card and all 4 "Spirit Message" cards with different names are placed on your field, you win the Duel. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Place 1 "Spirit Message" card from your hand or Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone face-up, in the proper order of "I", "N", "A", and "L". When any "Spirit Message" card or "Destiny Board" you control leaves the field, send all "Spirit Message" cards and "Destiny Board" you control to the Graveyard.

name: Needle Ball
cn_text: 反轉：可以支付2000分，對方受到1000分的傷害。
description: FLIP: You can pay 2000 Life Points to inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

name: Elemental Absorber
cn_text: 把手卡1張怪獸卡從游戲中除外。持有和這個效果除外的怪獸卡相同的屬性的對方怪獸，只要這張卡在場上存在不能攻擊宣言。
description: Remove from play 1 Monster Card in your hand to activate this card. Your opponent's monsters that have the same Attribute as the monster removed by this effect cannot declare an attack.

name: Tower of Babel
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，每次自己或者對方把魔法卡發動，給這張卡放置1個魔力指示物。這張卡放置第4個魔力指示物時這張卡破壞，那個時候把魔法卡發動的玩家受到3000分傷害。
description: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. If the 4th Spell Counter is placed on this card: Destroy this card, and if you do, the player who activated the Spell Card at that time takes 3000 damage.

name: LaLa Li-Oon
cn_text: 帶電的云形怪獸。下?能溶掉一切的危險之雨。
description: An electric cloud creature, its acid rain makes it very dangerous.

name: Hard-sellin' Zombie
cn_text: 每次自己場上的怪獸給與對方玩家戰斗傷害，選擇對方墓地存在的1張卡回到對方卡組最下面。
description: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, select 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard and return it to the bottom of their Deck.

name: Curse of the Masked Beast
cn_text:
「假面魔獸 鬼面修道士」的降臨必需。
①：從自己的手卡·場上把等級合計直到8以上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「假面魔獸 鬼面修道士」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "The Masked Beast". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Mechaleon
cn_text: 變換身體顏色可以隱藏在任何地方。
description: A large chameleon with the ability to alter its body coloring. Using this ability, it can conceal itself in any location.

name: Spring of Rebirth
cn_text: 場上的怪獸回到持有者手卡的場合，每1次自己回復500基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 500 points every time monsters return from the field to the owner's hand.

name: Kaiser Dragon
cn_text: 「守城的翼龍」＋「妖精龍」
description: "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1" + "Fairy Dragon"

name: Tyrant Dragon
cn_text: 只在對方場上有怪獸存在的場合才在戰斗階段中只再1次可以攻擊。此外，以這張卡為對象的陷阱卡無效并破壞。其他卡的效果把這張卡從墓地特殊召喚的場合，必須把自己場上1只龍族怪獸作為祭品。
description: During your Battle Phase, if your opponent controls a monster after this card's first attack, this card can make a second attack. Negate any Trap effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard, unless you Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster.

name: Pandemonium
cn_text: 名稱中含有「惡魔」字樣的怪獸在准備階段可以不必支付基本分。當名稱中含有「惡魔」字樣的怪獸由於戰斗以外的方式被破壞送去墓地時，可以從卡組中選擇1張等級比被破壞的怪獸等級低，且名稱中含有「惡魔」字樣的怪獸卡加入手卡。
description: Neither player has to pay Life Points during the Standby Phase for "Archfiend" monsters. Each time a player's "Archfiend" monster(s) is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except by battle, that player can add 1 "Archfiend" monster from their Deck to their hand with a lower Level than the destroyed card.

name: Larvas
cn_text: 行動速度飛快的鳥怪，用細長的手腕將敵人絞殺。
description: A fast-moving, bird-like creature that strangles opposing monsters with its long, thin arms.

name: Eradicating Aerosol
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的昆蟲族怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all face-up Insect-Type monsters on the field.

name: Remove Brainwashing
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，自己與對方場上存在的所有怪獸的控制權回歸原本持有者。
description: The control of all monsters on the field returns to the owners.

name: Spirit Message "A"
cn_text: 這張卡不用「通靈槃」的效果不能在場上出現。
description: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "Destiny Board".

name: Jirai Gumo
cn_text: 這張卡攻擊宣言時，猜硬幣的正反。猜中的話就繼續攻擊。猜不中的話自己的基本分減半再攻擊。
description: When this card declares an attack: Toss a coin and call it. If you call it wrong, lose half your Life Points.

name: Rod of the Mind's Eye
cn_text: 當裝備這張卡的怪獸對對方造成戰斗傷害時，戰斗傷害的數值變為1000點。
description: If a monster equipped with this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, the damage becomes 1000 points.

name: Firewall
cn_text: 對方直接攻擊宣言時，可以把自己墓地存在的1只炎族怪獸從游戲中除外，使那只怪獸的攻擊無效。每次自己的准備階段支付500基本分。若沒有支付，這張卡破壞。
description: When your opponent declares a direct attack, you can negate that monster's attack by removing from play 1 Pyro-Type monster in your Graveyard. Pay 500 Life Points during each of your Standby Phases. If you do not, destroy this card.

name: Banisher of the Radiance
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，被送去墓地的卡不去墓地從游戲中除外。
description: Any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

name: Rabid Horseman
cn_text: 「牛頭人」＋「人馬獸」
description: "Battle Ox" + "Mystic Horseman"

name: Magnet Circle LV2
cn_text: 從手卡特殊召喚1只2星以下的機械族怪獸。
description: Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Machine-Type monster from your hand.

name: Soul of Fire
cn_text: 對方玩家抽1張卡。從自己卡組選擇1只炎族怪獸從游戲中除外。給與對方基本分除外怪獸的攻擊力一半數值的傷害。這張卡發動的場合，這個回合自己不能攻擊宣言。
description: Your opponent draws 1 card. Select 1 Pyro-Type monster from your Deck and remove it from play. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK of the removed monster. If you activate this card, you cannot declare an attack this turn.

name: Eternal Rest
cn_text: 有裝備卡裝備的怪獸全部破壞。
description: Destroy all monsters equipped with Equip Cards.

name: Secrets of the Gallant
cn_text: 選擇自己場上表側表示存在的1只通常怪獸發動。這個回合選擇怪獸給與對方基本分戰斗傷害時，對方隨機丟棄2張手卡。
description: Select 1 Normal Monster you control. When the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent this turn, your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Aqua Chorus
cn_text: ①：場上有同名怪獸存在的場上的怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升500。
description: If there are monsters with the same name on the field, increase the ATK and DEF of all those monsters with the same name by 500 points.

name: Kwagar Hercules
cn_text: 「鍬甲阿爾法」＋「大力獨角仙」
description: "Kuwagata a" + "Hercules Beetle"

name: Grasschopper
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡可以向對方場上的全部怪獸各作1次攻擊。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:?This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

name: Ameba
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的這張卡的控制權轉移給對方時，對方受到2000分的傷害。這個效果只在這張卡在場上表側表示存在能使用1次。
description: When the control of this face-up card on the field shifts to your opponent, inflict 2000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. This effect can only be used once as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

name: Giant Germ
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地的場合發動。給與對方500傷害。那之后，可以從卡組把「巨型病毒」任意數量攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then you can Special Summon any number of "Giant Germs" from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

name: Dimension Distortion
cn_text: 當自己的墓地里沒有卡存在的場合這張卡才能發動。選擇自己1只被除外的怪獸特殊召喚到自己場上。
description: You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field.

name: Vengeful Bog Spirit
cn_text: 全場怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚的那個回合不能攻擊。
description: Monsters cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.

name: Ghoul with an Appetite
cn_text: 無論怎么吃也不會飽的怪獸。
description: A monster with a heavy appetite that has never been satisfied.

name: The Warrior Returning Alive
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只戰士族怪獸為對象才能發動。那只戰士族怪獸加入手卡。
description: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: De-Fusion
cn_text: ①：以場上1只融合怪獸為對象才能發動。那只融合怪獸回到持有者的額外卡組。那之后，若回到額外卡組的那只怪獸的融合召喚使用過的一組融合素材怪獸在自己墓地齊集，可以把那一組在自己場上特殊召喚。
description: Target 1 Fusion Monster on the field; return that target to the Extra Deck, then, if all the Fusion Materials that were used for its Fusion Summon are in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon all of them.

name: Sky Dragon
cn_text: 有?四枚羽翼的鳥的外形的龍，用如刀刃一般的羽毛進行攻擊。
description: A flying dragon with four wings housing some very dangerous blades.

name: Final Countdown
cn_text: ①：支付2000基本分才能發動。以發動的回合為第1回合來計算的第20回合的回合結束時自己決斗勝利。
description: Pay 2000 Life Points. After 20 turns have passed (counting the turn you activate this card as the 1st turn), you win the Duel.

name: Boulder Tortoise
cn_text: 全身由岩石做成的龜。特點是守備力非常高。
description: A stone turtle that is nearly indestructible.

name: Exhausting Spell
cn_text: 將自己與對方場上存在的所有魔力指示物全部除去。
description: Remove all Spell Counters on both sides of the field.

name: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
cn_text: ①：這張卡召喚·反轉召喚時才能發動。從卡組把1只儀式怪獸或1張儀式魔法卡加入手卡。
description: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Rod of Silence - Kay'est
cn_text: 裝備這張卡的怪獸守備力上升500分。以裝備怪獸為對象的這張卡以外的魔法卡的效果無效并破壞。
description: The equipped monster gains 500 DEF. Negate other Spell effects that target the equipped monster, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card.

name: Cannonball Spear Shellfish
cn_text: 當場上存在「海」時，這張卡不受魔法效果的影響。
description: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

name: Shooting Star Bow - Ceal
cn_text: 裝備這張卡的怪獸攻擊力下降1000點。裝備這張卡的怪獸可以對對方進行直接攻擊。
description: The equipped monster loses 1000 ATK, but it can attack your opponent directly.

name: Catapult Turtle
cn_text: 1回合1次，把自己場上1只怪獸解放才能發動。給與對方基本分解放的怪獸的攻擊力一半數值的傷害。
description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the Tributed monster's ATK on the field.

name: Griggle
cn_text: 場上表側表示存在的這張卡的控制權轉移給對方時，自己回復3000基本分。這個效果只在這張卡在場上表側表示存在能使用1次。
description: When the control of this face-up card on the field shifts to your opponent, increase your Life Points by 3000 points. This effect can only be used once as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

name: Kangaroo Champ
cn_text: 與這張卡進行戰斗的怪獸，戰斗傷害計算后變為守備表示。
description: A monster that battles with this card is changed to Defense Position after damage calculation.

name: Cat's Ear Tribe
cn_text: 對方回合時，與這張卡戰斗的怪獸的原本攻擊力在傷害步驟時變成200。
description: The original ATK of your opponent's monster(s) that battles with this card during his/her turn becomes 200 points during the Damage Step.

name: Chthonian Emperor Dragon
cn_text:
這張卡在墓地或者場上表側表示存在的場合，當作通常怪獸使用。場上表側表示存在的這張卡可以作當通常召喚使用的再度召喚，這張卡當作效果怪獸使用并得到以下效果。
●這張卡在同1次的戰斗階段中可以作2次攻擊。
description: This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:? This card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

name: Flower Wolf
cn_text: 「銀牙狼」＋「魔界之棘」
description: "Silver Fang" + "Darkworld Thorns"

name: Shining Angel
cn_text: 這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時，可以從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的光屬性怪獸表側攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Chaos Sorcerer
cn_text:
這張卡不能通常召喚。從自己墓地把光·暗屬性怪獸各1只除外的場合可以特殊召喚。
①：1回合1次，以場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動（這個效果發動的回合，這張卡不能攻擊）。那只表側表示怪獸除外。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that target. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

name: Hunter Dragon
cn_text: 以尖牙殺死獵物的龍。動作迅捷敏銳地發出攻擊，不過沒有守備能力。
description: This dragon has taken down countless prey with its sharp fangs. It strikes very quickly, because if it does not strike first it is vulnerable to a counter-attack.

name: Magical Arm Shield
cn_text: ①：對方場上有表側表示怪獸2只以上存在，自己場上有怪獸存在的場合，對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時以攻擊怪獸以外的對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只表側表示怪獸的控制權直到戰斗階段結束時得到，攻擊對象轉移為那只怪獸進行傷害計算。
description: When your opponent declares an attack while you control a monster: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, except the attacking monster; take control of that target until the end of the Battle Phase, and if you do, it is attacked instead, and you proceed to damage calculation.

name: Lucky Chance
cn_text: 進行1次投擲硬幣的效果怪獸的效果發動時對硬幣的里表作猜測。猜中的場合，從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: When an Effect Monster's effect that requires only 1 coin toss is activated, call Heads or Tails. If you call it right, draw 1 card.

name: Triggered Summon
cn_text: 對方場上有怪獸特殊召喚時才能發動。雙方可以從手卡把1只4星以下的怪獸在場上特殊召喚。
description: Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from their hand.

name: D.D.R. - Different Dimension Reincarnation
cn_text: ①：丟棄1張手卡，以除外的1只自己怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚，把這張卡裝備。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。
description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 of your banished monsters; Special Summon it in Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

name: Jar Turtle
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，每次「強欲之瓶」發動從自己卡組抽1張卡。
description: Each time "Jar of Greed" is activated, draw 1 card.

name: W-Wing Catapult
cn_text:
①：1回合1次，可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●以自己場上1只「V-噴氣虎」為對象，把這張卡當作裝備卡使用給那只怪獸裝備。裝備怪獸被戰斗·效果破壞的場合，作為代替把這張卡破壞。
●裝備的這張卡特殊召喚。
②：裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升400。
description: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a "V-Tiger Jet" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, the equipped monster gains 400 ATK and DEF. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Recycle
cn_text: 在自己准備階段支付300基本分，就可從存在於自己墓地的卡里選擇1張怪獸卡以外的卡放回卡組最下方。
description: During your Standby Phase, by paying 300 Life Points, select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck.

name: Guardian Kay'est
cn_text: 當自己場上存在「靜寂之杖-波紋」時才能召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。這張卡不受魔法效果影響。這張卡不能成為對方的攻擊對象。
description: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Rod of Silence - Kay'est". This card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

name: Enchanted Javelin
cn_text: 對方怪獸的攻擊宣言時才能發動。自己基本分回復那1只攻擊怪獸的攻擊力的數值。
description: Increase your Life Points by the ATK of 1 opponent's attacking monster.

name: Des Wombat
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，控制者受到的卡的效果的傷害為0。
description: Any damage to you from a card effect becomes 0.

name: Contract with the Dark Master
cn_text:
「暗之支配者-佐克」的降臨必需。
①：從自己的手卡·場上把等級合計直到8以上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「暗之支配者-佐克」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Dark Master - Zorc". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

name: Cybernetic Cyclopean
cn_text: 只要自己手卡數目是0張，這張卡的攻擊力上升1000。
description: While you have no cards in your hand, this card gains 1000 ATK.

name: Catnipped Kitty
cn_text: 自己場上有這張卡以外的獸族怪獸存在的場合，不能攻擊這張卡。把對方場上存在的1只怪獸守備力在回合結束前變為0。這個效果1回合只能使用1次。
description: This card cannot be attacked if there is another Beast-Type monster on your side of the field. Once per turn, you can make the DEF of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field 0 until the end of this turn.

name: Kaminari Attack
cn_text: 「耳天使」＋「大雷電球」
description: "Ocubeam" + "Mega Thunderball"

name: Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。把自己場上存在的1只「真紅眼黑龍」解放的場合才能特殊召喚。這張卡的攻擊力，自己墓地存在的龍族怪獸每有1只上升300。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Red-Eyes B. Dragon" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard.

name: Wetha
cn_text: 操縱雨的精靈。召喚台風吹飛各種東西。
description: A spirit that controls rain and is capable of summoning hurricanes to blow the enemy away.

name: Golem Dragon
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上表側表示存在，對方不能選擇表側表示存在的其他的龍族怪獸作為攻擊對象。
description: Your opponent cannot target face-up Dragon-Type monsters for attacks, except this one.

name: Spellbook Organization
cn_text: 翻開自己卡組最上面3張卡，將其按喜歡的順序放回。對方不能確認這些卡。
description: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, then return them to the top of the Deck in any order.

name: Swing of Memories
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只通常怪獸為對象才能發動。那只怪獸特殊召喚。這個效果特殊召喚的怪獸在這個回合的結束階段破壞。
description: Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard. It is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn.

name: Hinotama Soul
cn_text: 非常熾熱的火焰形成的塊，并用那身體沖撞敵人。
description: An intensely hot flame creature that rams anything standing in its way.

name: Flash Assailant
cn_text: 這張卡的攻擊力·守備力下降自己手卡數量×400的數值。
description: Decrease the ATK and DEF of this card by 400 points for each card in your hand.

name: Salvage
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地2只攻擊力1500以下的水屬性怪獸為對象才能發動。那些水屬性怪獸加入手卡。
description: Target 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Insect Imitation
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只怪獸解放才能發動。比解放的怪獸等級高1星的1只昆蟲族怪獸從卡組特殊召喚。
description: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Insect-Type monster from your Deck whose Level is 1 higher than the Tributed monster's.

name: Dharma Cannon
cn_text: 堆滿大炮的機械達磨。不會打偏。
description: A monstrous creature whose body is fitted with cannons that never miss their targets.

name: Giant Turtle Who Feeds on Flames
cn_text: 以深紅甲殼為特徵的烏龜。據說曾吞下了火焰。
description: A crimson-shelled tortoise that feeds on flames.

name: Giant Rat
cn_text: ①：這張卡被戰斗破壞送去墓地時才能發動。從卡組把1只攻擊力1500以下的地屬性怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。
description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in Attack Position.

name: Blade Skater
cn_text: 冰上的舞姬是華麗的戰士。以必殺技阿克塞爾切裂華麗地把敵人怪獸切裂。
description: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

name: Call of the Haunted
cn_text: ①：以自己墓地1只怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。那只怪獸攻擊表示特殊召喚。這張卡從場上離開時那只怪獸破壞。那只怪獸破壞時這張卡破壞。
description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: The Creator Incarnate
cn_text: 可以把這張卡作祭品，從手卡特殊召喚1只「創世神」。
description: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "The Creator" from your hand.

name: Smashing Ground
cn_text: ①：對方場上1只守備力最高的怪獸破壞。
description: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the highest DEF (your choice, if tied).

name: Owner's Seal
cn_text: ①：場上的全部怪獸的控制權回歸原本持有者。
description: Return control of all monsters on the field to their original owners.

name: Mad Lobster
cn_text: 作為被全世界的美食家怪獸們所喜愛的高級食材而聞名。可怕的味道據說很刺激。
description: A gourmet food renowned by the Dark World upper crust. It has sensational flavor.

name: Ectoplasmer
cn_text: 雙方玩家各自在自己的結束階段時只有1次，選自己場上表側表示存在的1只怪獸，把那只怪獸解放，給與對方基本分解放的那只怪獸的原本攻擊力一半數值的傷害。
description: Once per turn, during each player's End Phase: The turn player must Tribute 1 face-up monster, and if they do, inflict damage to their opponent equal to half the original ATK of the Tributed monster.

name: Unknown Warrior of Fiend
cn_text: 用敏捷的動作產生真空、切碎對方的戰士。
description: The speed of this warrior creates an intense vacuum that can slice through a monster's hide.

name: Chaos Greed
cn_text: 當自己的卡有4張以上從游戲中除外，且自己的墓地里沒有卡存在時這張卡才能發動。從自己的卡組抽2張卡。
description: You can only activate this card if 4 or more of your cards are currently removed from play and there are no cards in your Graveyard. Draw 2 cards.

name: Good Goblin Housekeeping
cn_text: 從卡組抽自己墓地存在的「哥布林的經營手腕」的數量＋1的卡，選擇1張手卡放回到卡組最下面。
description: Draw cards equal to the number of "Good Goblin Housekeeping" cards in your Graveyard +1, then select 1 card from your hand and return it to the bottom of your Deck.

name: Caius the Shadow Monarch
cn_text: ①：這張卡上級召喚成功的場合，以場上1張卡為對象發動。那張卡除外，除外的卡是暗屬性怪獸卡的場合，給與對方1000傷害。
description: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; banish that target, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent if it is a DARK monster.

name: La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp
cn_text: 凡是出自呼喚他的主人之口，任何要求都聽從的燈之精靈。
description: A genie of the lamp that is at the beck and call of its master.

name: Element Valkyrie
cn_text:
這只怪獸在場上有特定的屬性的怪獸存在的場合，得到以下的效果。
●炎屬性：這張卡攻擊力上升500。
●水屬性：這張卡的控制權不能變更。
description: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: ? FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK. ? WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.

name: Dark Master - Zorc
cn_text:
「與暗之支配者的契約」降臨。
①：1回合1次，自己主要階段才能發動。擲1次骰子，出現的數目的效果適用。
●1·2：對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
●3·4·5：選對方場上1只怪獸破壞。
●6：自己場上的怪獸全部破壞。
description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Contract with the Dark Master". Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, then destroy all monsters your opponent controls if you roll 1 or 2, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls if you roll 3, 4 or 5, or destroy all monsters you control if you roll 6.

name: Fairy Meteor Crush
cn_text: 裝備怪獸攻擊守備表示怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方基本分那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Blood Sucker
cn_text: 這張卡給與對方基本分戰斗傷害時，從對方卡組上面把1張卡送去墓地。
description: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, send the top card of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Forced Ceasefire
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。這個回合的結束階段前，不能發動陷阱卡。
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. No Trap Cards can be activated until the end of this turn.

name: Seal of the Ancients
cn_text: ①：支付1000基本分才能發動。對方場上蓋放的卡全部確認。
description: Pay 1000 Life Points. Pick up and see all face-down cards on your opponent's side of the field, then return them to their original positions. (The effects of the face-down cards are not activated.)

name: Djinn the Watcher of the Wind
cn_text: 操縱風并產生龍卷風與颶風吹飛周圍的東西。
description: This creature generates gale-force winds and tornadoes to blow its enemies away.

name: White Dragon Ritual
cn_text:
「白龍之聖騎士」的降臨必需。
①：等級合計直到4以上的自己的手卡·場上的怪獸解放，從手卡把「白龍之聖騎士」儀式召喚。
description: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of White Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more.

name: Inpachi
cn_text: 其原型是被砍倒的巨樹寄宿了邪惡靈魂的姿態。襲擊迷失在森林里的旅人。
description: A log that attacks lost travelers in the forest. Originally a big tree, it was cut down and possessed by a wicked spirit.

name: Droll Bird
cn_text: 嘴巴非常大、大聲的叫嚇跑膽小的對方。
description: This monster stuns its enemies with a massive beak and ear-piercing wails.

name: Enemy Controller
cn_text:
①：可以從以下效果選擇1個發動。
●以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只對方的表側表示怪獸的表示形式變更。
●把自己場上1只怪獸解放，以對方場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能發動。那只表側表示怪獸的控制權直到結束階段得到。
description: Activate 1 of these effects.? Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.? Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: Mystic Lamp
cn_text: 這張卡可以直接攻擊對方玩家。
description: This monster can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

name: Horn of Heaven
cn_text: 自己場上的1只怪獸作為祭品。怪獸的召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚無效并破壞。
description: When a monster(s) would be Summoned: Tribute 1 monster; negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s).

name: Spiked Snail
cn_text: 以黑暗力量進化了的蝸牛。有手有腳、動作迅速。
description: A very fast, bipedal snail with a pair of lethal arms.

name: Armed Dragon LV3
cn_text: ①：自己准備階段，把場上的這張卡送去墓地才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「武裝龍 LV5」特殊召喚。
description: During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV5" from your hand or Deck.

name: Skull Invitation
cn_text: 每次送卡去墓地，每1張卡、那些卡的主人基本分受到300的傷害。
description: Each time a card(s) is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 300 damage to its owner for each card sent.

name: Needle Burrower
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞怪獸并將其送去墓地時，對對方基本分造成數值等同於被破壞怪獸等級×500點的傷害。
description: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the destroyed monster x 500 points.

name: Gyaku-Gire Panda
cn_text: 對方場上每存在1只怪獸，這張卡的攻擊力上升500點。這張卡攻擊守備表示的怪獸時，若攻擊力超過那個守備力，給與對方那個數值的戰斗傷害。
description: Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field. When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Blast with Chain
cn_text:
①：以自己場上1只表側表示怪獸為對象才能把這張卡發動。這張卡當作攻擊力上升500的裝備卡使用給那只自己怪獸裝備。
②：當作裝備卡使用的這張卡被效果破壞的場合，以場上1張卡為對象發動。那張卡破壞。
description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Follow Wind
cn_text: 鳥獸族怪獸可以裝備。裝備怪獸的攻擊力·守備力上升300。
description: Increase the ATK and DEF of a Winged-Beast-Type monster equipped with this card by 300 points.

name: Ojamuscle
cn_text: 選擇場上1只表側表示存在的「擾亂王」。選擇的「擾亂王」以外的名字中帶有「擾亂」的怪獸全破壞。每破壞1只怪獸，選擇的1只「擾亂王」的攻擊力上升1000。
description: Select 1 face-up "Ojama King". Destroy all "Ojama" monsters on the field, except the selected "Ojama King". It gains 1000 ATK for each monster destroyed this way.

name: Gift of The Mystical Elf
cn_text: ①：自己回復場上的怪獸數量×300基本分。
description: Increase your Life Points by 300 points for each monster on the field.

name: Fusion Devourer
cn_text: 和這張卡進行戰斗的融合怪獸的攻擊力在傷害步驟內變成0。
description: When this card battles a Fusion Monster, the ATK of the Fusion Monster becomes 0 during the Damage Step only.

name: Invigoration
cn_text: 地屬性的怪獸才能裝備。裝備的怪獸攻擊力上升400，守備力下降200。
description: An EARTH monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

name: Suijin
cn_text: ①：只在這張卡在場上表側表示存在才有1次，這張卡被攻擊的傷害計算時，以1只攻擊怪獸為對象才能發動。那只攻擊怪獸的攻擊力變成0。
description: During damage calculation in your opponent's turn, if this card is being attacked: You can target the attacking monster; make that target's ATK 0 during damage calculation only (this is a Quick Effect). This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

name: Hand of Nephthys
cn_text: ①：把自己場上1只怪獸和這張卡解放才能發動。從手卡·卡組把1只「奈芙提斯之鳳凰神」特殊召喚。
description: You can Tribute this card and 1 other monster; Special Summon 1 "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" from your hand or Deck.

name: Boneheimer
cn_text: 在海中彷徨?，發現獵物后會將其水分吸干。
description: This monster wanders the seas, sucking dry any creatures it may encounter.

name: Magical Stone Excavation
cn_text: ①：丟棄2張手卡，以自己墓地1張魔法卡為對象才能發動。那張卡加入手卡。
description: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard; add it to your hand.

name: Sword of Deep-Seated
cn_text: 裝備的怪獸攻擊力·守備力上升500。這張卡送去墓地時，回到卡組最上面。
description: Increase the ATK and DEF of a monster equipped with this card by 500 points. When this card is sent to the Graveyard, place it on top of your Deck.

name: Dark Paladin
cn_name: 超魔導劍士-黑魔導劍士
cn_text:
「黑魔朮師」＋「破壞之劍士」
這張卡不用融合召喚不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡的攻擊力上升雙方的場上·墓地的龍族怪獸數量×500。
②：魔法卡發動時，丟棄1張手卡才能發動。這張卡在怪獸區域表側表示存在的場合，那個發動無效并破壞。
description: "Dark Magician" + "Buster Blader"Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Spell Card is activated: You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. This card gains 500 ATK for each Dragon-Type monster on the field or in either player's Graveyard.

name: Wing Egg Elf
cn_text: 被蛋殼包住的天使。用巨大翅膀守備攻擊。
description: This fairy in an eggshell uses massive wings to blow back almost any projectile attack.

name: Winged Kuriboh LV10
cn_text: 這張卡不能通常召喚。這張卡只能通過「進化之翼」的效果特殊召喚。可以把自己場上表側表示存在的這張卡作祭品，對方場上攻擊表示的怪獸全部破壞，給與對方基本分破壞怪獸的原本的攻擊力合計的數值的傷害。這個效果在對方戰斗階段中才能發動。
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Transcendent Wings" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During your opponent's Battle Phase: You can Tribute this face-up card; destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls and inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s).

name: Mystical Knight of Jackal
cn_text: 這張卡戰斗破壞對方場上1只怪獸并將送其進墓地時，可以把那張卡放回對方卡組最上面。
description: When this card destroys 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and sends it to your opponent's Graveyard as a result of battle, you can then return the card to the top of your opponent's Deck.

name: Gift of the Martyr
cn_text: 把自己場上1只怪獸送去墓地。選擇自己場上1只怪獸。選擇的那只怪獸的攻擊力，在發動回合的結束階段前上升送去墓地的那張卡的攻擊力的數值。
description: Send 1 monster on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Select 1 monster on your side of the field. The selected monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the sent monster until the end of this turn.

name: Mabarrel
cn_text: 大炮狀的惡魔。以飛快的速度發射眼球彈。
description: This cannon-like creature fires eyeballs so fast they can't be seen.

name: Frenzied Panda
cn_text: 經常手持一根粗大的竹子四處找茬，性格非常凶暴。
description: A savage beast that carries a big bamboo stick for beating down its enemies.

name: The Melting Red Shadow
cn_text: 融化身體藏在腳下的影子里，從敵人的正下方發動攻擊。
description: This monster melts away to materialize under its enemies, taking them by surprise.

name: Destruction Jammer
cn_text: 丟棄1張手卡。持有（把場上的怪獸破壞的效果）的卡的發動無效并破壞。
description: Discard 1 card. Negate the activation of a Spell Card, Trap Card, or Effect Monster's effect that destroys a monster(s) on the field, and destroy that card.

name: Happy Lover
cn_text: 從頭上放出心形的光給予戀人以幸福的小天使。
description: Enemies become overjoyed when struck by the Heart Ray emitted from the forehead of this tiny cherub.

name: Drillago
cn_text: 對方場上只有表側表示的攻擊力1600以上的怪獸存在的場合，這張卡可以對對方玩家進行直接攻擊。
description: If the only cards your opponent controls are face-up monsters with 1600 or more ATK, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: D.3.S. Frog
cn_text:
「死亡青蛙」＋「死亡青蛙」＋「死亡青蛙」
這只怪獸融合召喚只能使用上述的卡進行。這張卡的攻擊力上升自己墓地存在的「黃泉青蛙」的數量×500的數值。
description: "Des Frog" + "Des Frog" + "Des Frog"A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. This card gains 500 ATK for each "Treeborn Frog" in your Graveyard.

name: Kozaky
cn_text: 奉獻一切研究魔界語言的凶猛惡魔。由於工作過度而精神崩潰。
description: A workaholic fiend who devotes everything to his research into the languages of Dark World. His mind has collapsed because of working too hard.

name: Spiritual Energy Settle Machine
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，靈魂怪獸持續留在場上。自己的結束階段時丟棄1張手卡，若不丟棄，這張卡破壞。并且，這張卡從場上離開時，在場上存在的表側表示的靈魂怪獸全部回到持有者的手卡。
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, all Spirit monsters remain face-up on the field and do not return to their owners' hand during the End Phase even if they are Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. Discard 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard during each of your End Phases. If you do not, destroy this card. When this card is removed from the field, all face-up Spirit monsters return to the owners' hands.

name: Dark Rabbit
cn_text: 美國卡通世界里面的兔子羅杰。經常敏捷而匆忙的行動。
description: He leaps up, down, and all around! Nobody can lay a hand on this funny bunny.

name: Five-Headed Dragon
cn_text:
龍族怪獸×5
這張卡不用融合召喚不能特殊召喚。
①：這張卡不會被和暗·地·水·炎·風屬性怪獸的戰斗破壞。
description: 5 Dragon-Type monstersMust be Fusion Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Cannot be destroyed by battle with a DARK, EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND monster.

name: The Secret of the Bandit
cn_text: 只能在主要階段一發動。選擇場上的1只表側表示存在的怪獸。在這個回合，選擇的怪獸每次給與對方玩家戰斗傷害，對方隨機丟棄1張手卡。
description: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Each time the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points this turn, your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Elemental Mistress Doriado
cn_text: 「樹精的祈禱」降臨。這張卡的屬性也同時當作「風」「水」「炎」「地」使用。
description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Doriado's Blessing". The Attribute of this card is also treated as WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH while it is face-up on the field.

name: Beastking of the Swamps
cn_text: 這張卡可以代替融合怪獸素材的其中1只來融合。這個時候，其他的融合素材必須是指定的融合素材。
description: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster. When you do this, the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be the correct one(s).

name: Reign-Beaux, Overlord of Dark World
cn_name: 暗黑界的魔神 雷恩
cn_text:
①：這張卡被對方的效果從手卡丟棄去墓地的場合發動。這張卡特殊召喚。
②：這張卡的①的效果特殊召喚成功的場合發動。從以下效果選1個適用。
●對方場上的怪獸全部破壞。
●對方場上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破壞。
description: If this card is discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls OR all Spell/Trap Cards they control.

name: Lord of the Lamp
cn_text: 從神燈里出現的魔靈，服從召喚者的意志。
description: This spirit emerges from the mystic lamp and obeys the wishes of its summoner.

name: The Spell Absorbing Life
cn_text: 將場上所有里側守備表示的怪獸全部變成表側表示。此時反轉效果不發動。之后場上每存在1只效果怪獸，自己回復400基本分。
description: Flip all face-down Defense Position Monster Cards on the field face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Increase your Life Points by 400 points for each Effect Monster Card on the field.

name: Restructer Revolution
cn_text: 對方受到（對方的手卡數×200）的傷害。
description: Inflict 200 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each card in your opponent's hand.

name: Labyrinth Tank
cn_text: 「高科技狼」＋「加農炮兵」
description: "Giga-Tech Wolf" + "Cannon Soldier"

name: Malevolent Nuzzler
cn_text:
①：裝備怪獸的攻擊力上升700。
②：這張卡從場上送去墓地時，支付500基本分才能發動。這張卡回到卡組最上面。
description: The equipped monster gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can pay 500 LP; place this card on the top of the Deck.

name: Dokurorider
cn_text: 使用「骷髏騎手的復活」特殊召喚。
description: This monster can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Revival of Dokurorider". You must also offer monsters whose total Level Stars equal 6 or more as a Tribute from the field or your hand.

name: XZ-Tank Cannon
cn_text:
「X-首領加農」＋「Z-金屬履帶」
把自己場上的上記卡除外的場合才能從額外卡組特殊召喚。這張卡不能作從墓地的特殊召喚。
①：丟棄1張手卡，以對方場上1張里側表示的魔法·陷阱卡為對象才能發動。那張對方的里側表示的卡破壞。
description: "X-Head Cannon" + "Z-Metal Tank"Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
cn_text: 只要這張卡在場上存在，場上·墓地發動的暗屬性怪獸的效果無效化。
description: Negate all DARK monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

name: Legendary Fiend
cn_text: ①：自己准備階段發動。這張卡的攻擊力上升700。
description: During each of your Standby Phases: This card gains 700 ATK.

name: Alpha The Magnet Warrior
cn_text: 用α、β、γ來變形合體。
description: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma meld as one to form a powerful monster.

name: Dark Magic Curtain
cn_text:
這張卡發動的回合，自己不能用這張卡的效果以外把怪獸召喚·反轉召喚·特殊召喚。
①：把基本分支付一半才能發動。從卡組把1只「黑魔朮師」特殊召喚。
description: Pay half your LP; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your Deck. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

name: Wind Effigy
cn_text: 風屬性的通常怪獸祭品召喚的場合，這1只怪獸可以作為2只的數量的祭品。
description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Normal Monster.
